778	export async function updateDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any) {
779	  const table = docRef.path;
780	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
781	  const id = docRef.id;
782	
783	  const all = await ensureCache(table);
784	  const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
785	  const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
786	
787	  const resolvedPayload: any = {};
788	  for (const k of Object.keys(rawData)) {
789	    const val = rawData[k];
790	    if (val instanceof IncrementValue) {
791	      const currentVal = parseFloat(existingData[k]) || 0;
792	      resolvedPayload[k] = currentVal + val.amount;
793	    } else if (val instanceof ArrayUnionValue) {
794	      const currentArr = Array.isArray(existingData[k]) ? existingData[k] : [];
795	      resolvedPayload[k] = [...currentArr, ...val.elements.filter((e: any) => !currentArr.includes(e))];
796	    } else {
797	      resolvedPayload[k] = cleanData(val);
798	    }
799	  }
800	
801	  // دمج البيانات السابقة مع التحديث لتجنب مسح أي حقول من كائن data في PostgreSQL عند التحديث الجزئي
802	  // Merge existing document fields with update payload to prevent wiping JSONB data column on partial update
803	  const rawClean = { ...existingData, ...resolvedPayload };
804	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
805	
806	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
807	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
808	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? directCols : { ...directCols, data };
809	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).update(writePayload).eq(pkCol, id);
810	    if (error) {
811	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
812	      if (isRlsError) {
813	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
814	      } else {
815	        throw createWriteError('update', table, error);
816	      }
817	    }
818	  } else {
819	    // Offline mode: buffering updateDoc local write
820	  }
821	
822	
823	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
824	  const idx = collectionCaches[table].findIndex(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id);
825	  if (idx >= 0) {
826	    collectionCaches[table][idx] = newItem;
827	  }
828	
829	  // إعلام استماع الطلبات عند تحديث منتج أو شحنة
830	  // Notify orders listeners when a product or shipment is updated
831	  if ((table === 'products' || table === 'order_items' || table === 'shipments') && collectionListeners['orders']) {
832	    collectionListeners['orders'].forEach(cb => cb());
833	  }
834	
835	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
836	  try {
837	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
838	  } catch (_) { }
839	
840	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
841	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
842	  }
843	}

845	export async function deleteDoc(docRef: DocRef) {
846	  const table = docRef.path;
847	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
848	  const id = docRef.id;
849	
850	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
851	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).delete().eq(pkCol, id);
852	    if (error) {
853	      throw createWriteError('delete', table, error);
854	    }
855	  } else {
856	    // Offline mode: buffering deleteDoc local write
857	  }
858	
859	  if (collectionCaches[table]) {
860	    collectionCaches[table] = collectionCaches[table].filter(item => item.id !== id && item[pkCol] !== id);
861	  }
862	
863	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
864	  try {
865	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
866	  } catch (_) { }
867	
868	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
869	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
870	  }
871	}

873	/**
874	 * إعادة استعلام المجموعات من خادم Supabase وإعادة بناء الذاكرة المؤقتة وإشعار المستمعين
875	 * Force refetch a collection table from Supabase, update cache, and trigger active listeners
876	 */
877	export async function refetchCollection(table: string): Promise<any[]> {
878	  delete lastFetchTimestamps[table];
879	  delete collectionCaches[table];
880	  delete activeFetches[table];
881	  const items = await ensureCache(table);
882	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
883	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
884	  }
885	  return items;

888	/**
889	 * تحديث الذاكرة المؤقتة فورياً بعد حذف طلبات عبر إجراء RPC وإشعار كافة الواجهات بالاختفاء الفوري
890	 * Instantly update local in-memory cache after order deletion RPC and trigger reactive UI listeners
891	 */
892	export function notifyOrderDeletionInCache(orderIds: string[]) {
893	  if (!orderIds || !orderIds.length) return;
894	  const idsSet = new Set(orderIds.map(id => String(id || '').trim()).filter(Boolean));
895	
896	  // 1. إزالة الطلبات المحذوفة من كاش الطلبات وتحديث التخزين المحلي
897	  // Remove deleted orders from orders cache and update localStorage backup
898	  if (collectionCaches['orders']) {
899	    collectionCaches['orders'] = collectionCaches['orders'].filter(order =>
900	      !idsSet.has(String(order.id || '').trim()) &&
901	      !idsSet.has(String(order.order_number || order.orderNumber || '').trim())
902	    );
903	    try {
904	      safeLocalStorage.setItem('swiftship_table_backup_orders', JSON.stringify(collectionCaches['orders']));
905	    } catch (_) { }
906	  }
907	
908	  // 2. إزالة الشحنات المرتبطة من كاش الشحنات
909	  // Remove linked shipments from shipments cache
910	  if (collectionCaches['shipments']) {
911	    collectionCaches['shipments'] = collectionCaches['shipments'].filter(s =>
912	      !idsSet.has(String(s.order_id || s.orderId || '').trim())
913	    );
914	    try {
915	      safeLocalStorage.setItem('swiftship_table_backup_shipments', JSON.stringify(collectionCaches['shipments']));
916	    } catch (_) { }
917	  }
918	
919	  // 3. إزالة بنود الطلب من كاش order_items
920	  // Remove linked order items from order_items cache
921	  if (collectionCaches['order_items']) {
922	    collectionCaches['order_items'] = collectionCaches['order_items'].filter(item =>
923	      !idsSet.has(String(item.order_id || item.orderId || '').trim())
924	    );
925	    try {
926	      safeLocalStorage.setItem('swiftship_table_backup_order_items', JSON.stringify(collectionCaches['order_items']));
927	    } catch (_) { }
928	  }
929	
930	  // 4. إعادة ضبط التوقيتات للجداول المتأثرة لإلزام المزامنة الشبكية التالية
931	  // Invalidate fetch timestamps for affected relational tables
932	  ['orders', 'shipments', 'order_items', 'products', 'main_entry', 'account_trans', 'notifications', 'whatsapp_logs', 'orders_history'].forEach(table => {
933	    delete lastFetchTimestamps[table];
934	    delete activeFetches[table];
935	  });
936	
937	  // 5. إشعار جميع المستمعين المتصلين بجداول الطلبات والشحنات والبنود للتحديث الفوري بالواجهة
938	  // Trigger all active snapshot listeners for orders, shipments, order_items, and products
939	  ['orders', 'shipments', 'order_items', 'products'].forEach(table => {
940	    if (collectionListeners[table]) {
941	      collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
942	    }
943	  });
944	}

946	// Mock Batch write functionality
947	class MockWriteBatch {
948	  operations: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
949	
950	  set(docRef: DocRef, data: any, options?: any) {
951	    this.operations.push(() => setDoc(docRef, data, options));
952	  }
953	
954	  update(docRef: DocRef, data: any) {
955	    this.operations.push(() => updateDoc(docRef, data));
956	  }
957	
958	  delete(docRef: DocRef) {
959	    this.operations.push(() => deleteDoc(docRef));
960	  }
961	
962	  async commit() {
963	    for (const op of this.operations) {
964	      await op();
965	    }
966	  }
967	}

969	export function writeBatch(...args: any[]) {
970	  return new MockWriteBatch();
971	}

977	export function onSnapshot(
978	  queryObj: any,
979	  callback: (snapshot: any) => void,
980	  errorCallback?: (error: any) => void
981	) {
982	  if (queryObj instanceof DocRef) {
983	    const table = queryObj.path;
984	    const docId = queryObj.id;
985	
986	    const docListener = async () => {
987	      try {
988	        const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
989	        const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === docId);
990	        const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
991	        callback({
992	          id: docId,
993	          exists: () => !!item,
994	          data: () => {
995	            if (!item) return undefined;
996	            const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
997	            return rest;
998	          }
999	        });
1000	      } catch (err) {
1001	        if (errorCallback) errorCallback(err);
1002	      }
1003	    };
1004	
1005	    if (!collectionListeners[table]) {
1006	      collectionListeners[table] = new Set();
1007	    }
1008	    collectionListeners[table].add(docListener);
1009	    docListener();
1010	
1011	    return () => {
1012	      if (collectionListeners[table]) {
1013	        collectionListeners[table].delete(docListener);
1014	      }
1015	    };
1016	  }
1017	
1018	  const table = queryObj.path;
1019	  const listener = async () => {
1020	    try {
1021	      const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
1022	      const filtered = queryObj instanceof SupabaseQuery ? applyQuery(allItems, queryObj) : allItems;
1023	
1024	      const docs = filtered.map(rawItem => {
1025	        const item = table === 'orders' ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
1026	        return {

1175	export function encryptDataLocal(text: string, key: string): string {
1176	  let result = '';
1177	  const cleanKey = key || 'swiftship_emergency_core_system_salt';
1178	  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
1179	    const charCode = text.charCodeAt(i);
1180	    const keyChar = cleanKey.charCodeAt(i % cleanKey.length);
1181	    result += String.fromCharCode(charCode ^ keyChar);
1182	  }
1183	  return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(result)));
1184	}

1186	export function decryptDataLocal(cipherText: string, key: string): string {
1187	  try {
1188	    const cleanKey = key || 'swiftship_emergency_core_system_salt';
1189	    const text = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(cipherText)));
1190	    let result = '';
1191	    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
1192	      const charCode = text.charCodeAt(i);
1193	      const keyChar = cleanKey.charCodeAt(i % cleanKey.length);
1194	      result += String.fromCharCode(charCode ^ keyChar);
1195	    }
1196	    return result;
1197	  } catch (e) {
1198	    return '';
1199	  }
1200	}

1202	export function simpleHashPassword(message: string): string {
1203	  let hash = 0;
1204	  const input = message || '';
1205	  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
1206	    const char = input.charCodeAt(i);
1207	    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + char;
1208	    hash = hash & hash;
1209	  }
1210	  return 'emergency_hash_v1_' + Math.abs(hash).toString(16) + '_' + input.length;
1211	}

  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_order_occurred_idx
  ON public.orders_history (order_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_shipment_occurred_idx
  ON public.orders_history (shipment_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_event_type_idx
  ON public.orders_history (event_type, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_actor_idx
  ON public.orders_history (actor_id, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_resolve_order(p_reference text)
RETURNS TABLE(order_id text, order_number text)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
AS $$
  SELECT o.id, o.order_number
  FROM public.orders o
  WHERE p_reference IS NOT NULL
    AND (o.id = p_reference OR o.order_number = p_reference)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.id = p_reference THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  LIMIT 1;
$$;

    const match = rows.find(r => String(r.orderNumber ?? '').toUpperCase() === queryStr.toUpperCase()) ?? rows[0];
    if (match) { reconstruct; setResolvedSource('orders_db'); return; }
  } catch {}
}

statusRank defaults to -1 for unknown strings. 'تم تسجيل الطلب' → -1. Regression guard: input.status rank(-1) < previous rank → if previous > -1, then any transition to 'تم تسجيل الطلب' gets blocked. Even legitimate initial registration is blocked. The rank map is missing many DB status names (DB currently has 12 statuses). 102	/**
103	 * جلب جميع المنتجات المرتجعة مع دعم الفلترة
104	 * Fetch all returned products with optional filters
105	 */
106	export async function fetchReturnedProducts(
107	  filters?: ReturnedProductFilters
108	): Promise<ReturnedProduct[]> {
109	  let query = supabase
110	    .from('returned_products')
111	    .select(SELECT_FIELDS.returnedProduct)
112	    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
113	
114	  // تطبيق الفلاتر - Apply filters
115	  if (filters?.order_id) {
116	    query = query.eq('order_id', filters.order_id);
117	  }
118	  if (filters?.product_id) {
119	    query = query.eq('product_id', filters.product_id);
120	  }
121	  if (filters?.customer_id) {
122	    query = query.eq('customer_id', filters.customer_id);
123	  }
124	  if (filters?.return_status) {
125	    query = query.eq('return_status', filters.return_status);
126	  }
127	  if (filters?.return_type) {
128	    query = query.eq('return_type', filters.return_type);
129	  }
130	  if (filters?.date_from) {
131	    query = query.gte('returned_at', filters.date_from);
132	  }
133	  if (filters?.date_to) {
134	    query = query.lte('returned_at', filters.date_to + 'T23:59:59Z');
135	  }
136	  if (filters?.search) {
137	    const searchTerm = `%${filters.search}%`;
138	    query = query.or(
139	      `customer_name.ilike.${searchTerm},product_name.ilike.${searchTerm},order_id.ilike.${searchTerm},return_reason.ilike.${searchTerm}`
140	    );
141	  }
142	
143	  const { data, error } = await query;
144	  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
145	  return data || [];
146	}

148	/**
149	 * إنشاء سجل مرتجع جديد
150	 * Create a new returned product record
151	 */
152	export async function createReturnedProduct(
153	  returnData: Omit<ReturnedProduct, 'return_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>,
154	  createdBy?: string
155	): Promise<ReturnedProduct> {
156	  // توليد معرف فريد للمرتجع - Generate unique return ID
157	  const return_id = 'ret_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
158	  const now = new Date().toISOString();
159	
160	  const payload: ReturnedProduct = {
161	    return_id,
162	    ...returnData,
163	    order_id: (returnData.order_id || '').trim() || undefined,
164	    order_item_id: (returnData.order_item_id || '').trim() || undefined,
165	    product_id: (returnData.product_id || '').trim() || undefined,
166	    customer_id: (returnData.customer_id || '').trim() || undefined,
167	    quantity: Math.max(1, Number(returnData.quantity) || 1),
168	    refund_amount: Math.max(0, Number(returnData.refund_amount) || 0),
169	    insurance_refund: returnData.is_insured
170	      ? Math.max(0, Number(returnData.insurance_refund) || 0)
171	      : 0,
172	    return_status: returnData.return_status || 'معلق',
173	    return_type: returnData.return_type || 'استرداد',
174	    return_condition: returnData.return_condition || 'مستخدم',
175	    is_insured: Boolean(returnData.is_insured),
176	    returned_at: returnData.returned_at
177	      ? (returnData.returned_at.includes('T') ? returnData.returned_at : new Date(returnData.returned_at).toISOString())
178	      : now,
179	    processed_at: returnData.processed_at
180	      ? (returnData.processed_at.includes('T') ? returnData.processed_at : new Date(returnData.processed_at).toISOString())
181	      : undefined,
182	    processed_by: (returnData.processed_by || '').trim() || undefined,
183	    created_at: now,
184	    created_by: createdBy || 'system',
185	    updated_at: now,
186	    updated_by: createdBy || 'system',
187	  };
188	
189	  await addDoc(return_id, collection(db, 'returned_products'), payload);
190	  return payload;
191	}

193	/**
194	 * تحديث بيانات مرتجع موجود
195	 * Update an existing returned product record
196	 */
197	export async function updateReturnedProduct(
198	  return_id: string,
199	  updates: Partial<ReturnedProduct>,
200	  updatedBy?: string
201	): Promise<ReturnedProduct> {
202	  const { data, error } = await supabase
203	    .from('returned_products')
204	    .update({
205	      ...updates,
206	      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
207	      updated_by: updatedBy || null,
208	    })
209	    .eq('return_id', return_id)
210	    .select()
211	    .single();
212	
213	  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
214	  return data;
215	}

219	 * Update return status and record who processed it
220	 */
221	export async function updateReturnStatus(
222	  return_id: string,
223	  new_status: ReturnStatus,
224	  processed_by?: string
225	): Promise<ReturnedProduct> {
226	  const now = new Date().toISOString();
227	
228	  const { data, error } = await supabase
229	    .from('returned_products')
230	    .update({
231	      return_status: new_status,
232	      processed_by: processed_by || null,
233	      processed_at: new_status !== 'معلق' ? now : null,
234	      updated_at: now,
235	      updated_by: processed_by || null,
236	    })
237	    .eq('return_id', return_id)
238	    .select()
239	    .single();
240	
241	  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
242	  return data;
243	}

258	/**
259	 * احتساب إحصائيات المرتجعات
260	 * Calculate returned products statistics
261	 */
262	export function calculateReturnStats(returns: ReturnedProduct[]): ReturnedProductStats {
263	  return {
264	    total: returns.length,
265	    pending: returns.filter(r => r.return_status === 'معلق').length,
266	    accepted: returns.filter(r => r.return_status === 'مقبول').length,
267	    rejected: returns.filter(r => r.return_status === 'مرفوض').length,
268	    completed: returns.filter(r => r.return_status === 'مكتمل').length,
269	    total_refund_amount: returns.reduce(
270	      (sum, r) => sum + (Number(r.refund_amount) || 0) + (Number(r.insurance_refund) || 0),
271	      0
272	    ),
273	  };
274	}

2	import type { ReturnedOrderItemRecord, ReturnedOrderRecord } from '../types';
3	import type { ReturnedProduct } from '../../../../../../services/returnedProductService';

7	interface UseReturnedProductsDataArgs {
8	  orders?: ReturnedOrderRecord[];
9	  propOrderItems?: ReturnedOrderItemRecord[];
10	}
11	
12	export function useReturnedProductsData({ orders, propOrderItems }: UseReturnedProductsDataArgs) {
13	  const [returns, setReturns] = useState<ReturnedProduct[]>([]);
14	  const [queryState, setQueryState] = useState<AsyncState<ReturnedProduct[]>>(asyncState.loading());
15	  const [internalOrders, setInternalOrders] = useState<ReturnedOrderRecord[]>([]);
16	  const [internalOrderItems, setInternalOrderItems] = useState<ReturnedOrderItemRecord[]>([]);
17	
18	  useEffect(() => {
19	    if (!orders || orders.length === 0) {
20	      const unsub = returnedProductsGateway.subscribeOrders(setInternalOrders);
21	      return () => unsub?.();
22	    }
23	  }, [orders]);
24	
25	  useEffect(() => {
26	    if (!propOrderItems || propOrderItems.length === 0) {
27	      const unsub = returnedProductsGateway.subscribeOrderItems(setInternalOrderItems);
28	      return () => unsub?.();
29	    }
30	  }, [propOrderItems]);
31	
32	  useEffect(() => {
33	    const unsub = returnedProductsGateway.subscribeReturns((rows) => {
34	      setReturns(rows);
35	      setQueryState(rows.length === 0 ? asyncState.empty() : asyncState.success(rows));
36	    }, (error) => setQueryState(asyncState.error(error, 'RETURNED_PRODUCTS_LOAD_FAILED')));
37	    return () => unsub?.();
38	  }, []);
39	
40	  const allOrders = useMemo(() => (orders && orders.length > 0 ? orders : internalOrders), [orders, internalOrders]);
41	  const allOrderItems = useMemo(
42	    () => (propOrderItems && propOrderItems.length > 0 ? propOrderItems : internalOrderItems),
43	    [propOrderItems, internalOrderItems]
44	  );
45	
46	  return {
47	    returns,
48	    setReturns,
49	    loading: queryState.status === 'loading',
50	    queryState,
51	    allOrders,
52	    allOrderItems,
53	  };
54	}

OK, now I understand the surface of returned-products:

What the frontend needs:
1. List all returned products (no filter, client-side filtering) — the gateway's subscribeReturns supplies all rows in real time. Conversion: poll or fetch on load + refetch after mutation. Keep the ReturnedProduct shape in snake_case.
2. Create return (return_id is client-generated. Or would server-generated be better? Keep it client-side to preserve the existing "ret_" IDs. The API upserts by return_id).
3. Update return (arbitrary partial payload, snake_case fields, nulls allowed for processed_by/processed_at).
4. Delete return.
5. Update order item (items_status, updated_at) — order_items PATCH.
6. Order list for modal selection — already available via /api/v1/orders, but useReturnedProductsData is subscribing to the entire orders collection. What's the shape of ReturnedOrderRecord? The gateway is mapping `{id: doc.id, ...data}`. The orders table via the API returns rows with orderId/orderNumber and so on. Fields needed on ReturnedProductsTab: orderNumber or order_number or id, customerName/customer_name, customerPhone/phone, items array, customerId/customer_id, currency. Does the API's listOrders return those columns? Need to confirm what fields are included — is there customerName/currency? Let me check listOrders in operations.repository.ts.

  client: PoolClient,

    orderId: string;
    orderNumber: string;

async function page(
  pool: Pool,
  table: string,
  columns: string,
  order: string,
  input: PageQuery,
  searchColumns: string[],
): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  const values: unknown[] = [];
  const filters: string[] = [];
  if (input.search) {
    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
  }
  if (input.customerId) {
    values.push(input.customerId);
    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
  }
  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
    values,
  );
  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
}

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => products.filter(p => {

    const nameEn = (p.product_name_en || '').toLowerCase();
    const query = productSearch.toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch = !query || name.includes(query) || nameEn.includes(query);
    const matchesCat = productCategoryFilter === 'all' || p.item_category_id === productCategoryFilter;
    const matchesAllowed = productAllowedFilter === 'all'
      ? true
      : productAllowedFilter === 'allowed'
        ? p.is_allowed !== false
        : p.is_allowed === false;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCat && matchesAllowed;
  }).sort((a, b) => {

    if (productSortBy === 'price') return (b.unit_price || 0) - (a.unit_price || 0);

  }), [products, productSearch, productCategoryFilter, productAllowedFilter, productSortBy]);

  const entries = presentEntries(record, columnMap);
  const columns = [idColumn, ...entries.map(([c]) => c), 'created_by', 'updated_by', 'created_at', 'updated_at'];

  const placeholders = values.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`).join(', ');
  const result = await pool.query(`INSERT INTO public.${table} (${columns.join(', ')}) VALUES (${placeholders}) RETURNING ${returning}`, values);
  return result.rows[0];
}

update generic:
```ts
async function updateRecord(pool, table, idColumn, idValue, record, columnMap, returning, actorId) {
  const entries = presentEntries(record, columnMap);
  const sets = entries.map(([col], i) => `${col} = $${i + 1}`);
  sets.push(`updated_by = $${entries.length + 1}`, 'updated_at = NOW()');
  const values = [...entries.map(([, v]) => v ?? null), actorId, idValue];
  const result = await pool.query(`UPDATE public.${table} SET ${sets.join(', ')} WHERE ${idColumn} = $${entries.length + 2} RETURNING ${returning}`, values);
  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
}
```

import type { Response } from 'express';

export interface ApiErrorDetails {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  details: ReadonlyArray<{ field?: string; message: string }>;
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ApiSuccess<T> {
  success: true;
  data: T;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ApiFailure {
  success: false;
  error: ApiErrorDetails;
}

export function sendSuccess<T>(
  response: Response,
  data: T,
  requestId: string,
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Response<ApiSuccess<T>> {
  const body: ApiSuccess<T> = meta === undefined
    ? { success: true, data, requestId }
    : { success: true, data, meta, requestId };
  return response.json(body);
}

export function sendFailure(
  response: Response,
  status: number,
  code: string,
  message: string,
  requestId: string,
  details: ReadonlyArray<{ field?: string; message: string }> = [],
): Response<ApiFailure> {
  return response.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    error: { code, message, details, requestId },
  });
}

1. Return type of presentColumnEntries: change to `Array<[string | undefined, unknown]>`? The columnMap lookup could be undefined under noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Type the entries mapping like this: `.map(([key, value]) => [columnMap[key] ?? null, ...])` is not good. A better approach: since we're filtering by hasOwnProperty, TS doesn't narrow. Change the signature:

```ts
function presentColumnEntries(input: Record<string, unknown>, columnMap: Record<string, string>): Array<[string, unknown]> {
  const entries: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
    const column = columnMap[key];
    if (column !== undefined && value !== undefined) entries.push([column, value ?? null]);
  }
  return entries;
}
```
This fixes error 48.

import type { OrderStatusItem } from '../hooks/useOrderStatuses';
import type { OrderHistoryEvent } from './orderHistoryService';

export type StatusTransitionPlan = {
  allowed: boolean;
  reason?: 'same_status' | 'backward_transition' | 'status_previously_processed' | 'unknown_status';
  stagesToProcess: OrderStatusItem[];
  skippedStages: OrderStatusItem[];
};

function statusIdFromEvent(event: OrderHistoryEvent): number | null {
  if (event.eventType !== 'order.status_changed' && event.eventType !== 'order.created') return null;
  const after = event.afterData ?? {};
  const raw = after.order_status_id ?? after.orderStatusId ?? after.orderStatus;
  const id = Number(raw);
  return Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
}

export function getProcessedStatusIds(events: OrderHistoryEvent[]): Set<number> {
  return new Set(events.map(statusIdFromEvent).filter((id): id is number => id !== null));
}

export function planOrderStatusTransition(
  statuses: OrderStatusItem[],
  currentStatusId: number,
  targetStatusId: number,
  processedStatusIds: Set<number>,
): StatusTransitionPlan {
  const ordered = [...statuses]
    .filter((status) => status.code !== 'cancelled')
    .sort((left, right) => (left.sortOrder ?? left.id) - (right.sortOrder ?? right.id));
  const target = statuses.find((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);
  const currentIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === currentStatusId);
  const targetIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);

  if (!target || currentIndex < 0 || (target.code !== 'cancelled' && targetIndex < 0)) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'unknown_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }

  if (target.code === 'cancelled') {
    return { allowed: true, stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }
  if (targetStatusId === currentStatusId) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'same_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }
  if (targetIndex < currentIndex) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'backward_transition', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }
  if (processedStatusIds.has(targetStatusId)) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'status_previously_processed', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }

  const stagesToProcess = ordered.slice(currentIndex + 1, targetIndex + 1);
  return {
    allowed: true,
    stagesToProcess,
    skippedStages: stagesToProcess.slice(0, -1),
  };
}

  private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch;

        this.options.timeoutMs ?? 10000
      );

  CREATE = 'create',
  UPDATE = 'update',
  DELETE = 'delete',
  LIST = 'list',
  GET = 'get',
  WRITE = 'write',
}

export function handleSupabaseError(error: unknown, operationType: OperationType, path: string | null) {
  console.error('[Supabase query/mutation error]:', error, operationType, path);
}

export function handlePostgreSQLError(error: unknown, operationType: OperationType, path: string | null) {
  handleSupabaseError(error, operationType, path);
}

export function doc(...args: any[]) {
  // If first arg is a DocRef, return it
  if (args[0] instanceof DocRef) {
    return args[0];
  }
  // If first arg is a SupabaseQuery (CollectionRef), map it with its path and a secure auto-generated ID
  if (args[0] instanceof SupabaseQuery) {
    const id = args[1] || (Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11));
    return new DocRef(args[0].path, id);
  }
  // doc(db, 'id') or doc('table', 'id') or doc(db, 'table', 'id')
  if (args.length === 2 && typeof args[1] === 'string') {
    const parts = args[1].split('/');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return new DocRef(parts[0], parts[1]);
    }
    return new DocRef(args[1], "");
  }
  if (args.length === 3 && typeof args[1] === 'string' && typeof args[2] === 'string') {
    return new DocRef(args[1], args[2]);
  }
  const mainPath = typeof args[1] === 'string' ? args[1] : (typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : 'unknown');
  const subId = typeof args[2] === 'string' ? args[2] : '';
  return new DocRef(mainPath, subId);
}

export function query(collectionRef: SupabaseQuery, ...constraints: any[]) {
  return new SupabaseQuery(collectionRef.path, [...collectionRef.constraints, ...constraints]);
}

export function where(field: string, op: string, value: any) {
  return { type: 'where', field, op, value };
}

export function orderBy(field: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc') {
  return { type: 'orderBy', field, direction };
}

export function limit(value: number) {
  return { type: 'limit', value };
}

export function or(...conditions: any[]) {
  return { type: 'or', conditions };
}

export async function getDoc(docRef: DocRef) {
  const table = docRef.path;
  const id = docRef.id;
  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
  const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === id);
  const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;

  return {
    id,
    exists: () => !!item,
    data: () => {
      if (!item) return undefined;
      const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
      return rest;
    }
  };
}

export async function setDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any, options?: any) {
  const table = docRef.path;
  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
  const id = docRef.id;
  let rawClean = cleanData(rawData);

  if (options && options.merge) {
    const all = await ensureCache(table);
    const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
    const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
    rawClean = { ...existingData, ...rawClean };
  }
  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);

  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(writePayload);
    if (error) {
      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
      if (isRlsError) {
        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
      } else {
        throw createWriteError('upsert', table, error);
      }
    }

} from './operations.schemas';

function requestId(response: Response): string {
  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
}
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {
  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
}
function handleWriteError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'ORDER_STATUS_REGRESSION') {
    sendFailure(response, 409, 'ORDER_STATUS_REGRESSION', 'لا يمكن إرجاع حالة الطلب إلى الخلف.', requestId(response));
    return;
  }
  next(error);
}

29	export function useOrderStatuses() {
30	  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<OrderStatusItem[]>(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
31	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
32	
33	  useEffect(() => {
34	    // Order statuses are standard workflow stages provided by default.
35	    setStatuses(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
36	    setLoading(false);
37	  }, []);
38	
39	  // Helper functions
40	  const getStatusById = (id: number | string | undefined | null): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
41	    if (id === undefined || id === null || id === '') return undefined;
42	    const numId = typeof id === 'number' ? id : parseInt(String(id), 10);
43	    if (!isNaN(numId)) {
44	      const found = statuses.find(s => s.id === numId);
45	      if (found) return found;
46	    }
47	    return statuses.find(s => String(s.id) === String(id));
48	  };
49	
50	  const getStatusByName = (name: string): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
51	    if (!name) return undefined;
52	    const clean = name.trim().toLowerCase();
53	    return statuses.find(s => s.nameAr.toLowerCase() === clean || s.nameEn.toLowerCase() === clean || s.code?.toLowerCase() === clean);
54	  };
55	
56	  const getStatusByAny = (val: number | string | undefined | null): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
57	    if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return undefined;
58	    return getStatusById(val) || getStatusByName(String(val));
59	  };
60	
61	  const getFirstStatus = (): OrderStatusItem => {
62	    return statuses.find(s => s.isFirst) || statuses[0] || DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES[0];
63	  };
64	
65	  const getLastStatus = (): OrderStatusItem => {
66	    return statuses.find(s => s.isLast) || statuses[statuses.length - 1] || DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES[7];
67	  };
68	
69	  const getNextStatus = (currentStatusIdOrName: number | string): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
70	    let currentItem: OrderStatusItem | undefined = getStatusByAny(currentStatusIdOrName);
71	    if (!currentItem) return undefined;
72	    const currentIndex = statuses.findIndex(s => s.id === currentItem!.id);
73	    if (currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < statuses.length - 1) {
74	      return statuses[currentIndex + 1];
75	    }
76	    return undefined;
77	  };
78	
79	  return {
80	    statuses,
81	    loading,
82	    getStatusById,
83	    getStatusByName,
84	    getStatusByAny,
85	    getFirstStatus,
86	    getLastStatus,
87	    getNextStatus
88	  };
89	}

12	function collectSourceFiles(directory: string): string[] {
13	  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
14	    const path = resolve(directory, entry.name);
15	    if (entry.isDirectory()) return collectSourceFiles(path);
16	    return /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name) && !/\.test\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(entry.name) ? [path] : [];

20	function categoryMatches(category: BoundaryCategory, source: string): boolean {
21	  if (category === 'legacyCompatImport') return source.includes('data/legacy/legacy-compat');
22	  if (category === 'supabaseRuntimeReference') {
23	    return ['@supabase/supabase-js', 'supabase.from', 'supabase.channel', 'postgres_changes', 'createClient(']
24	      .some((pattern) => source.includes(pattern));
25	  }
26	  return ['onSnapshot(', 'onAuthStateChanged('].some((pattern) => source.includes(pattern));
27	}

219	export function onAuthStateChanged(...args: any[]) {
220	  const callback = typeof args[1] === 'function' ? args[1] : (typeof args[0] === 'function' ? args[0] : () => { });
221	  authListeners.add(callback);

229	// Populate collection cache and listen to realtime updates from Supabase
230	const lastFetchTimestamps: { [table: string]: number } = {};
231	const CACHE_TTL_MS = typeof window === 'undefined' ? 0 : 60000; // 0 on backend (always fresh), 60s in browser (realtime channel handles live updates)
232	const activeFetches: { [table: string]: Promise<any[]> | null } = {};
233	const collectionSubscribed: { [table: string]: boolean } = {};

235	/**
236	 * إثراء بيانات الطلب ديناميكياً بالأصناف والشحنات المجلوبة من الجداول المخصصة
237	 * Dynamically enrich order object with items and shipping details from products & shipments tables
238	 */
239	export function enrichOrderPayload(item: any): any {
240	  if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return item;
241	  const orderId = item.id;
242	  const orderNum = item.order_number || item.orderNumber;
243	
244	  const orderItemsCache = collectionCaches['order_items'] || collectionCaches['products'] || [];
245	  const matchedOrderItems = orderItemsCache.filter((oi: any) =>
246	    (oi.order_id && (oi.order_id === orderId || oi.order_id === orderNum)) ||
247	    (oi.orderId && (oi.orderId === orderId || oi.orderId === orderNum))
248	  );
249	
250	  const shipmentsCache = collectionCaches['shipments'] || [];
251	  const matchedShipments = shipmentsCache.filter((s: any) =>
252	    (s.order_id && (s.order_id === orderId || s.order_id === orderNum)) ||
253	    (s.orderId && (s.orderId === orderId || s.orderId === orderNum))
254	  );
255	
256	  return {
257	    ...item,
258	    items: matchedOrderItems,
259	    products: matchedOrderItems,
260	    orderItems: matchedOrderItems,
261	    shippingDetails: matchedShipments,
262	    shippings: matchedShipments
263	  };
264	}

266	async function ensureCache(table: string): Promise<any[]> {
267	  const now = Date.now();
268	  const lastFetch = lastFetchTimestamps[table] || 0;
269	  const isStale = (now - lastFetch > CACHE_TTL_MS) || (lastFetch === 0);
270	
271	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) {
272	    // 1. Try to load from localStorage cache first so it's instantly available or when offline
273	    try {
274	      const savedData = safeLocalStorage.getItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`);
275	      if (savedData) {
276	        collectionCaches[table] = JSON.parse(savedData);
277	      }
278	    } catch (e) {
279	      console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] Error parsing cached local storage backup for ${table}:`, e);
280	    }
281	
282	    if (!collectionCaches[table]) {
283	      collectionCaches[table] = [];
284	    }
285	  }
286	
287	  // ⚠️ تم تعطيل الجلب من الشبكة عبر Supabase - النظام يعتمد على ALX API الآن
288	  // ⚠️ Network fetching via Supabase is DISABLED - System uses ALX API now
289	  // لا تُحاول الاتصال بـ Supabase - استخدم alxDataGateway.ts بدلاً من ذلك
290	  // Do NOT attempt Supabase connections - use alxDataGateway.ts instead
291	  lastFetchTimestamps[table] = Date.now(); // منع أي محاولة إعادة جلب
292	
293	  // تعطيل Realtime channels تماماً
294	  // Realtime channels are fully disabled
295	
296	  return collectionCaches[table] || [];
297	}

299	// In-Memory query and constraint filtering layer
300	class SupabaseQuery {
301	  path: string;
302	  constraints: any[] = [];
303	  constructor(path: string, constraints: any[] = []) {
304	    this.path = path;
305	    this.constraints = constraints;
306	  }
307	}
308	
309	class DocRef {
310	  type = 'doc';
311	  path: string;
312	  id: string;
313	  constructor(path: string, id: string) {
314	    this.path = path;
315	    this.id = id;
316	  }
317	}
318	
319	function applyQuery(items: any[], queryObj: SupabaseQuery): any[] {
320	  let filtered = [...items];
321	
322	  const evaluateCondition = (item: any, cond: any): boolean => {
323	    const val = item[cond.field];
324	    const compare = cond.value;
325	
326	    switch (cond.op) {
327	      case '==':
328	        return val === compare;
329	      case '!=':
330	        return val !== compare;
331	      case '>':
332	        return val > compare;
333	      case '>=':
334	        return val >= compare;
335	      case '<':
336	        return val < compare;
337	      case '<=':
338	        return val <= compare;
339	      case 'array-contains':
340	        return Array.isArray(val) && val.includes(compare);
341	      case 'in':
342	        return Array.isArray(compare) && compare.includes(val);
343	      default:
344	        return true;
345	    }
346	  };
347	
348	  for (const c of queryObj.constraints) {
349	    if (c.type === 'where') {
350	      filtered = filtered.filter(item => evaluateCondition(item, c));
351	    } else if (c.type === 'or') {
352	      filtered = filtered.filter(item => {
353	        return c.conditions.some((cond: any) => evaluateCondition(item, cond));
354	      });
355	    }
356	  }
357	
358	  // Handle orderBy
359	  const sortConstraints = queryObj.constraints.filter(c => c.type === 'orderBy');
360	  if (sortConstraints.length > 0) {
361	    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
362	      for (const s of sortConstraints) {
363	        const valA = a[s.field];
364	        const valB = b[s.field];
365	        if (valA !== valB) {
366	          const order = s.direction === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
367	          if (valA === undefined || valA === null) return 1;
368	          if (valB === undefined || valB === null) return -1;
369	          return valA > valB ? order : -order;
370	        }
371	      }
372	      return 0;
373	    });
374	  }
375	
376	  // Handle limit
377	  const limitConstraint = queryObj.constraints.find(c => c.type === 'limit');
378	  if (limitConstraint) {
379	    filtered = filtered.slice(0, limitConstraint.value);
380	  }
381	
382	  return filtered;
383	}

511	export function doc(...args: any[]) {
512	  // If first arg is a DocRef, return it
513	  if (args[0] instanceof DocRef) {
514	    return args[0];
515	  }
516	  // If first arg is a SupabaseQuery (CollectionRef), map it with its path and a secure auto-generated ID
517	  if (args[0] instanceof SupabaseQuery) {
518	    const id = args[1] || (Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11));
519	    return new DocRef(args[0].path, id);
520	  }
521	  // doc(db, 'id') or doc('table', 'id') or doc(db, 'table', 'id')
522	  if (args.length === 2 && typeof args[1] === 'string') {
523	    const parts = args[1].split('/');
524	    if (parts.length >= 2) {
525	      return new DocRef(parts[0], parts[1]);
526	    }
527	    return new DocRef(args[1], "");
528	  }
529	  if (args.length === 3 && typeof args[1] === 'string' && typeof args[2] === 'string') {
530	    return new DocRef(args[1], args[2]);
531	  }
532	  const mainPath = typeof args[1] === 'string' ? args[1] : (typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : 'unknown');
533	  const subId = typeof args[2] === 'string' ? args[2] : '';
534	  return new DocRef(mainPath, subId);
535	}

557	export async function getDocs(queryObj: SupabaseQuery) {
558	  const table = queryObj.path;
559	  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
560	  const filtered = applyQuery(allItems, queryObj);
561	
562	  const docs = filtered.map(rawItem => {
563	    const item = table === 'orders' ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
564	    return {
565	      id: item.id,
566	      ref: new DocRef(table, item.id),
567	      exists: () => true,
568	      data: () => {
569	        const { id, ...rest } = item;
570	        return rest;
571	      }
572	    };
573	  });
574	
575	  return {
576	    docs,
577	    empty: docs.length === 0,
578	    size: docs.length,
579	    forEach: (cb: any) => docs.forEach(cb)
580	  };
581	}

583	export async function getDoc(docRef: DocRef) {
584	  const table = docRef.path;
585	  const id = docRef.id;
586	  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
587	  const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === id);
588	  const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
589	
590	  return {
591	    id,
592	    exists: () => !!item,
593	    data: () => {
594	      if (!item) return undefined;
595	      const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
596	      return rest;
597	    }
598	  };
599	}

605	export function createWriteError(operation: 'insert' | 'upsert' | 'update' | 'delete', table: string, error: any): Error {
606	  const writeError = new Error(`[Supabase Adapter] ${operation} failed on table ${table}: ${error?.message || 'Unknown database write error'}`);
607	  (writeError as any).code = error?.code;
608	  (writeError as any).cause = error;
609	  return writeError;
610	}

612	export async function addDoc(newID: any, collectionRef: SupabaseQuery, rawData: any) {
613	  const table = collectionRef.path;
614	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
615	  let id = newID ? String(newID) : 'noId_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
616	
617	  // Uniqueness check against cached items to prevent duplicate primary key violations
618	  const cache = collectionCaches[table] || [];
619	  if (cache.some((item: any) => String(item.id) === id || String(item[pkCol]) === id)) {
620	    id = `${id}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
621	  }
622	  const rawClean = cleanData(rawData);
623	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
624	
625	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
626	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
627	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
628	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).insert(writePayload);
629	    if (error) {
630	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
631	      if (isRlsError) {
632	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
633	      } else {
634	        throw createWriteError('insert', table, error);
635	      }
636	    }
637	  } else {
638	    // Offline mode: buffering addDoc local write
639	  }
640	
641	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
642	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
643	  collectionCaches[table].push(newItem);
644	
645	  // إعلام استماع الطلبات عند إضافة منتج أو شحنة جديدة
646	  // Notify orders listeners when a product or shipment is added
647	  if ((table === 'products' || table === 'order_items' || table === 'shipments') && collectionListeners['orders']) {
648	    collectionListeners['orders'].forEach(cb => cb());
649	  }
650	
651	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
652	  try {
653	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
654	  } catch (_) { }
655	
656	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
657	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
658	  }
659	
660	  return { id };
661	}

667	  const assetCode = arg1 ? arg1 : 'noAssetCode_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
668	  const rawClean = cleanData(rawData);

685	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
686	  collectionCaches[table].push(newItem);

691	  } catch (_) { }

700	export async function setDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any, options?: any) {
701	  const table = docRef.path;
702	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
703	  const id = docRef.id;
704	  let rawClean = cleanData(rawData);
705	
706	  if (options && options.merge) {
707	    const all = await ensureCache(table);
708	    const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
709	    const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
710	    rawClean = { ...existingData, ...rawClean };
711	  }
712	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
713	
714	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
715	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
716	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
717	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(writePayload);
718	    if (error) {
719	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
720	      if (isRlsError) {
721	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
722	      } else {
723	        throw createWriteError('upsert', table, error);
724	      }
725	    }
726	  } else {
727	    // Offline mode: buffering setDoc local write
728	  }
729	
730	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
731	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
732	  const idx = collectionCaches[table].findIndex(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id);
733	  if (idx >= 0) {
734	    collectionCaches[table][idx] = newItem;
735	  } else {

778	export async function updateDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any) {
779	  const table = docRef.path;
780	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
781	  const id = docRef.id;
782	
783	  const all = await ensureCache(table);
784	  const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
785	  const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
786	
787	  const resolvedPayload: any = {};
788	  for (const k of Object.keys(rawData)) {
789	    const val = rawData[k];
790	    if (val instanceof IncrementValue) {
791	      const currentVal = parseFloat(existingData[k]) || 0;
792	      resolvedPayload[k] = currentVal + val.amount;
793	    } else if (val instanceof ArrayUnionValue) {
794	      const currentArr = Array.isArray(existingData[k]) ? existingData[k] : [];
795	      resolvedPayload[k] = [...currentArr, ...val.elements.filter((e: any) => !currentArr.includes(e))];
796	    } else {
797	      resolvedPayload[k] = cleanData(val);
798	    }
799	  }
800	
801	  // دمج البيانات السابقة مع التحديث لتجنب مسح أي حقول من كائن data في PostgreSQL عند التحديث الجزئي
802	  // Merge existing document fields with update payload to prevent wiping JSONB data column on partial update
803	  const rawClean = { ...existingData, ...resolvedPayload };
804	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
805	
806	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
807	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
808	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? directCols : { ...directCols, data };
809	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).update(writePayload).eq(pkCol, id);
810	    if (error) {
811	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
812	      if (isRlsError) {
813	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
814	      } else {
815	        throw createWriteError('update', table, error);
816	      }
817	    }
818	  } else {
819	    // Offline mode: buffering updateDoc local write
820	  }
821	
822	
823	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
824	  const idx = collectionCaches[table].findIndex(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id);
825	  if (idx >= 0) {
826	    collectionCaches[table][idx] = newItem;
827	  }
828	
829	  // إعلام استماع الطلبات عند تحديث منتج أو شحنة
830	  // Notify orders listeners when a product or shipment is updated
831	  if ((table === 'products' || table === 'order_items' || table === 'shipments') && collectionListeners['orders']) {
832	    collectionListeners['orders'].forEach(cb => cb());
833	  }
834	
835	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
836	  try {
837	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
838	  } catch (_) { }
839	
840	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
841	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
842	  }
843	}

892	export function notifyOrderDeletionInCache(orderIds: string[]) {
893	  if (!orderIds || !orderIds.length) return;
894	  const idsSet = new Set(orderIds.map(id => String(id || '').trim()).filter(Boolean));
895	
896	  // 1. إزالة الطلبات المحذوفة من كاش الطلبات وتحديث التخزين المحلي
897	  // Remove deleted orders from orders cache and update localStorage backup
898	  if (collectionCaches['orders']) {
899	    collectionCaches['orders'] = collectionCaches['orders'].filter(order =>
900	      !idsSet.has(String(order.id || '').trim()) &&
901	      !idsSet.has(String(order.order_number || order.orderNumber || '').trim())
902	    );
903	    try {
904	      safeLocalStorage.setItem('swiftship_table_backup_orders', JSON.stringify(collectionCaches['orders']));
905	    } catch (_) { }
906	  }
907	
908	  // 2. إزالة الشحنات المرتبطة من كاش الشحنات
909	  // Remove linked shipments from shipments cache
910	  if (collectionCaches['shipments']) {
911	    collectionCaches['shipments'] = collectionCaches['shipments'].filter(s =>
912	      !idsSet.has(String(s.order_id || s.orderId || '').trim())
913	    );
914	    try {
915	      safeLocalStorage.setItem('swiftship_table_backup_shipments', JSON.stringify(collectionCaches['shipments']));
916	    } catch (_) { }
917	  }
918	
919	  // 3. إزالة بنود الطلب من كاش order_items
920	  // Remove linked order items from order_items cache
921	  if (collectionCaches['order_items']) {
922	    collectionCaches['order_items'] = collectionCaches['order_items'].filter(item =>
923	      !idsSet.has(String(item.order_id || item.orderId || '').trim())
924	    );
925	    try {
926	      safeLocalStorage.setItem('swiftship_table_backup_order_items', JSON.stringify(collectionCaches['order_items']));
927	    } catch (_) { }
928	  }
929	
930	  // 4. إعادة ضبط التوقيتات للجداول المتأثرة لإلزام المزامنة الشبكية التالية
931	  // Invalidate fetch timestamps for affected relational tables
932	  ['orders', 'shipments', 'order_items', 'products', 'main_entry', 'account_trans', 'notifications', 'whatsapp_logs', 'orders_history'].forEach(table => {
933	    delete lastFetchTimestamps[table];
934	    delete activeFetches[table];
935	  });
936	
937	  // 5. إشعار جميع المستمعين المتصلين بجداول الطلبات والشحنات والبنود للتحديث الفوري بالواجهة
938	  // Trigger all active snapshot listeners for orders, shipments, order_items, and products
939	  ['orders', 'shipments', 'order_items', 'products'].forEach(table => {
940	    if (collectionListeners[table]) {
941	      collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
942	    }
943	  });
944	}

977	export function onSnapshot(
978	  queryObj: any,
979	  callback: (snapshot: any) => void,
980	  errorCallback?: (error: any) => void
981	) {
982	  if (queryObj instanceof DocRef) {
983	    const table = queryObj.path;
984	    const docId = queryObj.id;
985	
986	    const docListener = async () => {
987	      try {
988	        const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
989	        const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === docId);
990	        const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
991	        callback({
992	          id: docId,
993	          exists: () => !!item,
994	          data: () => {
995	            if (!item) return undefined;
996	            const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
997	            return rest;
998	          }
999	        });
1000	      } catch (err) {
1001	        if (errorCallback) errorCallback(err);
1002	      }
1003	    };
1004	
1005	    if (!collectionListeners[table]) {
1006	      collectionListeners[table] = new Set();
1007	    }
1008	    collectionListeners[table].add(docListener);
1009	    docListener();
1010	
1011	    return () => {
1012	      if (collectionListeners[table]) {
1013	        collectionListeners[table].delete(docListener);
1014	      }
1015	    };
1016	  }
1017	
1018	  const table = queryObj.path;
1019	  const listener = async () => {
1020	    try {
1021	      const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
1022	      const filtered = queryObj instanceof SupabaseQuery ? applyQuery(allItems, queryObj) : allItems;
1023	
1024	      const docs = filtered.map(rawItem => {
1025	        const item = table === 'orders' ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
1026	        return {
1027	          id: item.id,
1028	          ref: new DocRef(table, item.id),
1029	          exists: () => true,
1030	          data: () => {
1031	            const { id, ...rest } = item;
1032	            return rest;
1033	          }
1034	        };
1035	      });
1036	
1037	      callback({
1038	        docs,
1039	        empty: docs.length === 0,
1040	        size: docs.length,
1041	        forEach: (cb: any) => docs.forEach(cb),
1042	        docChanges: () => []
1043	      });
1044	    } catch (err) {
1045	      if (errorCallback) errorCallback(err);
1046	    }
1047	  };
1048	
1049	  if (!collectionListeners[table]) {
1050	    collectionListeners[table] = new Set();
1051	  }
1052	  collectionListeners[table].add(listener);
1053	  listener();
1054	
1055	  return () => {
1056	    if (collectionListeners[table]) {
1057	      collectionListeners[table].delete(listener);
1058	    }
1059	  };
1060	}

1107	// Date parsing helper
1108	export function safeToDate(timestamp: any): Date | null {
1109	  if (!timestamp) return null;
1110	  if (timestamp instanceof Date) return timestamp;
1111	  if (timestamp && typeof timestamp.toDate === 'function') return timestamp.toDate();
1112	  if (typeof timestamp === 'number') return new Date(timestamp);
1113	  if (typeof timestamp === 'string') {
1114	    const d = new Date(timestamp);
1115	    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
1116	  }
1117	  return null;
1118	}

1175	export function encryptDataLocal(text: string, key: string): string {
1176	  let result = '';
1177	  const cleanKey = key || 'swiftship_emergency_core_system_salt';
1178	  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
1179	    const charCode = text.charCodeAt(i);
1180	    const keyChar = cleanKey.charCodeAt(i % cleanKey.length);
1181	    result += String.fromCharCode(charCode ^ keyChar);
1182	  }
1183	  return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(result)));
1184	}
1185	
1186	export function decryptDataLocal(cipherText: string, key: string): string {
1187	  try {
1188	    const cleanKey = key || 'swiftship_emergency_core_system_salt';
1189	    const text = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(cipherText)));
1190	    let result = '';
1191	    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
1192	      const charCode = text.charCodeAt(i);
1193	      const keyChar = cleanKey.charCodeAt(i % cleanKey.length);
1194	      result += String.fromCharCode(charCode ^ keyChar);
1195	    }
1196	    return result;
1197	  } catch (e) {
1198	    return '';
1199	  }
1200	}

1202	export function simpleHashPassword(message: string): string {
1203	  let hash = 0;
1204	  const input = message || '';
1205	  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
1206	    const char = input.charCodeAt(i);
1207	    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + char;
1208	    hash = hash & hash;
1209	  }
1210	  return 'emergency_hash_v1_' + Math.abs(hash).toString(16) + '_' + input.length;
1211	}

 * Current Database Client — wraps the Supabase-Firebase adapter for server-side use.
 *
 * هذا الملف يُعرِّف دالة تهيئة عميل قاعدة البيانات المؤقت المبني على Supabase Adapter.
 * This file initialises the temporary database client built on top of the Supabase adapter.
 *
 * ملاحظة: هذا الملف مؤقت لمرحلة الانتقال قبل API.
 * Note: This file is temporary — used only during the pre-API transition phase.
 */

import admin, {
  initializeApp,
  getPostgreSQL,
  doc,
  getDoc,
  collection,
  addDoc,

import { readErrorCode, readErrorMessage } from '../../src/shared/contracts/unknown.contracts';

export type DatabaseClient = ReturnType<typeof getPostgreSQL>;
export type ServerAuthClient = ReturnType<typeof initializeAuth>;

// ── نوع عميل قاعدة البيانات / Database client type ──────────────
export interface DbClient {
  db: DatabaseClient | null;
  auth: ServerAuthClient | null;
  ready: boolean;
}

/**
 * تهيئة عميل قاعدة البيانات والمصادقة الخلفية.
 * Initialises the database client and backend authentication.
 *
 * @returns كائن يحتوي db و auth وعلامة ready
 */
export async function createDbClient(): Promise<DbClient> {
  let db: DatabaseClient | null = null;
  let auth: ServerAuthClient | null = null;

  // تهيئة Admin SDK المحاكي / Initialise emulated Admin SDK
  try {
    admin.initializeApp();
    console.log('[DB Client] Backend Adapter Admin SDK initialized successfully');
  } catch (adminErr: unknown) {
    console.error('[DB Client] Backend Adapter Admin SDK init failed:', readErrorMessage(adminErr));
  }

-- سجل تدقيق تشغيلي ومالي دائم للطلبات والشحنات.
-- يحتفظ المعرّفات كنصوص من دون قيود خارجية كي تبقى السجلات مرئية حتى بعد حذف الكيان الأصلي.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.orders_history (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id text,
  order_number text,
  shipment_id text,
  journal_entry_id text,
  account_transaction_id text,
  activity_log_id text,
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  event_category text NOT NULL,
  operation text NOT NULL,
  entity_type text NOT NULL,
  actor_id text,
  actor_name text,
  actor_role text,
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'database',
  summary text,
  before_data jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  after_data jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_order_occurred_idx
  ON public.orders_history (order_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_shipment_occurred_idx
  ON public.orders_history (shipment_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_event_type_idx
  ON public.orders_history (event_type, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_actor_idx
  ON public.orders_history (actor_id, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_resolve_order(p_reference text)
RETURNS TABLE(order_id text, order_number text)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
AS $$
  SELECT o.id, o.order_number
  FROM public.orders o
  WHERE p_reference IS NOT NULL
    AND (o.id = p_reference OR o.order_number = p_reference)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.id = p_reference THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  LIMIT 1;
$$;

2	import type { ReturnedOrderItemRecord, ReturnedOrderRecord } from '../types';
3	import type { ReturnedProduct } from '../../../../../../services/returnedProductService';
4	import { returnedProductsGateway } from '../gateway';

7	interface UseReturnedProductsDataArgs {
8	  orders?: ReturnedOrderRecord[];
9	  propOrderItems?: ReturnedOrderItemRecord[];
10	}
11	
12	export function useReturnedProductsData({ orders, propOrderItems }: UseReturnedProductsDataArgs) {
13	  const [returns, setReturns] = useState<ReturnedProduct[]>([]);
14	  const [queryState, setQueryState] = useState<AsyncState<ReturnedProduct[]>>(asyncState.loading());
15	  const [internalOrders, setInternalOrders] = useState<ReturnedOrderRecord[]>([]);
16	  const [internalOrderItems, setInternalOrderItems] = useState<ReturnedOrderItemRecord[]>([]);
17	
18	  useEffect(() => {
19	    if (!orders || orders.length === 0) {
20	      const unsub = returnedProductsGateway.subscribeOrders(setInternalOrders);
21	      return () => unsub?.();
22	    }
23	  }, [orders]);
24	
25	  useEffect(() => {
26	    if (!propOrderItems || propOrderItems.length === 0) {
27	      const unsub = returnedProductsGateway.subscribeOrderItems(setInternalOrderItems);
28	      return () => unsub?.();
29	    }
30	  }, [propOrderItems]);
31	
32	  useEffect(() => {
33	    const unsub = returnedProductsGateway.subscribeReturns((rows) => {
34	      setReturns(rows);
35	      setQueryState(rows.length === 0 ? asyncState.empty() : asyncState.success(rows));
36	    }, (error) => setQueryState(asyncState.error(error, 'RETURNED_PRODUCTS_LOAD_FAILED')));
37	    return () => unsub?.();
38	  }, []);
39	
40	  const allOrders = useMemo(() => (orders && orders.length > 0 ? orders : internalOrders), [orders, internalOrders]);
41	  const allOrderItems = useMemo(
42	    () => (propOrderItems && propOrderItems.length > 0 ? propOrderItems : internalOrderItems),
43	    [propOrderItems, internalOrderItems]
44	  );
45	
46	  return {
47	    returns,
48	    setReturns,
49	    loading: queryState.status === 'loading',
50	    queryState,
51	    allOrders,
52	    allOrderItems,
53	  };
54	}

};

103	export async function fetchProducts(): Promise<Product[]> {

133	  productData: Omit<Product, 'product_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'order_count'>,
134	  createdBy?: string

136	  const productId = 'prod_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);

138	  const payload: Product = {
139	    product_id: productId,
140	    ...productData,
141	    is_allowed: productData.is_allowed !== false,
142	    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
143	    created_by: createdBy || null as any,
144	    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
145	    updated_by: createdBy || null as any,
146	  };
147	
148	  try {
149	    const res = await apiClient.post<{ success: boolean; data: Product }>('/api/v1/operations/products', payload);
150	    return res.data || payload;
151	  } catch (err) {
152	    console.warn('[productService] createProduct fallback:', err);
153	    return payload;
154	  }
155	}

231	    const query: Record<string, string> = {};

233	    if (filters?.productId) query.productId = filters.productId;
234	    if (filters?.status) query.status = filters.status;

245	/**
246	 * إنشاء بند طلب جديد مع إنشاء المنتج الرئيسي إذا لزم
247	 * Create a new order item (and optionally a new master product)
248	 */
249	export async function createOrderItem(
250	  itemData: Omit<OrderItem, 'items_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'product'>,
251	  createdBy?: string
252	): Promise<OrderItem> {
253	  const itemsId = 'item_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
254	
255	  const quantity = Number(itemData.quantity) || 1;
256	  const productPrice = Number(itemData.product_price) || 0;
257	  const weight = Number(itemData.total__weight) || 0;
258	  const cbm = Number(itemData.total_cbm) || 0;
259	
260	  const payload: OrderItem = {
261	    items_id: itemsId,
262	    ...itemData,
263	    quantity,
264	    product_price: productPrice,
265	    total_price: quantity * productPrice,
266	    total__weight: weight * quantity,
267	    total_cbm: cbm * quantity,
268	    items_status: itemData.items_status || 'قيد الطلب',
269	    is_insured: Boolean(itemData.is_insured),
270	    insurance_fee: itemData.is_insured ? (Number(itemData.insurance_fee) || 0) : 0,
271	    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
272	    created_by: createdBy || null as any,
273	    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
274	    updated_by: createdBy || null as any,
275	  };
276	
277	  try {
278	    const res = await apiClient.post<{ success: boolean; data: OrderItem }>('/api/v1/operations/order-items', payload);
279	    return res.data || payload;
280	  } catch (err) {
281	    console.warn('[productService] createOrderItem fallback:', err);
282	    return payload;
283	  }
284	}

286	/**
287	 * تحديث بند طلب موجود
288	 * Update an existing order item
289	 */
290	export async function updateOrderItem(
291	  itemsId: string,
292	  updates: Partial<OrderItem>,
293	  updatedBy?: string
294	): Promise<OrderItem> {
295	  const updatePayload: any = { ...updates };
296	  if (updates.quantity !== undefined || updates.product_price !== undefined) {
297	    const quantity = Number(updates.quantity ?? 1);
298	    const price = Number(updates.product_price ?? 0);
299	    updatePayload.total_price = quantity * price;
300	  }
301	  updatePayload.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
302	  updatePayload.updated_by = updatedBy || null;
303	
304	  try {
305	    const res = await apiClient.patch<{ success: boolean; data: OrderItem }>(`/api/v1/operations/order-items/${itemsId}`, updatePayload);
306	    return res.data || ({ items_id: itemsId, ...updatePayload } as OrderItem);
307	  } catch (err) {
308	    console.warn('[productService] updateOrderItem fallback:', err);
309	    return { items_id: itemsId, ...updatePayload } as OrderItem;
310	  }
311	}
312	
313	/**
314	 * إرجاع منتج مؤمن - تغيير حالة البند وإعادة المبلغ للعميل
315	 * Return an insured item - changes status to 'مرتجع' and logs a refund
316	 */
317	export async function returnOrderItem(
318	  itemsId: string,
319	  updatedBy?: string
320	): Promise<{ item: OrderItem; refundAmount: number }> {
321	  const existingItems = await fetchOrderItems();
322	  const existing = existingItems.find(i => i.items_id === itemsId);
323	
324	  if (!existing) {
325	    throw new Error('Order item not found');
326	  }
327	
328	  if (!existing.is_insured) {
329	    throw new Error('Only insured items can be returned (is_insured must be true)');
330	  }
331	
332	  const updatedItem = await updateOrderItem(itemsId, { items_status: 'مرتجع' as ItemStatus }, updatedBy);
333	  const refundAmount = Number(existing.total_price || 0) + Number(existing.insurance_fee || 0);
334	
335	  return { item: updatedItem, refundAmount };
336	}

345	  } catch (err) {
346	    console.warn('[productService] deleteOrderItem fallback:', err);
347	  }
348	}

async function writeHistory(
  client: PoolClient,
  input: {
    orderId: string;
    orderNumber: string;
    actorId: string;
    eventType: string;
    operation: string;
    beforeData?: unknown;
    afterData?: unknown;
    shipmentId?: string;
    summary: string;
  },
): Promise<void> {
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO public.orders_history
      (orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, source, summary, before_data, after_data, metadata, occurred_at, created_by, updated_by)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'api', $6, 'order', $7, 'alx_api', $8, $9::jsonb, $10::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb, NOW(), $7, $7)`,
    [
      `hist_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
      input.orderId,
      input.orderNumber,
      input.shipmentId ?? null,
      input.eventType,
      input.operation,
      input.actorId,
      input.summary,
      JSON.stringify(input.beforeData ?? null),
      JSON.stringify(input.afterData ?? null),
    ],
  );
}

export function createOperationsRepository(pool: Pool): OperationsRepository {
  return {
    async deleteOrdersWithDependents({ orderIds }) {
      const result = await pool.query<{ summary: unknown }>(
        'SELECT public.delete_orders_with_dependents($1::text[]) AS summary',
        [orderIds],
      );
      const summary = result.rows[0]?.summary;
      if (!summary || typeof summary !== 'object' || Array.isArray(summary)) {
        throw new Error('ORDER_DELETION_SUMMARY_MISSING');
      }
      return summary as Record<string, unknown>;
    },
    listOrders: (input) =>
      page(
        pool,
        'orders',
        'order_id AS "orderId", order_number AS "orderNumber", tracking_number AS "trackingNumber", customer_id AS "customerId", order_status_id AS "orderStatusId", order_status1 AS "orderStatus", order_party_id AS "orderPartyId", order_party_type AS "orderPartyType", delivery_courier_id AS "deliveryCourierId", shipping_courier_id AS "shippingCourierId", currency, order_currency AS "orderCurrency", order_currency_price AS "orderCurrencyPrice", external_order_number AS "externalOrderNumber", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"',
        'created_at DESC, order_id ASC',
        input,
        ['order_number', 'external_order_number', 'tracking_number'],
      ),
    async getOrder(orderId) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        'SELECT order_id AS "orderId", order_number AS "orderNumber", tracking_number AS "trackingNumber", customer_id AS "customerId", order_status_id AS "orderStatusId", order_status1 AS "orderStatus", order_party_id AS "orderPartyId", order_party_type AS "orderPartyType", delivery_courier_id AS "deliveryCourierId", shipping_courier_id AS "shippingCourierId", currency, order_currency AS "orderCurrency", order_currency_price AS "orderCurrencyPrice", external_order_number AS "externalOrderNumber", data, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = $1 LIMIT 1',
        [orderId],
      );
      if (!result.rows[0]) return null;
      const items = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${orderItemColumns} FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, order_item_id ASC`,
        [orderId],
      );
      const shipments = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${shipmentColumns} FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, shipment_id ASC`,
        [orderId],
      );
      return { ...result.rows[0], items: items.rows, shipments: shipments.rows };
    },
    async listOrderHistory(orderId) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        'SELECT orders_history_id AS "historyId", order_id AS "orderId", order_number AS "orderNumber", shipment_id AS "shipmentId", event_type AS "eventType", event_category AS "eventCategory", operation, entity_type AS "entityType", actor_id AS "actorId", actor_name AS "actorName", actor_role AS "actorRole", source, summary, before_data AS "beforeData", after_data AS "afterData", metadata, occurred_at AS "occurredAt" FROM public.orders_history WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, orders_history_id ASC',
        [orderId],
      );
      return result.rows;
    },
    listShipments: (input) =>
      page(
        pool,
        'shipments',
        'shipment_id AS "shipmentId", order_id AS "orderId", tracking_number AS "trackingNumber", shipping_company_id AS "shippingCompanyId", courier_id AS "courierId", shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus", shipping_cost AS "shippingCost", weight, shipping_type AS "shippingType", shipping_source AS "shippingSource", shipping_destination AS "shippingDestination", shipping_date AS "shippingDate", expected_arrival AS "expectedArrival", delivery_date AS "deliveryDate", carton_count AS "cartonCount", customs_fee AS "customsFee", tax_fee AS "taxFee", category_fees_total AS "categoryFeesTotal", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"',
        'created_at DESC NULLS LAST, shipment_id ASC',
        input,
        ['tracking_number', 'order_id', 'shipment_status'],
      ),
    async getShipment(shipmentId) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${shipmentColumns} FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
        [shipmentId],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async listTracking(shipmentId) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        'SELECT orders_history_id AS "historyId", order_id AS "orderId", order_number AS "orderNumber", shipment_id AS "shipmentId", event_type AS "eventType", event_category AS "eventCategory", operation, summary, after_data AS "afterData", metadata, occurred_at AS "occurredAt" FROM public.orders_history WHERE shipment_id = $1 ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, orders_history_id ASC',
        [shipmentId],
      );
      return result.rows;
    },
    listProducts: (input) =>
      page(
        pool,
        'products',
        'product_id AS "productId", product_name_ar AS "productNameAr", product_name_en AS "productNameEn", product_url AS "productUrl", product_price_currency AS "productPriceCurrency", unit_price AS "unitPrice", item_category_id AS "itemCategoryId", cbm, width, height, length, weight, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"',
        'created_at DESC NULLS LAST, product_id ASC',
        input,
        ['product_name_ar', 'product_name_en', 'product_id'],
      ),
    async getProduct(productId) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        'SELECT product_id AS "productId", product_name_ar AS "productNameAr", product_name_en AS "productNameEn", product_url AS "productUrl", product_price_currency AS "productPriceCurrency", unit_price AS "unitPrice", item_category_id AS "itemCategoryId", cbm, width, height, length, weight, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.products WHERE product_id = $1 LIMIT 1',
        [productId],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async createOrder(input: CreateOrderInput) {
      const client = await pool.connect();
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        const idem = await client.query(
          'SELECT response_data FROM alx_api_private.operation_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = $1 FOR UPDATE',
          [input.idempotencyKey],
        );
        if (idem.rows[0]) {
          await client.query('COMMIT');
          return idem.rows[0].response_data as Record<string, unknown>;
        }
        const orderId = input.orderNumber;

async function page(
  pool: Pool,
  table: string,
  columns: string,
  order: string,
  input: PageQuery,
  searchColumns: string[],
): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  const values: unknown[] = [];
  const filters: string[] = [];
  if (input.search) {
    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
  }
  if (input.customerId) {
    values.push(input.customerId);
    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
  }
  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
    values,
  );
  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
}

import type { Response } from 'express';

export interface ApiErrorDetails {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  details: ReadonlyArray<{ field?: string; message: string }>;
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ApiSuccess<T> {
  success: true;
  data: T;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ApiFailure {
  success: false;
  error: ApiErrorDetails;
}

export function sendSuccess<T>(
  response: Response,
  data: T,
  requestId: string,
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Response<ApiSuccess<T>> {
  const body: ApiSuccess<T> = meta === undefined
    ? { success: true, data, requestId }
    : { success: true, data, meta, requestId };
  return response.json(body);
}

export function sendFailure(
  response: Response,
  status: number,
  code: string,
  message: string,
  requestId: string,
  details: ReadonlyArray<{ field?: string; message: string }> = [],
): Response<ApiFailure> {
  return response.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    error: { code, message, details, requestId },
  });
}
