174	export const autoEntryService = {
175	  /**
176	   * Ensuring auto_entries collection is seeded with defaults if empty
177	   */
178	  async ensureAutoEntries(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
179	    try {
180	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'auto_entries'));
181	      if (snap.empty) {
182	        for (const rule of DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES) {
183	          await setDoc(doc(db, 'auto_entries', rule.id), {
184	            ...rule,
185	            createdAt: Date.now()
186	          });
187	        }
188	        return DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES;
189	      }
190	      return snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() } as AutoEntryRule));
191	    } catch (err) {
192	      console.error('[autoEntryService] ensureAutoEntries failed:', err);
193	      return DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES;
194	    }
195	  },
196	
197	  /**
198	   * Get auto entries linked to a specific statusId
199	   */
200	  async getAutoEntriesForStatus(statusId: number | string): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
201	    try {
202	      const all = await this.ensureAutoEntries();
203	      const numId = typeof statusId === 'number' ? statusId : parseInt(String(statusId), 10);
204	      return all.filter(r => (r.statusId === numId || String(r.statusId) === String(statusId)) && r.isActive);
205	    } catch (err) {
206	      console.error('[autoEntryService] getAutoEntriesForStatus failed:', err);
207	      return [];
208	    }
209	  },
210	
211	  /**
212	   * Create or update an auto entry rule
213	   */
214	  async saveAutoEntry(rule: AutoEntryRule): Promise<void> {
215	    const id = rule.id || `auto_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
216	    const { currency, ...ruleWithoutCurrency } = rule;
217	    const normalizedCurrency = normalizeOptionalAutoEntryCurrency(currency);
218	    const payload = {
219	      ...ruleWithoutCurrency,
220	      id,
221	      updatedAt: Date.now(),
222	      ...(normalizedCurrency ? { currency: normalizedCurrency } : {}),
223	    };
224	    if (!normalizedCurrency) {
225	      const { error } = await (supabase as any).from('auto_entries').update({ currency: null }).eq('auto_entry_id', id);
226	      if (error) console.warn('[autoEntryService] Unable to clear the stored voucher currency:', error.message);
227	    }
228	    // كتابة مستبدِلة متعمدة: حذف currency من الوثيقة عند الاعتماد على عملة الطلب الافتراضية.
229	    await setDoc(doc(db, 'auto_entries', id), payload);
230	  },
231	
232	  /**
233	   * Delete an auto entry rule
234	   */
235	  async deleteAutoEntry(ruleId: string): Promise<void> {
236	    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'auto_entries', ruleId));
237	  },
238	
239	  /**
240	   * Execute auto entries for a given statusId when order transitions
241	   */
242	  async executeAutoEntriesForStatus(
243	    statusId: number | string,
244	    order: any,
245	    context: {
246	      courier?: any;
247	      deliveryCourier?: any;
248	      shippingCourier?: any;
249	      customer?: any;
250	      orderParty?: any;
251	      purchaseSource?: any;
252	      shippingCompany?: any;
253	      sourcing_cost?: any;
254	      isAr?: boolean;
255	      profileName?: string;
256	      rawAmountOverride?: number;
257	      amountOriginal?: number;
258	      currencyOriginal?: string;
259	      paidCurrency?: string;
260	      /** توزيعات الدفعة المقدمة (نقد/بنك) — تُنفَّذ قيداً لكل توزيع على الحساب الذي اختاره المستخدم */
261	      downPaymentAllocations?: Array<{
262	        method?: 'cash' | 'bank';
263	        accountId: string;
264	        accountCode?: string;
265	        accountName?: string;
266	        amount: number;
267	        bankReference?: string;
268	      }>;
269	    }
270	  ): Promise<string[]> {
271	    const executedRuleIds: string[] = [];
272	    try {
273	      const resolvedStatusId = statusId ?? order?.order_status_id ?? order?.orderStatusId ?? 1;
274	      const rules = await this.getAutoEntriesForStatus(resolvedStatusId);
275	      const exchangeRates = await financialAccountService.getExchangeRates();
276	      for (const rule of rules) {
277	        if (!rule.isActive) continue;
278	        const calculated = calculateAutoEntryAmount(
279	          order,
280	          rule,
281	          (amount, fromCurrency, toCurrency) => financialAccountService.convertToTargetCurrency(
282	            amount,
283	            fromCurrency,
284	            toCurrency,
285	            exchangeRates,
286	          ),
287	        );
288	        const amount = context.rawAmountOverride !== undefined
289	          ? context.rawAmountOverride
290	          : calculated.amount;
291	        const currency = context.currencyOriginal || calculated.currency;
292	        const amountSources = getRuleAmountSources(rule);
293	        const automationKey = buildAutomaticVoucherKey(String(order.id || order.orderNumber), rule.id, resolvedStatusId);
294	
295	        if ((rule.skipWhenZero ?? true) && amount <= 0) {
296	          continue;
297	        }
298	
299	        // ============================================================
300	        // قيد الدفعة المقدمة — Order Down Payment Entry Logic
301	        // ============================================================
302	        // إذا كان نوع الدفع متعدد (نقد + بنك): ننشئ قيداً مركباً واحداً بثلاثة أطراف
303	        // If payment is mixed (cash + bank): create a single 3-party compound entry
304	        // أما إذا كان الدفع بطريقة واحدة: ننشئ قيداً بسيطاً (سطر واحد للمدين)
305	        // Otherwise (single payment method): create a regular debit entry per allocation
306	
307	        // بناء قائمة توزيعات الدفع (نقد + بنك) — build payment allocations (cash + bank)
308	        const effectiveAllocations = (context.downPaymentAllocations && context.downPaymentAllocations.length > 0)
309	          ? context.downPaymentAllocations
310	          : (order?.paymentMethod === 'Mixed' || ((order?.cashAmount || 0) > 0 && (order?.bankAmount || 0) > 0))
311	            ? [
312	                ...(order?.cashAccountId && (order?.cashAmount || 0) > 0
313	                  ? [{ method: 'cash' as const, accountId: order.cashAccountId, amount: Number(order.cashAmount) || 0 }]
314	                  : []),
315	                ...(order?.bankAccountId && (order?.bankAmount || 0) > 0
316	                  ? [{ method: 'bank' as const, accountId: order.bankAccountId, amount: Number(order.bankAmount) || 0, bankReference: order.bankReference || '' }]
317	                  : [])
318	              ]
319	            : undefined;
320	
321	        if (rule.id === 'order_down_payment' && effectiveAllocations && effectiveAllocations.length > 0) {
322	
323	          const paidCurrency = String(context.paidCurrency || order?.paidCurrency || order?.currency || 'YER').toUpperCase();
324	          const activeAllocations = effectiveAllocations.filter(
325	            (alloc) => alloc && alloc.accountId && (Number(alloc.amount) || 0) > 0
326	          );
327	          if (activeAllocations.length === 0) continue;
328	
329	          // القيد المركب: يتطلب طرفين مدينين (صندوق + بنك) وطرف دائن (العميل)
330	          // Compound entry: requires 2 debit lines (cash + bank) and 1 credit line (customer)
331	          if (activeAllocations.length >= 2) {
332	            // حساب العميل الدائن — resolve credit account (customer)
333	            const orderPartyAccount = context.orderParty || context.customer;
334	            const customerAccountId = orderPartyAccount?.financialAccountId
335	              || orderPartyAccount?.accountId
336	              || orderPartyAccount?.linkedAccountId
337	              || orderPartyAccount?.account_id;
338	
339	            if (!customerAccountId) {
340	              console.warn('[autoEntryService] لا يمكن إنشاء القيد المركب: حساب العميل غير مرتبط.', { orderId: order?.id, automationKey });
341	              continue;
342	            }
343	
344	            const totalAmount = activeAllocations.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (Number(a.amount) || 0), 0);
345	            if (!(totalAmount > 0)) continue;
346	
347	            // التحقق من عدم تنفيذ القيد مسبقاً (منع التكرار) — duplicate check
348	            const previousExec = await (supabase as any)
349	              .from('main_entry')
350	              .select('main_entry_id')
351	              .eq('automation_key', automationKey)
352	              .limit(1);
353	            if ((previousExec.data || []).length > 0) {
354	              console.info('[autoEntryService] Compound entry duplicate prevented.', { automationKey });
355	              executedRuleIds.push(rule.id);
356	              continue;
357	            }
358	
359	            // جلب تفاصيل حساب العميل الدائن — fetch customer credit account details
360	            const customerAccount = await financialAccountService.getAccountById(customerAccountId);
361	            const customerCurNo = customerAccount?.curNo || 0;
362	            const customerCurrencyCode = customerAccount?.currency || currency;
363	
364	            // بناء أسطر القيد المركب — build compound entry lines asynchronously with resolved account details
365	            const debitLines = await Promise.all(
366	              activeAllocations.map(async (alloc) => {
367	                const allocAmount = Number(alloc.amount) || 0;
368	                const convertedAllocAmount = currency === paidCurrency
369	                  ? allocAmount
370	                  : financialAccountService.convertToTargetCurrency(allocAmount, paidCurrency, currency, exchangeRates);
371	
372	                const allocAcc = await financialAccountService.getAccountById(alloc.accountId);
373	                return {
374	                  account: {
375	                    id: alloc.accountId,
376	                    curNo: allocAcc?.curNo || 0,
377	                    currency: allocAcc?.currency || currency,
378	                    entityType: allocAcc?.entityType,
379	                    entityId: allocAcc?.entityId,
380	                  },
381	                  transType: 'Debit' as const,
382	                  amountOriginal: convertedAllocAmount,
383	                  paymentMethod: ((alloc as any).method === 'bank' ? 'bank' : 'cash') as 'cash' | 'bank',
384	                  bankReference: (alloc as any).bankReference || '',
385	                };
386	              })
387	            );
388	
389	            const compoundLines = [
390	              ...debitLines,
391	              {
392	                account: {
393	                  id: customerAccountId,
394	                  curNo: customerCurNo,
395	                  currency: customerCurrencyCode,
396	                  entityType: customerAccount?.entityType,
397	                  entityId: customerAccount?.entityId,
398	                },
399	                transType: 'Credit' as const,
400	                amountOriginal: totalAmount,
401	              },
402	            ];
403	
404	            // تحديد حالة ترحيل القيد بناءً على autoPost — determine posting status from autoPost
405	            const postingStatus = rule.autoPost === false ? 'draft' : 'posted';
406	
407	            try {
408	              await financialEntryService.createCompoundFromLegacyVoucher({
409	                entryNumber: automationKey,
410	                createdAt: Date.now(),
411	                description: (context.isAr ?? true)
412	                  ? (rule.descriptionTempAr || rule.nameAr).replace('{orderNumber}', order?.orderNumber || '')
413	                  : (rule.descriptionTempEn || rule.nameEn).replace('{orderNumber}', order?.orderNumber || ''),
414	                currency,
415	                module: 'payment',
416	                refNumber: order?.orderNumber || '',
417	                orderId: order?.id,
418	                automationKey,
419	                autoRuleId: rule.id,
420	                isAutomatic: true,
421	                createdByUid: context.profileName || 'system',
422	                postingStatus,
423	                lines: compoundLines,
424	              });
425	              console.info('[autoEntryService] قيد مركب للدفع المتعدد أُنشئ بنجاح — Compound entry created for mixed payment.', { automationKey, totalAmount, currency, postingStatus });
426	              executedRuleIds.push(rule.id);
427	            } catch (compoundErr) {
428	              console.error('[autoEntryService] فشل إنشاء القيد المركب — Failed to create compound entry:', compoundErr);
429	            }
430	            continue;
431	          }
432	
433	          // دفعة واحدة: قيد بسيط لكل توزيع — Single allocation: simple debit per allocation
434	          for (let allocIndex = 0; allocIndex < activeAllocations.length; allocIndex++) {
435	            const allocation = activeAllocations[allocIndex];
436	            const allocAmount = Number(allocation.amount) || 0;
437	            const convertedAllocAmount = currency === paidCurrency
438	              ? allocAmount
439	              : financialAccountService.convertToTargetCurrency(allocAmount, paidCurrency, currency, exchangeRates);
440	            if (!(convertedAllocAmount > 0)) continue;
441	            const executedAllocation = await financialAccountService.triggerAutomaticVoucher(rule.id, order, {
442	              courier: context.courier,
443	              deliveryCourier: context.deliveryCourier,
444	              shippingCourier: context.shippingCourier,
445	              customer: context.customer,
446	              orderParty: context.orderParty || context.customer,
447	              purchaseSource: context.purchaseSource,
448	              shippingCompany: context.shippingCompany,
449	              sourcing_cost: context.sourcing_cost,
450	              isAr: context.isAr ?? true,
451	              rawAmount: convertedAllocAmount,
452	              amountOriginal: convertedAllocAmount,
453	              currencyOriginal: currency,
454	              profileName: context.profileName || 'System Status Automation',
455	              statusId: resolvedStatusId,
456	              automationKey: `${automationKey}:alloc:${allocIndex + 1}`,
457	              autoRuleId: rule.id,
458	              amountSources,
459	              debitAccountOverride: {
460	                id: allocation.accountId,
461	                code: (allocation as any).accountCode || '',
462	                name: (allocation as any).accountName || '',
463	              },
464	              // مرجع الحوالة البنكية يظهر كرقم مرجعي للسند
465	              expenseNumber: allocation.bankReference || order?.orderNumber || '',
466	              // تمرير autoPost من قاعدة القيد — pass autoPost from rule to respect posting preference
467	              autoPost: rule.autoPost,
468	            });
469	            if (executedAllocation) executedRuleIds.push(rule.id);
470	          }
471	          continue;
472	        }
473	
474	        const executed = await financialAccountService.triggerAutomaticVoucher(rule.id, order, {
475	          courier: context.courier,
476	          deliveryCourier: context.deliveryCourier,
477	          shippingCourier: context.shippingCourier,
478	          customer: context.customer,
479	          orderParty: context.orderParty || context.customer,
480	          purchaseSource: context.purchaseSource,
481	          shippingCompany: context.shippingCompany,
482	          sourcing_cost: context.sourcing_cost,
483	          isAr: context.isAr ?? true,
484	          rawAmount: amount,
485	          amountOriginal: context.amountOriginal ?? amount,
486	          currencyOriginal: currency,
487	          profileName: context.profileName || 'System Status Automation',
488	          statusId: resolvedStatusId,
489	          automationKey,
490	          autoRuleId: rule.id,
491	          amountSources,
492	          amountBreakdown: calculated.breakdown,
493	          autoPost: rule.autoPost,
494	        });
495	
496	        if (executed) executedRuleIds.push(rule.id);
497	      }
498	    } catch (err) {
499	      console.error(`[autoEntryService] Error executing auto entries for statusId ${statusId}:`, err);
500	    }
501	    return executedRuleIds;
502	  }
503	};
504

#### Thinking

Legacy touchpoints inside autoEntryService:
1. Line 2: Import from legacy-compat (collection/getDocs/setDoc/doc/updateDoc/deleteDoc/db/supabase).
2. ensureAutoEntries: getDocs on auto_entries; seed default values via setDoc.
3. saveAutoEntry: setDoc + supabase.from('auto_entries').update({currency:null}).
4. deleteAutoEntry: deleteDoc.
5. executeAutoEntriesForStatus: duplicate check via supabase.from('main_entry').select with automation_key as the condition.

Backend support:
- GET /api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules (listing, active only) — but ensureAutoEntries seeds defaults when empty. API auto-entry-rules CRUD routes do exist (create/update/delete/get were there previously: listAutoEntryRules/getAutoEntryRule/createAutoEntryRule/updateAutoEntryRule/deleteAutoEntryRule). Check the paths of those routes inside finance.routes (already existing). Probably GET /auto-entry-rules, GET /auto-entry-rules/:id, POST, PATCH, DELETE.
- Duplicate check via automation_key: does the API expose lookup by automationKey? The backend's createEntry has automationKey. Is there a GET entries?automationKey= route? listEntries only supports search. Hmm. The atomic RPC create_financial_entry_v2 probably handles idempotency via automation_key (unique constraint). The legacy duplicate check was to avoid double creation. If the backend enforces a unique automation_key, then createCompoundFromLegacyVoucher would fail on duplicates. financialEntryService.createCompoundFromLegacyVoucher — is it already API-only? Step 9 of the task made the gateway API-only. Check the imports of financialEntryService: probably uses ApiClient (API-only since step 9). Duplicate check via supabase is legacy → replacement proposal: query the API's entries listing with automationKey search? listEntries search matches entry_number/description with ILIKE. entryNumber = automationKey is passed on creation, so if it exists then a search by automationKey should match entry_number. - `src/config/legacy-boundary.baseline.json` أُعيد توليده؛ `api-contract-matrix.ts`: products و returns أصبحا available؛ `select-fields.ts`: حُذفت إسقاطات product/orderItem/returnedProduct الميتة؛ `server/productsManagementWiring.test.ts` حُدّث ليطابق الواقع.

- فحص معلوماتي (قراءة فقط عبر information_schema بحساب alx_api_runtime): جداول المالية كلها موجودة حيًّا: assets, account, acc_main, acc_sub, acc_sub_group, accounts, default_accounts, salary_history, account_id_migration_map, entry_module, entry_type, settings, auto_entries, main_entry, account_trans. جدول system_accounts غير موجود.
- صلاحيات alx_api_runtime على كل الجداول أعلاه: INSERT/REFERENCES/SELECT/TRIGGER/TRUNCATE/UPDATE — بدون DELETE. لذلك الحذف الفعلي عبر SQL مباشر سيفشل (42501) حتى يُنفّذ ترحيل GRANT DELETE المخطط (0023). الحذف المالي الحالي يعمل عبر RPCات security-definer الموجودة (delete_financial_entry...).
- RPCات موجودة وقابلة للتنفيذ من runtime: manage_financial_entry_setting(p_kind,p_action,p_id,p_payload) و recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(p_account_id) و recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(p_account_ids text[]) — كلها SECURITY DEFINER و execute=true. ستُستخدم بدل no-op supabase stubs.
- جدول assets الحيّ ينقصه أعمدة تستخدمها الواجهة: category, cost, purchase_date, assigned_courier_id, assigned_courier_name, notes, maintenance_logs (jsonb). سيُنشأ ترحيل 0023 يضيفها بـ ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + صلاحيات DELETE المطلوبة. الترحيل لا يُنفَّذ من جانبنا (DDL محظور على runtime) — يُنفَّذ يدويًا من المستخدم عبر لوحة Supabase مع 0021 و0022.
- جولة ترحيلات قيد الانتظار عند المستخدم: 0021_public_tracking.sql، 0022_products_is_allowed.sql، و0023 (قادم في مرحلة المالية).
=====

174	export const autoEntryService = {
175	  /**
176	   * Ensuring auto_entries collection is seeded with defaults if empty
177	   */
178	  async ensureAutoEntries(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
179	    try {
180	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'auto_entries'));
181	      if (snap.empty) {
182	        for (const rule of DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES) {
183	          await setDoc(doc(db, 'auto_entries', rule.id), {
184	            ...rule,
185	            createdAt: Date.now()
186	          });
187	        }
188	        return DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES;
189	      }
190	      return snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() } as AutoEntryRule));
191	    } catch (err) {
192	      console.error('[autoEntryService] ensureAutoEntries failed:', err);
193	      return DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES;
194	    }
195	  },
196	
197	  /**
198	   * Get auto entries linked to a specific statusId
199	   */
200	  async getAutoEntriesForStatus(statusId: number | string): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
201	    try {
202	      const all = await this.ensureAutoEntries();
203	      const numId = typeof statusId === 'number' ? statusId : parseInt(String(statusId), 10);
204	      return all.filter(r => (r.statusId === numId || String(r.statusId) === String(statusId)) && r.isActive);
205	    } catch (err) {
206	      console.error('[autoEntryService] getAutoEntriesForStatus failed:', err);
207	      return [];
208	    }
209	  },
210

212	   * Create or update an auto entry rule
213	   */
214	  async saveAutoEntry(rule: AutoEntryRule): Promise<void> {
215	    const id = rule.id || `auto_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
216	    const { currency, ...ruleWithoutCurrency } = rule;
217	    const normalizedCurrency = normalizeOptionalAutoEntryCurrency(currency);
218	    const payload = {
219	      ...ruleWithoutCurrency,
220	      id,
221	      updatedAt: Date.now(),
222	      ...(normalizedCurrency ? { currency: normalizedCurrency } : {}),
223	    };
224	    if (!normalizedCurrency) {
225	      const { error } = await (supabase as any).from('auto_entries').update({ currency: null }).eq('auto_entry_id', id);
226	      if (error) console.warn('[autoEntryService] Unable to clear the stored voucher currency:', error.message);
227	    }
228	    // كتابة مستبدِلة متعمدة: حذف currency من الوثيقة عند الاعتماد على عملة الطلب الافتراضية.
229	    await setDoc(doc(db, 'auto_entries', id), payload);
230	  },

239	  /**
240	   * Execute auto entries for a given statusId when order transitions
241	   */
242	  async executeAutoEntriesForStatus(
243	    statusId: number | string,
244	    order: any,
245	    context: {
246	      courier?: any;
247	      deliveryCourier?: any;
248	      shippingCourier?: any;
249	      customer?: any;
250	      orderParty?: any;
251	      purchaseSource?: any;
252	      shippingCompany?: any;
253	      sourcing_cost?: any;
254	      isAr?: boolean;
255	      profileName?: string;
256	      rawAmountOverride?: number;
257	      amountOriginal?: number;
258	      currencyOriginal?: string;
259	      paidCurrency?: string;
260	      /** توزيعات الدفعة المقدمة (نقد/بنك) — تُنفَّذ قيداً لكل توزيع على الحساب الذي اختاره المستخدم */
261	      downPaymentAllocations?: Array<{
262	        method?: 'cash' | 'bank';
263	        accountId: string;
264	        accountCode?: string;
265	        accountName?: string;
266	        amount: number;
267	        bankReference?: string;
268	      }>;
269	    }
270	  ): Promise<string[]> {
271	    const executedRuleIds: string[] = [];
272	    try {
273	      const resolvedStatusId = statusId ?? order?.order_status_id ?? order?.orderStatusId ?? 1;
274	      const rules = await this.getAutoEntriesForStatus(resolvedStatusId);
275	      const exchangeRates = await financialAccountService.getExchangeRates();
276	      for (const rule of rules) {
277	        if (!rule.isActive) continue;
278	        const calculated = calculateAutoEntryAmount(
279	          order,
280	          rule,
281	          (amount, fromCurrency, toCurrency) => financialAccountService.convertToTargetCurrency(
282	            amount,
283	            fromCurrency,
284	            toCurrency,
285	            exchangeRates,
286	          ),
287	        );
288	        const amount = context.rawAmountOverride !== undefined

292	        const amountSources = getRuleAmountSources(rule);
293	        const automationKey = buildAutomaticVoucherKey(String(order.id || order.orderNumber), rule.id, resolvedStatusId);
294	
295	        if ((rule.skipWhenZero ?? true) && amount <= 0) {
296	          continue;
297	        }
298	
299	        // ============================================================
300	        // قيد الدفعة المقدمة — Order Down Payment Entry Logic
301	        // ============================================================
302	        // إذا كان نوع الدفع متعدد (نقد + بنك): ننشئ قيداً مركباً واحداً بثلاثة أطراف
303	        // If payment is mixed (cash + bank): create a single 3-party compound entry
304	        // أما إذا كان الدفع بطريقة واحدة: ننشئ قيداً بسيطاً (سطر واحد للمدين)
305	        // Otherwise (single payment method): create a regular debit entry per allocation
306	
307	        // بناء قائمة توزيعات الدفع (نقد + بنك) — build payment allocations (cash + bank)
308	        const effectiveAllocations = (context.downPaymentAllocations && context.downPaymentAllocations.length > 0)
309	          ? context.downPaymentAllocations
310	          : (order?.paymentMethod === 'Mixed' || ((order?.cashAmount || 0) > 0 && (order?.bankAmount || 0) > 0))
311	            ? [
312	                ...(order?.cashAccountId && (order?.cashAmount || 0) > 0
313	                  ? [{ method: 'cash' as const, accountId: order.cashAccountId, amount: Number(order.cashAmount) || 0 }]
314	                  : []),
315	                ...(order?.bankAccountId && (order?.bankAmount || 0) > 0
316	                  ? [{ method: 'bank' as const, accountId: order.bankAccountId, amount: Number(order.bankAmount) || 0, bankReference: order.bankReference || '' }]
317	                  : [])
318	              ]
319	            : undefined;
320	
321	        if (rule.id === 'order_down_payment' && effectiveAllocations && effectiveAllocations.length > 0) {
322	
323	          const paidCurrency = String(context.paidCurrency || order?.paidCurrency || order?.currency || 'YER').toUpperCase();
324	          const activeAllocations = effectiveAllocations.filter(
325	            (alloc) => alloc && alloc.accountId && (Number(alloc.amount) || 0) > 0
326	          );
327	          if (activeAllocations.length === 0) continue;
328	
329	          // القيد المركب: يتطلب طرفين مدينين (صندوق + بنك) وطرف دائن (العميل)
330	          // Compound entry: requires 2 debit lines (cash + bank) and 1 credit line (customer)
331	          if (activeAllocations.length >= 2) {
332	            // حساب العميل الدائن — resolve credit account (customer)
333	            const orderPartyAccount = context.orderParty || context.customer;
334	            const customerAccountId = orderPartyAccount?.financialAccountId
335	              || orderPartyAccount?.accountId
336	              || orderPartyAccount?.linkedAccountId
337	              || orderPartyAccount?.account_id;
338	
339	            if (!customerAccountId) {
340	              console.warn('[autoEntryService] لا يمكن إنشاء القيد المركب: حساب العميل غير مرتبط.', { orderId: order?.id, automationKey });

342	            }

344	            const totalAmount = activeAllocations.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (Number(a.amount) || 0), 0);
345	            if (!(totalAmount > 0)) continue;

35	export const naturalBalanceDelta = (
36	  accountType: string | undefined,
37	  transactionType: 'Debit' | 'Credit',
38	  amount: number,
39	): number => {
40	  const normalizedAmount = Number(amount || 0);
41	  const debitNormal = accountType === 'Asset' || accountType === 'Expense';
42	  if (debitNormal) return transactionType === 'Debit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;
43	  return transactionType === 'Credit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;

47	export const hierarchyCodeRules = {
48	  nextRootCode(records: any[]): string {
49	    const used = new Set((records || []).map(readCode).filter((code) => /^\d$/.test(code)));
50	    let next = 1;
51	    while (used.has(String(next))) next += 1;
52	    if (next > 9) throw new Error('لا يمكن إنشاء حساب رئيسي جديد: نطاق أكواد الجذر المكوّن من رقم واحد ممتلئ.');
53	    return String(next);
54	  },
55	
56	  nextChildCode(parentCode: string, records: any[]): string {
57	    const normalizedParent = onlyDigits(parentCode);
58	    if (!normalizedParent || normalizedParent.length >= 4) {
59	      throw new Error('رمز الأب غير صالح لإنشاء عقدة فرعية.');
60	    }
61	    const childNumbers = (records || [])
62	      .map(readCode)
63	      .filter((code) => code.startsWith(normalizedParent) && /^\d+$/.test(code))
64	      .map((code) => code.slice(normalizedParent.length))
65	      .filter((suffix) => /^\d$/.test(suffix))
66	      .map(Number);
67	    const next = Math.max(0, ...childNumbers) + 1;
68	    if (next > 9) throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء عقدة أخرى تحت ${normalizedParent}: نطاق التسلسل ممتلئ.`);
69	    return `${normalizedParent}${next}`;
70	  },
71	
72	  postingPrefix(accSubCode: string, groupCode?: string): string {
73	    const selected = onlyDigits(groupCode || accSubCode);
74	    if (!selected || selected.length > 4) {
75	      throw new Error('يجب اختيار حساب جزئي صالح، ومجموعة اختيارية ذات كود صالح، قبل إنشاء حساب مالي.');
76	    }
77	    return selected.padEnd(4, '0');
78	  },
79	
80	  nextPostingSequence(prefix: string, records: any[]): number {
81	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
82	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4) throw new Error('بادئة الحساب المالي يجب أن تتكون من أربعة أرقام.');
83	    return (records || []).reduce((maximum, record) => {
84	      const explicitSequence = Number(readValue(record, 'accountSeq', 'account_seq') || 0);
85	      const codeMatch = readCode(record).match(new RegExp(`^${normalizedPrefix}-(\\d{1,4})$`));
86	      const codeSequence = codeMatch ? Number(codeMatch[1]) : 0;
87	      return Math.max(maximum, Number.isInteger(explicitSequence) ? explicitSequence : 0, codeSequence);
88	    }, 0) + 1;
89	  },
90	
91	  formatPostingCode(prefix: string, sequence: number): string {
92	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
93	    const normalizedSequence = Number(sequence);
94	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4 || !Number.isInteger(normalizedSequence) || normalizedSequence < 1 || normalizedSequence > 9999) {
95	      throw new Error('كود الحساب المالي أو تسلسله غير صالح.');
96	    }
97	    return `${normalizedPrefix}-${String(normalizedSequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;
98	  },
99	
100	  validateCode(kind: HierarchyCodeKind, code: string, parents: { accountCode?: string; mainCode?: string; subCode?: string; groupCode?: string }): string | null {
101	    const normalized = String(code || '').trim();
102	    if (kind === 'account') return /^\d$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الرئيسي يجب أن يكون رقمًا واحدًا.';
103	    if (kind === 'main') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.accountCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{2}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الفرعي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الرئيسي مباشرة.';
104	    if (kind === 'sub') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.mainCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{3}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الجزئي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الفرعي مباشرة.';
105	    if (kind === 'group') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.subCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{4}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود المجموعة يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الجزئي مباشرة.';
106	
107	    const prefix = this.postingPrefix(parents.subCode || '', parents.groupCode);

156	  async getEntityPostingLocation(entityType: LedgerEntityType): Promise<AccountGroupLocation | null> {
157	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub_group'));
158	    const group = snap.docs
159	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
160	      .find((entry: any) => readValue(entry, 'entityType', 'entity_type') === entityType
161	        && entry.isActive !== false
162	        && entry.is_active !== false
163	        && readValue(entry, 'allowsDirectAccounts', 'allows_direct_accounts') !== false);
164	    if (!group) return null;
165	
166	    const accountCode = readCode(group);
167	    const accSubId = String(readValue(group, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') || '').trim();
168	    if (!accountCode || !accSubId) return null;
169	    const curNo = readValue(group, 'curNo', 'cur_no');
170	    return { accSubId, groupId: group.id, accountCode, currencyId: curNo == null ? undefined : Number(curNo) };

173	  async getNextAccountSequence(location: AccountGroupLocation): Promise<number> {
174	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'accounts'));
175	    const siblings = snap.docs
176	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
177	      .filter((account: any) => {
178	        const sameGroup = location.groupId && readValue(account, 'groupId', 'group_id') === location.groupId;
179	        const sameSub = !location.groupId && readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') === location.accSubId;
180	        return Boolean(sameGroup || sameSub);
181	      });
182	    return hierarchyCodeRules.nextPostingSequence(location.accountCode, siblings);

190	    if (!binding || binding.isActive === false || binding.is_active === false) return null;

196	      accountId,

199	      curNo: readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no') == null ? undefined : Number(readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no')),
200	      isActive: true,

204	  async resolveDefaultPostingAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<any | null> {
205	    const binding = await this.getDefaultAccount(defaultKey);
206	    if (!binding) return null;
207	    const account = await getDoc(doc(db, 'accounts', binding.accountId));
208	    if (!account.exists()) return null;
209	    const resolved = { id: account.id, ...account.data() };
210	    return this.isPostingAccount(resolved) ? resolved : null;
211	  }
212	
213	  validateNaturalBalanceLimit(account: any, delta: number): void {
214	    const limit = Number(readValue(account, 'limitedBalance', 'limited_balance') || 0);
215	    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return;
216	    const current = Number(readValue(account, 'balance', 'balance') || 0);
217	    const next = current + Number(delta || 0);
218	    if (next > limit) {
219	      throw new Error(`Account ${readCode(account)} exceeds its configured natural balance limit.`);
220	    }
221	  }
222	}

35	export const naturalBalanceDelta = (
36	  accountType: string | undefined,
37	  transactionType: 'Debit' | 'Credit',
38	  amount: number,
39	): number => {
40	  const normalizedAmount = Number(amount || 0);
41	  const debitNormal = accountType === 'Asset' || accountType === 'Expense';
42	  if (debitNormal) return transactionType === 'Debit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;
43	  return transactionType === 'Credit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;

46	/** قواعد أكواد شجرة الحسابات. تظل مستقلة لتختبر وتستخدم في الواجهة والخدمة بالمنطق نفسه. */
47	export const hierarchyCodeRules = {
48	  nextRootCode(records: any[]): string {
49	    const used = new Set((records || []).map(readCode).filter((code) => /^\d$/.test(code)));
50	    let next = 1;
51	    while (used.has(String(next))) next += 1;
52	    if (next > 9) throw new Error('لا يمكن إنشاء حساب رئيسي جديد: نطاق أكواد الجذر المكوّن من رقم واحد ممتلئ.');
53	    return String(next);
54	  },
55	
56	  nextChildCode(parentCode: string, records: any[]): string {
57	    const normalizedParent = onlyDigits(parentCode);
58	    if (!normalizedParent || normalizedParent.length >= 4) {
59	      throw new Error('رمز الأب غير صالح لإنشاء عقدة فرعية.');
60	    }
61	    const childNumbers = (records || [])
62	      .map(readCode)
63	      .filter((code) => code.startsWith(normalizedParent) && /^\d+$/.test(code))
64	      .map((code) => code.slice(normalizedParent.length))
65	      .filter((suffix) => /^\d$/.test(suffix))
66	      .map(Number);
67	    const next = Math.max(0, ...childNumbers) + 1;
68	    if (next > 9) throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء عقدة أخرى تحت ${normalizedParent}: نطاق التسلسل ممتلئ.`);
69	    return `${normalizedParent}${next}`;
70	  },
71	
72	  postingPrefix(accSubCode: string, groupCode?: string): string {
73	    const selected = onlyDigits(groupCode || accSubCode);
74	    if (!selected || selected.length > 4) {
75	      throw new Error('يجب اختيار حساب جزئي صالح، ومجموعة اختيارية ذات كود صالح، قبل إنشاء حساب مالي.');
76	    }
77	    return selected.padEnd(4, '0');
78	  },
79	
80	  nextPostingSequence(prefix: string, records: any[]): number {
81	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
82	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4) throw new Error('بادئة الحساب المالي يجب أن تتكون من أربعة أرقام.');
83	    return (records || []).reduce((maximum, record) => {
84	      const explicitSequence = Number(readValue(record, 'accountSeq', 'account_seq') || 0);
85	      const codeMatch = readCode(record).match(new RegExp(`^${normalizedPrefix}-(\\d{1,4})$`));
86	      const codeSequence = codeMatch ? Number(codeMatch[1]) : 0;
87	      return Math.max(maximum, Number.isInteger(explicitSequence) ? explicitSequence : 0, codeSequence);
88	    }, 0) + 1;
89	  },
90	
91	  formatPostingCode(prefix: string, sequence: number): string {
92	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
93	    const normalizedSequence = Number(sequence);
94	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4 || !Number.isInteger(normalizedSequence) || normalizedSequence < 1 || normalizedSequence > 9999) {
95	      throw new Error('كود الحساب المالي أو تسلسله غير صالح.');
96	    }
97	    return `${normalizedPrefix}-${String(normalizedSequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;
98	  },
99	
100	  validateCode(kind: HierarchyCodeKind, code: string, parents: { accountCode?: string; mainCode?: string; subCode?: string; groupCode?: string }): string | null {
101	    const normalized = String(code || '').trim();
102	    if (kind === 'account') return /^\d$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الرئيسي يجب أن يكون رقمًا واحدًا.';
103	    if (kind === 'main') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.accountCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{2}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الفرعي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الرئيسي مباشرة.';
104	    if (kind === 'sub') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.mainCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{3}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الجزئي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الفرعي مباشرة.';
105	    if (kind === 'group') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.subCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{4}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود المجموعة يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الجزئي مباشرة.';
106	
107	    const prefix = this.postingPrefix(parents.subCode || '', parents.groupCode);
108	    return new RegExp(`^${prefix}-\\d{4}$`).test(normalized)
109	      ? null
110	      : `كود الحساب المالي يجب أن يطابق ${prefix}-0001.`;
111	  },
112	};

114	class AccountingHierarchyService {
115	  /** يبقى الحساب القديم قابلاً للقيد فقط إلى أن تصنّف الحسابات في الترحيل التالي. */
116	  isPostingAccount(account: any): boolean {
117	    return Boolean(account?.id)
118	      && account?.isActive !== false
119	      && account?.is_active !== false
120	      && account?.isHierarchyNode !== true;
121	  }
122	
123	  filterPostingAccounts(accounts: any[], requireClassified = false): any[] {
124	    return (accounts || []).filter((account) => {
125	      if (!this.isPostingAccount(account)) return false;
126	      return !requireClassified || Boolean(readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id'));
127	    });
128	  }
129	
130	  async hasHierarchyStructure(): Promise<boolean> {
131	    const [rootSnapshot, subSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
132	      getDocs(collection(db, 'account')),
133	      getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub')),
134	    ]);
135	    return !rootSnapshot.empty && !subSnapshot.empty;
136	  }
137	
138	  async getDefaultCurrencyId(): Promise<number | undefined> {
139	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'currency'));
140	    const currency = snap.docs
141	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
142	      .find((entry: any) => entry.isDefault === true || entry.is_default === true);
143	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
144	  }
145	
146	  async getCurrencyIdByCode(currencyCode?: string): Promise<number | undefined> {
147	    const normalizedCode = String(currencyCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
148	    if (!normalizedCode) return this.getDefaultCurrencyId();
149	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'currency'));
150	    const currency = snap.docs
151	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
152	      .find((entry: any) => String(entry.code || '').toUpperCase() === normalizedCode);
153	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
154	  }
155	
156	  async getEntityPostingLocation(entityType: LedgerEntityType): Promise<AccountGroupLocation | null> {
157	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub_group'));
158	    const group = snap.docs
159	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
160	      .find((entry: any) => readValue(entry, 'entityType', 'entity_type') === entityType
161	        && entry.isActive !== false
162	        && entry.is_active !== false
163	        && readValue(entry, 'allowsDirectAccounts', 'allows_direct_accounts') !== false);
164	    if (!group) return null;
165	
166	    const accountCode = readCode(group);
167	    const accSubId = String(readValue(group, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') || '').trim();
168	    if (!accountCode || !accSubId) return null;
169	    const curNo = readValue(group, 'curNo', 'cur_no');
170	    return { accSubId, groupId: group.id, accountCode, currencyId: curNo == null ? undefined : Number(curNo) };
171	  }
172	
173	  async getNextAccountSequence(location: AccountGroupLocation): Promise<number> {
174	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'accounts'));
175	    const siblings = snap.docs
176	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
177	      .filter((account: any) => {
178	        const sameGroup = location.groupId && readValue(account, 'groupId', 'group_id') === location.groupId;
179	        const sameSub = !location.groupId && readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') === location.accSubId;
180	        return Boolean(sameGroup || sameSub);
181	      });
182	    return hierarchyCodeRules.nextPostingSequence(location.accountCode, siblings);
183	  }

185	  async getDefaultAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<DefaultAccountBinding | null> {
186	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'default_accounts'));
187	    const binding = snap.docs
188	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
189	      .find((entry: any) => String(readValue(entry, 'defaultKey', 'default_key') || '') === defaultKey);
190	    if (!binding || binding.isActive === false || binding.is_active === false) return null;
191	    const accountId = String(readValue(binding, 'accountId', 'account_id') || '').trim();
192	    if (!accountId) return null;
193	    return {
194	      id: String(binding.id),

196	      accountId,
197	      accNameAr: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameAr', 'acc_name_ar') || binding.nameAr || ''),
198	      accNameEn: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameEn', 'acc_name_en') || binding.nameEn || ''),
199	      curNo: readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no') == null ? undefined : Number(readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no')),
200	      isActive: true,

204	  async resolveDefaultPostingAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<any | null> {
205	    const binding = await this.getDefaultAccount(defaultKey);
206	    if (!binding) return null;
207	    const account = await getDoc(doc(db, 'accounts', binding.accountId));
208	    if (!account.exists()) return null;
209	    const resolved = { id: account.id, ...account.data() };
210	    return this.isPostingAccount(resolved) ? resolved : null;
211	  }

213	  validateNaturalBalanceLimit(account: any, delta: number): void {
214	    const limit = Number(readValue(account, 'limitedBalance', 'limited_balance') || 0);
215	    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return;
216	    const current = Number(readValue(account, 'balance', 'balance') || 0);
217	    const next = current + Number(delta || 0);
218	    if (next > limit) {
219	      throw new Error(`Account ${readCode(account)} exceeds its configured natural balance limit.`);
220	    }
221	  }

const rpc = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
vi.mock('../data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts', () => ({ supabase: { rpc } }));

import { financialEntrySettingsService } from './financialEntrySettingsService';

describe('financialEntrySettingsService', () => {
  it('يفوض الحفظ إلى إجراء خلفي واحد بدل الكتابة المباشرة على الجداول', async () => {
    rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 'module_test', code: 'TEST', isActive: true }, error: null });
    await expect(financialEntrySettingsService.manage('create', 'module', 'module_test', {
      code: 'TEST', nameAr: 'فئة اختبار', isActive: true,
    })).resolves.toMatchObject({ id: 'module_test' });
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('manage_financial_entry_setting', {
      p_action: 'create', p_kind: 'module', p_id: 'module_test',
      p_payload: { code: 'TEST', nameAr: 'فئة اختبار', isActive: true },
    });

79	/** قواعد أكواد شجرة الحسابات. تظل مستقلة لتختبر وتستخدم في الواجهة والخدمة بالمنطق نفسه. */
80	export const hierarchyCodeRules = {
81	  nextRootCode(records: any[]): string {
82	    const used = new Set((records || []).map(readCode).filter((code) => /^\d$/.test(code)));
83	    let next = 1;
84	    while (used.has(String(next))) next += 1;
85	    if (next > 9) throw new Error('لا يمكن إنشاء حساب رئيسي جديد: نطاق أكواد الجذر المكوّن من رقم واحد ممتلئ.');
86	    return String(next);
87	  },
88	
89	  nextChildCode(parentCode: string, records: any[]): string {
90	    const normalizedParent = onlyDigits(parentCode);
91	    if (!normalizedParent || normalizedParent.length >= 4) {
92	      throw new Error('رمز الأب غير صالح لإنشاء عقدة فرعية.');
93	    }
94	    const childNumbers = (records || [])
95	      .map(readCode)
96	      .filter((code) => code.startsWith(normalizedParent) && /^\d+$/.test(code))
97	      .map((code) => code.slice(normalizedParent.length))
98	      .filter((suffix) => /^\d$/.test(suffix))
99	      .map(Number);
100	    const next = Math.max(0, ...childNumbers) + 1;
101	    if (next > 9) throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء عقدة أخرى تحت ${normalizedParent}: نطاق التسلسل ممتلئ.`);
102	    return `${normalizedParent}${next}`;
103	  },
104	
105	  postingPrefix(accSubCode: string, groupCode?: string): string {
106	    const selected = onlyDigits(groupCode || accSubCode);
107	    if (!selected || selected.length > 4) {
108	      throw new Error('يجب اختيار حساب جزئي صالح، ومجموعة اختيارية ذات كود صالح، قبل إنشاء حساب مالي.');
109	    }
110	    return selected.padEnd(4, '0');
111	  },
112	
113	  nextPostingSequence(prefix: string, records: any[]): number {
114	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
115	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4) throw new Error('بادئة الحساب المالي يجب أن تتكون من أربعة أرقام.');
116	    return (records || []).reduce((maximum, record) => {
117	      const explicitSequence = Number(readValue(record, 'accountSeq', 'account_seq') || 0);
118	      const codeMatch = readCode(record).match(new RegExp(`^${normalizedPrefix}-(\\d{1,4})$`));
119	      const codeSequence = codeMatch ? Number(codeMatch[1]) : 0;
120	      return Math.max(maximum, Number.isInteger(explicitSequence) ? explicitSequence : 0, codeSequence);
121	    }, 0) + 1;
122	  },
123	
124	  formatPostingCode(prefix: string, sequence: number): string {
125	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
126	    const normalizedSequence = Number(sequence);
127	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4 || !Number.isInteger(normalizedSequence) || normalizedSequence < 1 || normalizedSequence > 9999) {
128	      throw new Error('كود الحساب المالي أو تسلسله غير صالح.');
129	    }
130	    return `${normalizedPrefix}-${String(normalizedSequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;
131	  },
132	
133	  validateCode(kind: HierarchyCodeKind, code: string, parents: { accountCode?: string; mainCode?: string; subCode?: string; groupCode?: string }): string | null {
134	    const normalized = String(code || '').trim();
135	    if (kind === 'account') return /^\d$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الرئيسي يجب أن يكون رقمًا واحدًا.';
136	    if (kind === 'main') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.accountCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{2}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الفرعي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الرئيسي مباشرة.';
137	    if (kind === 'sub') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.mainCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{3}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الجزئي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الفرعي مباشرة.';
138	    if (kind === 'group') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.subCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{4}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود المجموعة يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الجزئي مباشرة.';
139	
140	    const prefix = this.postingPrefix(parents.subCode || '', parents.groupCode);
141	    return new RegExp(`^${prefix}-\\d{4}$`).test(normalized)
142	      ? null
143	      : `كود الحساب المالي يجب أن يطابق ${prefix}-0001.`;
144	  },
145	};

147	class AccountingHierarchyService {
148	  /** يبقى الحساب القديم قابلاً للقيد فقط إلى أن تصنّف الحسابات في الترحيل التالي. */
149	  isPostingAccount(account: any): boolean {
150	    return Boolean(account?.id || account?.accountId)
151	      && account?.isActive !== false
152	      && account?.is_active !== false
153	      && account?.isHierarchyNode !== true;
154	  }
155	
156	  filterPostingAccounts(accounts: any[], requireClassified = false): any[] {
157	    return (accounts || []).filter((account) => {
158	      if (!this.isPostingAccount(account)) return false;
159	      return !requireClassified || Boolean(readSubAccountId(account));
160	    });
161	  }
162	
163	  /** وجود هيكل للشجرة = جذر واحد على الأقل وحساب جزئي واحد على الأقل. */
164	  async hasHierarchyStructure(): Promise<boolean> {
165	    const [rootRows, subRows] = await Promise.all([
166	      readRows('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/account', { limit: 1 }),
167	      readRows('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/acc-sub', { limit: 1 }),
168	    ]);
169	    return rootRows.length > 0 && subRows.length > 0;
170	  }
171	
172	  async getDefaultCurrencyId(): Promise<number | undefined> {
173	    const currency = await currencyService.getDefaultCurrency();
174	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined || currency?.cur_id === null ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
175	  }
176	
177	  async getCurrencyIdByCode(currencyCode?: string): Promise<number | undefined> {
178	    const normalizedCode = String(currencyCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
179	    if (!normalizedCode) return this.getDefaultCurrencyId();
180	    const currencies = await currencyService.getAllCurrencies(false);
181	    const currency = currencies.find((entry) => String(entry.code || '').toUpperCase() === normalizedCode);
182	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
183	  }
184	
185	  /** يحدد المجموعة التي تُنشأ تحتها حسابات الكيان (entity_type) مع كودها والعملية المرتبطة بها. */
186	  async getEntityPostingLocation(entityType: LedgerEntityType): Promise<AccountGroupLocation | null> {
187	    const rows = asRows(await apiClient.get<unknown>('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/acc-sub-group', { limit: 1000 }));
188	    const group = rows.find((entry: any) => readValue(entry, 'entityType', 'entity_type') === entityType
189	      && entry.isActive !== false
190	      && readValue(entry, 'allowsDirectAccounts', 'allows_direct_accounts') !== false);
191	    if (!group) return null;
192	
193	    const accountCode = readCode(group);
194	    const accSubId = String(readValue(group, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') || '').trim();
195	    if (!accountCode || !accSubId) return null;
196	    const curNo = readValue(group, 'curNo', 'cur_no');
197	    const groupId = String(group.nodeId ?? group.accSubGroupId ?? group.id ?? '').trim();
198	    return { accSubId, groupId: groupId || undefined, accountCode, currencyId: curNo == null ? undefined : Number(curNo) };
199	  }
200	
201	  async getNextAccountSequence(location: AccountGroupLocation): Promise<number> {
202	    const rows = asRows(await apiClient.get<unknown>('/api/v1/finance/accounts', { limit: 1000 }));
203	    const siblings = rows.filter((account: any) => {
204	      const sameGroup = location.groupId && readValue(account, 'groupId', 'group_id') === location.groupId;
205	      const sameSub = !location.groupId && readSubAccountId(account) === location.accSubId;
206	      return Boolean(sameGroup || sameSub);
207	    });
208	    return hierarchyCodeRules.nextPostingSequence(location.accountCode, siblings);
209	  }
210	
211	  async getDefaultAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<DefaultAccountBinding | null> {
212	    const rows = asRows(await apiClient.get<unknown>('/api/v1/finance/default-accounts', { limit: 1000, search: defaultKey }));
213	    const binding = rows.find((entry: any) => String(readValue(entry, 'defaultKey', 'default_key') || '') === defaultKey);
214	    if (!binding || binding.isActive === false || binding.is_active === false) return null;
215	    const accountId = String(readValue(binding, 'accountId', 'account_id') || '').trim();
216	    if (!accountId) return null;
217	    return {
218	      id: String(binding.defaultAccountId ?? binding.id ?? ''),
219	      defaultKey,
220	      accountId,
221	      accNameAr: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameAr', 'acc_name_ar') || binding.nameAr || ''),
222	      accNameEn: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameEn', 'acc_name_en') || binding.nameEn || ''),
223	      curNo: readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no') == null ? undefined : Number(readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no')),
224	      isActive: true,
225	    };
226	  }
227	
228	  async resolveDefaultPostingAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<any | null> {
229	    const binding = await this.getDefaultAccount(defaultKey);
230	    if (!binding) return null;
231	    try {
232	      const account = await apiClient.get<any>(`/api/v1/finance/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(binding.accountId)}`);
233	      if (!account) return null;
234	      const resolved = { ...account, id: account.accountId ?? binding.accountId };
235	      return this.isPostingAccount(resolved) ? resolved : null;
236	    } catch (error) {
237	      if ((error as { code?: string }).code !== 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') throw error;
238	      return null;
239	    }
240	  }
241	
242	  validateNaturalBalanceLimit(account: any, delta: number): void {
243	    const limit = Number(readValue(account, 'limitedBalance', 'limited_balance') || 0);
244	    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return;
245	    const current = Number(readValue(account, 'balance', 'balance') || 0);
246	    const next = current + Number(delta || 0);
247	    if (next > limit) {
248	      throw new Error(`Account ${readCode(account)} exceeds its configured natural balance limit.`);
249	    }
250	  }
251	}

```ts
import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';

const apiClient = new ApiClient({...});

const basePath = (kind) => kind === 'module' ? '/api/v1/finance/entry-modules' : '/api/v1/finance/entry-types';

// payload: strip undefined keys because schemas are .strict()
const toPayload = (kind, payload) => {
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { code: payload.code, nameAr: payload.nameAr };
  if (payload.nameEn) body.nameEn = payload.nameEn;
  if (payload.note) body.note = payload.note;
  if (kind === 'type' && payload.moduleId) body.moduleId = payload.moduleId;
  if (payload.isActive !== undefined) body.isActive = payload.isActive;
  return body;
};

manage(action, kind, id, payload) {
  const path = basePath(kind);
  if (action === 'delete') return apiClient.delete(path + '/' + encodeURIComponent(id));
  const body = toPayload(kind, payload);
  return action === 'create' ? apiClient.post(path, body) : apiClient.patch(`${path}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, body);
}
```

```ts
const PURGE_PATH_BY_TYPE = { customer: 'customers', courier: 'couriers', user: 'users', employee: 'employees' } as const;

export async function purgeEntityAndFinancialFootprint(service, entityType, entityId) {
  const target = PURGE_PATH_BY_TYPE[entityType];
  if (!target) throw new Error('نوع الكيان غير مدعوم للتطهير المالي.');
  const res = await apiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{result?: any}>>(`/api/v1/finance/entities/${target}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}/purge`, {});
  // إعادة احتساب الأرصدة المتأثرة بعد التطهير
  await service.recalculateAllBalances();
  return res?.data?.result ?? null;
}
```

313

319	      throw new Error(

329	      );
330	    }
331

339	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {

706	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
707	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
708	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {

711	      if (!accountDoc.exists()) {
712	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);

715	      const { error } = await (supabase as any).rpc('recalculate_accounting_hierarchy', {
716	        p_account_id: accountId,
717	      });
718	      if (error) {
719	        throw new Error(error.message || String(error));

721	      const refreshedAccount = await this.getAccountById(accountId);
722	      return Number(refreshedAccount?.balance || 0);

724	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
725	      return 0;
726	    }

729	  /**
730	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
731	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
732	   */
733	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
734	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
735	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
736	    }
737	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
738	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
739	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
740	    }, delayMs);
741	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
742	  }

744	  /**
745	   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.
746	   * Returns a summary of accounts processed and any errors encountered.
747	   * Useful for migration / reconciliation runs.
748	   */
749	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{
750	    processed: number;
751	    errors: number;
752	    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;
753	  }> {
754	    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];
755	    let errors = 0;
756	
757	    try {
758	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, "accounts"));
759	      const docs = snap.docs;
760	
761	      // Process in parallel batches of 5 to avoid overwhelming the DB while still being fast
762	      const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
763	      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
764	        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
765	        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {
766	          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;
767	          const oldBalance = data.balance || 0;
768	          try {
769	            const newBalance = await this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(d.id);
770	            results.push({
771	              accountId: d.id,
772	              accountCode: data.accountCode || d.id,
773	              oldBalance,
774	              newBalance,
775	            });
776	          } catch (err) {
777	            errors++;
778	            console.error(`[recalculateAllBalances] Error on account ${d.id}:`, err);
779	          }
780	        }));
781	      }
782	    } catch (err) {
783	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error loading accounts:", err);
784	    }
785	
786	    return { processed: results.length, errors, results };

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { SettingsCategory, SettingsRecord, SettingsRepository, UserSettingsData, UserSettingsRecord } from './settings.contracts';

const settingsColumns = `
  setting_id AS "settingId",
  COALESCE(category, setting_id) AS category,
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

const userSettingsColumns = `
  user_setting_id AS "userSettingId",
  user_id AS "userId",
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

export function createSettingsRepository(pool: Pool): SettingsRepository {
  return {
    async get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${settingsColumns} FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id = $1 OR category = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [category],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `INSERT INTO public.settings (setting_id, category, data, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
         VALUES ($1, $1, $2::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $3, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (setting_id) DO UPDATE SET
           category = EXCLUDED.category,
           data = COALESCE(public.settings.data, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.data,
           updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
         RETURNING ${settingsColumns}`,
        [category, JSON.stringify(settings), actorId],
      );
      const row = result.rows[0];
      if (!row) throw new Error('SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
      return row;
    },
    async getUser(userId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${userSettingsColumns} FROM public.user_settings
         WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [userId],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async updateUser(userId: string, settings: UserSettingsData, actorId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord> {
      const existing = await this.getUser(userId);
      const data = JSON.stringify(settings);
      let result;
      if (existing) {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `UPDATE public.user_settings SET data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb,
             language = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'language'), language),
             theme = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'theme'), theme),
             font_size = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'fontSize'), font_size),

61	async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
62	  collectionName: string

64	  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
65	  if (!path)

70	  });
71	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data)
72	    ? response.data
73	    : (response.data.items ?? []);
74	  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];

export const customerIdSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(128);
const nullableText = z.string().trim().max(500).nullable().optional();
const jsonValue = z.unknown().optional();

  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).default(25),
  offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0),

});

  preferredCategories: jsonValue,
  location: jsonValue,
  address: nullableText,
  onboardingCompleted: z.boolean().nullable().optional(),
});

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalculate_all_account_balances()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  acc record;
  recalculated_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR acc IN SELECT account_id FROM public.accounts LOOP
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(acc.account_id);
    recalculated_count := recalculated_count + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'recalculatedCount', recalculated_count);
END;
$function$

```ts
    async recalculateAccountHierarchy(accountIds, actorId) {
```

```ts
/**
 * financeApi.ts
 * بوابة HTTP مشتركة لخدمات المالية — تمنع تكرار إنشاء ApiClient في كل خدمة.
 * Shared HTTP gateway for finance services (single ApiClient instance, envelope unwrap, row mappers).
 */
import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';
import type { GatewayQuery } from '../data/contracts/common.gateway';
import type { AccountEntityType, FinancialAccount } from './financialAccountTypes';

export const financeApiClient = new ApiClient({...});

export interface ApiEnvelope<T> { success: boolean; data: T; meta?: { total?: number } }

export const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] => ...

export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: GatewayQuery): Promise<any[]>
export async function readFinancePage(path, query): Promise<{rows, total}>  // for paging
export async function readAllFinanceRows(path, query?, options?): Promise<any[]>  // pages up to maxRows
export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null>  // null when ENTITY_NOT_FOUND
export const isNotFound = (error: unknown): boolean
export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null
export const ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>>
export async function linkEntityAccount(entityType, entityId, fields): Promise<boolean>  // PATCH, tolerant
export async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean>
export async function recalculateAccounts(accountIds?: string[]): Promise<{ success: boolean; recalculatedCount: number }>
```

GatewayQuery lacks includeInactive/automationKey → extend locally:
```ts
export interface FinanceQuery extends GatewayQuery { includeInactive?: boolean; automationKey?: string; entityId?: string; moduleId?: string; oldAccountId?: string; employeeId?: string }
```
But ApiClient.get accepts GatewayQuery — passing an object with extra props: GatewayQuery is an interface without index signature → excess property check applies only to object literals. If I type my param as FinanceQuery (an interface extending GatewayQuery), passing it to get(query?: GatewayQuery) is fine (no literal check since it's a variable).

```ts
export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {
  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();
  if (!accountId) return null;
  return {
    ...row,
    id: accountId,
    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),
    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),
    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),
    entityType: row.entityType,
    entityId: String(row.entityId ?? ''),
    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? ''),
    currency: String(row.currency ?? 'YER'),
    curNo: row.currencyNo ?? row.curNo,
    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),
    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),
    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
    accSubId: row.subAccountId ?? row.accSubId,
    groupId: row.groupId,
    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),
    accNameAr: row.accountNameAr ?? row.accNameAr,
    accNameEn: row.accountNameEn ?? row.accNameEn,
    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),
    type: row.type,
    parentCode: row.parentCode,
    notes: row.notes,
    createdAt: row.createdAt, updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
  } as FinancialAccount;
}
```
Note FinancialAccount declares createdAt: number; API returns ISO strings. Consumers... createdAt as number is used maybe for sorting. Keep the row value (string) — cast as any. It's a legacy-shape compromise; I'll type the return as FinancialAccount with a cast and add a comment.

Careful with `curNo`: API alias is currencyNo. Legacy FinancialAccount.curNo. Both included via spread? spread includes currencyNo; I set curNo explicitly. Good.

Also important: legacy `code` field (accountData.code) used in createFinancialEntityAccount → FinancialAccount has no `code` in the type but the legacy doc had it. The accounts table has no `code` column (probe showed: account_code, account_prefix, account_number). So `code` was a Firestore-ism. In createFinancialEntityAccount I'll drop `code` from the payload (schema is .strict() → unknown key = 400). But generateFinancialAccountIdentifiers returns `code` — keep for API compatibility with callers (CouriersPage/orderEntityHandlers may use .code).     }
  });

1	/**
2	 * Financial Account Service
3	 * خدمة الحسابات المالية المركزية
4	 *
5	 * Manages creation and management of financial sub-accounts:
6	 *   Customers  → prefix 1130  (Asset — Accounts Receivable)
7	 *   Couriers   → prefix 2120  (Liability — Courier Ledger)
8	 *   Employees  → prefix 2130  (Liability — Employee Ledger)
9	 *
10	 * Every transaction that touches an account is written through the atomic
11	 * financial-entry procedure. Database safeguards maintain the authoritative

706	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
707	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
708	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
709	    try {
710	      const accountDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "accounts", accountId));
711	      if (!accountDoc.exists()) {
712	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);
713	        return 0;
714	      }
715	      const { error } = await (supabase as any).rpc('recalculate_accounting_hierarchy', {
716	        p_account_id: accountId,
717	      });
718	      if (error) {
719	        throw new Error(error.message || String(error));
720	      }
721	      const refreshedAccount = await this.getAccountById(accountId);
722	      return Number(refreshedAccount?.balance || 0);
723	    } catch (error) {
724	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
725	      return 0;
726	    }
727	  }
728	
729	  /**
730	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
731	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
732	   */
733	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
734	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
735	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
736	    }
737	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
738	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
739	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
740	    }, delayMs);
741	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
742	  }

744	  /**
745	   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.
746	   * Returns a summary of accounts processed and any errors encountered.
747	   * Useful for migration / reconciliation runs.
748	   */
749	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{
750	    processed: number;
751	    errors: number;
752	    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;
753	  }> {
754	    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];
755	    let errors = 0;
756	
757	    try {
758	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, "accounts"));
759	      const docs = snap.docs;
760	
761	      // Process in parallel batches of 5 to avoid overwhelming the DB while still being fast
762	      const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
763	      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
764	        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
765	        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {
766	          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;
767	          const oldBalance = data.balance || 0;
768	          try {
769	            const newBalance = await this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(d.id);
770	            results.push({
771	              accountId: d.id,
772	              accountCode: data.accountCode || d.id,
773	              oldBalance,
774	              newBalance,
775	            });
776	          } catch (err) {
777	            errors++;
778	            console.error(`[recalculateAllBalances] Error on account ${d.id}:`, err);
779	          }
780	        }));
781	      }
782	    } catch (err) {
783	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error loading accounts:", err);
784	    }
785	
786	    return { processed: results.length, errors, results };
787	  }

273	    '/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules',
274	    { limit: 1000, offset: 0 },
275	  );
276	  const rows = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : (res.data?.items ?? []);
277	  return rows.map(fromApiRow);

188	export async function alxRequest<T = unknown>(
189	  path: string,
190	  options: RequestOptions = {},
191	): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
192	  if (!ALX_API_URL) {
193	    return {
194	      success: false,
195	      error: {
196	        code: 'ALX_API_NOT_CONFIGURED',
197	        message: 'alx_api URL غير مهيأ في بيئة التطوير.',
198	        requestId: '',
199	        details: [],
200	      },
201	    };
202	  }
203	
204	  const requestId = generateRequestId();
205	  const { method = 'GET', body, authenticated = true, idempotencyKey } = options;
206	
207	  // بناء Headers
208	  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
209	    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
210	    'X-Request-Id': requestId,
211	    ...options.headers,
212	  };
213	
214	  if (idempotencyKey) {
215	    headers['Idempotency-Key'] = idempotencyKey;
216	  }
217	
218	  if (authenticated) {
219	    const token = getStoredAccessToken();
220	    if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
221	  }
222	
223	  // تنفيذ الطلب
224	  let response = await fetch(`${ALX_API_URL}${path}`, {
225	    method,
226	    headers,
227	    body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
228	  });
229	
230	  // تجديد تلقائي إذا انتهت صلاحية Access Token (401)
231	  if (response.status === 401 && authenticated) {
232	    const newToken = await refreshAccessToken();
233	    if (newToken) {
234	      headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${newToken}`;
235	      response = await fetch(`${ALX_API_URL}${path}`, {
236	        method,
237	        headers,
238	        body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
239	      });
240	    }
241	  }
242	
243	  const result = (await response.json()) as ApiResult<T>;
244	  return result;
245	}

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

For `getAccountById`:
1. readFinanceRecord(`${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}`) → mapAccountRow
2. legacy code: `String(accountId).replace(/^acc_/,'').replace(/_/g,'-')` → if different, findAccountByCode(legacyCode)
3. account-id-map: GET `/api/v1/finance/account-id-map?oldAccountId=` → `{oldAccountId, newAccountId}`; ENTITY_NOT_FOUND → null (readFinanceRecord handles) → then read account by new id
4. fallback: getAccountByEntityId(accountId)

Note: readFinanceRecord returns null on ENTITY_NOT_FOUND; but the accounts/:id route requires the id to be URL-safe. Account ids contain '-' and maybe '_' — encodeURIComponent handles.

Careful: `/api/v1/finance/accounts/by-entity` must be queried via `financeApiClient.get(path, {entityId})`.
