import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { SettingsCategory, SettingsRecord, SettingsRepository, UserSettingsData, UserSettingsRecord } from './settings.contracts';

const settingsColumns = `
  setting_id AS "settingId",
  COALESCE(category, setting_id) AS category,
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

const userSettingsColumns = `
  user_setting_id AS "userSettingId",
  user_id AS "userId",
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

export function createSettingsRepository(pool: Pool): SettingsRepository {
  return {
    async get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${settingsColumns} FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id = $1 OR category = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [category],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `INSERT INTO public.settings (setting_id, category, data, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
         VALUES ($1, $1, $2::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $3, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (setting_id) DO UPDATE SET
           category = EXCLUDED.category,
           data = COALESCE(public.settings.data, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.data,
           updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
         RETURNING ${settingsColumns}`,
        [category, JSON.stringify(settings), actorId],
      );
      const row = result.rows[0];
      if (!row) throw new Error('SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
      return row;
    },
    async getUser(userId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${userSettingsColumns} FROM public.user_settings
         WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [userId],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async updateUser(userId: string, settings: UserSettingsData, actorId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord> {
      const existing = await this.getUser(userId);
      const data = JSON.stringify(settings);
      let result;
      if (existing) {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `UPDATE public.user_settings SET data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb,
             language = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'language'), language),
             theme = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'theme'), theme),
             font_size = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'fontSize'), font_size),
             dashboard_grid_columns = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'dashboardGridColumns')::numeric, dashboard_grid_columns),
             visible_metrics = COALESCE($1::jsonb -> 'visibleMetrics', visible_metrics),
             updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = $2
           WHERE user_setting_id = $3 RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
          [data, actorId, existing.userSettingId],
        );
      } else {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `INSERT INTO public.user_settings
             (user_setting_id, user_id, data, language, theme, font_size, dashboard_grid_columns, visible_metrics, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $9, $9)
           RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
          [
            `user_${userId}`,
            userId,
            data,
            settings.language ?? null,
            settings.theme ?? null,
            settings.fontSize ?? null,
            settings.dashboardGridColumns ?? null,
            settings.visibleMetrics ? JSON.stringify(settings.visibleMetrics) : null,
            actorId,
          ],
        );
      }
      const row = result.rows[0];
      if (!row) throw new Error('USER_SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
      return row;
    },
  };
}

```ts
async ensureAutomaticVoucherRules(): Promise<any[]> {
  const normalizedDefaultRules = buildDefaultAutomaticVoucherRules();
  try {
    const record = await readFinanceRecord('/api/v1/settings/automatic_voucher_rules');
    const settings = (record?.settings ?? {}) as { data?: unknown };
    const currentRules: any[] = Array.isArray(settings.data) ? settings.data : [];
    const existingRuleIds = new Set(currentRules.map((rule) => rule?.id));
    const missingRules = normalizedDefaultRules.filter((rule) => !existingRuleIds.has(rule.id));
    if (missingRules.length === 0 && record) return currentRules;

    const mergedRules = [...currentRules, ...missingRules];
    // الكتابة تتطلب صلاحية edit_general_settings؛ المحاسبون يقرؤون القواعد دون تعديلها.
    try {
      await financeApiClient.patch('/api/v1/settings/automatic_voucher_rules', { settings: { data: mergedRules } });
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر حفظ قواعد القيود التلقائية (صلاحية أو خطأ في API):', error);
    }
    return mergedRules;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[FinancialAccountService] Failed to seed automatic voucher rules:", e);
    return normalizedDefaultRules;
  }
}
```

const readSettingsRecord = async (category: string) => {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<{settings?: unknown}>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as {code?: string})?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return null;
    throw error;
  }
};
```

/**
 * accountingHierarchyService.ts
 * خدمة شجرة الحسابات والحسابات الافتراضية — API-only عبر alx_api.
 * Accounting-hierarchy and default-account service — API-only through alx_api (no legacy Supabase access).
 */
import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';
import type { GatewayQuery } from '../data/contracts/common.gateway';
import currencyService from './currencyService';

const apiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined'
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
}

/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
  Array.isArray(payload) ? (payload as any[]) : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items) ? (payload as any).items : [];

/** يقرأ قائمة من alx_api ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة {success,data}. */
const readRows = async (path: string, query?: GatewayQuery): Promise<any[]> => {
  const res = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
  return asRows(res?.data);
};

/**
 * useAutoVoucherRules.ts
 * مزود قواعد القيود التلقائية — يقرأ من alx_api فقط (API-only).
 * Auto voucher rules provider — reads exclusively from alx_api (no legacy Supabase access).
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';

const apiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined'
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

export interface AutoVoucherRule {
  id: string;
  actionCode?: string;
  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string;
  descriptionTempAr: string;
  descriptionTempEn: string;
  debitAccount: any;
  creditAccount: any;
  isActive: boolean;
  autoPost?: boolean;
  requiredEntities?: string[];
}

/** صف قاعدة قيد تلقائي كما يعيده /api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules */
/** Auto-entry rule row as returned by the API. */
interface AutoEntryRuleRow {
  autoEntryId: string;
  statusId?: number | null;
  statusNameAr?: string | null;
  nameAr?: string | null;
  nameEn?: string | null;
  isActive?: boolean | null;
  autoPost?: boolean | null;
  amountSources?: string[] | null;
  debitAccount?: string | null;
  creditAccount?: string | null;
  descriptionTemplateAr?: string | null;
  descriptionTemplateEn?: string | null;
}

// حسابات القاعدة مخزنة نصيًا في auto_entries؛ قد تكون JSON قديم أو نصًا بسيطًا.
// Rule accounts are stored as text; tolerate legacy JSON payloads and plain strings.
function parseAccount(value: unknown): any {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return value;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(value);
    } catch {
      return { id: value, name: value };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function toRule(row: AutoEntryRuleRow): AutoVoucherRule {
  return {
    id: row.autoEntryId,
    actionCode: row.statusNameAr ?? undefined,
    nameAr: row.nameAr ?? '',
    nameEn: row.nameEn ?? '',
    descriptionTempAr: row.descriptionTemplateAr ?? '',
    descriptionTempEn: row.descriptionTemplateEn ?? '',
    debitAccount: parseAccount(row.debitAccount),
    creditAccount: parseAccount(row.creditAccount),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
    autoPost: row.autoPost !== false,
    requiredEntities: row.amountSources ?? undefined,
  };
}

export function useAutoVoucherRules() {
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<AutoVoucherRule[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<{ success: boolean; data: AutoEntryRuleRow[] | { items?: AutoEntryRuleRow[] } }>(
          '/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules',
          { limit: 1000, offset: 0 },
        );
        const payload = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : (res.data?.items ?? []);
        if (!cancelled) setRules(payload.map(toRule));
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setRules([]);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  return { rules, loading };
}

  it('does not allow legacy-migration in production', () => {
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('legacy-migration'))).toThrow(

    );
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('shadow'))).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('api-only'))).not.toThrow();
  });

  it('does not silently permit legacy writes in shadow mode', () => {
    expect(getApiMode('shadow')).toMatchObject({
      mode: 'shadow',
      isApiOnly: false,
      allowsLegacyReads: true,
      allowsLegacyWrites: false,
    });
  });
});

FROM pg_constraint con
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (con.conkey)
WHERE con.contype = 'p'
  AND c.relname IN ('customers','couriers','employees','users','sources','shipping_companies','custody_advances')
ORDER BY c.relname;

SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_name = 'orders' AND column_name IN ('customer_id','courier_id','employee_id','driver_id')
ORDER BY column_name;
```
**النتيجة:** المفاتيح: customer_id/courier_id/employee_id/user_id+id(مركّب)/source_id/shipping_company_id/custody_advance_id؛ وفي orders: courier_id, customer_id, employee_id (لا يوجد driver_id). استُخدمت لتثبيت خريطة الحذف داخل دالة 0023. **لم تُجرَ أي كتابة على قاعدة البيانات.**

5	/**
6	 * Compatibility report surface for callers outside the unified FinanceEntries page.
7	 * The report source is the normalized ledger only: posted main_entry headers and
8	 * their account_trans lines. No legacy expenditure collection is queried.
9	 */
10	export default function FinanceReports() {
11	  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
12	  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);
13	
14	  useEffect(() => {
15	    const unsubEntries = onSnapshot(
16	      query(collection(db, 'main_entry'), orderBy('effectiveAt', 'desc')),
17	      (snap) => setEntries(snap.docs.map((doc: any) => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }))),
18	      (error) => console.warn('FinanceReports: main_entry subscription error:', error),
19	    );
20	    const unsubLines = onSnapshot(
21	      query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')),
22	      (snap) => setLines(snap.docs.map((doc: any) => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }))),
23	      (error) => console.warn('FinanceReports: account_trans subscription error:', error),
24	    );
25	    return () => {
26	      unsubEntries();
27	      unsubLines();
28	    };
29	  }, []);
30	
31	  const entryById = new Map(entries.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry]));
32	  const postedLines = lines.filter((tx) => {
33	    const entry = entryById.get(tx.entryId || tx.main_entry_id);
34	    return tx.entry?.postingStatus === 'posted' || (entry && entry.postingStatus === 'posted');
35	  });
36	
37	  return (
38	    <section aria-label="Normalized financial report" className="space-y-3">
39	      <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white">Financial Reports</h2>
40	      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
41	        {postedLines.length.toLocaleString()} posted ledger lines from {entries.length.toLocaleString()} entry headers.
42	      </p>
43	    </section>
44	  );
45	}

7	const mapEntry = (row: Record<string, unknown>): FinanceEntryViewModel => ({

10	});
11	
12	export class CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway implements FinanceEntriesGateway {
13	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<FinanceEntryViewModel>> {
14	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
15	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
16	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' }).range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
17	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
18	    const items = (data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapEntry));
19	    return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
20	  }
21	
22	  async getById(id: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel | null> {
23	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('main_entry_id', id).maybeSingle();
24	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
25	    return data ? mapRow(data, mapEntry) : null;
26	  }
27	
28	  async post(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
29	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
30	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'posted', posted_by_uid: actorId, posted_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
31	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
32	    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
33	  }
34	
35	  async reverse(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
36	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
37	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'voided', voided_by_uid: actorId, voided_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
38	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
39	    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
40	  }
41	}

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL and access-token factory.
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح — نفس المفاتيح المستخدمة في بقية البوابات. */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

export const APP_API_BASE_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});
```

/**
 * securityPinService.ts
 * التحقق من رمز PIN للعمليات الحساسة عبر الخادم — لا تُقارَن الرموز في المتصفح ولا توجد بدائل ثابتة.
 * Server-side PIN verification for destructive operations: no in-browser comparison and no hardcoded fallbacks.
 */
import { appApiClient } from '../data/http/app-api-client';

export type PinVerification =
  | { status: 'valid' }
  | { status: 'invalid' }
  | { status: 'not-configured' }
  | { status: 'unavailable'; message: string };

interface VerifyPinResult { configured: boolean; valid: boolean; }
interface ApiEnvelope<T> { success: boolean; data: T; }

export async function verifyCurrentUserPin(pin: string): Promise<PinVerification> {
  const trimmed = pin.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return { status: 'invalid' };
  try {
    const res = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<VerifyPinResult>>('/api/v1/users/verify-pin', { pin: trimmed });
    const result = res?.data;
    if (!result) return { status: 'unavailable', message: 'استجابة غير صالحة من خدمة التحقق.' };
    if (!result.configured) return { status: 'not-configured' };
    return result.valid ? { status: 'valid' } : { status: 'invalid' };
  } catch (error) {
    ...
  }
}
```

`alxLogin` stores tokens (via `storeTokens`) presumably. So after `authenticate`, an access token exists in sessionStorage even before `completeSignIn`. That means `verifySystemPin(userId, pin)` CAN call the server endpoint during pending sign-in.

So the honest fix for `alx-api-auth.gateway.ts:227`: implement it via the shared `verifyCurrentUserPin`, but only when `userId` matches the pending login user (to prevent verifying someone else's PIN — though the endpoint already ties it to the token).

```ts
  /**
   * التحقق من System PIN خادميًا عبر alx_api — لا قيمة ثابتة ولا تجاوز.
   * Server-side PIN verification through alx_api; no hardcoded value and no bypass.
   */
  async verifySystemPin(userId: string, pin: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // المنفذ يُستخرج من رمز الوصول في الخادم؛ نرفض أي معرف لا يطابق الجلسة المعلّقة.
    const pendingId = this.pendingLoginResult?.user?.userId;
    if (pendingId && pendingId !== userId) return false;
    const verification = await verifyCurrentUserPin(pin);
    return verification.status === 'valid';
  }

```ts
/**
 * security-pin.api.ts
 * نداء HTTP واحد للتحقق من رمز PIN في الخادم — المصدر الوحيد لهذه المكالمة.
 * The single HTTP call that verifies a PIN server-side; every layer reuses it (DRY).
 */
import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from './app-api-client';

/** استجابة الخادم: هل الرمز مضبوط أصلًا، وهل القيمة المدخلة صحيحة. */
export interface PinVerificationResult {
  configured: boolean;
  valid: boolean;
}

/**
 * يتحقق من رمز PIN الخاص بصاحب رمز الوصول الحالي.
 * Verifies the PIN of the access-token owner; identity is never taken from the client.
 */
export async function requestPinVerification(pin: string): Promise<PinVerificationResult> {
  const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<PinVerificationResult>>('/api/v1/users/verify-pin', { pin });
  const result = response?.data;
  if (!result) throw new Error('استجابة غير صالحة من خدمة التحقق من الرمز.');
  return { configured: result.configured === true, valid: result.valid === true };
}
```

#### Thinking

Now I have the contracts:
- `GET /api/v1/finance/entries?limit&offset&search&automationKey` → items with `entryId`, `postingStatus`, `effectiveAt`, etc. Response envelope: `sendSuccess(response, items, requestId, {...query, total})` → `{success, data: [...], meta: {limit, offset, total}}`.
- `GET /api/v1/finance/account-movements` (paged, posted-only) → items with `transactionId`, `entryId`, `transType`, `amount`, ...

FinanceReports needs: count of posted ledger lines + count of entry headers (posted only). 

The movements endpoint only returns posted lines and gives `total` in meta → exact count of posted lines without fetching rows! And entries: `readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', {limit:1, offset:0})` gives total headers (all statuses). To count posted headers only, we'd need a filter... `entriesQuerySchema` — does it support postingStatus? From the repository, only search + automationKey. So no postingStatus filter.

Options: fetch entries with limit=1000 and count posted client-side (bounded by maxRows), or just report total headers. The original component reported `postedLines.length` from all lines and `entries.length` (all headers, not just posted). The old code filtered lines by posted status and counted all entries headers.

So the API version: postedLines total = meta.total from `/account-movements` with limit=1 (posted-only already server-side). entries total = meta.total from `/entries` with limit=1. That's an exact, cheap implementation — better than the old client-side scan.

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { readFinancePage } from '../services/financeApi';

interface ReportTotals {
  postedLines: number;
  entryHeaders: number;
}

/**
 * Compatibility report surface for callers outside the unified FinanceEntries page.
 * مصدر التقرير هو دفتر الأستاذ المُطبع عبر alx_api: رؤوس main_entry وسطور account_trans المنشورة فقط.
 * The report source is the normalized ledger served by alx_api — main_entry headers plus posted account_trans lines only.
 */
export default function FinanceReports() {
  const [totals, setTotals] = useState<ReportTotals | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        // limit=1: نحتاج العدد الكلي من meta.total لا الصفوف نفسها — the totals come from meta.total, not from the rows.
        const [lines, entries] = await Promise.all([
          readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/account-movements', { limit: 1, offset: 0 }),
          readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { limit: 1, offset: 0 }),
        ]);
        if (!cancelled) setTotals({ postedLines: lines.total, entryHeaders: entries.total });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('FinanceReports: تعذر تحميل ملخص دفتر الأستاذ:', err);
        if (!cancelled) setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'تعذر تحميل التقرير.');
      }
    };
    void load();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);
  ...
}

  });

    await expect(verifyCurrentUserPin('0000')).resolves.toEqual({ status: 'not-configured' });

  });

    await expect(verifyCurrentUserPin('9999')).resolves.toEqual({ status: 'unauthenticated' });

    mocks.requestPinVerification.mockRejectedValue(apiError('ENTITY_NOT_FOUND'));
    await expect(verifyCurrentUserPin('9999')).resolves.toEqual({ status: 'not-configured' });

    mocks.requestPinVerification.mockRejectedValue(new Error('timeout'));
    await expect(verifyCurrentUserPin('9999')).resolves.toEqual({ status: 'unavailable', message: 'timeout' });
  });

    const message = pinVerificationMessage({ status: 'unavailable', message: 'API request failed with status 500.' }, false);
    expect(message).not.toContain('1234');
    expect(message).toContain('PIN verification failed');
  });
});

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { autoEntryService, type AutoEntryRule } from '../services/autoEntryService';

export function useAutoVoucherRules() {

  /** إعادة التحميل بعد كل حفظ — القواعد لم تعد تصل عبر مستمع لحظي. */
  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);

      setRules(await autoEntryService.ensureAutoEntries());

    } finally {
      setLoading(false);

  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { void reload(); }, [reload]);

  return { rules, loading, error, reload };
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export interface ExpenseCategory {
  id: string;
  labelAr: string;
  labelEn: string;
  icon?: string;
  accountId?: string; // Linked account from chart of accounts
  accountCode?: string;
  isSystem?: boolean; // Can't be deleted if system
}

// Fallback initial categories to seed
export const DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES: ExpenseCategory[] = [
  { id: 'wages', labelAr: 'أجور التوصيل', labelEn: 'Delivery Wages', icon: '🚚', isSystem: true, accountId: 'sys_delivery_cost', accountCode: '5000-2788' },
  { id: 'marketing', labelAr: 'تسويق وإعلانات', labelEn: 'Marketing', icon: '📈' },
  { id: 'office', labelAr: 'مستلزمات مكتبية', labelEn: 'Office Supplies', icon: '📎' },
  { id: 'maintenance', labelAr: 'صيانة وإصلاح', labelEn: 'Maintenance', icon: '🔧' },
  { id: 'fuel', labelAr: 'وقود ومحروقات', labelEn: 'Fuel', icon: '⛽' },
  { id: 'rent', labelAr: 'إيجارات', labelEn: 'Rent', icon: '🏢' },
  { id: 'salary', labelAr: 'رواتب موظفين', labelEn: 'Salaries', icon: '👨‍💼', isSystem: true },
  { id: 'custody', labelAr: 'عهدة مناديب', labelEn: 'Custody / Receivables', icon: '💳', isSystem: true },
  { id: 'factory', labelAr: 'دفعات المصانع', labelEn: 'Factory Payouts', icon: '🏭', isSystem: true },
  { id: 'other', labelAr: 'أخرى', labelEn: 'Other', icon: '📄', isSystem: true }
];

export function useExpenseCategories() {
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<ExpenseCategory[]>(DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES);

  useEffect(() => {
    setCategories(DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES);
  }, []);

  return categories;
}

#### Thinking

`useExpenseCategories` is a stub that always returns defaults — it never reads stored data! That means the manager's edits (writing the full array to settings) are never reflected back on reload, and worse: each save writes `[...defaults, newCat]`, potentially duplicating previously added categories.

This is a genuine functional gap. The honest fix: make `useExpenseCategories` read from the settings category `expense_categories` via the API, falling back to defaults only when the server has no stored data. And writes should merge against the *server* state, not the local snapshot.

import { ApiClient } from './api-client';
import type { SettingsApiDto, UserSettingsApiDto, SystemSettingsData } from '../dtos/settings.dto';

export interface ApiCurrencyDto {
  currencyId: number;
  code: string;
  mainNameAr: string;
  subNameAr: string | null;
  mainNameEn: string | null;
  subNameEn: string | null;
  symbol: string;
  flag: string | null;
  isDefault: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  currentPrice: number | null;
  lastSeq: number | null;
  lastUpdateBy: string | null;
  lastUpdateDate: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyRateDto {
  rateId: number;
  currencyId: number;
  price: number;
  dayDate: string;
  sequence: number;
  updatedBy: string | null;
  createdAt: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyCreateInput {
  code: string;
  mainNameAr: string;
  subNameAr?: string | null;
  mainNameEn?: string | null;
  subNameEn?: string | null;
  symbol: string;
  flag?: string | null;
  isDefault?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
}

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

export const settingsCurrenciesApiGateway = {
  async getSettings(category: 'general' | 'logistics' | 'whatsapp'): Promise<SettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<SettingsApiDto>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`);
    return response.data;
  },
  async updateSettings(category: 'general' | 'logistics' | 'whatsapp', settings: Partial<SystemSettingsData>): Promise<SettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<SettingsApiDto>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, { settings });
    return response.data;
  },
  async getUserSettings(): Promise<UserSettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<UserSettingsApiDto>>('/api/v1/settings/user');

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';

export interface ExpenseCategory {
  id: string;
  labelAr: string;
  labelEn: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** الحساب المرتبط في دليل الحسابات (قد يكون entityId لنظامي) — linked chart account (may hold a system entityId). */
  accountId?: string;
  accountCode?: string;

  isSystem?: boolean;

export const EXPENSE_CATEGORIES_SETTING = 'expense_categories';

export const DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES: ExpenseCategory[] = [ ...same list... ];

interface SettingsRecord { settingId?: string; category?: string; settings?: { data?: unknown } }

function asCategoryList(value: unknown): ExpenseCategory[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.filter((entry): entry is ExpenseCategory => Boolean(entry) && typeof entry === 'object' && typeof (entry as any).id === 'string');
}

async function readStored(): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
  try {
    const res = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<SettingsRecord>>(`/api/v1/settings/${EXPENSE_CATEGORIES_SETTING}`);
    return asCategoryList(res?.data?.settings?.data);
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as { code?: string })?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return [];
    throw error;
  }
}

async function writeStored(categories: ExpenseCategory[]): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
  await appApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<SettingsRecord>>(`/api/v1/settings/${EXPENSE_CATEGORIES_SETTING}`, { settings: { data: categories } });
  return categories;
}

    }

  },

  },

};

Careful with `update`/`remove` when the server has nothing stored yet (fresh install where UI shows defaults): then `stored` is empty and the row isn't found. The old behavior wrote `[...defaults]` array. To be user-correct: when the server has no stored document, seed from defaults first. I'll implement `update`/`remove` on the *effective* list (`list()`), which merges defaults. That means the first write persists the defaults too — exactly what the old code did (`setDoc` with `[...categories]` where categories came from the hook = defaults). Good, behavior preserved and now consistent.

So:
```ts
async update(id, patch) {
  const current = await this.list();  // effective list (stored or defaults)
  const index = current.findIndex(e => e.id === id);
  if (index === -1) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» غير موجودة.`);
  const next = current.map((entry, i) => (i === index ? { ...entry, ...patch } : entry));
  return writeStored(next);
}
```
Note `this` inside an object literal method works.

Hmm — but `this.list()` inside `add` too. For `add`, using effective list prevents duplicates against defaults as well. Good.

Also the `isSystem` guard for delete belongs in the service (business rule): refuse removing a system category.

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES, expenseCategoriesService, type ExpenseCategory } from '../services/expenseCategoriesService';

export type { ExpenseCategory };
export { DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES };

export function useExpenseCategories(): ExpenseCategory[] {
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<ExpenseCategory[]>(DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    expenseCategoriesService.list()
      .then((stored) => { if (!cancelled) setCategories(stored); })
      .catch((error) => { console.warn('[useExpenseCategories] تعذر تحميل فئات المصروفات:', error); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);
  return categories;
}

65	}

67	export const expenseCategoriesService = {
68	  /**
69	   * يعيد القائمة الفعّالة: المخزّن على الخادم، أو الافتراضية عندما لا يوجد مستند بعد.
70	   * Returns the effective list — stored categories, or the defaults when nothing is stored yet.
71	   */
72	  async list(): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
73	    const stored = await readStored();
74	    return stored.length > 0 ? stored : DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES;
75	  },
76	
77	  /**
78	   * إضافة فئة بعد قراءة حالة الخادم أولًا حتى لا تُمسح إضافات متزامنة.
79	   * Read-modify-write against the server state so concurrent additions are never clobbered.
80	   */
81	  async add(category: ExpenseCategory): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
82	    const id = category.id.trim();
83	    if (!id) throw new Error('معرّف الفئة مطلوب.');
84	    const current = await this.list();
85	    if (current.some((entry) => entry.id === id)) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» موجودة مسبقًا.`);
86	    return writeStored([...current, { ...category, id, isSystem: false }]);
87	  },
88	
89	  async update(id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<ExpenseCategory, 'id'>>): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
90	    const current = await this.list();
91	    if (!current.some((entry) => entry.id === id)) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» غير موجودة.`);
92	    return writeStored(current.map((entry) => (entry.id === id ? { ...entry, ...patch } : entry)));
93	  },
94	
95	  /** حذف فئة غير نظامية — النظامية مرفوضة لأن القيود التلقائية تعتمد عليها. */
96	  async remove(id: string): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
97	    const current = await this.list();
98	    const target = current.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
99	    if (!target) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» غير موجودة.`);
100	    if (target.isSystem) throw new Error('لا يمكن حذف فئة نظامية.');
101	    return writeStored(current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
102	  },
103	};

/**
 * financeAssetsService.ts
 * خدمة الأصول الثابتة — تسجيل وقراءة وحذف الأصول وسجلات الصيانة عبر alx_api فقط.
 * Fixed-asset operations (list / register / delete / maintenance logs) go through alx_api exclusively;
 * the UI never touches the database or the legacy adapter.
 */
import { financeApiClient, readAllFinanceRows, type ApiEnvelope } from './financeApi';
import { financialAccountService } from './financialAccountService';

export type AssetCategory = 'Vehicles' | 'Inspection' | 'Office' | 'Computers' | 'Other';
export type AssetType = 'Fixed' | 'NonFixed';
export type AssetStatus = 'Active' | 'UnderMaintenance' | 'Retired';
export type MaintenanceType = 'Preventive' | 'Repair' | 'Overhaul';

export interface MaintenanceLog { ... }

export interface FinancialAsset {
  id: string;
  assetCode: string;
  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string;
  category: AssetCategory;
  type: AssetType;
  cost: number;
  currency: string;
  purchaseDate: string;
  assignedCourierId: string | null;
  assignedCourierName: string | null;
  status: AssetStatus;
  notes: string;
  maintenanceLogs: MaintenanceLog[];
  isActive: boolean;
  financialAccountId?: string;
  financialAccountCode?: string;
  createdAt?: number | string;
}

export const ASSET_ACCOUNTING: Record<AssetCategory, { prefix: string; parentCode: string; nameAr: string }> = {...};

const ASSETS_PATH = '/api/v1/finance/assets';

/** معرّف الأصل مشتق من رمزه كما في السجلات القائمة — keeps ids compatible with stored rows. */
export const buildAssetId = (assetCode: string): string => `asset${String(assetCode || '').trim()}`;

export interface AssetRegistration {
  assetCode, nameAr, nameEn, category, type, cost, currency, purchaseDate, assignedCourierId?, assignedCourierName?, status, notes
}

function toText(value: unknown): string { return value == null ? '' : String(value); }
function toNumber(value: unknown): number { const n = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; }
function toLogs(value: unknown): MaintenanceLog[] { return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter(...) : []; }

function mapAssetRow(row: any): FinancialAsset | null {
  const id = toText(row?.assetId ?? row?.id).trim();
  if (!id) return null;
  return {...};
}

export const financeAssetsService = {
  async list(): Promise<FinancialAsset[]> {
    const rows = await readAllFinanceRows(ASSETS_PATH);
    return rows.map(mapAssetRow).filter((a): a is FinancialAsset => a !== null);
  },

  async register(registration: AssetRegistration): Promise<FinancialAsset> {
    const assetCode = registration.assetCode.trim();
    if (!assetCode) throw new Error('رمز الأصل مطلوب.');
    const assetId = buildAssetId(assetCode);
    const accounting = ASSET_ACCOUNTING[registration.category] ?? ASSET_ACCOUNTING.Other;
    // الحساب المالي يُنشأ أولًا لأن صف الأصل يحمل مرجعه — account first so the row stores its reference.
    const account = await financialAccountService.createAccountForEntity(
      'asset', assetId, `${assetCode} — ${registration.nameAr}`, registration.currency, undefined,
      { accountPrefix: accounting.prefix, parentCode: accounting.parentCode, accountType: 'Asset', notes: `حساب أصل ثابت: ${accounting.nameAr}`, updateEntity: false },
    );
    const response = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<any>>(ASSETS_PATH, {
      assetId,
      assetCode,
      nameAr: ..., nameEn, category, type, status,
      cost: Number(registration.cost),
      currency, purchaseDate, 
      assignedCourierId: registration.assignedCourierId || null,
      assignedCourierName: registration.assignedCourierName || null,
      notes: registration.notes || null,
      accountId: account.id, accountCode: account.accountCode || null,
      isActive: true,
      maintenanceLogs: [],
    });
    return mapAssetRow(response?.data) ?? {...fallback};
  },
```

export interface MaintenanceLogInput {
  cost: number | string;
  currency: string;
  type: MaintenanceType;
  notes?: string;
  doneBy?: string;
  date: string;
}

/** يبني سجل صيانة بمعرّف فريد — unique log id keeps PDF/report rows distinguishable. */
export function createMaintenanceLog(input: MaintenanceLogInput): MaintenanceLog {
  return {
    logId: `MNT-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
    cost: Number(input.cost) || 0,
    currency: input.currency,
    type: input.type,
    notes: input.notes ?? '',
    doneBy: input.doneBy ?? '',
    date: input.date,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}
```

660	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {

677	  /**
678	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
679	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
680	   */
681	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
682	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
683	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
684	    }
685	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
686	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
687	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
688	    }, delayMs);
689	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
690	  }

    async deleteFinancialAccount(accountId) {
      const existing = await pool.query('SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts WHERE account_id = $1', [accountId]);
      if ((existing.rowCount ?? 0) === 0) return { status: 'not_found', movements: 0 };
      const usage = await pool.query<{ total: string }>(
        'SELECT count(*)::text AS total FROM public.account_trans WHERE account_id = $1',
        [accountId],
      );
      const movements = Number(usage.rows[0]?.total ?? 0);
      // وجود حركات = رفض؛ يُعطّل الحساب بدل حذفه حتى يبقى الأثر المالي قابلاً للتدقيق.
      if (movements > 0) return { status: 'in_use', movements };
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.accounts WHERE account_id = $1', [accountId]);
      return { status: 'deleted', movements: 0 };
    },

Now, the backend gap: `parentCode` isn't writable via `financialAccountSchema`. Legacy wrote both `parentCode` and `accountPrefix` (same value). The merge logic reads `ca.accountPrefix || ca.parentCode`. So writing `accountPrefix` alone suffices for the tree — parentCode is redundant. 

Also legacy wrote `code` and `nameAr`/`nameEn`. The API schema has `accNameAr`/`accNameEn` (columns acc_name_ar/acc_name_en) but not `nameAr`/`nameEn`. mapAccountRow maps `accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr`. The merge logic reads `ca.entityName || ca.nameAr` — since accounts rows return `accountNameAr` (acc_name_ar AS "accountNameAr"), `ca.nameAr` would be undefined... but `entityName` is set by legacy create to nameAr. /**
 * financialAccountAdmin.ts
 * إدارة دليل الحسابات يدويًا (إنشاء/تعديل/حذف/حركات) عبر alx_api فقط.
 * Manual chart-of-accounts administration over alx_api; the UI never writes to the database directly.
 */
import { financeApiClient, mapAccountRow, readAllFinanceRows, type ApiEnvelope } from './financeApi';
import type { FinancialAccount } from './financialAccountTypes';

const ACCOUNTS_PATH = '/api/v1/finance/accounts';

/** حقول يقبلها API عند إنشاء/تعديل حساب — mirrors the strict financialAccountSchema. */
export interface FinancialAccountInput {
  accountCode?: string;
  accountNumber?: string | null;
  accountPrefix?: string | null;
  accNameAr?: string | null;
  accNameEn?: string | null;
  entityName?: string | null;
  entityType?: string | null;
  entityId?: string | null;
  type?: string | null;
  currency?: string | null;
  balance?: number | null;
  isActive?: boolean | null;
  notes?: string | null;
}

export type AccountDeletionResult =
  | { status: 'deleted' }
  | { status: 'in_use'; movements: number }
  | { status: 'not_found' };

/** يستخرج رقم الحساب من آخر مقطع في الرمز — derives the account number from the code's last segment. */
export function accountNumberFromCode(accountCode: string): string {
  const segments = String(accountCode || '').split('-');
  return segments.length > 1 ? segments[segments.length - 1].trim() : String(accountCode || '').trim();
}

export async function createFinancialAccount(accountId: string, input: FinancialAccountInput): Promise<FinancialAccount> {...}
export async function updateFinancialAccount(accountId: string, input: FinancialAccountInput): Promise<FinancialAccount> {...}
export async function deleteFinancialAccount(accountId: string): Promise<AccountDeletionResult> {...}
export async function listAccountMovements(accountId: string): Promise<any[]> {...}

The report render uses `tx.id` as key, `tx.createdAt`, `tx.entryNumber`, `tx.description`, `tx.module`, `tx.transType`, `tx.amountOriginal`, `tx.currencyOriginal`, `tx.amount`.

The API movement row provides: transactionId, entryId, entryNumber, module (entry_category), lineNo, transType, accountId, amount, amountOriginal, currencyOriginalNo (number, not code), description, note, createdAt. No `id`, no `currencyOriginal` string.

So for the render to work I should map movements into a report row shape in the service/component:
```ts
interface AccountReportLine {
  id: string;
  createdAt?: string | number;
  entryNumber?: string;
  description?: string;
  module?: string;
  transType?: string;
  amount: number;
  amountOriginal?: number;
  currency?: string;   // native display currency
}
```

  amount: Number(movement.amount ?? 0),

}));
```

But careful: the render uses `tx.currencyOriginal && tx.currencyOriginal !== ...` for the ≈ line. With my mapping, I'd use `amountOriginal`/`currency`. import { ApiClient } from "../../data/http/api-client";

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T; meta?: { total?: number } };
type ApiPage<T> = { items: T[]; total?: number };
type Unsubscribe = () => void;

const apiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:3001",
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === "undefined"
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem("alx_access_token") || sessionStorage.getItem("alx_api_access_token")),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

const MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE = 1_000;
const MAX_MOVEMENT_ROWS = 20_000;

const apiCollectionPaths: Record<string, string> = {
  accounts: "/api/v1/finance/accounts",
  main_entry: "/api/v1/finance/entries",
  account_trans: "/api/v1/finance/account-movements",
  custody_advances: "/api/v1/finance/custody-advances",
  auto_entries: "/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules",
};

function isEnabled(): boolean {
  return true;
}

function normalizeRows(
  collectionName: string,
  rows: Record<string, unknown>[]
): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  if (collectionName === "accounts")
    return rows.map(row => ({
      ...row,
      id: row.accountId ?? row.id,
      accountName: row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn,
    }));

41	  const debitNormal = accountType === 'Asset' || accountType === 'Expense';
42	  if (debitNormal) return transactionType === 'Debit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;
43	  return transactionType === 'Credit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;

46	/** قواعد أكواد شجرة الحسابات. تظل مستقلة لتختبر وتستخدم في الواجهة والخدمة بالمنطق نفسه. */
47	export const hierarchyCodeRules = {
48	  nextRootCode(records: any[]): string {
49	    const used = new Set((records || []).map(readCode).filter((code) => /^\d$/.test(code)));
50	    let next = 1;
51	    while (used.has(String(next))) next += 1;
52	    if (next > 9) throw new Error('لا يمكن إنشاء حساب رئيسي جديد: نطاق أكواد الجذر المكوّن من رقم واحد ممتلئ.');
53	    return String(next);
54	  },
55	
56	  nextChildCode(parentCode: string, records: any[]): string {
57	    const normalizedParent = onlyDigits(parentCode);
58	    if (!normalizedParent || normalizedParent.length >= 4) {
59	      throw new Error('رمز الأب غير صالح لإنشاء عقدة فرعية.');
60	    }
61	    const childNumbers = (records || [])
62	      .map(readCode)
63	      .filter((code) => code.startsWith(normalizedParent) && /^\d+$/.test(code))
64	      .map((code) => code.slice(normalizedParent.length))
65	      .filter((suffix) => /^\d$/.test(suffix))
66	      .map(Number);
67	    const next = Math.max(0, ...childNumbers) + 1;
68	    if (next > 9) throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء عقدة أخرى تحت ${normalizedParent}: نطاق التسلسل ممتلئ.`);
69	    return `${normalizedParent}${next}`;
70	  },
71	
72	  postingPrefix(accSubCode: string, groupCode?: string): string {
73	    const selected = onlyDigits(groupCode || accSubCode);
74	    if (!selected || selected.length > 4) {
75	      throw new Error('يجب اختيار حساب جزئي صالح، ومجموعة اختيارية ذات كود صالح، قبل إنشاء حساب مالي.');
76	    }
77	    return selected.padEnd(4, '0');
78	  },
79	
80	  nextPostingSequence(prefix: string, records: any[]): number {
81	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
82	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4) throw new Error('بادئة الحساب المالي يجب أن تتكون من أربعة أرقام.');
83	    return (records || []).reduce((maximum, record) => {
84	      const explicitSequence = Number(readValue(record, 'accountSeq', 'account_seq') || 0);
85	      const codeMatch = readCode(record).match(new RegExp(`^${normalizedPrefix}-(\\d{1,4})$`));
86	      const codeSequence = codeMatch ? Number(codeMatch[1]) : 0;
87	      return Math.max(maximum, Number.isInteger(explicitSequence) ? explicitSequence : 0, codeSequence);
88	    }, 0) + 1;
89	  },
90	
91	  formatPostingCode(prefix: string, sequence: number): string {
92	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
93	    const normalizedSequence = Number(sequence);
94	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4 || !Number.isInteger(normalizedSequence) || normalizedSequence < 1 || normalizedSequence > 9999) {
95	      throw new Error('كود الحساب المالي أو تسلسله غير صالح.');
96	    }
97	    return `${normalizedPrefix}-${String(normalizedSequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;
98	  },
99	
100	  validateCode(kind: HierarchyCodeKind, code: string, parents: { accountCode?: string; mainCode?: string; subCode?: string; groupCode?: string }): string | null {
101	    const normalized = String(code || '').trim();
102	    if (kind === 'account') return /^\d$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الرئيسي يجب أن يكون رقمًا واحدًا.';
103	    if (kind === 'main') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.accountCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{2}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الفرعي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الرئيسي مباشرة.';
104	    if (kind === 'sub') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.mainCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{3}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الجزئي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الفرعي مباشرة.';
105	    if (kind === 'group') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.subCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{4}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود المجموعة يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الجزئي مباشرة.';
106	
107	    const prefix = this.postingPrefix(parents.subCode || '', parents.groupCode);
108	    return new RegExp(`^${prefix}-\\d{4}$`).test(normalized)
109	      ? null
110	      : `كود الحساب المالي يجب أن يطابق ${prefix}-0001.`;
111	  },
112	};

114	class AccountingHierarchyService {
115	  /** يبقى الحساب القديم قابلاً للقيد فقط إلى أن تصنّف الحسابات في الترحيل التالي. */
116	  isPostingAccount(account: any): boolean {
117	    return Boolean(account?.id)
118	      && account?.isActive !== false
119	      && account?.is_active !== false
120	      && account?.isHierarchyNode !== true;
121	  }
122	
123	  filterPostingAccounts(accounts: any[], requireClassified = false): any[] {
124	    return (accounts || []).filter((account) => {
125	      if (!this.isPostingAccount(account)) return false;
126	      return !requireClassified || Boolean(readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id'));
127	    });
128	  }
129	
130	  async hasHierarchyStructure(): Promise<boolean> {
131	    const [rootSnapshot, subSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
132	      getDocs(collection(db, 'account')),
133	      getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub')),
134	    ]);
135	    return !rootSnapshot.empty && !subSnapshot.empty;
136	  }
137	
138	  async getDefaultCurrencyId(): Promise<number | undefined> {
139	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'currency'));
140	    const currency = snap.docs
141	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
142	      .find((entry: any) => entry.isDefault === true || entry.is_default === true);
143	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
144	  }
145	
146	  async getCurrencyIdByCode(currencyCode?: string): Promise<number | undefined> {
147	    const normalizedCode = String(currencyCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
148	    if (!normalizedCode) return this.getDefaultCurrencyId();
149	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'currency'));
150	    const currency = snap.docs
151	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
152	      .find((entry: any) => String(entry.code || '').toUpperCase() === normalizedCode);
153	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
154	  }
155	
156	  async getEntityPostingLocation(entityType: LedgerEntityType): Promise<AccountGroupLocation | null> {
157	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub_group'));
158	    const group = snap.docs
159	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
160	      .find((entry: any) => readValue(entry, 'entityType', 'entity_type') === entityType
161	        && entry.isActive !== false
162	        && entry.is_active !== false
163	        && readValue(entry, 'allowsDirectAccounts', 'allows_direct_accounts') !== false);
164	    if (!group) return null;
165	
166	    const accountCode = readCode(group);
167	    const accSubId = String(readValue(group, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') || '').trim();
168	    if (!accountCode || !accSubId) return null;
169	    const curNo = readValue(group, 'curNo', 'cur_no');
170	    return { accSubId, groupId: group.id, accountCode, currencyId: curNo == null ? undefined : Number(curNo) };
171	  }
172	
173	  async getNextAccountSequence(location: AccountGroupLocation): Promise<number> {
174	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'accounts'));
175	    const siblings = snap.docs
176	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
177	      .filter((account: any) => {
178	        const sameGroup = location.groupId && readValue(account, 'groupId', 'group_id') === location.groupId;
179	        const sameSub = !location.groupId && readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') === location.accSubId;
180	        return Boolean(sameGroup || sameSub);
181	      });
182	    return hierarchyCodeRules.nextPostingSequence(location.accountCode, siblings);
183	  }
184	
185	  async getDefaultAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<DefaultAccountBinding | null> {
186	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'default_accounts'));
187	    const binding = snap.docs
188	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
189	      .find((entry: any) => String(readValue(entry, 'defaultKey', 'default_key') || '') === defaultKey);
190	    if (!binding || binding.isActive === false || binding.is_active === false) return null;
191	    const accountId = String(readValue(binding, 'accountId', 'account_id') || '').trim();
192	    if (!accountId) return null;
193	    return {
194	      id: String(binding.id),
195	      defaultKey,
196	      accountId,
197	      accNameAr: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameAr', 'acc_name_ar') || binding.nameAr || ''),
198	      accNameEn: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameEn', 'acc_name_en') || binding.nameEn || ''),
199	      curNo: readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no') == null ? undefined : Number(readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no')),
200	      isActive: true,
201	    };
202	  }
203	
204	  async resolveDefaultPostingAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<any | null> {
205	    const binding = await this.getDefaultAccount(defaultKey);
206	    if (!binding) return null;
207	    const account = await getDoc(doc(db, 'accounts', binding.accountId));
208	    if (!account.exists()) return null;
209	    const resolved = { id: account.id, ...account.data() };
210	    return this.isPostingAccount(resolved) ? resolved : null;
211	  }
212	
213	  validateNaturalBalanceLimit(account: any, delta: number): void {
214	    const limit = Number(readValue(account, 'limitedBalance', 'limited_balance') || 0);
215	    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return;
216	    const current = Number(readValue(account, 'balance', 'balance') || 0);
217	    const next = current + Number(delta || 0);
218	    if (next > limit) {
219	      throw new Error(`Account ${readCode(account)} exceeds its configured natural balance limit.`);
220	    }
221	  }
222	}

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

const rpc = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
vi.mock('../data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts', () => ({ supabase: { rpc } }));

import { financialEntrySettingsService } from './financialEntrySettingsService';

describe('financialEntrySettingsService', () => {
  it('يفوض الحفظ إلى إجراء خلفي واحد بدل الكتابة المباشرة على الجداول', async () => {
    rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: { id: 'module_test', code: 'TEST', isActive: true }, error: null });
    await expect(financialEntrySettingsService.manage('create', 'module', 'module_test', {
      code: 'TEST', nameAr: 'فئة اختبار', isActive: true,
    })).resolves.toMatchObject({ id: 'module_test' });
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('manage_financial_entry_setting', {
      p_action: 'create', p_kind: 'module', p_id: 'module_test',
      p_payload: { code: 'TEST', nameAr: 'فئة اختبار', isActive: true },
    });
  });

  it('يعرض خطأ الإجراء الخلفي ولا يخفي رفض الصلاحية', async () => {
    rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({ data: null, error: { message: 'لا تملك صلاحية create_entry_settings' } });
    await expect(financialEntrySettingsService.manage('delete', 'type', 'type_test')).rejects.toThrow('لا تملك صلاحية');
  });
});

68	export const naturalBalanceDelta = (
69	  accountType: string | undefined,
70	  transactionType: 'Debit' | 'Credit',
71	  amount: number,
72	): number => {
73	  const normalizedAmount = Number(amount || 0);
74	  const debitNormal = accountType === 'Asset' || accountType === 'Expense';
75	  if (debitNormal) return transactionType === 'Debit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;
76	  return transactionType === 'Credit' ? normalizedAmount : -normalizedAmount;

79	/** قواعد أكواد شجرة الحسابات. تظل مستقلة لتختبر وتستخدم في الواجهة والخدمة بالمنطق نفسه. */
80	export const hierarchyCodeRules = {
81	  nextRootCode(records: any[]): string {
82	    const used = new Set((records || []).map(readCode).filter((code) => /^\d$/.test(code)));
83	    let next = 1;
84	    while (used.has(String(next))) next += 1;
85	    if (next > 9) throw new Error('لا يمكن إنشاء حساب رئيسي جديد: نطاق أكواد الجذر المكوّن من رقم واحد ممتلئ.');
86	    return String(next);
87	  },
88	
89	  nextChildCode(parentCode: string, records: any[]): string {
90	    const normalizedParent = onlyDigits(parentCode);
91	    if (!normalizedParent || normalizedParent.length >= 4) {
92	      throw new Error('رمز الأب غير صالح لإنشاء عقدة فرعية.');
93	    }
94	    const childNumbers = (records || [])
95	      .map(readCode)
96	      .filter((code) => code.startsWith(normalizedParent) && /^\d+$/.test(code))
97	      .map((code) => code.slice(normalizedParent.length))
98	      .filter((suffix) => /^\d$/.test(suffix))
99	      .map(Number);
100	    const next = Math.max(0, ...childNumbers) + 1;
101	    if (next > 9) throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء عقدة أخرى تحت ${normalizedParent}: نطاق التسلسل ممتلئ.`);
102	    return `${normalizedParent}${next}`;
103	  },
104	
105	  postingPrefix(accSubCode: string, groupCode?: string): string {
106	    const selected = onlyDigits(groupCode || accSubCode);
107	    if (!selected || selected.length > 4) {
108	      throw new Error('يجب اختيار حساب جزئي صالح، ومجموعة اختيارية ذات كود صالح، قبل إنشاء حساب مالي.');
109	    }
110	    return selected.padEnd(4, '0');
111	  },
112	
113	  nextPostingSequence(prefix: string, records: any[]): number {
114	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
115	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4) throw new Error('بادئة الحساب المالي يجب أن تتكون من أربعة أرقام.');
116	    return (records || []).reduce((maximum, record) => {
117	      const explicitSequence = Number(readValue(record, 'accountSeq', 'account_seq') || 0);
118	      const codeMatch = readCode(record).match(new RegExp(`^${normalizedPrefix}-(\\d{1,4})$`));
119	      const codeSequence = codeMatch ? Number(codeMatch[1]) : 0;
120	      return Math.max(maximum, Number.isInteger(explicitSequence) ? explicitSequence : 0, codeSequence);
121	    }, 0) + 1;
122	  },
123	
124	  formatPostingCode(prefix: string, sequence: number): string {
125	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
126	    const normalizedSequence = Number(sequence);
127	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4 || !Number.isInteger(normalizedSequence) || normalizedSequence < 1 || normalizedSequence > 9999) {
128	      throw new Error('كود الحساب المالي أو تسلسله غير صالح.');
129	    }
130	    return `${normalizedPrefix}-${String(normalizedSequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;
131	  },
132	
133	  validateCode(kind: HierarchyCodeKind, code: string, parents: { accountCode?: string; mainCode?: string; subCode?: string; groupCode?: string }): string | null {
134	    const normalized = String(code || '').trim();
135	    if (kind === 'account') return /^\d$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الرئيسي يجب أن يكون رقمًا واحدًا.';
136	    if (kind === 'main') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.accountCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{2}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الفرعي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الرئيسي مباشرة.';
137	    if (kind === 'sub') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.mainCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{3}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الجزئي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الفرعي مباشرة.';
138	    if (kind === 'group') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.subCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{4}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود المجموعة يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الجزئي مباشرة.';
139	
140	    const prefix = this.postingPrefix(parents.subCode || '', parents.groupCode);
141	    return new RegExp(`^${prefix}-\\d{4}$`).test(normalized)
142	      ? null
143	      : `كود الحساب المالي يجب أن يطابق ${prefix}-0001.`;
144	  },
145	};

147	class AccountingHierarchyService {
148	  /** يبقى الحساب القديم قابلاً للقيد فقط إلى أن تصنّف الحسابات في الترحيل التالي. */
149	  isPostingAccount(account: any): boolean {
150	    return Boolean(account?.id || account?.accountId)
151	      && account?.isActive !== false
152	      && account?.is_active !== false
153	      && account?.isHierarchyNode !== true;
154	  }
155	
156	  filterPostingAccounts(accounts: any[], requireClassified = false): any[] {
157	    return (accounts || []).filter((account) => {
158	      if (!this.isPostingAccount(account)) return false;
159	      return !requireClassified || Boolean(readSubAccountId(account));
160	    });
161	  }
162	
163	  /** وجود هيكل للشجرة = جذر واحد على الأقل وحساب جزئي واحد على الأقل. */
164	  async hasHierarchyStructure(): Promise<boolean> {
165	    const [rootRows, subRows] = await Promise.all([
166	      readRows('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/account', { limit: 1 }),
167	      readRows('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/acc-sub', { limit: 1 }),
168	    ]);
169	    return rootRows.length > 0 && subRows.length > 0;
170	  }
171	
172	  async getDefaultCurrencyId(): Promise<number | undefined> {
173	    const currency = await currencyService.getDefaultCurrency();
174	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined || currency?.cur_id === null ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
175	  }
176	
177	  async getCurrencyIdByCode(currencyCode?: string): Promise<number | undefined> {
178	    const normalizedCode = String(currencyCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
179	    if (!normalizedCode) return this.getDefaultCurrencyId();
180	    const currencies = await currencyService.getAllCurrencies(false);
181	    const currency = currencies.find((entry) => String(entry.code || '').toUpperCase() === normalizedCode);
182	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
183	  }
184	
185	  /** يحدد المجموعة التي تُنشأ تحتها حسابات الكيان (entity_type) مع كودها والعملية المرتبطة بها. */
186	  async getEntityPostingLocation(entityType: LedgerEntityType): Promise<AccountGroupLocation | null> {
187	    const rows = asRows(await apiClient.get<unknown>('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/acc-sub-group', { limit: 1000 }));
188	    const group = rows.find((entry: any) => readValue(entry, 'entityType', 'entity_type') === entityType
189	      && entry.isActive !== false
190	      && readValue(entry, 'allowsDirectAccounts', 'allows_direct_accounts') !== false);
191	    if (!group) return null;
192	
193	    const accountCode = readCode(group);
194	    const accSubId = String(readValue(group, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') || '').trim();
195	    if (!accountCode || !accSubId) return null;
196	    const curNo = readValue(group, 'curNo', 'cur_no');
197	    const groupId = String(group.nodeId ?? group.accSubGroupId ?? group.id ?? '').trim();
198	    return { accSubId, groupId: groupId || undefined, accountCode, currencyId: curNo == null ? undefined : Number(curNo) };
199	  }
200	
201	  async getNextAccountSequence(location: AccountGroupLocation): Promise<number> {
202	    const rows = asRows(await apiClient.get<unknown>('/api/v1/finance/accounts', { limit: 1000 }));
203	    const siblings = rows.filter((account: any) => {
204	      const sameGroup = location.groupId && readValue(account, 'groupId', 'group_id') === location.groupId;
205	      const sameSub = !location.groupId && readSubAccountId(account) === location.accSubId;
206	      return Boolean(sameGroup || sameSub);
207	    });
208	    return hierarchyCodeRules.nextPostingSequence(location.accountCode, siblings);
209	  }
210	
211	  async getDefaultAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<DefaultAccountBinding | null> {
212	    const rows = asRows(await apiClient.get<unknown>('/api/v1/finance/default-accounts', { limit: 1000, search: defaultKey }));
213	    const binding = rows.find((entry: any) => String(readValue(entry, 'defaultKey', 'default_key') || '') === defaultKey);
214	    if (!binding || binding.isActive === false || binding.is_active === false) return null;
215	    const accountId = String(readValue(binding, 'accountId', 'account_id') || '').trim();
216	    if (!accountId) return null;
217	    return {
218	      id: String(binding.defaultAccountId ?? binding.id ?? ''),
219	      defaultKey,
220	      accountId,
221	      accNameAr: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameAr', 'acc_name_ar') || binding.nameAr || ''),
222	      accNameEn: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameEn', 'acc_name_en') || binding.nameEn || ''),
223	      curNo: readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no') == null ? undefined : Number(readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no')),
224	      isActive: true,
225	    };
226	  }
227	
228	  async resolveDefaultPostingAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<any | null> {
229	    const binding = await this.getDefaultAccount(defaultKey);
230	    if (!binding) return null;
231	    try {
232	      const account = await apiClient.get<any>(`/api/v1/finance/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(binding.accountId)}`);
233	      if (!account) return null;
234	      const resolved = { ...account, id: account.accountId ?? binding.accountId };
235	      return this.isPostingAccount(resolved) ? resolved : null;
236	    } catch (error) {
237	      if ((error as { code?: string }).code !== 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') throw error;
238	      return null;
239	    }
240	  }
241	
242	  validateNaturalBalanceLimit(account: any, delta: number): void {
243	    const limit = Number(readValue(account, 'limitedBalance', 'limited_balance') || 0);
244	    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return;
245	    const current = Number(readValue(account, 'balance', 'balance') || 0);
246	    const next = current + Number(delta || 0);
247	    if (next > limit) {
248	      throw new Error(`Account ${readCode(account)} exceeds its configured natural balance limit.`);
249	    }
250	  }
251	}

'/api/v1/finance/entry-modules' : '/api/v1/finance/entry-types';\n\n/**\n * المسارات الخلفية strict: أي مفتاح undefined أو غير معروف يسبب رفض 400.\n * Backend schemas are strict, so undefined/unknown keys are dropped before sending.\n */\nfunction toRequestBody(kind: FinancialEntrySettingKind, payload: FinancialEntrySettingPayload): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { code: payload.code, nameAr: payload.nameAr };\n  if (payload.nameEn !== undefined) body.nameEn = payload.nameEn;\n  if (payload.note !== undefined) body.note = payload.note;\n  if (payload.isActive !== undefined) body.isActive = payload.isActive;\n  if (kind === 'type' && payload.moduleId) body.moduleId = payload.moduleId;\n  return body;\n}\n\nexport const financialEntrySettingsService = {\n  async manage(\n    action: FinancialEntrySettingAction,\n    kind: FinancialEntrySettingKind,\n    id: string,\n    payload: FinancialEntrySettingPayload = { code: '', nameAr: '' },\n  ) {\n    const path = basePath(kind);\n    if (action === 'delete') {\n      const res = await apiClient.delete<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(`${path}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);\n      return res?.data ?? null;\n    }\n\n    const body = toRequestBody(kind, payload);\n    const res = action === 'create'\n      ? await apiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, body)\n      : await apiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(`${path}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, body);\n    return res?.data ?? null;\n  },\n};\n",

297	  /**
298	   * Centralized, unified and strict recordTransaction method.
299	   * Enforces that every transaction defines a source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account,
300	   * checks that the transaction amounts are fully balanced,
301	   * and registers the unified transaction accordingly.
302	   */
303	  async recordTransaction(
304	    transaction: Transaction,
305	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },
306	  ): Promise<void> {
307	    // 1. Enforce strict requirement: Must explicitly define source (Credit) and destination (Debit)
308	    if (!transaction.debitAccount?.id || !transaction.creditAccount?.id) {
309	      throw new Error(
310	        "Transaction submission rejected: A source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account are explicitly required.",
311	      );
312	    }
313	
314	    // 2. Prevent any transaction submission where totalDebit !== totalCredit
315	    // On the single value amount double entry form, the debit and credit totals are inherently equal to this amount.
316	    const debitTotal = transaction.amount;
317	    const creditTotal = transaction.amount;
318	    if (debitTotal !== creditTotal) {
319	      throw new Error(
320	        "Transaction submission rejected: Sum of Debits must equal Sum of Credits (totalDebit == totalCredit). debitTotal=" + debitTotal + "creditTotal=" + creditTotal,
321	      );
322	    } else if (debitTotal <= 0) {
323	      throw new Error(
324	        "Transaction submission rejected: Debit Amount must be greater than zero.",
325	      );
326	    } else if (creditTotal <= 0) {
327	      throw new Error(
328	        "Transaction submission rejected: Credit Amount must be greater than zero.",
329	      );
330	    }
331	
332	
333	
334	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(transaction.debitAccount.id);
335	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(
336	      transaction.creditAccount.id,
337	    );
338	
339	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
340	      throw new Error(
341	        "Transaction submission rejected: Specified accounts do not exist.",
342	      );
343	    }
344	
345	    const journalEntry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id"> = {
346	      entryNumber:
347	        (transaction as any).entryNumber ||
348	        transaction.automationKey ||
349	        `JV-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replaceAll('-', '')}-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
350	      createdAt: transaction.date || Date.now(),
351	      description: transaction.description || "",
352	      attachments: transaction.attachments || [],
353	      notes: transaction.notes || transaction.description || "",
354	
355	      debitAccountId: transaction.debitAccount.id,
356	      debitAccountName: debitAccount.entityName,
357	      debitAccountCode: debitAccount.accountCode,
358	
359	      creditAccountId: transaction.creditAccount.id,
360	      creditAccountName: creditAccount.entityName,
361	      creditAccountCode: creditAccount.accountCode,
362	
363	      amount: transaction.amount,
364	      currency: transaction.currency || debitAccount.currency || "YER",
365	      amountDebitCurrency: 0,

367	
368	      module: transaction.module || "adjustment",

370	      orderId: transaction.orderId,

510	   */
511	  async getExchangeRates(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
512	    try {
513	      const activeCurrencies = await currencyService.getActiveCurrencies();

517	      const rates: Record<string, number> = {};

519	        const code = String(currency.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
520	        const price = currency.isDefault ? 1 : Number(currency.currentPrice);
521	        if (!code || !Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) {
522	          throw new Error(`لا يوجد سعر صرف موثق للعملة ${code || '[unknown]'}.`);
523	        }
524	        rates[code] = price;
525	      }

527	    } catch (e) {
528	      console.error('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر تحميل أسعار الصرف الموثقة؛ أُوقف إنشاء القيد بدل استخدام سعر احتياطي.', e);

706	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
707	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
708	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
709	    try {
710	      const accountDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "accounts", accountId));
711	      if (!accountDoc.exists()) {
712	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);
713	        return 0;
714	      }
715	      const { error } = await (supabase as any).rpc('recalculate_accounting_hierarchy', {
716	        p_account_id: accountId,
717	      });
718	      if (error) {
719	        throw new Error(error.message || String(error));
720	      }
721	      const refreshedAccount = await this.getAccountById(accountId);
722	      return Number(refreshedAccount?.balance || 0);
723	    } catch (error) {
724	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
725	      return 0;
726	    }
727	  }

729	  /**
730	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
731	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
732	   */
733	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
734	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
735	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
736	    }
737	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
738	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
739	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
740	    }, delayMs);
741	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
742	  }

744	  /**
745	   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.
746	   * Returns a summary of accounts processed and any errors encountered.
747	   * Useful for migration / reconciliation runs.
748	   */
749	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{
750	    processed: number;
751	    errors: number;
752	    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;
753	  }> {
754	    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];
755	    let errors = 0;
756	
757	    try {
758	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, "accounts"));
759	      const docs = snap.docs;
760	
761	      // Process in parallel batches of 5 to avoid overwhelming the DB while still being fast
762	      const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
763	      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
764	        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
765	        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {
766	          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;
767	          const oldBalance = data.balance || 0;
768	          try {
769	            const newBalance = await this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(d.id);
770	            results.push({
771	              accountId: d.id,
772	              accountCode: data.accountCode || d.id,
773	              oldBalance,
774	              newBalance,
775	            });
776	          } catch (err) {
777	            errors++;
778	            console.error(`[recalculateAllBalances] Error on account ${d.id}:`, err);
779	          }
780	        }));
781	      }
782	    } catch (err) {
783	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error loading accounts:", err);
784	    }
785	
786	    return { processed: results.length, errors, results };
787	  }

});

export const settingsCategorySchema = z.enum(['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules']);
export const updateSettingsSchema = z.object({ settings: settingsObject }).strict();

  fontSize: z.enum(['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl']).optional(),
  dashboardGridColumns: z.number().int().min(1).max(12).optional(),
  visibleMetrics: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(100).optional(),
  sidebarCollapsed: z.boolean().optional(),
  sidebarItems: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(100).optional(),
}).strict();
export const updateUserSettingsSchema = z.object({ settings: userSettingsSchema }).strict();
