import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { SettingsCategory, SettingsRecord, SettingsRepository, UserSettingsData, UserSettingsRecord } from './settings.contracts';

const settingsColumns = `
  setting_id AS "settingId",
  COALESCE(category, setting_id) AS category,
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

const userSettingsColumns = `
  user_setting_id AS "userSettingId",
  user_id AS "userId",
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

export function createSettingsRepository(pool: Pool): SettingsRepository {
  return {
    async get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${settingsColumns} FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id = $1 OR category = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [category],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `INSERT INTO public.settings (setting_id, category, data, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
         VALUES ($1, $1, $2::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $3, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (setting_id) DO UPDATE SET
           category = EXCLUDED.category,
           data = COALESCE(public.settings.data, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.data,
           updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
         RETURNING ${settingsColumns}`,
        [category, JSON.stringify(settings), actorId],
      );
      const row = result.rows[0];
      if (!row) throw new Error('SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
      return row;
    },
    async getUser(userId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${userSettingsColumns} FROM public.user_settings
         WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [userId],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async updateUser(userId: string, settings: UserSettingsData, actorId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord> {
      const existing = await this.getUser(userId);
      const data = JSON.stringify(settings);
      let result;
      if (existing) {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `UPDATE public.user_settings SET data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb,
             language = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'language'), language),
             theme = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'theme'), theme),
             font_size = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'fontSize'), font_size),
             dashboard_grid_columns = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'dashboardGridColumns')::numeric, dashboard_grid_columns),
             visible_metrics = COALESCE($1::jsonb -> 'visibleMetrics', visible_metrics),
             updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = $2
           WHERE user_setting_id = $3 RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
          [data, actorId, existing.userSettingId],
        );
      } else {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `INSERT INTO public.user_settings
             (user_setting_id, user_id, data, language, theme, font_size, dashboard_grid_columns, visible_metrics, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $9, $9)
           RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,

import type { IsoUtcString } from './common.dto';

export interface CustomCurrencyDto {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  rateToYER: number;
  flag?: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export type WhatsAppProvider = 'ultramsg' | 'twilio' | 'custom';

export interface WhatsAppSettingsWriteInput {
  enabled: boolean;
  provider: WhatsAppProvider;
  config: {
    token?: string;
    instanceId?: string;
    accountSid?: string;
    sender?: string;
    customUrl?: string;
    customMethod?: string;
    customHeaders?: string;
    customBody?: string;
  };
  triggers: {
    onOrderCreated: boolean;
    onOrderStatusChanged: boolean;
    onPaymentReceived: boolean;
  };
  templates: {
    onOrderCreated: string;
    onOrderStatusChanged: string;
    onPaymentReceived: string;
  };
}

/** Safe read model: never returns tokens, account SIDs, custom headers, or raw custom request bodies. */
export interface WhatsAppSettingsApiDto {
  enabled: boolean;
  provider: WhatsAppProvider;
  credentials: {
    hasToken: boolean;
    hasInstanceId: boolean;
    hasAccountSid: boolean;
    sender: string | null;
    hasCustomUrl: boolean;
    hasCustomHeaders: boolean;
    hasCustomBody: boolean;
  };
  triggers: WhatsAppSettingsWriteInput['triggers'];
  templates: WhatsAppSettingsWriteInput['templates'];
}

/** Allowlisted settings used by SettingsContext; raw JSONB is not returned. */
export interface SystemSettingsData {
  language: 'ar' | 'en';
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';

32	      if ((previousExecutions.data || []).length > 0) {
33	        console.info('[AutomaticVouchers] Duplicate execution prevented.', { automationKey, ruleId, orderIdentifier });

36	      let rule: AutomaticVoucherRule | null = null;

41	        if (autoEntryDoc.exists()) {
42	          rule = { id: autoEntryDoc.id, ...autoEntryDoc.data() };
43	        } else {
44	          // Check query by id field in auto_entries
45	          const qAuto = query(collection(db, "auto_entries"), where("id", "==", ruleId));
46	          const autoSnap = await getDocs(qAuto);

48	            const first = autoSnap.docs[0];

61	async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
62	  collectionName: string
63	): Promise<T[]> {
64	  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
65	  if (!path)
66	    throw new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`);
67	  const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiPage<T>>>(path, {
68	    limit: 100,
69	    offset: 0,
70	  });
71	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data)
72	    ? response.data
73	    : (response.data.items ?? []);
74	  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];

78	  isEnabled,
79	  subscribeCollection<
80	    T extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>,
81	  >(
82	    collectionName: string,
83	    onData: (rows: T[]) => void,
84	    onError: (error: unknown) => void

86	    if (!isEnabled()) {

90	    if (!apiCollectionPaths[collectionName]) {

92	      return () => undefined;

7	export async function generateFinancialAccountIdentifiers(service: any, entityType: AccountEntityType, prefixOverride?: string): Promise<{ prefix: string; accountNumber: string; accountCode: string; code: string; accountId: string }> {

12	    }
13	    const prefix = hierarchyLocation
14	      ? hierarchyCodeRules.postingPrefix(hierarchyLocation.accountCode)
15	      : (prefixOverride || LEGACY_ACCOUNT_PREFIXES[entityType] || "5000");
16	
17	    let allAccounts: any[] = [];
18	    let entityDocs: any[] = [];
19	    try {
20	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, "accounts"));
21	      allAccounts = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));

23	      const entityCollectionName = service.getEntityCollection(entityType);
24	      if (entityCollectionName) {

27	      }
28	    } catch (e) {
29	      console.warn("[FinancialAccountService] Error fetching existing accounts/entities for uniqueness check:", e);
30	    }
31	
32	    const existingIds = new Set<string>();
33	    const existingCodes = new Set<string>();
34	    const existingNumbersForPrefix = new Set<string>();
35	
36	    let maxSeq = 0;
37	
38	    for (const acc of allAccounts) {
39	      if (acc.id) existingIds.add(String(acc.id));
40	
41	      const accCode = String(acc.accountCode || acc.code || '').trim();
42	      if (accCode) existingCodes.add(accCode);
43	
44	      const rawCode = String(acc.code || '').trim();
45	      if (rawCode) existingCodes.add(rawCode);
46	
47	      const accNum = String(acc.accountNumber || '').trim();
48	      const accPrefix = String(acc.accountPrefix || acc.parentCode || '').trim();
49	
50	      if (accPrefix === prefix || accCode.startsWith(`${prefix}-`)) {
51	        if (accNum) existingNumbersForPrefix.add(accNum);
52	
53	        const parts = accCode.split("-");
54	        if (parts.length >= 2) {
55	          const num = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
56	          if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxSeq) {
57	            maxSeq = num;

59	        }
60	        if (accNum) {

import { z } from 'zod';

export const customerIdSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(128);
const nullableText = z.string().trim().max(500).nullable().optional();
const jsonValue = z.unknown().optional();

export const listCustomersQuerySchema = z.object({
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).default(25),
  offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0),
  search: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(120)
    .transform((val) => (val.length > 0 ? val : undefined))
    .optional(),
  isActive: z
    .enum(['true', 'false'])
    .transform((value) => value === 'true')
    .optional(),
});

export const createCustomerSchema = z.object({
  customerId: customerIdSchema.optional(),
  accountId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(128).nullable().optional(),
  isActive: z.boolean().optional(),
  joinBy: nullableText,
  referrerId: nullableText,
  fullName: nullableText,
  nameAr: nullableText,
  nameEn: nullableText,
  customerLevel: nullableText,
  acquisitionSource: nullableText,
  preferredCategories: jsonValue,
  location: jsonValue,
  address: nullableText,
  onboardingCompleted: z.boolean().nullable().optional(),
});

export const updateCustomerSchema = createCustomerSchema
  .omit({ customerId: true })
  .partial()
  .refine((value) => Object.keys(value).length > 0, 'يجب إرسال حقل واحد على الأقل للتعديل.');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalculate_all_account_balances()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  acc record;
  recalculated_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR acc IN SELECT account_id FROM public.accounts LOOP
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(acc.account_id);
    recalculated_count := recalculated_count + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'recalculatedCount', recalculated_count);
END;
$function$

(payload as any).items\n      : [];\n\nexport const isNotFoundError = (error: unknown): boolean =>\n  (error as { code?: string })?.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND';\n\n/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */\nexport async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {\n  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);\n  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };\n}\n\nexport async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {\n  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;\nconst DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 20_000;\n\n/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */\nexport async function readAllFinanceRows(\n  path: string,\n  query: FinanceQuery = {},\n  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,\n  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,\n): Promise<any[]> {\n  const rows: any[] = [];\n  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {\n    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });\n    rows.push(...page.rows);\n    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;\n  }\n  return rows;\n}\n\n/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */\nexport async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {\n  try {\n    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<any>>(path);\n    return res?.data ?? null;\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (isNotFoundError(error)) return null;\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * يحوّل صف الحساب القادم من alx_api إلى الشكل الذي تعرفه واجهات النظام.\n * Maps an accounts row (accountId/accountNameAr/subAccountId/currencyNo) to the legacy FinancialAccount shape.\n */\nexport function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {\n  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();\n  if (!accountId) return null;\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    id: accountId,\n    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),\n    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),\n    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),\n    entityType: row.entityType,\n    entityId: String(row.entityId ?? ''),\n    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn ?? ''),\n    currency: String(row.currency ?? ''),\n    curNo: row.curNo ?? row.currencyNo ?? undefined,\n    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),\n    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),\n    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),\n    isActive: row.isActive !== false,\n    type: row.type,\n    parentCode: row.parentCode ?? undefined,\n    accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId ?? undefined,\n    groupId: row.groupId ?? undefined,\n    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),\n    accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr ?? undefined,\n    accNameEn: row.accNameEn ?? row.accountNameEn ?? undefined,\n    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),\n    notes: row.notes ?? undefined,\n    createdAt: row.createdAt,\n    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,\n  } as FinancialAccount;\n}\n\n/** مسارات تعديل الكيانات التي تحمل مرجع حسابها المالي. */\nconst ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>> = {\n  customer: '/api/v1/customers',\n  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',\n  employee: '/api/v1/operations/employees',\n  source: '/api/v1/operations/sources',\n  shipping_company: '/api/v1/operations/shipping-companies',\n};\n\n/**\n * يربط الحساب المالي بسجل الكيان. الفشل هنا تحذير فقط: الحساب أُنشئ ولا يجوز التراجع عنه بصمت.\n * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.\n */\nexport async function linkEntityAccount(\n  entityType: AccountEntityType,\n  entityId: string,\n  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },\n): Promise<boolean> {\n  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];\n  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;\n  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;\n  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;\n  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;\n  try {\n    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);\n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/** التحقق من وجود قيد بمفتاح أتمتة معين — يمنع تكرار القيود التلقائية. */\nexport async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean> {\n  const key = String(automationKey || '').trim();\n  if (!key) return false;\n  const { rows, total } = await readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { automationKey: key, limit: 1 });\n  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? 26	/** معاملات قراءة المالية الموسعة (تشمل مرشحات لا تعرفها GatewayQuery العامة). */
27	export interface FinanceQuery extends GatewayQuery {
28	  includeInactive?: boolean;
29	  automationKey?: string;
30	  entityId?: string;
31	  employeeId?: string;
32	  moduleId?: string;
33	  oldAccountId?: string;

35	}

37	/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
38	export const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
39	  Array.isArray(payload)
40	    ? (payload as any[])
41	    : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items)
42	      ? (payload as any).items
43	      : [];
44	
45	export const isNotFoundError = (error: unknown): boolean =>
46	  (error as { code?: string })?.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND';
47	
48	/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */
49	export async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {
50	  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
51	  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };
52	}
53	
54	export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {
55	  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;
56	}
57	
58	const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
59	const DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 20_000;
60	
61	/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */
62	export async function readAllFinanceRows(
63	  path: string,
64	  query: FinanceQuery = {},
65	  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
66	  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
67	): Promise<any[]> {
68	  const rows: any[] = [];
69	  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
70	    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });
71	    rows.push(...page.rows);
72	    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;
73	  }
74	  return rows;
75	}

77	/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */
78	export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {
79	  try {
80	    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<any>>(path);
81	    return res?.data ?? null;
82	  } catch (error) {
83	    if (isNotFoundError(error)) return null;
84	    throw error;
85	  }
86	}

88	/**
89	 * يحوّل صف الحساب القادم من alx_api إلى الشكل الذي تعرفه واجهات النظام.
90	 * Maps an accounts row (accountId/accountNameAr/subAccountId/currencyNo) to the legacy FinancialAccount shape.
91	 */
92	export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {
93	  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();
94	  if (!accountId) return null;
95	  return {
96	    ...row,
97	    id: accountId,
98	    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),
99	    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),
100	    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),
101	    entityType: row.entityType,
102	    entityId: String(row.entityId ?? ''),
103	    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn ?? ''),
104	    currency: String(row.currency ?? ''),
105	    curNo: row.curNo ?? row.currencyNo ?? undefined,
106	    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),
107	    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),
108	    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),
109	    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
110	    type: row.type,
111	    parentCode: row.parentCode ?? undefined,
112	    accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId ?? undefined,
113	    groupId: row.groupId ?? undefined,
114	    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),
115	    accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr ?? undefined,
116	    accNameEn: row.accNameEn ?? row.accountNameEn ?? undefined,
117	    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),
118	    notes: row.notes ?? undefined,
119	    createdAt: row.createdAt,
120	    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
121	  } as FinancialAccount;
122	}

124	/** مسارات تعديل الكيانات التي تحمل مرجع حسابها المالي. */
125	const ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>> = {
126	  customer: '/api/v1/customers',
127	  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',
128	  employee: '/api/v1/operations/employees',
129	  source: '/api/v1/operations/sources',
130	  shipping_company: '/api/v1/operations/shipping-companies',
131	};
132	
133	/**
134	 * يربط الحساب المالي بسجل الكيان. الفشل هنا تحذير فقط: الحساب أُنشئ ولا يجوز التراجع عنه بصمت.
135	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.
136	 */
137	export async function linkEntityAccount(
138	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
139	  entityId: string,
140	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
141	): Promise<boolean> {
142	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
143	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
144	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
145	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
146	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
147	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
148	  try {
149	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
150	    return true;
151	  } catch (error) {
152	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
153	    return false;
154	  }
155	}
156	
157	/** التحقق من وجود قيد بمفتاح أتمتة معين — يمنع تكرار القيود التلقائية. */
158	export async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean> {
159	  const key = String(automationKey || '').trim();
160	  if (!key) return false;
161	  const { rows, total } = await readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { automationKey: key, limit: 1 });
162	  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? '') === key);
163	}
164	
165	/** يعيد احتساب الأرصدة عبر الدالة الآمنة؛ بدون معرفات = كل الحسابات. */
166	export async function recalculateAccountBalances(
167	  accountIds?: string[],
168	): Promise<{ success: boolean; recalculatedCount: number }> {
169	  const res = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ result?: { success?: boolean; recalculatedCount?: number } }>>(
170	    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/recalculate',
171	    accountIds && accountIds.length > 0 ? { accountIds } : {},
172	  );
173	  const result = res?.data?.result ?? {};
174	  return {
175	    success: result.success !== false,
176	    recalculatedCount: Number(result.recalculatedCount ?? accountIds?.length ?? 0),
177	  };
178	}

729	  /**
730	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
731	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
732	   */
733	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
734	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
735	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
736	    }
737	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
738	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);

740	    }, delayMs);
741	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
742	  }

749	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{
750	    processed: number;
751	    errors: number;
752	    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;
753	  }> {
754	    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];

763	      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
764	        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
765	        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {
766	          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;

782	    } catch (err) {

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

103	export async function createFinancialEntityAccount(service: any, entityType: AccountEntityType, entityId: string, entityName: string, currency: string, monthlySalary?: number, options?: {

106	      parentCode?: string;

112	      const existing = await service.getAccountByEntityId(entityId, entityType);
113	      if (existing && existing.id) {
114	        const now = Date.now();
115	        const existingUpdate = {
116	          entityName,
117	          currency: currency || existing.currency,
118	          type: options?.accountType || existing.type,
119	          updatedAt: now,
120	        };

125	            updatedAt: now,
126	          });
127	        }
128	        return { ...existing, ...existingUpdate };
129	      }
130	
131	      // 2. Generate guaranteed unique account identifiers
132	      const hierarchyLocation = await accountingHierarchyService.getEntityPostingLocation(entityType);
133	      if (!hierarchyLocation && await accountingHierarchyService.hasHierarchyStructure()) {
134	        throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء حساب «${entityName}»: لا توجد مجموعة نشطة لنوع الكيان «${entityType}» في شجرة الحسابات.`);
135	      }

'draft' : 'posted';\n\n    await service.recordTransaction({\n      date: Date.now(),\n      description,\n      module: moduleAssign,\n      refNumber,\n      amount,\n      currency: entities.currencyOriginal || 'YER',\n      debitAccount: { id: debitId, code: debitCode },\n      creditAccount: { id: creditId, code: creditCode },\n      // هوية المنفّذ تُستخرج في الخادم من رمز الوصول؛ لا ترسل الواجهة معرف مستخدم.\n      // The actor is derived server-side from the access token, so no client-supplied user id.\n      createdByName: entities.profileName || 'System Auto',\n      orderId: order.id,\n      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,\n      automationKey,\n      autoRuleId: entities.autoRuleId || ruleId,\n      statusId: Number(entities.statusId) || undefined,\n      isAutomatic: true,\n      amountSources: entities.amountSources,\n      amountBreakdown: entities.amountBreakdown,\n      // حالة الترحيل ستُستخدم في createFromLegacyVoucher — postingStatus is used inside recordJournalEntry via createFromLegacyVoucher\n      postingStatus,\n    });\n    console.log('automatic voucher fired successfully', { automationKey, amount, currency: entities.currencyOriginal || 'YER', debitAccount: { id: debitId, code: debitCode }, creditAccount: { id: creditId, code: creditCode }, createdByName: entities.profileName || 'System Auto', amountSources: entities.amountSources, amountBreakdown: entities.amountBreakdown, postingStatus });\n    return true;\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\n      `[AutomaticVouchers] Failed to fire automatic voucher rule: ${ruleId}`,\n      err,\n    );\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n",

  "new_string": "  /**\n   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.\n   * تعمل دالة قاعدة البيانات على كل الحسابات دفعة واحدة وتعيد عدد ما احتُسب.\n   * The database function processes every account in one call and reports how many were recalculated.\n   */\n  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{ processed: number; errors: number }> {\n    try {\n      const summary = await recalculateAccountBalances();\n      return { processed: summary.recalculatedCount, errors: summary.success ? 0 : 1 };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error recalculating balances:\", error);\n      return { processed: 0, errors: 1 };\n    }\n  }\n",
  "old_string": "  /**\n   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.\n   * Returns a summary of accounts processed and any errors encountered.\n   * Useful for migration / reconciliation runs.\n   */\n  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{\n    processed: number;\n    errors: number;\n    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;\n  }> {\n    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];\n    let errors = 0;\n\n    try {\n      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, \"accounts\"));\n      const docs = snap.docs;\n\n      // Process in parallel batches of 5 to avoid overwhelming the DB while still being fast\n      const BATCH_SIZE = 5;\n      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {\n        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);\n        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {\n          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;\n          const oldBalance = data.balance || 0;\n          try {\n            const newBalance = await this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(d.id);\n            results.push({\n              accountId: d.id,\n              accountCode: data.accountCode || d.id,\n              oldBalance,\n              newBalance,\n            });\n          } catch (err) {\n            errors++;\n            console.error(`[recalculateAllBalances] Error on account ${d.id}:`, err);\n          }\n        }));\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error loading accounts:\", err);\n    }\n\n    return { processed: results.length, errors, results };\n  }\n"
}

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { SettingsCategory, SettingsRecord, SettingsRepository, UserSettingsData, UserSettingsRecord } from './settings.contracts';

const settingsColumns = `
  setting_id AS "settingId",
  COALESCE(category, setting_id) AS category,
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

const userSettingsColumns = `
  user_setting_id AS "userSettingId",
  user_id AS "userId",
  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
  created_by AS "createdBy",
  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
`;

export function createSettingsRepository(pool: Pool): SettingsRepository {
  return {
    async get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${settingsColumns} FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id = $1 OR category = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [category],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord> {
      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
        `INSERT INTO public.settings (setting_id, category, data, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
         VALUES ($1, $1, $2::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $3, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (setting_id) DO UPDATE SET
           category = EXCLUDED.category,
           data = COALESCE(public.settings.data, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.data,
           updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
         RETURNING ${settingsColumns}`,
        [category, JSON.stringify(settings), actorId],
      );
      const row = result.rows[0];
      if (!row) throw new Error('SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
      return row;
    },
    async getUser(userId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
        `SELECT ${userSettingsColumns} FROM public.user_settings
         WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
        [userId],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async updateUser(userId: string, settings: UserSettingsData, actorId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord> {
      const existing = await this.getUser(userId);
      const data = JSON.stringify(settings);
      let result;
      if (existing) {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `UPDATE public.user_settings SET data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb,
             language = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'language'), language),
             theme = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'theme'), theme),
             font_size = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'fontSize'), font_size),
             dashboard_grid_columns = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'dashboardGridColumns')::numeric, dashboard_grid_columns),
             visible_metrics = COALESCE($1::jsonb -> 'visibleMetrics', visible_metrics),
             updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = $2
           WHERE user_setting_id = $3 RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
          [data, actorId, existing.userSettingId],
        );
      } else {
        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
          `INSERT INTO public.user_settings
             (user_setting_id, user_id, data, language, theme, font_size, dashboard_grid_columns, visible_metrics, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $9, $9)
           RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
          [
            `user_${userId}`,
            userId,
            data,
            settings.language ?? null,
            settings.theme ?? null,
            settings.fontSize ?? null,
            settings.dashboardGridColumns ?? null,
            settings.visibleMetrics ? JSON.stringify(settings.visibleMetrics) : null,
            actorId,
          ],
        );
      }
      const row = result.rows[0];
      if (!row) throw new Error('USER_SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
      return row;
    },
  };
}

/**
 * accountingHierarchyService.ts
 * خدمة شجرة الحسابات والحسابات الافتراضية — API-only عبر alx_api.
 * Accounting-hierarchy and default-account service — API-only through alx_api (no legacy Supabase access).
 */
import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';
import type { GatewayQuery } from '../data/contracts/common.gateway';
import currencyService from './currencyService';

const apiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined'
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
}

/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
  Array.isArray(payload) ? (payload as any[]) : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items) ? (payload as any).items : [];

/** يقرأ قائمة من alx_api ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة {success,data}. */
const readRows = async (path: string, query?: GatewayQuery): Promise<any[]> => {
  const res = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
  return asRows(res?.data);
};

export interface AutoVoucherRule {

  actionCode?: string;
  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string;
  descriptionTempAr: string;
  descriptionTempEn: string;
  debitAccount: any;
  creditAccount: any;
  isActive: boolean;
  autoPost?: boolean;
  requiredEntities?: string[];
}

/** صف قاعدة قيد تلقائي كما يعيده /api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules */
/** Auto-entry rule row as returned by the API. */
interface AutoEntryRuleRow {
  autoEntryId: string;
  statusId?: number | null;
  statusNameAr?: string | null;
  nameAr?: string | null;
  nameEn?: string | null;
  isActive?: boolean | null;
  autoPost?: boolean | null;
  amountSources?: string[] | null;
  debitAccount?: string | null;
  creditAccount?: string | null;
  descriptionTemplateAr?: string | null;
  descriptionTemplateEn?: string | null;
}

// حسابات القاعدة مخزنة نصيًا في auto_entries؛ قد تكون JSON قديم أو نصًا بسيطًا.
// Rule accounts are stored as text; tolerate legacy JSON payloads and plain strings.
function parseAccount(value: unknown): any {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return value;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(value);
    } catch {
      return { id: value, name: value };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function toRule(row: AutoEntryRuleRow): AutoVoucherRule {
  return {
    id: row.autoEntryId,
    actionCode: row.statusNameAr ?? undefined,
    nameAr: row.nameAr ?? '',
    nameEn: row.nameEn ?? '',
    descriptionTempAr: row.descriptionTemplateAr ?? '',
    descriptionTempEn: row.descriptionTemplateEn ?? '',
    debitAccount: parseAccount(row.debitAccount),
    creditAccount: parseAccount(row.creditAccount),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
    autoPost: row.autoPost !== false,
    requiredEntities: row.amountSources ?? undefined,
  };
}

export function useAutoVoucherRules() {
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<AutoVoucherRule[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<{ success: boolean; data: AutoEntryRuleRow[] | { items?: AutoEntryRuleRow[] } }>(
          '/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules',
          { limit: 1000, offset: 0 },
        );
        const payload = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : (res.data?.items ?? []);
        if (!cancelled) setRules(payload.map(toRule));
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setRules([]);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  return { rules, loading };
}

import { API_MODES, assertProductionApiMode, getApiMode, parseApiMode } from './api-mode';
import { API_CONTRACT_MATRIX, getApiDomainContract } from './api-contract-matrix';

describe('API mode contract', () => {
  it('supports only the explicitly defined migration modes', () => {
    expect(API_MODES).toEqual(['api-only', 'shadow', 'legacy-migration']);
    expect(parseApiMode(' API-ONLY ')).toBe('api-only');
    expect(() => parseApiMode('fallback')).toThrow('Unsupported VITE_API_MODE');
  });

  it('does not allow legacy-migration in production', () => {
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('legacy-migration'))).toThrow(
      'Production cannot run with VITE_API_MODE=legacy-migration',
    );
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('shadow'))).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('api-only'))).not.toThrow();
  });

      mode: 'shadow',

      allowsLegacyReads: true,
      allowsLegacyWrites: false,
    });

});

  1) ALTER TABLE public.assets ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS: category text، cost numeric DEFAULT 0، purchase_date text، assigned_courier_id text، assigned_courier_name text، notes text، maintenance_logs jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'، created_by text، updated_by text.
  2) GRANT DELETE ON public.assets, account, acc_main, acc_sub, acc_sub_group, accounts, default_accounts, salary_history, auto_entries, products, order_items, returned_products TO alx_api_runtime (يغلق فجوة 42501 التي تكسر مسارات الحذف المنشورة).
  3) CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_entity_financial_footprint(p_entity_type text, p_entity_id text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog: قائمة أنواع بيضاء (customers/couriers/employees/users/sources/shipping_companies)، حراسة عميل→طلبات ومندوب→custody_advances غير مسددة، حذف متسلسل entry_payment_details ← account_trans ← main_entry ← custody_advances ← accounts ← صف الجهة (جدول/مفتاح من خريطة بيضاء تم التحقق منها حيًّا)، وإرجاع jsonb بعدّادات الحذف. REVOKE من PUBLIC وGRANT EXECUTE لـ alx_api_runtime.
- تحقق مسبق (قراءة فقط): أعمدة المفاتيح الأساسية الحيّة = customers.customer_id، couriers.courier_id، employees.employee_id، users.user_id (+id مركّب)، sources.source_id، shipping_companies.shipping_company_id، custody_advances.custody_advance_id؛ وجدول orders يحوي customer_id/courier_id/employee_id.
- حالة التنفيذ: **لم يُنفَّذ أي DDL** — الترحيلات 0021 و0022 و0023 كلها بانتظار تنفيذ المستخدم يدويًا عبر لوحة Supabase (حساب runtime لا يملك صلاحيات DDL).

FROM pg_constraint con
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (con.conkey)
WHERE con.contype = 'p'
  AND c.relname IN ('customers','couriers','employees','users','sources','shipping_companies','custody_advances')
ORDER BY c.relname;

SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_name = 'orders' AND column_name IN ('customer_id','courier_id','employee_id','driver_id')
ORDER BY column_name;
```
**النتيجة:** المفاتيح: customer_id/courier_id/employee_id/user_id+id(مركّب)/source_id/shipping_company_id/custody_advance_id؛ وفي orders: courier_id, customer_id, employee_id (لا يوجد driver_id). استُخدمت لتثبيت خريطة الحذف داخل دالة 0023. **لم تُجرَ أي كتابة على قاعدة البيانات.**

1	import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
2	import { collection, onSnapshot, query, orderBy } from '../data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts';
3	import { db } from '../data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts';
4	
5	/**
6	 * Compatibility report surface for callers outside the unified FinanceEntries page.
7	 * The report source is the normalized ledger only: posted main_entry headers and
8	 * their account_trans lines. No legacy expenditure collection is queried.
9	 */
10	export default function FinanceReports() {
11	  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
12	  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);
13	
14	  useEffect(() => {
15	    const unsubEntries = onSnapshot(
16	      query(collection(db, 'main_entry'), orderBy('effectiveAt', 'desc')),
17	      (snap) => setEntries(snap.docs.map((doc: any) => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }))),
18	      (error) => console.warn('FinanceReports: main_entry subscription error:', error),
19	    );
20	    const unsubLines = onSnapshot(
21	      query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')),
22	      (snap) => setLines(snap.docs.map((doc: any) => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }))),
23	      (error) => console.warn('FinanceReports: account_trans subscription error:', error),
24	    );
25	    return () => {
26	      unsubEntries();
27	      unsubLines();
28	    };
29	  }, []);
30	
31	  const entryById = new Map(entries.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry]));
32	  const postedLines = lines.filter((tx) => {
33	    const entry = entryById.get(tx.entryId || tx.main_entry_id);
34	    return tx.entry?.postingStatus === 'posted' || (entry && entry.postingStatus === 'posted');
35	  });
36	
37	  return (
38	    <section aria-label="Normalized financial report" className="space-y-3">
39	      <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white">Financial Reports</h2>
40	      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
41	        {postedLines.length.toLocaleString()} posted ledger lines from {entries.length.toLocaleString()} entry headers.
42	      </p>
43	    </section>
44	  );
45	}

7	const mapEntry = (row: Record<string, unknown>): FinanceEntryViewModel => ({
8	  entryId: String(row.main_entry_id ?? ''),
9	  status: String(row.posting_status ?? ''),
10	});
11	
12	export class CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway implements FinanceEntriesGateway {
13	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<FinanceEntryViewModel>> {
14	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
15	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
16	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' }).range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
17	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
18	    const items = (data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapEntry));
19	    return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
20	  }
21	
22	  async getById(id: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel | null> {
23	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('main_entry_id', id).maybeSingle();
24	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
25	    return data ? mapRow(data, mapEntry) : null;
26	  }
27	
28	  async post(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
29	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
30	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'posted', posted_by_uid: actorId, posted_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
31	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
32	    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
33	  }
34	
35	  async reverse(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
36	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
37	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'voided', voided_by_uid: actorId, voided_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
38	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
39	    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
40	  }
41	}

The value never leaves the request body of the acting user.\n */\nimport { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';\n\n/** نتيجة التحقق — حالة صريحة بدل قيمة منطقية حتى لا يُخلط بين «رمز خاطئ» و«لا يوجد رمز مضبوط». */\nexport type PinVerification =\n  | { status: 'valid' }\n  | { status: 'invalid' }\n  | { status: 'not-configured' }\n  | { status: 'unauthenticated' }\n  | { status: 'unavailable'; message: string };\n\ninterface VerifyPinResult {\n  configured: boolean;\n  valid: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction readErrorCode(error: unknown): string {\n  return (error as { code?: string } | null)?.code ?? '';\n}\n\n/**\n * يتحقق من رمز PIN الخاص بالمستخدم الحالي خادميًا.\n * Verifies the acting user's own PIN server-side; identity comes from the access token.\n */\nexport async function verifyCurrentUserPin(pin: string): Promise<PinVerification> {\n  const trimmed = pin.trim();\n  if (!trimmed) return { status: 'invalid' };\n\n  try {\n    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<VerifyPinResult>>('/api/v1/users/verify-pin', {\n      pin: trimmed,\n    });\n    const result = response?.data;\n    if (!result) return { status: 'unavailable', message: 'استجابة غير صالحة من خدمة التحقق من الرمز.' };\n    if (!result.configured) return { status: 'not-configured' };\n    return result.valid ? { status: 'valid' } : { status: 'invalid' };\n  } catch (error) {\n    // الرمز نفسه لا يُسجَّل أبدًا — Only the failure reason is surfaced, never the PIN value.\n    const code = readErrorCode(error);\n    if (code === 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS') return { status: 'unauthenticated' };\n    if (code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') return { status: 'not-configured' };\n    return { status: 'unavailable', message: (error as { message?: string } | null)?.message || 'تعذر التحقق من الرمز.' };\n  }\n}\n\n/** رسالة عربية/إنجليزية موحّدة لكل حالة حتى تتطابق تجربة المستخدم في كل نوافذ التأكيد. */\nexport function pinVerificationMessage(verification: PinVerification, isAr = true): string {\n  switch (verification.status) {\n    case 'not-configured':\n      return isAr\n        ? 'لا يوجد رمز PIN مضبوط لحسابك. اضبط الرمز من إدارة المستخدمين ثم أعد المحاولة.'\n        : 'No PIN is configured for your account. Set one in user management and try again.';\n    case 'unauthenticated':\n      return isAr ? 'انتهت الجلسة — أعد تسجيل الدخول لتأكيد الرمز.' : 'Session expired — sign in again to confirm the PIN.';\n    case 'unavailable':\n      return isAr ? `تعذر التحقق من الرمز: ${verification.message}` : `PIN verification failed: ${verification.message}`;\n    default:\n      return isAr ? 'رمز PIN غير صحيح. تعذر إتمام العملية.' : 'Invalid PIN code. Access denied.';\n  }\n}\n",

4	export type StaffLoginFailureCode =

6	  | 'CREDENTIALS_UNVERIFIED'
7	  | 'ACCOUNT_DISABLED'
8	  | 'COURIER_NOT_ALLOWED';
9	
10	export class StaffLoginError extends Error {
11	  constructor(readonly code: StaffLoginFailureCode) {
12	    super(code);
13	    this.name = 'StaffLoginError';
14	  }
15	}
16	
17	export type StaffLoginGateway = Pick<
18	  AuthGateway,
19	  | 'authenticate'
20	  | 'cancelPendingSignIn'
21	  | 'completeSignIn'
22	  | 'ensureInitialRootProfile'
23	  | 'findEmailByUsername'
24	  | 'getLoginProfile'
25	  | 'verifySystemPin'
26	>;
27	
28	export interface StaffLoginResult {
29	  user: CurrentUserDto;
30	  profile: AuthLoginProfileDto | null;
31	  requiresSystemPin: boolean;
32	}
33	
34	export async function beginStaffLogin(
35	  identifier: string,
36	  password: string,
37	  gateway: StaffLoginGateway,
38	): Promise<StaffLoginResult> {
39	  let normalizedIdentifier = identifier.trim().toLowerCase();
40	  if (!normalizedIdentifier.includes('@') && normalizedIdentifier !== 'admin') {
41	    const email = await gateway.findEmailByUsername(normalizedIdentifier);
42	    if (!email) throw new StaffLoginError('USERNAME_NOT_FOUND');
43	    normalizedIdentifier = email;
44	  }
45	
46	  const user = await gateway.authenticate(normalizedIdentifier, password);
47	  if (!user.id) throw new StaffLoginError('CREDENTIALS_UNVERIFIED');
48	
49	  let profile = await gateway.getLoginProfile(user.id);
50	  if (!profile) profile = await gateway.ensureInitialRootProfile(user.id);
51	
52	  if (profile?.disabled) {
53	    gateway.cancelPendingSignIn();
54	    throw new StaffLoginError('ACCOUNT_DISABLED');
55	  }
56	
57	  if (
58	    (profile?.role !== null && profile?.role !== undefined && ['Courier', 'courier'].includes(profile.role)) ||
59	    profile?.roleId === 'courier'
60	  ) {
61	    gateway.cancelPendingSignIn();
62	    throw new StaffLoginError('COURIER_NOT_ALLOWED');
63	  }
64	
65	  const requiresSystemPin = profile?.requiresSystemPin ?? false;
66	  if (!requiresSystemPin) gateway.completeSignIn(user.id);
67	  return { user, profile, requiresSystemPin };
68	}
69	
70	export async function verifyStaffLoginPin(
71	  userId: string,
72	  pin: string,
73	  gateway: StaffLoginGateway,
74	): Promise<boolean> {
75	  if (!await gateway.verifySystemPin(userId, pin)) return false;
76	  gateway.completeSignIn(userId);
77	  return true;
78	}

2	 * financeApi.ts

4	 * Shared finance HTTP gateway: one ApiClient instance, one envelope unwrap, and the account-row mapper
5	 * used by every finance service so the legacy shape is produced in exactly one place (DRY).

7	import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';

11	/** عميل المالية هو عميل التطبيق المشترك نفسه — لا إعداد اتصال مكرر. */
12	export const financeApiClient = appApiClient;

14	export type { ApiEnvelope };

16	/** معاملات قراءة المالية الموسعة (تشمل مرشحات لا تعرفها GatewayQuery العامة). */

27	/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
28	export const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
29	  Array.isArray(payload)
30	    ? (payload as any[])
31	    : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items)
32	      ? (payload as any).items
33	      : [];

35	export const isNotFoundError = (error: unknown): boolean =>
36	  (error as { code?: string })?.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND';

38	/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */
39	export async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {
40	  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
41	  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };
42	}
43	
44	export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {
45	  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;
46	}

48	const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
49	const DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 20_000;
50	
51	/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */
52	export async function readAllFinanceRows(
53	  path: string,
54	  query: FinanceQuery = {},
55	  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
56	  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
57	): Promise<any[]> {
58	  const rows: any[] = [];
59	  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
60	    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });
61	    rows.push(...page.rows);
62	    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;
63	  }
64	  return rows;
65	}

67	/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */
68	export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {
69	  try {

81	 */
82	export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {
83	  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();
84	  if (!accountId) return null;
85	  return {
86	    ...row,
87	    id: accountId,
88	    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),
89	    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),
90	    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),
91	    entityType: row.entityType,
92	    entityId: String(row.entityId ?? ''),
93	    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn ?? ''),
94	    currency: String(row.currency ?? ''),
95	    curNo: row.curNo ?? row.currencyNo ?? undefined,
96	    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),
97	    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),
98	    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),
99	    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
100	    type: row.type,
101	    parentCode: row.parentCode ?? undefined,
102	    accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId ?? undefined,
103	    groupId: row.groupId ?? undefined,
104	    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),
105	    accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr ?? undefined,
106	    accNameEn: row.accNameEn ?? row.accountNameEn ?? undefined,
107	    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),
108	    notes: row.notes ?? undefined,
109	    createdAt: row.createdAt,
110	    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
111	  } as FinancialAccount;
112	}

115	const ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>> = {
116	  customer: '/api/v1/customers',
117	  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',
118	  employee: '/api/v1/operations/employees',
119	  source: '/api/v1/operations/sources',

123	/**
124	 * يربط الحساب المالي بسجل الكيان. الفشل هنا تحذير فقط: الحساب أُنشئ ولا يجوز التراجع عنه بصمت.
125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.
126	 */
127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}

148	export async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean> {
149	  const key = String(automationKey || '').trim();
150	  if (!key) return false;
151	  const { rows, total } = await readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { automationKey: key, limit: 1 });
152	  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? '') === key);
153	}

156	export async function recalculateAccountBalances(
157	  accountIds?: string[],
158	): Promise<{ success: boolean; recalculatedCount: number }> {
159	  const res = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ result?: { success?: boolean; recalculatedCount?: number } }>>(
160	    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/recalculate',
161	    accountIds && accountIds.length > 0 ? { accountIds } : {},
162	  );
163	  const result = res?.data?.result ?? {};
164	  return {
165	    success: result.success !== false,
166	    recalculatedCount: Number(result.recalculatedCount ?? accountIds?.length ?? 0),
167	  };
168	}

No legacy collection is read.\n */\nexport default function FinanceReports() {\n  const [totals, setTotals] = useState<ReportTotals | null>(null);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let cancelled = false;\n\n    const load = async () => {\n      try {\n        // limit=1 لأن العدد الدقيق يأتي من meta.total — لا حاجة لسحب الصفوف نفسها.\n        // limit=1 because the exact count arrives in meta.total; the rows themselves are not needed.\n        const [lines, entries] = await Promise.all([\n          readFinancePage(LEDGER_LINES_PATH, { limit: 1, offset: 0 }),\n          readFinancePage(ENTRY_HEADERS_PATH, { limit: 1, offset: 0 }),\n        ]);\n        if (cancelled) return;\n        setTotals({ postedLines: lines.total, entryHeaders: entries.total });\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.warn('FinanceReports: تعذر تحميل ملخص دفتر الأستاذ:', err);\n        if (!cancelled) setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'تعذر تحميل التقرير المالي.');\n      }\n    };\n\n    void load();\n    return () => {\n      cancelled = true;\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <section aria-label=\"Normalized financial report\" className=\"space-y-3\">\n      <h2 className=\"text-sm font-black text-white\">Financial Reports</h2>\n      {error ? (\n        <p className=\"text-xs text-rose-400\">{error}</p>\n      ) : (\n        <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-400\">\n          {totals === null\n            ? 'جاري تحميل ملخص دفتر الأستاذ…'\n            : `${totals.postedLines.toLocaleString()} posted ledger lines from ${totals.entryHeaders.toLocaleString()} entry headers.`}\n        </p>\n      )}\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n",

}

import type { SettingsApiDto, UserSettingsApiDto, SystemSettingsData } from '../dtos/settings.dto';

export interface ApiCurrencyDto {
  currencyId: number;

  mainNameEn: string | null;

  isDefault: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  currentPrice: number | null;
  lastSeq: number | null;
  lastUpdateBy: string | null;
  lastUpdateDate: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyRateDto {
  rateId: number;
  currencyId: number;
  price: number;
  dayDate: string;
  sequence: number;
  updatedBy: string | null;
  createdAt: string | null;
}

  code: string;

  flag?: string | null;
  isDefault?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
}

});

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

import { z } from 'zod';

const settingsObject = z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).refine((value) => Object.keys(value).length <= 200, {
  message: 'Too many settings fields.',
});

export const settingsCategorySchema = z.enum(['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules']);
export const updateSettingsSchema = z.object({ settings: settingsObject }).strict();

export const userSettingsSchema = z.object({
  language: z.enum(['ar', 'en']).optional(),
  theme: z.enum(['light', 'dark']).optional(),
  fontSize: z.enum(['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl']).optional(),
  dashboardGridColumns: z.number().int().min(1).max(12).optional(),
  visibleMetrics: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(100).optional(),
  sidebarCollapsed: z.boolean().optional(),
  sidebarItems: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(100).optional(),
}).strict();
export const updateUserSettingsSchema = z.object({ settings: userSettingsSchema }).strict();

export const currencyCodeSchema = z.string().trim().regex(/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_-]{1,9}$/);
export const currencyIdSchema = z.coerce.number().int().positive();
export const listCurrenciesQuerySchema = z.object({
  activeOnly: z.enum(['true', 'false']).default('false').transform((value) => value === 'true'),
});
export const createCurrencySchema = z.object({
  code: currencyCodeSchema,
  mainNameAr: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120),
  subNameAr: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().nullable(),
  mainNameEn: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().nullable(),
  subNameEn: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().nullable(),
  symbol: z.string().trim().min(1).max(20),
  flag: z.string().trim().max(20).optional().nullable(),
  isDefault: z.boolean().default(false),
  isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
}).strict();
export const updateCurrencySchema = createCurrencySchema.partial().strict();
export const createCurrencyRateSchema = z.object({
  price: z.coerce.number().finite().positive(),
  dayDate: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
}).strict();

1	/**
2	 * expenseCategoriesService.ts
3	 * فئات المصروفات المخزّنة في مستند الإعدادات expense_categories — القراءة والكتابة عبر alx_api فقط.
4	 * Expense categories live in the `expense_categories` settings document; every read and write goes
5	 * through alx_api (no direct database access from the browser).
6	 */
7	import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';
8	
9	export interface ExpenseCategory {
10	  id: string;
11	  labelAr: string;
12	  labelEn: string;
13	  icon?: string;
14	  /** الحساب المرتبط من دليل الحسابات — قد يحمل entityId لحساب نظامي قديم. */
15	  accountId?: string;
16	  accountCode?: string;
17	  /** الفئات النظامية لا يجوز حذفها — system categories are protected from deletion. */
18	  isSystem?: boolean;
19	}
20	
21	const SETTINGS_PATH = '/api/v1/settings/expense_categories';
22	
23	/** الفئات الأساسية التي تُعرض عند غياب أي تخزين على الخادم. */
24	export const DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES: ExpenseCategory[] = [
25	  { id: 'wages', labelAr: 'أجور التوصيل', labelEn: 'Delivery Wages', icon: '🚚', isSystem: true, accountId: 'sys_delivery_cost', accountCode: '5000-2788' },
26	  { id: 'marketing', labelAr: 'تسويق وإعلانات', labelEn: 'Marketing', icon: '📈' },
27	  { id: 'office', labelAr: 'مستلزمات مكتبية', labelEn: 'Office Supplies', icon: '📎' },
28	  { id: 'maintenance', labelAr: 'صيانة وإصلاح', labelEn: 'Maintenance', icon: '🔧' },
29	  { id: 'fuel', labelAr: 'وقود ومحروقات', labelEn: 'Fuel', icon: '⛽' },
30	  { id: 'rent', labelAr: 'إيجارات', labelEn: 'Rent', icon: '🏢' },
31	  { id: 'salary', labelAr: 'رواتب موظفين', labelEn: 'Salaries', icon: '👨‍💼', isSystem: true },
32	  { id: 'custody', labelAr: 'عهدة مناديب', labelEn: 'Custody / Receivables', icon: '💳', isSystem: true },
33	  { id: 'factory', labelAr: 'دفعات المصانع', labelEn: 'Factory Payouts', icon: '🏭', isSystem: true },
34	  { id: 'other', labelAr: 'أخرى', labelEn: 'Other', icon: '📄', isSystem: true },
35	];
36	
37	interface SettingsRecord {
38	  settingId?: string;
39	  category?: string;
40	  settings?: { data?: unknown };
41	}
42	
43	/** المستند القديم يخزن المصفوفة داخل settings.data — نقبل الصفوف الصالحة فقط. */
44	function asCategoryList(value: unknown): ExpenseCategory[] {
45	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
46	  return value.filter(
47	    (entry): entry is ExpenseCategory =>
48	      Boolean(entry) && typeof entry === 'object' && typeof (entry as ExpenseCategory).id === 'string',
49	  );
50	}
51	
52	async function readStored(): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
53	  try {
54	    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<SettingsRecord>>(SETTINGS_PATH);
55	    return asCategoryList(response?.data?.settings?.data);
56	  } catch (error) {
57	    if ((error as { code?: string } | null)?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return [];
58	    throw error;
59	  }
60	}
61	
62	async function writeStored(categories: ExpenseCategory[]): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
63	  await appApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<SettingsRecord>>(SETTINGS_PATH, { settings: { data: categories } });
64	  return categories;
65	}
66	
67	export const expenseCategoriesService = {
68	  /**
69	   * يعيد القائمة الفعّالة: المخزّن على الخادم، أو الافتراضية عندما لا يوجد مستند بعد.
70	   * Returns the effective list — stored categories, or the defaults when nothing is stored yet.
71	   */
72	  async list(): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
73	    const stored = await readStored();
74	    return stored.length > 0 ? stored : DEFAULT_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES;
75	  },
76	
77	  /**
78	   * إضافة فئة بعد قراءة حالة الخادم أولًا حتى لا تُمسح إضافات متزامنة.
79	   * Read-modify-write against the server state so concurrent additions are never clobbered.
80	   */
81	  async add(category: ExpenseCategory): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
82	    const id = category.id.trim();
83	    if (!id) throw new Error('معرّف الفئة مطلوب.');
84	    const current = await this.list();
85	    if (current.some((entry) => entry.id === id)) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» موجودة مسبقًا.`);
86	    return writeStored([...current, { ...category, id, isSystem: false }]);
87	  },
88	
89	  async update(id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<ExpenseCategory, 'id'>>): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
90	    const current = await this.list();
91	    if (!current.some((entry) => entry.id === id)) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» غير موجودة.`);
92	    return writeStored(current.map((entry) => (entry.id === id ? { ...entry, ...patch } : entry)));
93	  },
94	
95	  /** حذف فئة غير نظامية — النظامية مرفوضة لأن القيود التلقائية تعتمد عليها. */
96	  async remove(id: string): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
97	    const current = await this.list();
98	    const target = current.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
99	    if (!target) throw new Error(`الفئة «${id}» غير موجودة.`);
100	    if (target.isSystem) throw new Error('لا يمكن حذف فئة نظامية.');
101	    return writeStored(current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
102	  },
103	};

});

    allowsDirectAccounts: nullableBoolean,
    entityType: nullableTrimmed(60),
  })
  .strict();
export const hierarchyImportSchema = z.object({
  rows: z
    .array(z.object({ level: hierarchyLevelSchema, nodeId: entityIdSchema, payload: hierarchyNodeSchema }).strict())
    .min(1)

38	/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */
39	export async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {
40	  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
41	  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };
42	}

44	export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {
45	  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;

48	const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;

51	/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */
52	export async function readAllFinanceRows(
53	  path: string,
54	  query: FinanceQuery = {},
55	  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
56	  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
57	): Promise<any[]> {
58	  const rows: any[] = [];
59	  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
60	    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });
61	    rows.push(...page.rows);
62	    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;
63	  }
64	  return rows;
65	}

115	const ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>> = {
116	  customer: '/api/v1/customers',
117	  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',
118	  employee: '/api/v1/operations/employees',

125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.
126	 */
127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}

148	export async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean> {
149	  const key = String(automationKey || '').trim();
150	  if (!key) return false;
151	  const { rows, total } = await readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { automationKey: key, limit: 1 });
152	  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? '') === key);
153	}

156	export async function recalculateAccountBalances(
157	  accountIds?: string[],
158	): Promise<{ success: boolean; recalculatedCount: number }> {
159	  const res = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ result?: { success?: boolean; recalculatedCount?: number } }>>(
160	    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/recalculate',
161	    accountIds && accountIds.length > 0 ? { accountIds } : {},
162	  );
163	  const result = res?.data?.result ?? {};
164	  return {
165	    success: result.success !== false,
166	    recalculatedCount: Number(result.recalculatedCount ?? accountIds?.length ?? 0),
167	  };

  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);

  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);

      ? { [pkCol]: id, assetCode, ...directCols }
      : { [pkCol]: id, assetCode, ...directCols, data };
    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).insert(writePayload);

      throw createWriteError('insert', table, error);
    }
  } else {
    // Offline mode: buffering addDoc local write
  }

  collectionCaches[table].push(newItem);

    const body = financialAccountSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actorId = principalId(response);
    if (!body.success || !actorId)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT', 'بيانات الحساب المالي غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    const { accountId, ...fields } = body.data;
    try {
      return sendSuccess(response, await repository.createFinancialAccount({ ...fields, accountId: accountId ?? `acc_${crypto.randomUUID()}`, actorId }), requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/finance/accounts/:id', ...route('edit_finance', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const id = idParam(request, response);
    if (!id) return;
    const actorId = principalId(response);
    if (!actorId) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    const body = financialAccountSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    if (!body.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT', 'بيانات الحساب المالي غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    const { accountId: _omitted, ...fields } = body.data;
    try {
      const result = await repository.updateFinancialAccount({ ...fields, accountId: id, actorId });
      return result
        ? sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response))
        : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'الحساب المالي غير موجود.', requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/account-id-map', ...route('view_financial_accounts', auth), async (request, response, next) => {

      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'معرّف الحساب القديم مطلوب.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const newAccountId = await repository.getMigratedAccountId(oldAccountId);
      return newAccountId
        ? sendSuccess(response, { oldAccountId, newAccountId }, requestId(response))
        : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'لا توجد خريطة ترحيل لهذا الحساب.', requestId(response));
