658	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
659	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
660	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
661	    try {
662	      const accountPath = `${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}`;
663	      const account = await readFinanceRecord(accountPath);
664	      if (!account) {
665	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);
666	        return 0;
667	      }
668	      await recalculateAccountBalances([accountId]);
669	      const refreshedAccount = await readFinanceRecord(accountPath);
670	      return Number(mapAccountRow(refreshedAccount)?.balance ?? 0);
671	    } catch (error) {
672	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
673	      return 0;
674	    }
675	  }
676	
677	  /**
678	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
679	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
680	   */
681	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
682	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
683	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
684	    }
685	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
686	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
687	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
688	    }, delayMs);
689	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
690	  }

1	/**
2	 * Financial Account Service
3	 * خدمة الحسابات المالية المركزية
4	 *
5	 * Manages creation and management of financial sub-accounts:
6	 *   Customers  → prefix 1130  (Asset — Accounts Receivable)
7	 *   Couriers   → prefix 2120  (Liability — Courier Ledger)
8	 *   Employees  → prefix 2130  (Liability — Employee Ledger)
9	 *
10	 * Every transaction that touches an account is written through the atomic
11	 * financial-entry procedure. Database safeguards maintain the authoritative
12	 * posting balance and its hierarchy roll-up from account_trans.
13	 *
14	 * Use recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId) to reconcile the stored balance
15	 * against the live transaction history.
16	 */

import { ApiClient } from "../../data/http/api-client";

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T; meta?: { total?: number } };
type ApiPage<T> = { items: T[]; total?: number };
type Unsubscribe = () => void;

const apiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:3001",
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === "undefined"
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem("alx_access_token") || sessionStorage.getItem("alx_api_access_token")),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

const MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE = 1_000;
const MAX_MOVEMENT_ROWS = 20_000;

const apiCollectionPaths: Record<string, string> = {
  accounts: "/api/v1/finance/accounts",
  main_entry: "/api/v1/finance/entries",
  account_trans: "/api/v1/finance/account-movements",
  custody_advances: "/api/v1/finance/custody-advances",
  auto_entries: "/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules",
};

function isEnabled(): boolean {
  return true;
}

function normalizeRows(
  collectionName: string,
  rows: Record<string, unknown>[]
): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  if (collectionName === "accounts")
    return rows.map(row => ({
      ...row,
      id: row.accountId ?? row.id,
      accountName: row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn,
    }));

61	async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
62	  collectionName: string
63	): Promise<T[]> {
64	  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];

66	    throw new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`);

68	    limit: 100,
69	    offset: 0,
70	  });
71	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data)
72	    ? response.data
73	    : (response.data.items ?? []);
74	  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];
75	}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

type BoundaryCategory = 'legacyCompatImport' | 'supabaseRuntimeReference' | 'legacyListener';
type Baseline = Record<BoundaryCategory, string[]>;

const sourceRoot = resolve(process.cwd(), 'src');
const baselinePath = resolve(sourceRoot, 'config/legacy-boundary.baseline.json');
const baseline = JSON.parse(readFileSync(baselinePath, 'utf8')) as Baseline;

function collectSourceFiles(directory: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const path = resolve(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) return collectSourceFiles(path);
    return /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name) && !/\.test\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(entry.name) ? [path] : [];
  });
}

function categoryMatches(category: BoundaryCategory, source: string): boolean {
  if (category === 'legacyCompatImport') return source.includes('data/legacy/legacy-compat');
  if (category === 'supabaseRuntimeReference') {
    return ['@supabase/supabase-js', 'supabase.from', 'supabase.channel', 'postgres_changes', 'createClient(']
      .some((pattern) => source.includes(pattern));
  }
  return ['onSnapshot(', 'onAuthStateChanged('].some((pattern) => source.includes(pattern));
}

function relative(file: string): string {
  return file.slice(process.cwd().length + 1).replaceAll('\\', '/');
}

describe('Phase 0 — legacy/API-only boundary', () => {
  it('keeps migrated roles and finance gateways API-only', () => {
    const rolesPage = readFileSync(resolve(sourceRoot, 'features/roles/pages/RolesPage.tsx'), 'utf8');
    const financeGateway = readFileSync(resolve(sourceRoot, 'components/financeAccounting/FinanceApiDataGateway.ts'), 'utf8');

    expect(rolesPage).not.toContain('data/legacy/legacy-compat');
    expect(rolesPage).not.toContain('onSnapshot(');
    expect(financeGateway).not.toContain('FinanceAccountingDataGateway');
    expect(financeGateway).not.toContain('fallback');
  });

  it('does not allow new legacy or Supabase runtime references beyond the baseline', () => {
    const files = collectSourceFiles(sourceRoot);
    for (const category of ['legacyCompatImport', 'supabaseRuntimeReference', 'legacyListener'] as const) {
      const violations = files
        .filter((file) => categoryMatches(category, readFileSync(file, 'utf8')))
        .map(relative);
      const unexpected = violations.filter((file) => !baseline[category].includes(file));
      expect(unexpected, `New ${category} references detected`).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it('keeps the baseline manifest internally valid', () => {
    for (const category of ['legacyCompatImport', 'supabaseRuntimeReference', 'legacyListener'] as const) {
      for (const file of baseline[category]) {
        expect(statSync(resolve(process.cwd(), file)).isFile(), `Missing baseline file: ${file}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });
});

- جدول `salary_history`: عمود `extra` (jsonb) يحمل employeeName وaccountCode وcreatedByName، وعمود `month` هو مصدر `salaryMonth` في الواجهة. الكتابة تقبل مفاتيح المخطط الصارم فقط؛ أي مفتاح زائد (salaryMonth/createdAt/createdByUid/monthlySalary) يسبب رفض 400.
- حركات الحساب (`account_transactions`): تُقرأ عبر مسار الحركات وتُعاد بأسماء transType وamount، وتشمل الأسطر ذات `posting_status = posted` فقط.
- دوال إعادة الحساب: `recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(p_account_id)` للحساب الواحد و`recalculate_all_account_balances()` للجماعي؛ الاثنتان تعيدان عدد الصفوف المتأثرة، لذا لا تُختلق نتائج تفصيلية لكل حساب في الواجهة.
- جدول `auto_entries`: العمودان debit_account وcredit_account نصّان يحويان JSON (وليسا مفاتيح خارجية)، والعمودان description_template_ar وdescription_template_en يقابلهما في الواجهة descriptionTempAr وdescriptionTempEn، والمفتاح `auto_entry_id` يقابله `id`.
- خرائط المعرّفات: `account_id_migration_map` يُستخدم لجسر المعرّفات القديمة، وصيغة المعرّف الحالي للحساب المالي هي PREFIX-NNNN بينما معرّفات الجهات بصيغ cust_ وcour_ وemp_ وUUID، وهو ما برّر حذف مسح التعارض بين المجالين من الواجهة.
- هوية منفّذ القيود تُستخرج خادميًا من رمز الوصول داخل `withActorClaims`؛ لذلك أُسقط `createdByUid` من حمولات الواجهة (لا ثقة بمعرّف قادم من العميل).

#### Thinking

Now I understand the scope. Plan the API surface needed:

1. `loadHierarchy()`: GET `/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/account|acc-main|acc-sub|acc-sub-group` (limit large, e.g. 1000). Note readFinanceRows helper exists in financeApi (`readAllFinanceRows` paginates). Check what `accountingHierarchyService` uses: `readRows('/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/account', {limit:1})`. `readFinanceRows` returns rows array from a page.

2. Ledger accounts: `financialAccountService.getAllAccounts()` (used in ChartOfAccounts) returns FinancialAccount[] mapped (id, accountCode, accNameAr?, entityName...). But this component reads raw records with `read(item,'accNameAr','acc_name_ar')` and `accountType`. mapAccountRow keeps `...row` spread so extra keys survive; for accounts the API returns accNameAr? Let me check the accounts list columns in repository.

3. default_accounts: GET `/api/v1/finance/default-accounts` → rows with defaultKey, accountId, accNameAr/En, curNo, isActive, and id=defaultAccountId? Check repository.

4. currencies: which API? There's a currencies route `/api/v1/finance/currencies`? Let me check. `useExchangeRates` is already API-only and returns `currencies` with `cur_id`? The component uses both `currencies` state (from legacy `currency` table) and `exchangeCurrencies` from useExchangeRates. Since useExchangeRates already provides currencies, I can drop the legacy currency subscription and use exchangeCurrencies. Need to check shape: does it include `cur_id`, `isDefault`, `code`, `isActive`?

5. entry_module: GET `/api/v1/finance/entry-modules` (needs view_entry_settings permission — hmm, a viewer of hierarchy might not have that permission; the component uses entryModules only for statement module naming). Risk: 403 for users without `view_entry_settings`. Handle gracefully: catch and leave empty.

6. Writes:
 - hierarchy node create: POST `/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/:level` with payload {accountCode, accNameAr, accNameEn, accountType|accountId|accMainId|accSubId, allowsDirectAccounts, entityType, curNo, isActive} and generated nodeId server-side.
 - update: PATCH `/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/:level/:id`.
 - delete: DELETE `/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/:level/:id`.
 - ledger account: POST/PATCH `/api/v1/finance/accounts[/:id]` → financialAccountAdmin already has createFinancialAccount/updateFinancialAccount/deleteFinancialAccount! Reuse them (DRY).
 - default accounts: POST/PATCH/DELETE `/api/v1/finance/default-accounts[/:id]`.
 - import: POST `/api/v1/finance/hierarchy/import` — need to check its payload contract.
 - statement: `listAccountMovements` from financialAccountAdmin (reuse).

So the right design: extend `accountingHierarchyService` with hierarchy node CRUD + default account CRUD + import + a `listHierarchy` read; and use `financialAccountAdmin` for ledger accounts and movements. Then the component calls the service (business logic out of UI).

Let me check the alx_api hierarchy import route + default accounts contract + repository column lists to build accurate payloads.

/**
 * financeApi.ts
 * بوابة HTTP مشتركة لخدمات المالية — عميل واحد وفكّ غلاف موحّد وخرائط صفوف.
 * Shared finance HTTP gateway: one ApiClient instance, one envelope unwrap, and the account-row mapper
 * used by every finance service so the legacy shape is produced in exactly one place (DRY).
 */
import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';
import type { GatewayQuery } from '../data/contracts/common.gateway';
import type { AccountEntityType, FinancialAccount } from './financialAccountTypes';

/** عميل المالية هو عميل التطبيق المشترك نفسه — لا إعداد اتصال مكرر. */
export const financeApiClient = appApiClient;

export type { ApiEnvelope };

/** معاملات قراءة المالية الموسعة (تشمل مرشحات لا تعرفها GatewayQuery العامة). */
export interface FinanceQuery extends GatewayQuery {
  includeInactive?: boolean;
  automationKey?: string;
  entityId?: string;
  employeeId?: string;
  moduleId?: string;
  oldAccountId?: string;
  [key: string]: string | number | boolean | undefined;
}

/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
export const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
  Array.isArray(payload)
    ? (payload as any[])
    : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items)
      ? (payload as any).items
      : [];

export const isNotFoundError = (error: unknown): boolean =>
  (error as { code?: string })?.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND';

/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */
export async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {
  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };
}

export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {
  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;
}

const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 20_000;

/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */
export async function readAllFinanceRows(
  path: string,
  query: FinanceQuery = {},
  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
): Promise<any[]> {
  const rows: any[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });
    rows.push(...page.rows);
    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */
export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<any>>(path);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isNotFoundError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * يحوّل صف الحساب القادم من alx_api إلى الشكل الذي تعرفه واجهات النظام.
 * Maps an accounts row (accountId/accountNameAr/subAccountId/currencyNo) to the legacy FinancialAccount shape.
=== useExchangeRates
/**
 * useExchangeRates
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Singleton hook يُجلب أسعار الصرف والعملات من API بدلاً من Supabase realtime.
 *
 * يُعيد:
 *   - `rates`            — خريطة أسعار الصرف: { [code]: priceVsBase }
 *   - `currencies`       — قائمة العملات الكاملة (نشطة وغير نشطة)

```ts
import { financeApiClient, readAllFinanceRows, type ApiEnvelope } from './financeApi';

export type HierarchyLevel = 'account' | 'main' | 'sub' | 'group';
export type HierarchyApiLevel = 'account' | 'accMain' | 'accSub' | 'accSubGroup';

const levelPath: Record<HierarchyLevel, string> = { account:'account', main:'acc-main', sub:'acc-sub', group:'acc-sub-group' };
const levelKey: Record<HierarchyLevel, HierarchyApiLevel> = { account:'account', main:'accMain', sub:'accSub', group:'accSubGroup' };

export interface HierarchyNodeInput { accountCode?, accNameAr?, accNameEn?, curNo?: number|null, isActive?, accountType?, accountId?, accMainId?, accSubId?, allowsDirectAccounts?, entityType? }

/** عقدة شجرة بالشكل الذي تستهلكه الواجهة: id من nodeId والأسماء بصيغة camel. */
export interface HierarchyNode { id: string; accountCode: string; accNameAr?...; [key:string]: unknown }

function mapNode(row: any) { const id = String(row?.nodeId ?? row?.accSubGroupId ?? row?.accSubId ?? row?.accMainId ?? row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim(); return id ? {...row, id, accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? '', ...} : null }

export async function listHierarchyNodes(level: HierarchyLevel): Promise<HierarchyNode[]>
export async function createHierarchyNode(level, nodeId, input)
export async function updateHierarchyNode(level, nodeId, input)
export async function deleteHierarchyNode(level, nodeId)
export interface DefaultAccountInput { defaultKey?, accountId?, accNameAr?, accNameEn?, curNo?, isActive? }
export async function listDefaultAccountRecords(): Promise<DefaultAccountRecord[]>  // includes inactive! because the manager shows all
export async function createDefaultAccount(defaultAccountId, input)
export async function updateDefaultAccount(id, input)
export async function deleteDefaultAccount(id)
export interface TreeImportPlanRow { level: AccountingImportLevel; nodeId: string; payload: Record<string, unknown> }
export async function importAccountingTree(rows): Promise<{importedNodes:number; importedAccounts:number}>
```

There's a subtlety: the old loop added newly created rows into `nodes` as it went, so later rows referencing earlier imported parents resolve via the map. My service builds payloads from `knownNodes` which is only the pre-existing nodes... but `createKnownTreeNodes` is built from current state; the imported file's own rows are not in it. `buildImportedTreePayload(row, allNodes)` looks up `allNodes.get(row.parentId)` — for rows whose parent is also in the file, this returns undefined → accSubId/groupId null for ledger rows. That's a bug risk for files importing subgroups + accounts together.

To preserve behavior, the service must register each created row into the nodes map as it processes. Let me handle that inside `importAccountingTree`: after computing each hierarchy payload, add the node to the map:

However `nodes.set` must happen before ledger rows are processed — since hierarchy phase completes first, and I keep the same map for the ledger phase, ledger rows referencing imported parents resolve ✓. import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

type BoundaryCategory = 'legacyCompatImport' | 'supabaseRuntimeReference' | 'legacyListener';
type Baseline = Record<BoundaryCategory, string[]>;

const sourceRoot = resolve(process.cwd(), 'src');
const baselinePath = resolve(sourceRoot, 'config/legacy-boundary.baseline.json');
const baseline = JSON.parse(readFileSync(baselinePath, 'utf8')) as Baseline;

function collectSourceFiles(directory: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const path = resolve(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) return collectSourceFiles(path);
    return /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name) && !/\.test\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(entry.name) ? [path] : [];
  });
}

function categoryMatches(category: BoundaryCategory, source: string): boolean {
  if (category === 'legacyCompatImport') return source.includes('data/legacy/legacy-compat');
  if (category === 'supabaseRuntimeReference') {
    return ['@supabase/supabase-js', 'supabase.from', 'supabase.channel', 'postgres_changes', 'createClient(']
      .some((pattern) => source.includes(pattern));
  }
  return ['onSnapshot(', 'onAuthStateChanged('].some((pattern) => source.includes(pattern));
}

function relative(file: string): string {
  return file.slice(process.cwd().length + 1).replaceAll('\\', '/');
}

describe('Phase 0 — legacy/API-only boundary', () => {
  it('keeps migrated roles and finance gateways API-only', () => {
    const rolesPage = readFileSync(resolve(sourceRoot, 'features/roles/pages/RolesPage.tsx'), 'utf8');
    const financeGateway = readFileSync(resolve(sourceRoot, 'components/financeAccounting/FinanceApiDataGateway.ts'), 'utf8');

    expect(rolesPage).not.toContain('data/legacy/legacy-compat');
    expect(rolesPage).not.toContain('onSnapshot(');
    expect(financeGateway).not.toContain('FinanceAccountingDataGateway');
    expect(financeGateway).not.toContain('fallback');
  });

  it('does not allow new legacy or Supabase runtime references beyond the baseline', () => {
    const files = collectSourceFiles(sourceRoot);
    for (const category of ['legacyCompatImport', 'supabaseRuntimeReference', 'legacyListener'] as const) {
      const violations = files
        .filter((file) => categoryMatches(category, readFileSync(file, 'utf8')))
        .map(relative);
      const unexpected = violations.filter((file) => !baseline[category].includes(file));
      expect(unexpected, `New ${category} references detected`).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it('keeps the baseline manifest internally valid', () => {
    for (const category of ['legacyCompatImport', 'supabaseRuntimeReference', 'legacyListener'] as const) {
      for (const file of baseline[category]) {
        expect(statSync(resolve(process.cwd(), file)).isFile(), `Missing baseline file: ${file}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });
});

97	  const response = await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(

109	  const id = String(accountId || '').trim();
110	  if (!id) throw new Error('معرّف الحساب مطلوب.');
111	  try {
112	    await financeApiClient.delete<ApiEnvelope<{ accountId?: string; deleted?: boolean }>>(
113	      `${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
114	    );
115	    return { status: 'deleted', accountId: id };
116	  } catch (error) {
117	    const code = readErrorCode(error);
118	    const message = (error as { message?: string } | null)?.message ?? '';
119	    if (code === 'FINANCE_ACCOUNT_IN_USE') return { status: 'in_use', accountId: id, message };
120	    if (code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') return { status: 'not_found', accountId: id, message };
121	    throw error;

### التحقق النهائي
- الواجهة: `npx tsc --noEmit` نظيف؛ `npx vitest run` = 83 ملفًا ناجحًا و2 متخطى، 329 اختبارًا ناجحًا و5 متخطاة.
- الخلفية (alx_api): `npx tsc --noEmit` نظيف؛ `npx jest` = 34 مجموعة و217 اختبارًا كلها ناجحة.
- قاعدة البيانات: **لم يُنفَّذ أي DDL ولم تُجرَ أي كتابة** هذا الدور. الترحيلات 0021 و0022 و0023 ما زالت بانتظار تنفيذ المستخدم يدويًا عبر لوحة Supabase (حساب alx_api_runtime بلا صلاحيات DDL)، وترتيب النشر: الترحيلات ثم alx_api ثم الواجهة.
- لم يُنفَّذ أي commit أو push (يتطلب تأكيدًا صريحًا من المستخدم).
--- DBdevloping_history.md (1594 lines)
- جدول `salary_history`: عمود `extra` (jsonb) يحمل employeeName وaccountCode وcreatedByName، وعمود `month` هو مصدر `salaryMonth` في الواجهة. الكتابة تقبل مفاتيح المخطط الصارم فقط؛ أي مفتاح زائد (salaryMonth/createdAt/createdByUid/monthlySalary) يسبب رفض 400.
- حركات الحساب (`account_transactions`): تُقرأ عبر مسار الحركات وتُعاد بأسماء transType وamount، وتشمل الأسطر ذات `posting_status = posted` فقط.
- دوال إعادة الحساب: `recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(p_account_id)` للحساب الواحد و`recalculate_all_account_balances()` للجماعي؛ الاثنتان تعيدان عدد الصفوف المتأثرة، لذا لا تُختلق نتائج تفصيلية لكل حساب في الواجهة.
- جدول `auto_entries`: العمودان debit_account وcredit_account نصّان يحويان JSON (وليسا مفاتيح خارجية)، والعمودان description_template_ar وdescription_template_en يقابلهما في الواجهة descriptionTempAr وdescriptionTempEn، والمفتاح `auto_entry_id` يقابله `id`.
- خرائط المعرّفات: `account_id_migration_map` يُستخدم لجسر المعرّفات القديمة، وصيغة المعرّف الحالي للحساب المالي هي PREFIX-NNNN بينما معرّفات الجهات بصيغ cust_ وcour_ وemp_ وUUID، وهو ما برّر حذف مسح التعارض بين المجالين من الواجهة.
- هوية منفّذ القيود تُستخرج خادميًا من رمز الوصول داخل `withActorClaims`؛ لذلك أُسقط `createdByUid` من حمولات الواجهة (لا ثقة بمعرّف قادم من العميل).

**Response:**

/**
 * financeApi.ts
 * بوابة HTTP مشتركة لخدمات المالية — عميل واحد وفكّ غلاف موحّد وخرائط صفوف.
 * Shared finance HTTP gateway: one ApiClient instance, one envelope unwrap, and the account-row mapper
 * used by every finance service so the legacy shape is produced in exactly one place (DRY).
 */
import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';
import type { GatewayQuery } from '../data/contracts/common.gateway';
import type { AccountEntityType, FinancialAccount } from './financialAccountTypes';

/** عميل المالية هو عميل التطبيق المشترك نفسه — لا إعداد اتصال مكرر. */
export const financeApiClient = appApiClient;

export type { ApiEnvelope };

/** معاملات قراءة المالية الموسعة (تشمل مرشحات لا تعرفها GatewayQuery العامة). */
export interface FinanceQuery extends GatewayQuery {
  includeInactive?: boolean;
  automationKey?: string;
  entityId?: string;
  employeeId?: string;
  moduleId?: string;
  oldAccountId?: string;
  [key: string]: string | number | boolean | undefined;
}

/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
export const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
  Array.isArray(payload)
    ? (payload as any[])
    : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items)
      ? (payload as any).items
      : [];

export const isNotFoundError = (error: unknown): boolean =>
  (error as { code?: string })?.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND';

/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */
export async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {
  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };
}

export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {
  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;
}

const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 20_000;

/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */
export async function readAllFinanceRows(
  path: string,
  query: FinanceQuery = {},
  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
): Promise<any[]> {
  const rows: any[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });
    rows.push(...page.rows);
    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */
export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<any>>(path);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isNotFoundError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

=== useExchangeRates
/**
 * useExchangeRates

 * Singleton hook يُجلب أسعار الصرف والعملات من API بدلاً من Supabase realtime.
 *
 * يُعيد:
 *   - `rates`            — خريطة أسعار الصرف: { [code]: priceVsBase }
 *   - `currencies`       — قائمة العملات الكاملة (نشطة وغير نشطة)
 *   - `activeCurrencies` — العملات النشطة فقط
 *   - `loading`          — true أثناء التحميل الأولي
 *
 * Singleton hook that fetches exchange rates and currencies from API.
 * No Supabase realtime — uses polling instead.

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import type { Currency, ExchangeRates } from '../services/currencyService';
import { asyncState, runQuery, type AsyncState } from '../shared/contracts/ui.contracts';

// ── Singleton State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ExchangeRatesState {
  rates: ExchangeRates;
  currencies: Currency[];
  activeCurrencies: Currency[];
  loading: boolean;
  queryState: AsyncState<ExchangeRatesData>;
  updatedAt: number;
}

interface ExchangeRatesData {
  rates: ExchangeRates;
  currencies: Currency[];
  activeCurrencies: Currency[];
}

// فترة إعادة التحميل بالمللي ثانية (3 دقائق)
// Polling interval: 3 minutes
const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000;

let _state: ExchangeRatesState = {
  // الحالة الأولية: خريطة فارغة — ستُملأ من API فور الاتصال
  // Initial state: empty map — will be filled from API on first call
  rates: {},
  currencies: [],
  activeCurrencies: [],
  loading: true,
  queryState: asyncState.loading(),
  updatedAt: 0,
};

const _subscribers = new Set<() => void>();
let _initialized = false;
let _pollTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

function _notify() {
  _subscribers.forEach(cb => cb());
}

repository: FinanceRepository,
): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  // includeInactive يتيح فحص تفرّد الأكواد عند إنشاء حساب جديد — exposes disabled accounts for uniqueness checks.
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/accounts', ...route('view_financial_accounts', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const query = accountsQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
    if (!query.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const result = await repository.listAccounts(query.data);
      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });
  // يجب تسجيل by-entity قبل :id حتى لا يبتلع المعامل الديناميكي المسار الثابت.
  // Register by-entity before :id so the dynamic param cannot swallow the static path.
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/accounts/by-entity', ...route('view_financial_accounts', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const entityId = typeof request.query.entityId === 'string' ? request.query.entityId.trim() : '';
    if (!entityId)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'معرّف الكيان مطلوب.', requestId(response));
    try {
      return sendSuccess(response, await repository.listAccountsByEntity(entityId), requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });
  app.get(
    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/:id',
    ...route('view_financial_accounts', auth),
    async (request, response, next) => {
      const id = idParam(request, response);
      if (!id) return;
      try {
        const result = await repository.getAccount(id);
        return result
          ? sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response))
          : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'الحساب غير موجود.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    },
  );
  app.get(
    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/:id/movements',
    ...route('view_account_movements', auth),
    async (request, response, next) => {
      const id = idParam(request, response);
      if (!id) return;
      const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
      if (!query.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await repository.listAccountMovements(id, query.data);
        return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    },
  );
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/account-movements', ...route('view_account_movements', auth), pageHandler(repository.listAllAccountMovements));
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/entry-modules', ...route('view_entry_settings', auth), async (_request, response, next) => {
    try {
      return sendSuccess(response, await repository.listEntryModules(), requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/entry-types', ...route('view_entry_settings', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const moduleId = typeof request.query.moduleId === 'string' ? request.query.moduleId : undefined;
    try {
      return sendSuccess(response, await repository.listEntryTypes(moduleId), requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });
  // automationKey filter keeps the duplicate check for automatic entries exact and indexable.
  app.get('/api/v1/finance/entries', ...route('view_finance', auth), async (request, response, next) => {

=== DBdevloping_history.md ===
1604 DBdevloping_history.md
- حقن SQL: معرّف الحساب يصل كعامل مُسند `$1` في الاستعلامات الثلاثة ولا يُبنى أي SQL بنص مضمّن.
- أعمدة تقرير الحركة (`movementColumns`): `account_trans_id AS "transactionId"`، `main_entry_id AS "entryId"`، `me.entry_number AS "entryNumber"`، `me.entry_category AS "module"`، `trans_type AS "transType"`، `amount`، `amount_original AS "amountOriginal"`، `currency_original_no AS "currencyOriginalNo"`، `description`، `note`، `created_at AS "createdAt"`؛ الربط `account_id` هو مفتاح الكشف.
- شرط الترحيل صار خادميًا: `WHERE me.posting_status = 'posted'` داخل استعلام `/:id/movements`؛ الواجهة لم تعد تعيد تنفيذ الفلترة يدويًا.
- أعمدة `assets`: `asset_id`, `asset_code`, `category`, `name_ar`, `name_en`, `type`, `status`, `cost`, `currency`, `purchase_date`, `assigned_courier_id`, `assigned_courier_name`, `notes`, `account_id`, `account_code`, `is_active`, `maintenance_logs` (jsonb؛ قد يصل كنص JSON وتتحمّل طبقة الخريطة الصيغتين).
- أعمدة `accounts` القابلة للكتابة من دليل الحسابات: `account_code`, `account_prefix`, `account_number`, `entity_type`, `entity_id`, `entity_name`, `currency`, `balance`, `is_active`, `notes`, `type`, `acc_sub_id`, `group_id`, `account_seq`, `acc_name_ar`, `acc_name_en`, `limited_balance`, `cur_no`. لا يوجد عمود `parent_code` ولا `code` في المخطط الصارم، لذلك تُشتق الأبوة من `account_prefix` في الواجهة.
- شجرة الحسابات تُخزَّن في جداول منفصلة: `account` (بمفتاح `account_id`) و`acc_main` و`acc_sub` و`acc_sub_group` مع `balance` و`cur_no` و`is_active` في كلٍّ منها، و`allows_direct_accounts` في المستويين الأدنى.

## Findings

### A. Single customer / courier by id over HTTP

**Customer — server route exists, frontend single-read only via the orders gateway.**

| Layer | Path | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Backend | `GET /api/v1/customers/:customerId` | `F:\system\swiftship-tracker\swiftshift2\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.routes.ts:115-126` |
| Backend repo | `findById` → `SELECT ${columns} FROM alx_api_private.customers_read WHERE customer_id = $1` | `alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.repository.ts:111-117` |
| Frontend (API-only, ready to use) | `ordersApiDataGateway.collections.customers.get(id)` → `GET /api/v1/customers/{id}` | `src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:66` + generic `get()` at `:39-42` |
| Frontend (list only, **no getById**) | `customersApiDataGateway.getCustomers()` → `GET /api/v1/customers?limit=1000&offset=0` | `src\features\customers\services\customersApiDataGateway.ts:33-39` |

No frontend service today calls `GET /api/v1/customers/:id`; that path is only used with PATCH/DELETE (`customersApiDataGateway.ts:47,52`). The shared client to call it directly is `appApiClient` (`src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23`), whose `get(path, query)` builds search params and reads the token from sessionStorage (`src\data\http\api-client.ts:32-36`).

**Courier — there is NO GET-by-id route at all.**

- `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.routes.ts` registers only `POST /api/v1/operations/couriers` (:477), `PATCH /api/v1/operations/couriers/:id` (:488), `DELETE` (:519). No `app.get` for couriers anywhere in `modules/operations`.
- The only courier HTTP read is the reporting resource: `alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.routes.ts:12` (`couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' }`) generating `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers` (:28-45).
- Its query schema is `pageQuerySchema` (`alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.schemas.ts:4-14`: `limit` 1–1000 default 25, `offset`, `search`, `customerId`), **but** `createReportingRepository.list` applies only `search` — `customerId` is accepted by zod then silently dropped (`alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.repository.ts:90-99`). `search` ILIKE-matches `full_name/name_ar/name_en` (:18), never the id.
- Consequence: a single courier by id must come from a paged list + client-side match. Reusable helper: `staffApiDataGateway` internal `readRows('/api/v1/reporting/couriers')` with 1000/20000 pagination and `normalizeCourier` (`src\features\staff\services\staffApiDataGateway.ts:70-80`, `:87-97`, used at `:158`).
- **Trap**: `ordersApiDataGateway.collections.couriers` is configured `readPath: '/api/v1/reporting/couriers'` with `writePath: '/api/v1/operations/couriers'` (`ordersApiDataGateway.ts:68`), so its `get(id)` produces `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers/{id}` → route does not exist (404). Do not use it for single reads.

### B. Orders API-only + finance pagination helper

- Frontend function for read #2 (customer case): `ordersApiDataGateway.commands.findOrdersByCustomerId(customerId)` → `GET /api/v1/orders?limit=1000&offset=0&customerId=…` (`src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:170-177`); declared in `src\features\orders\api.ts:75`.
- Backend: `app.get('/api/v1/orders', ...route('view_orders', auth), list(repository.listOrders))` — `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.routes.ts:90`.
- Query zod: `pageQuerySchema` — `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.schemas.ts:4-14`. Supported filters = `limit`, `offset`, `search`, `customerId`. The `list()` wrapper forwards exactly `{limit, offset, search, customerId}` (`operations.routes.ts:54-73`).
- Implemented SQL filters (`operations.repository.ts:56-66`): `search` over `order_number/external_order_number/tracking_number` (:151) and **`customer_id = $n` only (:62-65)**. **There is no `deliveryCourierId` / `courierId` order filter** — courier order scoping does not exist server-side. `deliveryCourierId` appears only in the write schema (`operations.schemas.ts:67`) and as a returned alias.
- **Amount gap for the customer ledger**: `listOrders` column list (`operations.repository.ts:148`) returns `orderId, orderNumber, trackingNumber, customerId, orderStatusId, orderStatus, orderPartyId, orderPartyType, deliveryCourierId, shippingCourierId, currency, orderCurrency, orderCurrencyPrice, externalOrderNumber, createdAt, updatedAt` — **no `data` jsonb**. `amountPaid` / `amountRemaining` live inside `orders.data` (proved by the portal reading `(o.data->>'amountRemaining')::numeric` — `alx_api\src\modules\portal\portal-owned.repository.ts:625,688`; allowed write keys listed at `:93`). Only `getOrder` (single, `operations.repository.ts:155`) returns `data`. So the modal's `order.amountPaid + order.amountRemaining` charge line has no API source from the list endpoint.
- Finance helper to reuse for read #3: `readAllFinanceRows(path, query, pageSize=1000, maxRows=20000)` in `src\services\financeApi.ts:52-65`, plus `readFinancePage` (:39-42), `readFinanceRows` (:44-46), `readFinanceRecord` (returns `null` on `ENTITY_NOT_FOUND`, :68-76). `FinanceQuery` already declares `entityId` (`src\services\financeApi.ts:21`).
- Your new route confirmed: `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.routes.ts:161-171` (`permission view_account_movements`) → `accountMovementsQuerySchema` = `pageQuerySchema.extend({ entityId })` (`finance.schemas.ts:253-255`). Repo `listAllAccountMovements` (`finance.repository.ts:187-200`) inner-joins `main_entry` and hard-filters `me.posting_status = 'posted'`, ordering by `created_at DESC`. **The posted filter is server-side, so legacy read #4 (`main_entry` snapshot / `mainEntriesMap`) and the `ps !== 'posted'` checks at `GlobalEntityLedgerModal.tsx:103-111, 175-184, 212-221` become dead weight after conversion.**

### C. Existing code to reuse instead of new plumbing

1. `financeApiDataGateway.getAccountTransactions(accountId)` and `.subscribeAccountMovements(...)` — `src\components\financeAccounting\FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:127-140` / `:142-172`. Same paged-movements + `normalizeRows('account_trans')` aliasing (`:47-55`) you need; only keyed by accountId instead of entityId.
2. `normalizeRows('account_trans')` (`FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:47-55`) already converts API rows to the modal's legacy shape (`id ← transactionId`, `type ← transType`, `module ← entryCategory`, `refNumber ← entryNumber`) — the single best reuse point.
3. `CouriersPage.getCourierUnifiedLedger()` — `src\features\couriers\pages\CouriersPage.tsx:277-341+` — duplicate of the modal's courier branch (custody/order/expense/wage title + running-balance logic), driven by already-API-only `courierTransactions`.
4. `useAccountBalances` / `isTransactionPostable` — `src\hooks\useAccountBalances.ts:148`, `:349` — API-only posted-movement filtering over `financeApiDataGateway`.
5. `ordersApiDataGateway.commands.findOrdersByCustomerId` for read #2 (customer).

### D. Field naming you can read after conversion

**Customer** (`GET /api/v1/customers/{id}`, `CustomerDto` in `alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.contracts.ts:1-18`; aliases from `customers.repository.ts:6`):
`customerId, accountId, isActive, joinBy, referrerId, fullName, nameAr, nameEn, customerLevel, createdAt, updatedAt, acquisitionSource, preferredCategories, location, address, onboardingCompleted`.
⚠️ **No `phone`, no `email`, no `city`, no `financialBalance`/`walletBalance`.** So `entityData?.phone` (`GlobalEntityLedgerModal.tsx:327,328`) and `entityData?.financialBalance || walletBalance` (`:354`) have no API equivalent for customers — phone must come from `preferredCategories/location`-free sources or a balance/account route; `fullName`/`address` do exist.

**Courier** (`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`, `alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.repository.ts:20`):
`courierId, fullName, nameAr, nameEn, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, type (dup of courierType), courierLevel, level (dup), commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy, updatedBy`, plus `map` adds `id = courierId` (`:21`). `staffApiDataGateway.normalizeCourier` (`:87-97`) coerces the nullable strings to `""` and derives `disabled = isActive === false`. So couriers give you `phone`/`address`; customers do not.

**Account movements** (`movementColumns`, `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.repository.ts:23`): `transactionId, entryId, entryNumber, module (= main_entry.entry_category), lineNo, transType, accountId, accountCurrencyNo, amount, amountOriginal, currencyOriginalNo, currencyPriceId, currencyPriceSeq, paymentMethod, entityType, entityId, orderId, shipmentId, custodyId, automationKey, autoRuleId, description, note, createdAt`.
Gaps vs the modal's current reads: there is **no `id`** (use `transactionId`, or `normalizeRows` which injects it), **no `refNumber`** (modal's `tx.refNumber` at `:151` must become `entryNumber`), **no `currency` string** (only numeric `currencyOriginalNo` — `tx.currencyOriginal || 'YER'` at `:198,264` needs resolution via `currencyService`), and **no `moduleId`** (modal's `tx.moduleId` at `:229`). Payment-order matching at `:151` compares `tx.refNumber === order.orderNumber`; the API rows expose `entryNumber` + `orderId`, so match on `orderId` instead.

# Research Report

## 1. What the UI actually needs

All rows come via `extractSiteManagementRows` (`src/features/siteManagement/services/siteManagementGateway.ts:4-9`): only `id` + spread of the jsonb `data` column are used — a few columns, not full rows.

- **orders** (`portalOrders`): filtered client-side on `customerUid|portalUid|orderSourceType==='App'` (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:54`); rendered: `orderNumber, trackingNumber, createdAt, customerName, recipientName, customerPhone, deliveryCity, orderSourceName, orderStatus|status, totalPrice|totalAmount` (`components/PortalOrdersTab.tsx:50-58`). No mutations from this page.
- **portal_tickets** (`tickets`): `subject, userName, userEmail, status ('open'), message, replies[].{sender,createdAt,message}, createdAt` (`SupportTicketsTab.tsx:46-63`; sort `useWebsiteManagementData.ts:45`). **Write**: reply does `supabase.from('portal_tickets').update({data: cleanPayload}).eq('portal_ticket_id',…)` (`pages/WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:153`).
- **announcements**: `title, content, priority, targetAudience, isActive|is_active, createdAt` (`AnnouncementsTab.tsx:99-115`). **Writes**: insert `{announcement_id, data}` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:186`), update `data` (`:210`), delete (`:223`).
- **jobs_req**: `fullName, jobPosition, refCode, phone, email, city, address, qualification, experienceYears, idNumber, createdAt, notes, status, updatedAt` (`JobApplicationsTab.tsx:39-77`). **Writes**: update `data` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:245`), delete (`:284`), plus courier creation via `setDoc(doc(db,'couriers',…))` (`:261`).
- **couriers**: loaded (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:35`) but **never destructured/rendered** in `WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:31-40` — dead read path.
- `SiteAnalyticsTab.tsx:90-95` & `WebsiteManagementTabs.tsx:29`: only `status` counts.

## 2. Existing API coverage

- **`GET /api/v1/orders`** — admin JWT + permission `view_orders` (`alx_api/src/modules/operations/operations.routes.ts:90`, route() at `:37-39`). Query: `limit, offset, search, customerId` (`operations.schemas.ts:4-8`; applied in `operations.repository.ts:80-83`; search hits `order_number/external_order_number/tracking_number` `:169`). Columns: `orderListColumns` (`:52-64`) = orderId, orderNumber, trackingNumber, customerId, orderStatusId, orderStatus, orderParty*, courier ids, currency fields, externalOrderNumber, jsonb-extracted `amountPaid/amountRemaining/totalCostYER/paymentStatus`, createdAt, updatedAt. **No** customerName/recipientName/phone/deliveryCity/orderSourceName/totalPrice.
- **Couriers**: no `GET /api/v1/operations/couriers` list exists — only `GET /:id`, POST, PATCH, DELETE (`operations.routes.ts:479-522`). List is at **`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`** (admin JWT, `view_couriers`) (`reporting.routes.ts:12,29-31`), returning all couriers with `courierId, fullName, nameAr/En, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, courierLevel, commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, id` (`reporting.repository.ts:14-21`).
- **portal_tickets**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/tickets` — **portal-session Bearer auth** (`portal-owned.routes.ts:57-68,73`), no permission code, filters `WHERE user_uid = $1` (`portal-owned.repository.ts:217`) → **cannot list all rows**. Aliases: `portal_ticket_id AS id, user_uid AS "userUid", type, subject, message, status, replies, data, created_at AS "createdAt"` (`:214-215`), mapped to `PortalTicketDto` incl. `userName, userRole, adminResponse` (`portal-owned.contracts.ts:55-67`). `portal-admin.routes.ts` has **no** tickets endpoint (users only, `:31-114`).
- **announcements**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/announcements` — **public, no auth, no permission** (`portal.routes.ts:63`), but hard-caps `WHERE is_active = true … LIMIT 20` (`portal.repository.ts:102-106`) → cannot list all incl. inactive. Aliases `announcement_id AS id, title, content, priority, created_at AS "createdAt"`; no targetAudience, no `data`.
- **jobs_req**: only `POST /api/v1/portal/job-applications` (public, rate-limited) (`job-applications.routes.ts:24-27`); repository has `create` only (`job-applications.repository.ts:6`). **No list/get endpoint at all.**

## 3. Schema facts

- **portal_tickets** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1023-1038`): `portal_ticket_id text` (renamed from `id` in `supabase/migrations/202609170001_rename_primary_keys_to_table_id.sql:283`), `user_uid → portal_users`, `message, replies jsonb, status, subject, type, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. `data` jsonb not in the doc but exists — repository selects/inserts it (`portal-owned.repository.ts:215,228`). Index on `(user_uid, created_at DESC)` (`alx_api/src/db/migrations/0015_portal_owned_resource_indexes.sql:3-4`).
- **announcements**: two conflicting definitions. `alx_api/src/db/migrations/0011_portal_announcements.sql:11-36`: `announcement_id uuid PK, title, content, priority CHECK('normal','high','urgent'), is_active bool, expires_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at, created_by, updated_by` — **no data column**. `DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1364-1380`: adds `data jsonb {content, target_audience}`. Legacy UI writes only `{announcement_id, data}`.
- **jobs_req** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1341-1362`; PK renamed `id→jobs_req_id` at `202609170001…sql:184`): `jobs_req_id, address, city, email, experience_years int, full_name, id_number, job_position, notes, phone, qualification, ref_code, status, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. Doc omits `data`, but repository inserts `data jsonb` plus flat columns (`job-applications.repository.ts:25-31`). Note: the doc's `job_req_id` spelling is stale.

- **orders** — covered by `GET /api/v1/orders` (`operations.routes.ts:90`), except missing display columns (customerName/phone/deliveryCity/source/totalPrice) that today come from the `data` jsonb spread.

Reply mutation would need an admin PATCH there too.

Stage 7-ط is closed: the website-management page no longer touches Supabase at all.

**Backend (alx_api)** — new `site-content` module with `GET/POST /api/v1/site/tickets` (+ `:id/replies`), `GET/POST /api/v1/site/announcements` (+ `PATCH/DELETE :id`), `GET /api/v1/site/job-applications` (+ `PATCH/DELETE :id`), and `GET /api/v1/site/portal-orders`. Reads are paginated and filtered server-side, `data` jsonb is the source of truth (writes never touch unverified flat columns), ticket replies force `sender`/`status` server-side, announcement IDs are generated server-side, and portal-order provenance (`customerUid`/`portalUid`/`App`) is now a SQL predicate instead of a whole-table browser scan. Permissions reuse the existing `view_website_management`/`manage_website` codes, so no permission seeding is needed.

**Frontend** — `src/services/siteContentService.ts` replaces the gateway; `useWebsiteManagementData` reads only from it (the dead `couriers` read is gone); all five write handlers in `WebsiteManagementPage.tsx` call the API, and the approved-courier creation now goes through `couriersApiDataGateway.createCourier` instead of Firestore `setDoc`. `src/features/siteManagement/services/siteManagementGateway.ts` is deleted, and the legacy baseline tightened to **10/7/8**. import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { FinanceRepository } from './finance.contracts';
import {
  accountsQuerySchema,
  assetInputSchema,
  assetsQuerySchema,
  autoEntryRuleSchema,
  createEntrySchema,
  custodyAdvanceSchema,
  defaultAccountSchema,
  entityIdSchema,
  entityPurgeTypeSchema,
  entriesQuerySchema,
  entryModuleInputSchema,
  entryTypeInputSchema,
  financialAccountSchema,
  hierarchyImportSchema,
  hierarchyNodeSchema,
  orderPaymentSchema,
  pageQuerySchema,
  recalculateSchema,
  reverseEntrySchema,
  salaryHistoryQuerySchema,
  salaryHistorySchema,
  settleCustodySchema,
} from './finance.schemas';

function requestId(response: Response): string {
  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
}
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {
  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
}
function pageHandler(
  load: (query: {
    limit: number;
    offset: number;
    search?: string | undefined;
  }) => Promise<{ items: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]; total: number }>,
) {
  return async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
    if (!query.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const result = await load(query.data);
      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  };
}
function idParam(request: Request, response: Response): string | undefined {
  const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
    return undefined;
  }
  return parsed.data;
}
function writeError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  if (error instanceof Error && /غير متوازن|balance|balanced/i.test(error.message)) {
    sendFailure(response, 422, 'FINANCIAL_ENTRY_NOT_BALANCED', 'لا يمكن إنشاء قيد غير متوازن.', requestId(response));
    return;
  }
  next(error);
}

// مطابقة منطق الصلاحيات الدقيقة للإجراءين secure_replace/secure_delete في قاعدة البيانات
// Mirrors the granular permission mapping of the legacy secure_replace/secure_delete RPC wrappers.
const RECEIPT_TYPE_CODES = ['RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT'];
const PAYMENT_TYPE_CODES = ['PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT'];

function entryPermissionFor(typeCode: string | null, category: string, action: 'edit' | 'delete'): string {
  if (RECEIPT_TYPE_CODES.includes(typeCode ?? '')) return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_receipt_vouchers' : 'delete_receipt_vouchers';
  if (PAYMENT_TYPE_CODES.includes(typeCode ?? '')) return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_payment_vouchers' : 'delete_payment_vouchers';
  if (category === 'Compound') return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_compound_entries' : 'delete_compound_entries';
  if (category === 'Temp') return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_temporary_entries' : 'delete_temporary_entries';
  return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_general_entries' : 'delete_general_entries';
}

async function hasPermission(auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, userId: string, code: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!auth) return false;
  const permissions = await auth.listPermissions({ userId });
  return permissions.includes(code);
}

  const bearer = 'Authorization';
  const lastCall = (mock: unknown) => (mock as jest.Mock).mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0];

  it('keeps disabled accounts hidden unless includeInactive is requested', async () => {
    const app = createApiApp({ environment, auth: auth(['view_financial_accounts']), finance: repository });

    const active = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/accounts').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(active.status).toBe(200);
    expect(lastCall(repository.listAccounts)).toMatchObject({ includeInactive: false, limit: 25, offset: 0 });

    const all = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/accounts?includeInactive=true').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(all.status).toBe(200);
    expect(lastCall(repository.listAccounts)).toMatchObject({ includeInactive: true });

    const invalid = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/accounts?includeInactive=maybe').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(invalid.status).toBe(400);
    expect(invalid.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_PAGE_QUERY');
  });

  it('filters entries by automation key so duplicate automatic entries stay detectable', async () => {
    const app = createApiApp({ environment, auth: auth(['view_finance']), finance: repository });

    const response = await request(app)

    const rejected = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/entries?automationKey=%20').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(rejected.status).toBe(400);
  });
});

No frontend service today calls `GET /api/v1/customers/:id`; that path is only used with PATCH/DELETE (`customersApiDataGateway.ts:47,52`). ### D. Field naming you can read after conversion

**Customer** (`GET /api/v1/customers/{id}`, `CustomerDto` in `alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.contracts.ts:1-18`; aliases from `customers.repository.ts:6`):
`customerId, accountId, isActive, joinBy, referrerId, fullName, nameAr, nameEn, customerLevel, createdAt, updatedAt, acquisitionSource, preferredCategories, location, address, onboardingCompleted`.
⚠️ **No `phone`, no `email`, no `city`, no `financialBalance`/`walletBalance`.** So `entityData?.phone` (`GlobalEntityLedgerModal.tsx:327,328`) and `entityData?.financialBalance || walletBalance` (`:354`) have no API equivalent for customers — phone must come from `preferredCategories/location`-free sources or a balance/account route; `fullName`/`address` do exist.

**Courier** (`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`, `alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.repository.ts:20`):
`courierId, fullName, nameAr, nameEn, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, type (dup of courierType), courierLevel, level (dup), commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy, updatedBy`, plus `map` adds `id = courierId` (`:21`). `staffApiDataGateway.normalizeCourier` (`:87-97`) coerces the nullable strings to `""` and derives `disabled = isActive === false`. So couriers give you `phone`/`address`; customers do not.

**Account movements** (`movementColumns`, `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.repository.ts:23`): `transactionId, entryId, entryNumber, module (= main_entry.entry_category), lineNo, transType, accountId, accountCurrencyNo, amount, amountOriginal, currencyOriginalNo, currencyPriceId, currencyPriceSeq, paymentMethod, entityType, entityId, orderId, shipmentId, custodyId, automationKey, autoRuleId, description, note, createdAt`.
Gaps vs the modal's current reads: there is **no `id`** (use `transactionId`, or `normalizeRows` which injects it), **no `refNumber`** (modal's `tx.refNumber` at `:151` must become `entryNumber`), **no `currency` string** (only numeric `currencyOriginalNo` — `tx.currencyOriginal || 'YER'` at `:198,264` needs resolution via `currencyService`), and **no `moduleId`** (modal's `tx.moduleId` at `:229`). Payment-order matching at `:151` compares `tx.refNumber === order.orderNumber`; the API rows expose `entryNumber` + `orderId`, so match on `orderId` instead.

86	
87	    const unsubOrders = onSnapshot(qOrders, (snap) => {
88	      setOrders(snap.docs.map((d: AdapterDocument) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })));
89	    }, (err) => console.error("Error fetching orders:", err));

91	    // 3. Fetch Ledger Account Transactions from account_trans
92	    const qTx = query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), where('entity_id', '==', entityId));
93	    const unsubTx = onSnapshot(qTx, (snap) => {
94	      setTransactions(snap.docs.map((d: AdapterDocument) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })));

96	    }, (err) => {

99	    });

101	    // 4. الاستماع لجدول main_entry لبناء خريطة حالة الترحيل

103	    const unsubMainEntries = onSnapshot(collection(db, 'main_entry'), (snap) => {
104	      const map = new Map<string, any>();
105	      snap.docs.forEach((d: AdapterDocument) => {
106	        map.set(d.id, d.data());
107	      });
108	      setMainEntriesMap(map);
109	    }, (err) => {
110	      console.warn("Error fetching main_entry for ledger modal:", err);
111	    });

113	    return () => {
114	      unsubEntity();
115	      unsubOrders();
116	      unsubTx();
117	      unsubMainEntries();
118	    };

123	  // Compute Chronological Ledger Items
124	  const getUnifiedLedger = () => {
125	    const ledger: any[] = [];
126	
127	    if (entityType === 'customer') {
128	      // ----------------- CUSTOMER LEDGER GENERATOR -----------------
129	      orders.forEach(order => {
130	        const amtPaid = parseFloat(order.amountPaid || order.paidAmount || 0);
131	        const amtRemain = parseFloat(order.amountRemaining || 0);
132	        const totalCost = amtPaid + amtRemain;
133	
134	        // Total Cost (Debit - customer owes this amount)
135	        if (totalCost > 0) {
136	          ledger.push({
137	            id: `order-charge-${order.id}`,
138	            date: order.createdAt || Date.now(),
139	            type: 'Debit',
140	            amount: totalCost,
141	            module: 'order',
142	            title: isAr ? 'قيمة مبيعات / رسوم شحن' : 'Sales COD Charge',
143	            description: isAr 
144	              ? `قيمة الشحنة الموكلة رقم: ${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'}` 
145	              : `Gross COD for shipment #${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'}`,
146	            ref: order.orderNumber || order.id
147	          });
148	        }
149	
150	        // COD Paid (Credit - customer paid this amount)
151	        const orderPaymentTxs = transactions.filter(tx => tx.module === 'payment' && (tx.refNumber === order.orderNumber || tx.refNumber === order.id));
152	        const sumOfRecordedTxs = orderPaymentTxs.reduce((sum, tx) => sum + (parseFloat(tx.amountOriginal || tx.amount || 0)), 0);
153	        
154	        const unrecordedPayment = amtPaid - sumOfRecordedTxs;
155	
156	        if (unrecordedPayment > 0.01) {
157	          ledger.push({
158	            id: `order-pay-${order.id}`,
159	            date: (order.updatedAt || order.createdAt || Date.now()) + 1,
160	            type: 'Credit',
161	            amount: unrecordedPayment,
162	            module: 'payment',
163	            title: isAr ? 'مقبوضات شحن مبدئية / غير مقيدة' : 'Initial COD Payment',
164	            description: isAr 
165	              ? `كاش سدد مسبقاً للشحنة رقم: ${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'} ولم يُقيد بسند منفصل` 
166	              : `Legacy cash paid for shipment #${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'}`,
167	            ref: order.orderNumber || order.id
168	          });
169	        }
170	      });

172	      // System manual/accounting transactions for customers
173	      transactions.forEach(tx => {
174	        const entryId = tx.entryId || tx.entry_id;
175	        if (entryId) {
176	          const mainEntry = mainEntriesMap.get(entryId);
177	          // استبعاد الحركات التي قيدها غير موجود في main_entry

186	        // Prevent duplication: our order generator always adds the 'order charge' debit line

189	        const currentType = tx.transType || tx.trans_type || tx.type || 'Debit';
190	        const refNo = tx.entryNumber || tx.entry_number || tx.refNumber || tx.accountCode || '';
191	
192	        ledger.push({
193	          id: tx.id || `tx-${Math.random()}`,
194	          date: tx.createdAt || Date.now(),
195	          type: currentType, // 'Debit' | 'Credit'
196	          amount: tx.amount || 0,
197	          amountOriginal: tx.amountOriginal || tx.amount_original || tx.amount || 0,
198	          currencyOriginal: tx.currencyOriginal || tx.currency || 'YER',
199	          module: 'transaction',

201	          description: isAr 
202	            ? `حركة حساب مركزية رقم القيد: ${refNo || 'Ledger-Tx'}`
203	            : `System main entry ref: ${refNo || 'Ledger-Tx'}`,

208	    } else {

211	        const entryId = tx.entryId || tx.entry_id;
212	        if (entryId) {
213	          const mainEntry = mainEntriesMap.get(entryId);
214	          // استبعاد الحركات التي قيدها غير موجود في main_entry

224	        const refNo = tx.entryNumber || tx.entry_number || tx.refNumber || tx.accountCode || 'GL-TX';

226	        // We normalize types to ensure perfect bookkeeping and auto-heal any legacy data quirks.

231	        if (category === 'custody') {

241	          }
242	        } else if (category === 'order') {

247	          }
248	        } else if (category === 'expense') {

250	          title = isAr ? 'مصروف تشغيلي / أجور مسددة' : 'Operating Expense / Disbursed';
251	        } else if (category === 'wage' || category === 'salary_payment') {

254	        } else {

258	        ledger.push({

281	      } else {

283	      }

285	      return {
286	        ...item,
287	        runningAccountBal

19	export function registerCustomersRoutes(

42	          limit: parsed.data.limit,
43	          offset: parsed.data.offset,
44	          total: result.total,
45	        });

47	        return next(error);
48	      }
49	    },
50	  );

1	import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
2	import type { Pool, PoolClient } from 'pg';
3	import type { CustomerDto, CustomerRepository, CustomerWriteInput } from './customers.contracts';
4	
5	type CustomerRow = CustomerDto & { total_count?: string };
6	const columns = `customer_id AS "customerId", account_id AS "accountId", is_active AS "isActive", join_by AS "joinBy", referrer_id AS "referrerId", full_name AS "fullName", name_ar AS "nameAr", name_en AS "nameEn", customer_level AS "customerLevel", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt", acquisition_source AS "acquisitionSource", preferred_categories AS "preferredCategories", location, address, onboarding_completed AS "onboardingCompleted"`;
7	
8	function mapCustomer(row: CustomerRow): CustomerDto {
9	  return {
10	    customerId: row.customerId,
11	    accountId: row.accountId,
12	    isActive: row.isActive,
13	    joinBy: row.joinBy,
14	    referrerId: row.referrerId,
15	    fullName: row.fullName,
16	    nameAr: row.nameAr,
17	    nameEn: row.nameEn,
18	    customerLevel: row.customerLevel,
19	    createdAt: row.createdAt,
20	    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
21	    acquisitionSource: row.acquisitionSource,
22	    preferredCategories: row.preferredCategories,
23	    location: row.location,
24	    address: row.address,
25	    onboardingCompleted: row.onboardingCompleted,
26	  };
27	}
28	
29	async function writeAudit(client: PoolClient, action: string, customerId: string, actorUserId: string): Promise<void> {
30	  const now = new Date();
31	  await client.query(
32	    `INSERT INTO public.activity_logs
33	      (activity_log_id, action, category, target, type, details, user_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
34	     VALUES ($1, $2, 'customer', $3, 'api', $4, $5, $6, $6, $5, $5)`,
35	    [
36	      `audit_${randomUUID()}`,
37	      action,
38	      customerId,
39	      JSON.stringify({ source: 'alx_api', entityType: 'customer', entityId: customerId }),
40	      actorUserId,
41	      now,
42	    ],
43	  );
44	}
45	
46	async function inTransaction<T>(pool: Pool, operation: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
47	  const client = await pool.connect();
48	  try {
49	    await client.query('BEGIN');
50	    const result = await operation(client);
51	    await client.query('COMMIT');
52	    return result;
53	  } catch (error) {
54	    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
55	    throw error;
56	  } finally {
57	    client.release();
58	  }
59	}
60	
61	function writeFields(input: CustomerWriteInput): { assignments: string[]; values: unknown[] } {
62	  const fields: Array<[keyof CustomerWriteInput, string]> = [
63	    ['accountId', 'account_id'],
64	    ['isActive', 'is_active'],
65	    ['joinBy', 'join_by'],
66	    ['referrerId', 'referrer_id'],
67	    ['fullName', 'full_name'],
68	    ['nameAr', 'name_ar'],
69	    ['nameEn', 'name_en'],
70	    ['customerLevel', 'customer_level'],
71	    ['acquisitionSource', 'acquisition_source'],
72	    ['preferredCategories', 'preferred_categories'],
73	    ['location', 'location'],
74	    ['address', 'address'],
75	    ['onboardingCompleted', 'onboarding_completed'],
76	  ];
77	  const assignments: string[] = [];
78	  const values: unknown[] = [];
79	  for (const [property, column] of fields) {
80	    if (input[property] !== undefined) {
81	      values.push(input[property] ?? null);
82	      assignments.push(`${column} = $${values.length}`);
83	    }
84	  }
85	  return { assignments, values };
86	}
87	
88	export function createCustomersRepository(pool: Pool): CustomerRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async list(query) {
91	      const values: unknown[] = [];
92	      const filters: string[] = [];
93	      if (query.search) {
94	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
95	        filters.push(
96	          `(full_name ILIKE $${values.length} OR name_ar ILIKE $${values.length} OR name_en ILIKE $${values.length})`,
97	        );
98	      }
99	      if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
100	        values.push(query.isActive);
101	        filters.push(`is_active = $${values.length}`);
102	      }
103	      const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
104	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
105	      const result = await pool.query<CustomerRow>(
106	        `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS total_count FROM alx_api_private.customers_read ${where} ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id ASC LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
107	        values,
108	      );
109	      return { items: result.rows.map(mapCustomer), total: Number(result.rows[0]?.total_count ?? 0) };
110	    },
111	    async findById(customerId) {
112	      const result = await pool.query<CustomerRow>(
113	        `SELECT ${columns} FROM alx_api_private.customers_read WHERE customer_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
114	        [customerId],
115	      );
116	      return result.rows[0] ? mapCustomer(result.rows[0]) : null;
117	    },
118	    async create(input, actorUserId) {
119	      return inTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
120	        const customerId = input.customerId ?? `cust_${randomUUID()}`;
121	        const fields = writeFields(input);
122	        const columnsToInsert = ['customer_id', ...fields.assignments.map((assignment) => assignment.split(' = ')[0]), 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'created_by', 'updated_by'];
123	        const values = [customerId, ...fields.values, new Date(), new Date(), actorUserId, actorUserId];
124	        const placeholders = values.map((_, index) => `$${index + 1}`).join(', ');
125	        const result = await client.query<CustomerRow>(
126	          `INSERT INTO public.customers (${columnsToInsert.join(', ')}) VALUES (${placeholders}) RETURNING ${columns}`,
127	          values,
128	        );
129	        const row = result.rows[0];
130	        if (!row) throw new Error('CUSTOMER_CREATE_RETURNED_NO_ROW');
131	        const customer = mapCustomer(row);
132	        await writeAudit(client, 'create_customer', customer.customerId, actorUserId);
133	        return customer;
134	      });
135	    },
136	    async update(customerId, input, actorUserId) {
137	      return inTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
138	        const fields = writeFields(input);
139	        if (fields.assignments.length === 0) return null;
140	        const values = [...fields.values, new Date(), actorUserId, customerId];
141	        const result = await client.query<CustomerRow>(
142	          `UPDATE public.customers SET ${fields.assignments.join(', ')}, updated_at = $${values.length - 2}, updated_by = $${values.length - 1} WHERE customer_id = $${values.length} RETURNING ${columns}`,
143	          values,
144	        );
145	        if (!result.rows[0]) return null;
146	        const customer = mapCustomer(result.rows[0]);
147	        await writeAudit(client, 'update_customer', customer.customerId, actorUserId);
148	        return customer;
149	      });
150	    },
151	    async archive(customerId, actorUserId) {
152	      return inTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
153	        const values = [new Date(), actorUserId, customerId];
154	        const result = await client.query<CustomerRow>(
155	          `UPDATE public.customers SET is_active = false, updated_at = $1, updated_by = $2 WHERE customer_id = $3 RETURNING ${columns}`,
156	          values,
157	        );
158	        if (!result.rows[0]) return null;
159	        const customer = mapCustomer(result.rows[0]);
160	        await writeAudit(client, 'archive_customer', customer.customerId, actorUserId);
161	        return customer;
162	      });
163	    },
164	  };
165	}

9	/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
10	export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =

13	/**

15	 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
16	 */
17	function readAccessToken(): string | null {
18	  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
19	  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');

23	export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({

25	  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
26	  maxReadRetries: 0,
27	});

125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.
126	 */
127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}

88	export function createReportingRepository(pool: Pool): ReportingRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async list(resource, query) {
91	      const definition = definitions[resource];
92	      const values: unknown[] = [];
93	      const filters: string[] = [];
94	      if (query.search) {
95	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
96	        const placeholder = `$${values.length}`;
97	        filters.push(`(${definition.searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE ${placeholder}`).join(' OR ')})`);
98	      }
99	      const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
100	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
101	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
102	        `SELECT ${definition.columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM ${definition.from} ${where} ORDER BY ${definition.orderBy} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
103	        values,
104	      );
105	      return {
106	        items: result.rows.map(({ _total: _ignored, ...row }) => definition.map?.(row) ?? (row as ReportingRow)),
107	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0),
108	      };
109	    },
110	  };
111	}

9	const LEDGER_LINES_PATH = '/api/v1/finance/account-movements';

12	/**
13	 * Compatibility report surface for callers outside the unified FinanceEntries page.
14	 * مصدر التقرير هو دفتر الأستاذ المُطبع عبر alx_api فقط: مسارات الحركات تُعيد سطور account_trans
15	 * المرحّلة (posting_status = posted) حصراً، ورؤوس القيود تُقرأ من main_entry.
16	 * The report source is the normalized ledger served by alx_api: the movements route already filters
17	 * account_trans to posted lines only, and entry headers come from main_entry. No legacy collection is read.
18	 */
19	export default function FinanceReports() {
20	  const [totals, setTotals] = useState<ReportTotals | null>(null);
21	  const [error, setError] = useState('');
22	
23	  useEffect(() => {
24	    let cancelled = false;
25	
26	    const load = async () => {
27	      try {
28	        // limit=1 لأن العدد الدقيق يأتي من meta.total — لا حاجة لسحب الصفوف نفسها.

32	          readFinancePage(ENTRY_HEADERS_PATH, { limit: 1, offset: 0 }),
33	        ]);
34	        if (cancelled) return;
35	        setTotals({ postedLines: lines.total, entryHeaders: entries.total });
36	      } catch (err) {
37	        console.warn('FinanceReports: تعذر تحميل ملخص دفتر الأستاذ:', err);
38	        if (!cancelled) setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'تعذر تحميل التقرير المالي.');
39	      }
40	    };
41	
42	    void load();
43	    return () => {
44	      cancelled = true;
45	    };
46	  }, []);
47	
48	  return (
49	    <section aria-label="Normalized financial report" className="space-y-3">
50	      <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white">Financial Reports</h2>
51	      {error ? (
52	        <p className="text-xs text-rose-400">{error}</p>
53	      ) : (
54	        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
55	          {totals === null

71	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data)
72	    ? response.data

9	const client = new ApiClient({

15	const unsupported = (operation: string): never => {
16	  throw new Error(`ORDERS_API_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED:${operation}`);
17	};
18	const normalize = <T extends ApiRow>(row: T, idKey: string): T & { id: string } => ({ ...row, id: String(row[idKey] ?? row.id ?? '') });
19	const extractRows = <T extends ApiRow>(data: T[] | { items?: T[] } | undefined): T[] => Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : [];
20	
21	function makeApiCollection<T extends ApiRow>(config: ApiCollectionConfig): OrdersCollectionRepository<T> {
22	  const list = async (): Promise<readonly T[]> => {
23	    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T[] | { items?: T[] }>>(config.readPath, { limit: 100, offset: 0 });
24	    return extractRows(response.data).map((row) => normalize(row, config.idKey) as T);
25	  };
26	  const pathFor = (id: string) => `${config.writePath ?? config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
27	  return {
28	    subscribe(onData: (snapshot: { records: readonly T[] }) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
29	      let disposed = false;
30	      const refresh = async () => {
31	        try { const records = await list(); if (!disposed) onData({ records }); }
32	        catch (error) { if (!disposed) onError?.(error); }
33	      };
34	      void refresh();
35	      const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000);
36	      return () => { disposed = true; clearInterval(timer); };
37	    },
38	    list,
39	    async get(id) {
40	      const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T>>(`${config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
41	      return normalize(response.data, config.idKey) as T;
42	    },
43	    async create(id, payload) {
44	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`create:${config.readPath}`);
45	      const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(config.writePath, { ...payload, [config.idKey]: id });
46	      return { id: String(response.data[config.idKey] ?? response.data.id ?? id) };
47	    },
48	    async set(id, payload) {
49	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`set:${config.readPath}`);
50	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
51	    },
52	    async update(id, payload) {
53	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`update:${config.readPath}`);
54	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
55	    },
56	    async delete(id) {
57	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`delete:${config.readPath}`);
58	      await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id));
59	    },
60	  };
61	}

68	 * Universal Currency Converter (Client side helper)
69	 */
70	function convertCurrency(
71	  amount: number,
72	  from: string,
73	  to: string,
74	  rates: Record<string, number>
75	): number {
76	  if (!from || !to || from === to) return amount;
77	
78	  // Convert to YER base
79	  let baseAmountYER = amount;
80	  if (from === 'YER') {
81	    baseAmountYER = amount;
82	  } else {
83	    const fromRate = rates[from] || 1;
84	    baseAmountYER = amount * fromRate;
85	  }
86	
87	  // Convert YER to target
88	  if (to === 'YER') return baseAmountYER;
89	  const toRate = rates[to] || 1;
90	  return baseAmountYER / (toRate || 1);
91	}

93	/**
94	 * Determines the normal balance side for an account type.
95	 * Returns +1 if Debit increases balance (Asset/Expense)
96	 * Returns -1 if Credit increases balance (Liability/Equity/Revenue)
97	 */
98	export function getAccountNormalSide(type: AccountType): 1 | -1 {
99	  if (type === 'Asset' || type === 'Expense') return 1;
100	  return -1;
101	}
102	
103	/**
104	 * Compute balance from debit and credit totals using the proper accounting formula.
105	 * @param debitTotal  - Total of all Debit entries (amount)
106	 * @param creditTotal - Total of all Credit entries (amount)
107	 * @param type        - Account type (Asset | Liability | Equity | Revenue | Expense)
108	 */
109	export function computeAccountBalance(
110	  debitTotal: number,
111	  creditTotal: number,
112	  type: AccountType,
113	): number {
114	  const normalSide = getAccountNormalSide(type);
115	  return normalSide === 1
116	    ? debitTotal - creditTotal
117	    : creditTotal - debitTotal;
118	}
