## Findings

### A. Single customer / courier by id over HTTP

**Customer — server route exists, frontend single-read only via the orders gateway.**

| Layer | Path | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Backend | `GET /api/v1/customers/:customerId` | `F:\system\swiftship-tracker\swiftshift2\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.routes.ts:115-126` |
| Backend repo | `findById` → `SELECT ${columns} FROM alx_api_private.customers_read WHERE customer_id = $1` | `alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.repository.ts:111-117` |
| Frontend (API-only, ready to use) | `ordersApiDataGateway.collections.customers.get(id)` → `GET /api/v1/customers/{id}` | `src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:66` + generic `get()` at `:39-42` |
| Frontend (list only, **no getById**) | `customersApiDataGateway.getCustomers()` → `GET /api/v1/customers?limit=1000&offset=0` | `src\features\customers\services\customersApiDataGateway.ts:33-39` |

No frontend service today calls `GET /api/v1/customers/:id`; that path is only used with PATCH/DELETE (`customersApiDataGateway.ts:47,52`). The shared client to call it directly is `appApiClient` (`src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23`), whose `get(path, query)` builds search params and reads the token from sessionStorage (`src\data\http\api-client.ts:32-36`).

**Courier — there is NO GET-by-id route at all.**

- `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.routes.ts` registers only `POST /api/v1/operations/couriers` (:477), `PATCH /api/v1/operations/couriers/:id` (:488), `DELETE` (:519). No `app.get` for couriers anywhere in `modules/operations`.
- The only courier HTTP read is the reporting resource: `alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.routes.ts:12` (`couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' }`) generating `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers` (:28-45).
- Its query schema is `pageQuerySchema` (`alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.schemas.ts:4-14`: `limit` 1–1000 default 25, `offset`, `search`, `customerId`), **but** `createReportingRepository.list` applies only `search` — `customerId` is accepted by zod then silently dropped (`alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.repository.ts:90-99`). `search` ILIKE-matches `full_name/name_ar/name_en` (:18), never the id.
- Consequence: a single courier by id must come from a paged list + client-side match. Reusable helper: `staffApiDataGateway` internal `readRows('/api/v1/reporting/couriers')` with 1000/20000 pagination and `normalizeCourier` (`src\features\staff\services\staffApiDataGateway.ts:70-80`, `:87-97`, used at `:158`).
- **Trap**: `ordersApiDataGateway.collections.couriers` is configured `readPath: '/api/v1/reporting/couriers'` with `writePath: '/api/v1/operations/couriers'` (`ordersApiDataGateway.ts:68`), so its `get(id)` produces `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers/{id}` → route does not exist (404). Do not use it for single reads.

### B. Orders API-only + finance pagination helper

- Frontend function for read #2 (customer case): `ordersApiDataGateway.commands.findOrdersByCustomerId(customerId)` → `GET /api/v1/orders?limit=1000&offset=0&customerId=…` (`src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:170-177`); declared in `src\features\orders\api.ts:75`.
- Backend: `app.get('/api/v1/orders', ...route('view_orders', auth), list(repository.listOrders))` — `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.routes.ts:90`.
- Query zod: `pageQuerySchema` — `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.schemas.ts:4-14`. Supported filters = `limit`, `offset`, `search`, `customerId`. The `list()` wrapper forwards exactly `{limit, offset, search, customerId}` (`operations.routes.ts:54-73`).
- Implemented SQL filters (`operations.repository.ts:56-66`): `search` over `order_number/external_order_number/tracking_number` (:151) and **`customer_id = $n` only (:62-65)**. **There is no `deliveryCourierId` / `courierId` order filter** — courier order scoping does not exist server-side. `deliveryCourierId` appears only in the write schema (`operations.schemas.ts:67`) and as a returned alias.
- **Amount gap for the customer ledger**: `listOrders` column list (`operations.repository.ts:148`) returns `orderId, orderNumber, trackingNumber, customerId, orderStatusId, orderStatus, orderPartyId, orderPartyType, deliveryCourierId, shippingCourierId, currency, orderCurrency, orderCurrencyPrice, externalOrderNumber, createdAt, updatedAt` — **no `data` jsonb**. `amountPaid` / `amountRemaining` live inside `orders.data` (proved by the portal reading `(o.data->>'amountRemaining')::numeric` — `alx_api\src\modules\portal\portal-owned.repository.ts:625,688`; allowed write keys listed at `:93`). Only `getOrder` (single, `operations.repository.ts:155`) returns `data`. So the modal's `order.amountPaid + order.amountRemaining` charge line has no API source from the list endpoint.
- Finance helper to reuse for read #3: `readAllFinanceRows(path, query, pageSize=1000, maxRows=20000)` in `src\services\financeApi.ts:52-65`, plus `readFinancePage` (:39-42), `readFinanceRows` (:44-46), `readFinanceRecord` (returns `null` on `ENTITY_NOT_FOUND`, :68-76). `FinanceQuery` already declares `entityId` (`src\services\financeApi.ts:21`).

Repo `listAllAccountMovements` (`finance.repository.ts:187-200`) inner-joins `main_entry` and hard-filters `me.posting_status = 'posted'`, ordering by `created_at DESC`. **The posted filter is server-side, so legacy read #4 (`main_entry` snapshot / `mainEntriesMap`) and the `ps !== 'posted'` checks at `GlobalEntityLedgerModal.tsx:103-111, 175-184, 212-221` become dead weight after conversion.**

export function registerOperationsRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: OperationsRepository,
): void {
  const list =
    (
      load: (query: {
        limit: number;
        offset: number;
        search?: string | undefined;
        customerId?: string | undefined;
      }) => Promise<{ items: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]; total: number }>,
    ) =>
    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
      if (!query.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await load(query.data);
        return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    };
  const single =
    (load: (key: string) => Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null>) =>
    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
      if (!parsed.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await load(parsed.data);
        return result
          ? sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response))
          : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'السجل غير موجود.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    };

  app.get('/api/v1/orders', ...route('view_orders', auth), list(repository.listOrders));
  app.get('/api/v1/orders/:id', ...route('view_orders', auth), single(repository.getOrder));
  app.get('/api/v1/orders/:id/history', ...route('view_orders', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
    if (!parsed.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));

async function page(
  pool: Pool,
  table: string,
  columns: string,
  order: string,
  input: PageQuery,
  searchColumns: string[],
): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  const values: unknown[] = [];
  const filters: string[] = [];
  if (input.search) {
    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
  }
  if (input.customerId) {
    values.push(input.customerId);
    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
  }
  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
    values,
  );
  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
}

SELECT

}

function isEmployeeRecord(value: unknown): value is EmployeeRecord {
  return isEntityRecord(value);
}

function isCourierRecord(value: unknown): value is CourierRecord {
  return isEntityRecord(value);
}

function isOrderRecord(value: unknown): value is OrderRecord {
  return isEntityRecord(value);
}

function parseOrderRecord(value: unknown): OrderRecord | null {
  if (!isEntityRecord(value)) return null;
  const orderStatusId = value.orderStatusId;
  const amountRemaining = value.amountRemaining;
  const createdAt = value.createdAt;
  return {
    ...value,
    id: value.id,
    orderStatus: readText(value.orderStatus) ?? undefined,
    status: readText(value.status) ?? undefined,
    orderNumber: readText(value.orderNumber) ?? undefined,
    customerId: readText(value.customerId) ?? undefined,
    orderStatusId:
      typeof orderStatusId === 'string' || typeof orderStatusId === 'number'
        ? orderStatusId
        : undefined,
    orderSourceName: readText(value.orderSourceName) ?? undefined,
    orderSourceType: readText(value.orderSourceType) ?? undefined,
    customerName: readText(value.customerName) ?? undefined,
    customerPhone: readText(value.customerPhone) ?? undefined,
    amountPaid:
      typeof value.amountPaid === 'string' || typeof value.amountPaid === 'number'
        ? value.amountPaid
        : undefined,
    amountRemaining:
      typeof amountRemaining === 'string'
        ? amountRemaining
        : typeof amountRemaining === 'number'
          ? String(amountRemaining)
          : amountRemaining === null
            ? null
            : undefined,
    currency: readText(value.currency) ?? undefined,
    exchangeRateUSD:
      typeof value.exchangeRateUSD === 'number' ? value.exchangeRateUSD : undefined,
    exchangeRateSAR:
      typeof value.exchangeRateSAR === 'number' ? value.exchangeRateSAR : undefined,
    createdAt:
      typeof createdAt === 'string' || typeof createdAt === 'number' ? createdAt : undefined,
  };
}

299	        } else {

301	          title = isAr ? 'تسليم عهدة مالية للمندوب' : 'Custody Handed Over';
302	        }
303	      } else if (tx.module === 'order') {
304	        if (tx.type === 'Debit') {
305	          title = isAr ? 'تحصيل قيمة شحنة (كاش بعهدة المندوب)' : 'Collected COD Cargo Cash';
306	        } else {
307	          title = isAr ? 'أجور توصيل وعمولة المندوب للطلب' : 'Earned Courier Delivery Commission';
308	        }
309	      } else if (tx.module === 'expense') {
310	        type = 'Credit';
311	        title = isAr ? 'مصروف تشغيلي / أجور مسددة' : 'Operating Expense / Disbursed';
312	      } else if (tx.module === 'wage' || tx.module === 'salary_payment') {
313	        type = 'Credit';
314	        title = isAr ? 'صرف راتب أو مستحقات الموظف' : 'Salary / Wages Paid';
315	      } else {
316	        title = tx.description || (isAr ? 'قيد تسوية لمطابقة رصيد المندوب' : 'Corporate Ledger Adjustment');
317	      }
318	
319	      let amountInFCurrency = amtBase;
320	      if (fCurrency === 'SAR') {

322	          amountInFCurrency = amtOriginal;
323	        } else {
324	          amountInFCurrency = amtBase / exchangeRateSAR;
325	        }
326	      }
327	
328	      ledger.push({

331	        type,
332	        amount: amtBase,
333	        amountFCurrency: amountInFCurrency,
334	        amountOriginal: amtOriginal,
335	        currencyOriginal: tx.currencyOriginal || 'YER',

339	        ref: tx.refNumber || tx.accountCode || 'GL-TX'
340	      });
341	    });
342	
343	    // Sort oldest to newest
344	    const sorted = [...ledger].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date).getTime() - new Date(b.date).getTime());
345	
346	    // Calculate running balance: Debits (+) increase outstanding custody, Credits (-) reduce outstanding custody.
347	    let runningAccountBal = 0;
348	    const finalLedger = sorted.map(item => {
349	      if (item.type === 'Debit') {
350	        runningAccountBal += item.amountFCurrency;
351	      } else {
352	        runningAccountBal -= item.amountFCurrency;
353	      }
354	
355	      return {
356	        ...item,
357	        runningAccountBal
358	      };
359	    });

const MAX_ROWS = 20_000;

const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:3001",
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === "undefined"
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem("alx_access_token") || sessionStorage.getItem("alx_api_access_token")),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

async function readRows(path: string): Promise<Row[]> {
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < MAX_ROWS; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<Row[]>>(path, { limit: PAGE_SIZE, offset });
    const page = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [];
    rows.push(...page);
    const total = Number(response.meta?.total ?? rows.length);
    if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE || rows.length >= total) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

const normalize = (row: Row, key: string): Row => ({
  ...row,
  id: String(row[key] ?? row.id),
});

const normalizeCourier = (row: Row): Row => ({
  ...normalize(row, "courierId"),
  phone: String(row.phone ?? ""),
  email: String(row.email ?? ""),
  address: String(row.address ?? ""),
  gpsLocation: String(row.gpsLocation ?? ""),
  notes: String(row.notes ?? ""),
  courierType: row.courierType ?? row.type ?? "local",
  courierLevel: row.courierLevel ?? row.level ?? "",
  disabled: row.isActive === false,
});

const normalizeEmployee = (row: Row): Row => ({
  ...normalize(row, "employeeId"),
  phone: String(row.phone ?? ""),
  email: String(row.email ?? ""),
  address: String(row.address ?? ""),
  gpsLocation: String(row.gpsLocation ?? row.gps_location ?? ""),
  notes: String(row.notes ?? ""),
  jobsType: String(row.jobType ?? row.jobsType ?? "إداري"),
  jobType: String(row.jobType ?? row.jobsType ?? "إداري"),
  disabled: Boolean(row.disabled),
});

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { ReportingRepository, ReportingResource } from './reporting.contracts';
import { pageQuerySchema } from '../operations/operations.schemas';

const resources: Record<string, { resource: ReportingResource; permission: string }> = {
  expenses: { resource: 'expenses', permission: 'view_expenses' },
  couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' },
  employees: { resource: 'employees', permission: 'view_employees' },
  sources: { resource: 'sources', permission: 'view_sources' },
  'shipping-companies': { resource: 'shippingCompanies', permission: 'view_shipping_companies' },
  users: { resource: 'users', permission: 'view_users' },
  'activity-logs': { resource: 'activityLogs', permission: 'view_dashboard' },
  'report-templates': { resource: 'reportTemplates', permission: 'view_reports' },
};

export function registerReportingRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: ReportingRepository,
): void {
  for (const [path, definition] of Object.entries(resources)) {
    app.get(
      `/api/v1/reporting/${path}`,
      requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),
      requirePermission(auth, definition.permission),
      async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
        const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId);
        const parsed = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
        if (!parsed.success)
          return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_REPORTING_QUERY', 'معاملات التقرير غير صالحة.', requestId);
        try {
          const result = await repository.list(definition.resource, parsed.data);
          return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId, { ...parsed.data, total: result.total });
        } catch (error) {
          return next(error);
        }
      },
    );
  }
}

buildCourierLines(movements: any[]): LedgerLine[] {\n  return movements.map((movement) => {\n    if (movement.category === 'custody') {\n      return isSettlementDescription(movement.description)\n        ? movementLine(movement, 'custody_settlement', 'Credit', 'custody')\n        : movementLine(movement, 'custody_handover', 'Debit', 'custody');\n    }\n    if (movement.category === 'order') {\n 25	  const [entityId, setEntityId] = useState<string | null>(null);
26	  const [entityType, setEntityType] = useState<'customer' | 'courier' | null>(null);
27	  
28	  const [entityData, setEntityData] = useState<any>(null);
29	  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<any[]>([]);
30	  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState<any[]>([]);
31	  // خريطة رؤوس القيود: entryId → بيانات القيد
32	  // Main entry headers map: entryId → entry data
33	  const [mainEntriesMap, setMainEntriesMap] = useState<Map<string, any>>(new Map());
34	  
35	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
36	  const [finSearch, setFinSearch] = useState('');
37	  const [finModuleFilter, setFinModuleFilter] = useState<'all' | 'order' | 'expense' | 'payment' | 'transaction'>('all');
38	
39	  // Register Event Listener for Global Opening
40	  useEffect(() => {
41	    const handleOpen = (e: any) => {
42	      const { entityId: id, entityType: type } = e.detail || {};
43	      if (id && type) {
44	        setEntityId(id);
45	        setEntityType(type);
46	        setFinSearch('');
47	        setFinModuleFilter('all');
48	        setIsOpen(true);
49	      }
50	    };
51	
52	    window.addEventListener('open-entity-ledger', handleOpen);
53	    return () => window.removeEventListener('open-entity-ledger', handleOpen);
54	  }, []);
55	
56	  // Sync Entity Profile & Core Financials
57	  useEffect(() => {
58	    if (!isOpen || !entityId || !entityType) {
59	      setEntityData(null);
60	      setOrders([]);
61	      setTransactions([]);
62	      return;
63	    }
64	
65	    setLoading(true);
66	
67	    // 1. Fetch Entity Details
68	    const collName = entityType === 'customer' ? 'customers' : 'couriers';
69	    const unsubEntity = onSnapshot(doc(db, collName, entityId), (docSnap) => {
70	      if (docSnap.exists()) {
71	        setEntityData({ id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() });
72	      }
73	    }, (err) => console.error("Error fetching entity info:", err));
74	
75	    // 2. Fetch Orders Realtime
76	    let qOrders;
77	    if (entityType === 'customer') {
78	      qOrders = query(collection(db, 'orders'), where('customerId', '==', entityId));
79	    } else {
80	      // Use direct DB column delivery_courier_id (FK) with fallback to camelCase field
81	      qOrders = query(collection(db, 'orders'), where('deliveryCourierId', '==', entityId));
82	    }
83	
84	    const unsubOrders = onSnapshot(qOrders, (snap) => {
85	      setOrders(snap.docs.map((d: AdapterDocument) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })));
86	    }, (err) => console.error("Error fetching orders:", err));
87	
88	    // 3. Fetch Ledger Account Transactions from account_trans
89	    const qTx = query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), where('entity_id', '==', entityId));
90	    const unsubTx = onSnapshot(qTx, (snap) => {
91	      setTransactions(snap.docs.map((d: AdapterDocument) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })));
92	      setLoading(false);
93	    }, (err) => {
94	      console.error("Error fetching transactions:", err);
95	      setLoading(false);
96	    });
97	
98	    // 4. الاستماع لجدول main_entry لبناء خريطة حالة الترحيل
99	    //    Subscribe to main_entry to build posting-status map for this entity
100	    const unsubMainEntries = onSnapshot(collection(db, 'main_entry'), (snap) => {
101	      const map = new Map<string, any>();
102	      snap.docs.forEach((d: AdapterDocument) => {
103	        map.set(d.id, d.data());
104	      });
105	      setMainEntriesMap(map);
106	    }, (err) => {
107	      console.warn("Error fetching main_entry for ledger modal:", err);
108	    });
109	
110	    return () => {
111	      unsubEntity();
112	      unsubOrders();
113	      unsubTx();
114	      unsubMainEntries();
115	    };
116	  }, [isOpen, entityId, entityType]);
117	
118	  if (!isOpen || !entityType || !entityId) return null;
119	
120	  // Compute Chronological Ledger Items
121	  const getUnifiedLedger = () => {
122	    const ledger: any[] = [];
123	
124	    if (entityType === 'customer') {
125	      // ----------------- CUSTOMER LEDGER GENERATOR -----------------
126	      orders.forEach(order => {
127	        const amtPaid = parseFloat(order.amountPaid || order.paidAmount || 0);
128	        const amtRemain = parseFloat(order.amountRemaining || 0);
129	        const totalCost = amtPaid + amtRemain;
130	
131	        // Total Cost (Debit - customer owes this amount)
132	        if (totalCost > 0) {
133	          ledger.push({
134	            id: `order-charge-${order.id}`,
135	            date: order.createdAt || Date.now(),
136	            type: 'Debit',
137	            amount: totalCost,
138	            module: 'order',
139	            title: isAr ? 'قيمة مبيعات / رسوم شحن' : 'Sales COD Charge',
140	            description: isAr 
141	              ? `قيمة الشحنة الموكلة رقم: ${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'}` 
142	              : `Gross COD for shipment #${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'}`,
143	            ref: order.orderNumber || order.id
144	          });
145	        }
146	
147	        // COD Paid (Credit - customer paid this amount)
148	        const orderPaymentTxs = transactions.filter(tx => tx.module === 'payment' && (tx.refNumber === order.orderNumber || tx.refNumber === order.id));
149	        const sumOfRecordedTxs = orderPaymentTxs.reduce((sum, tx) => sum + (parseFloat(tx.amountOriginal || tx.amount || 0)), 0);
150	        
151	        const unrecordedPayment = amtPaid - sumOfRecordedTxs;
152	
153	        if (unrecordedPayment > 0.01) {
154	          ledger.push({
155	            id: `order-pay-${order.id}`,
156	            date: (order.updatedAt || order.createdAt || Date.now()) + 1,
157	            type: 'Credit',
158	            amount: unrecordedPayment,
159	            module: 'payment',
160	            title: isAr ? 'مقبوضات شحن مبدئية / غير مقيدة' : 'Initial COD Payment',
161	            description: isAr 
162	              ? `كاش سدد مسبقاً للشحنة رقم: ${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'} ولم يُقيد بسند منفصل` 
163	              : `Legacy cash paid for shipment #${order.orderNumber || 'ALX-CR'}`,
164	            ref: order.orderNumber || order.id
165	          });
166	        }
167	      });
168	
169	      // System manual/accounting transactions for customers
170	      transactions.forEach(tx => {
171	        const entryId = tx.entryId || tx.entry_id;
172	        if (entryId) {
173	          const mainEntry = mainEntriesMap.get(entryId);
174	          // استبعاد الحركات التي قيدها غير موجود في main_entry
175	          // Exclude if entry not found
176	          if (!mainEntry) return;
177	          // استبعاد القيود غير المرحّلة (posting_status !== 'posted')
178	          // Exclude non-posted entries
179	          const ps = mainEntry.postingStatus || mainEntry.posting_status || '';
180	          if (ps !== 'posted') return;
181	        }
182	
183	        // Prevent duplication: our order generator always adds the 'order charge' debit line
184	        if (tx.module === 'order') return;
185	
186	        const currentType = tx.transType || tx.trans_type || tx.type || 'Debit';
187	        const refNo = tx.entryNumber || tx.entry_number || tx.refNumber || tx.accountCode || '';
188	
189	        ledger.push({
190	          id: tx.id || `tx-${Math.random()}`,
191	          date: tx.createdAt || Date.now(),
192	          type: currentType, // 'Debit' | 'Credit'
193	          amount: tx.amount || 0,
194	          amountOriginal: tx.amountOriginal || tx.amount_original || tx.amount || 0,
195	          currencyOriginal: tx.currencyOriginal || tx.currency || 'YER',
196	          module: 'transaction',
197	          title: tx.description ? tx.description : (isAr ? (currentType === 'Credit' ? 'إيداع نقدي للحساب' : 'سحب / تسوية من الحساب') : (currentType === 'Credit' ? 'Account Deposit' : 'Account Withdrawal')),
198	          description: isAr 
199	            ? `حركة حساب مركزية رقم القيد: ${refNo || 'Ledger-Tx'}`
200	            : `System main entry ref: ${refNo || 'Ledger-Tx'}`,
201	          ref: refNo
202	        });
203	      });
204	
205	    } else {
206	      // ----------------- COURIER LEDGER GENERATOR -----------------
207	      transactions.forEach(tx => {
208	        const entryId = tx.entryId || tx.entry_id;
209	        if (entryId) {
210	          const mainEntry = mainEntriesMap.get(entryId);
211	          // استبعاد الحركات التي قيدها غير موجود في main_entry
212	          // Exclude if entry not found
213	          if (!mainEntry) return;
214	          // استبعاد القيود غير المرحّلة
215	          // Exclude non-posted entries
216	          const ps = mainEntry.postingStatus || mainEntry.posting_status || '';
217	          if (ps !== 'posted') return;
218	        }
219	        const amtBase = parseFloat(tx.amount || 0);
220	        const amtOriginal = parseFloat(tx.amountOriginal || tx.amount_original || tx.amount || 0);
221	        const refNo = tx.entryNumber || tx.entry_number || tx.refNumber || tx.accountCode || 'GL-TX';
222	
223	        // We normalize types to ensure perfect bookkeeping and auto-heal any legacy data quirks.
224	        let type = tx.transType || tx.trans_type || tx.type || 'Debit';
225	        let title = '';
226	        let category = tx.module || tx.moduleId || 'transaction';
227	
228	        if (category === 'custody') {
229	          const isSettlement = (tx.description || '').includes('تسوية') || 
230	                               (tx.description || '').includes('سداد') || 
231	                               (tx.description || '').toLowerCase().includes('settle');
232	          if (isSettlement) {
233	            type = 'Credit';
234	            title = isAr ? 'تسوية وسداد عهدة مالية' : 'Custody Settlement / Return';
235	          } else {
236	            type = 'Debit';
237	            title = isAr ? 'تسليم عهدة مالية للمندوب' : 'Custody Handed Over';
238	          }
239	        } else if (category === 'order') {
240	          if (type === 'Debit') {
241	            title = isAr ? 'تحصيل قيمة شحنة (كاش بعهدة المندوب)' : 'Collected COD Cargo Cash';
242	          } else {
243	            title = isAr ? 'أجور توصيل وعمولة المندوب للطلب' : 'Earned Courier Delivery Commission';
244	          }
245	        } else if (category === 'expense') {
246	          type = 'Credit';
247	          title = isAr ? 'مصروف تشغيلي / أجور مسددة' : 'Operating Expense / Disbursed';
248	        } else if (category === 'wage' || category === 'salary_payment') {
249	          type = 'Credit';
250	          title = isAr ? 'صرف راتب أو مستحقات الموظف' : 'Salary / Wages Paid';
251	        } else {
252	          title = tx.description || (isAr ? 'قيد تسوية لمطابقة رصيد المندوب' : 'Corporate Ledger Adjustment');
253	        }
254	
255	        ledger.push({
256	          id: tx.id || `tx-${Math.random()}`,
257	          date: tx.createdAt || Date.now(),
258	          type,
259	          amount: amtBase,
260	          amountOriginal: amtOriginal,
261	          currencyOriginal: tx.currencyOriginal || tx.currency || 'YER',
262	          module: category,
263	          title,
264	          description: tx.description || (isAr ? `قيد مالي رقم: ${refNo}` : `Entry reference: ${refNo}`),
265	          ref: refNo
266	        });
267	      });
268	    }
269	
270	    // Sort oldest to newest to compute running totals correctly
271	    const sorted = [...ledger].sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date);
272	
273	    // Compute running balance: Debits (+) increase the outstanding balance, Credits (-) decrease it.
274	    let runningAccountBal = 0;
275	    const finalLedger = sorted.map(item => {
276	      if (item.type === 'Debit') {
277	        runningAccountBal += item.amount;
278	      } else {
279	        runningAccountBal -= item.amount;
280	      }
281	
282	      return {
283	        ...item,
284	        runningAccountBal
285	      };
286	    });
287	
288	    // Return newest first for chronological table layout
289	    return finalLedger.reverse();
290	  };
291	
292	  const ledgerData = getUnifiedLedger();
293	
294	  // Metrics calculation
295	  const getTotals = () => {
296	    let debits = 0;
297	    let credits = 0;
298	    ledgerData.forEach(item => {
299	      if (item.type === 'Debit') debits += item.amount;
300	      else credits += item.amount;
301	    });
302	    return { debits, credits };
303	  };
304	
305	  const { debits, credits } = getTotals();
306	
307	  return (
308	    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 animate-fade-in font-sans">
309	      <div className="bg-[#0b0b0d] border border-[#d4af37]/25 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-w-4xl w-full h-[88vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col relative">
310	        
311	        {/* Modal Header */}
312	        <div className="bg-black/40 p-5 border-b border-slate-850/80 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
313	          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
314	            <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#121215] to-[#070708] border border-[#d4af37]/20 text-[#d4af37] flex items-center justify-center font-black text-base shadow-inner">
315	              {entityData?.fullName ? entityData.fullName.substring(0, 2) : '?'}
316	            </div>
317	            <div className="text-start">
318	              <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 leading-none">
319	                {entityData?.fullName || (isAr ? 'حساب مالي معلق' : 'Loading Entity...')}
320	                <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37] animate-pulse" />
321	              </h2>
322	              <p className="text-[10px] text-[#d4af37] font-bold font-mono mt-0.5" dir="ltr">
323	                {entityType === 'customer' 
324	                  ? (isAr ? `كشف حساب عميل • ${entityData?.phone || ''}` : `Customer Statement • ${entityData?.phone || ''}`)
325	                  : (isAr ? `كشف حساب مندوب • ${entityData?.phone || ''}` : `Courier Statement • ${entityData?.phone || ''}`)
326	                }
327	              </p>
328	            </div>
329	          </div>
330	          <button 
331	            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} 
332	            className="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-850 p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-500 hover:text-white border border-slate-800 transition duration-200"
333	          >
334	            <X className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
335	          </button>
336	        </div>
337	
338	        {/* Modal Body Container */}
339	        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6" id="global-ledger-content">
340	          
341	          {/* Quick Metrics Card Grid */}
342	          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
343	            
344	            {/* Current Account Balance Metrics */}
345	            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#02130a] to-[#041a10] border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between text-start shadow">
346	              <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-emerald-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
347	                <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
348	                {isAr ? 'رصيد الحساب الموحد' : 'Consolidated Account Balance'}
349	              </span>
350	              <div className="font-mono font-black text-emerald-400 text-base">
351	                {(entityData?.financialBalance || entityData?.walletBalance || 0).toLocaleString()} {settings.currency || 'YER'}
352	              </div>
353	              <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-500 font-sans mt-1">
354	                {isAr ? 'مزامنة تحديثات حية للنظام' : 'Live synced database balance'}
355	              </span>
356	            </div>
357	
358	            {/* Total debits / allocations */}
359	            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#121215] to-[#070708] border border-slate-850 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between text-start shadow">
360	              <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-rose-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
361	                <ArrowDownRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
362	                {isAr ? 'كل الحركات المدنية (-)' : 'Total Debits / Obligations'}
363	              </span>
364	              <div className="font-mono font-black text-rose-400 text-base">
365	                {debits.toLocaleString()} {settings.currency || 'YER'}
366	              </div>
367	              <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-500 font-sans mt-1">
368	                {entityType === 'customer'
369	                  ? (isAr ? 'يشمل مبيعات ورسوم شحن معلقة' : 'Includes shipments Cod billed')
370	                  : (isAr ? 'يشمل عهد مستلمة وتحصيلات ميدانية' : 'Includes custody received and collected COD')
371	                }
372	              </span>
373	            </div>
374	
375	            {/* Total credits / payments */}
376	            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#121215] to-[#070708] border border-slate-850 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between text-start shadow">
377	              <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-emerald-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
378	                <ArrowUpLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
379	                {isAr ? 'كل التوريدات الدائنية (+)' : 'Total Credits / Inflows'}
380	              </span>
381	              <div className="font-mono font-black text-emerald-400 text-base">
382	                {credits.toLocaleString()} {settings.currency || 'YER'}
383	              </div>
384	              <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-500 font-sans mt-1">
385	                {entityType === 'customer'
386	                  ? (isAr ? 'خصومات ومدفوعات كاش موردة' : 'Payments, adjustments & deposits')
387	                  : (isAr ? 'تصفية عهد وأجور توصيل مكتسبة' : 'Wages earned and physical handovers')
388	                }
389	              </span>
390	            </div>
391	
392	          </div>
393	
394	          {/* Table Filters Panel */}
395	          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 p-4 bg-black/45 border border-slate-850/60 rounded-2xl">
396	            <div className="relative flex-1">
397	              <Search className="absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 w-4 h-4" />
398	              <input 
399	                type="text"
400	                placeholder={isAr ? 'البحث عن حركة برقم السند أو المرجع أو البيان...' : 'Filter ledger details...'}
401	                value={finSearch}
402	                onChange={e => setFinSearch(e.target.value)}
403	                className="w-full bg-black/50 border border-slate-855 rounded-xl py-2 px-9 text-xs font-bold text-white focus:border-[#d4af37]/50 outline-none text-start"
404	              />
405	            </div>
406	            
407	            <select 
408	              value={finModuleFilter} 
409	              onChange={e => setFinModuleFilter(e.target.value as any)} 
410	              className="bg-[#0e0e11] border border-slate-820 rounded-xl py-2 px-3 text-xs font-black text-slate-300 outline-none focus:border-[#d4af37]/50 cursor-pointer text-start"
411	            >
412	              <option value="all">{isAr ? 'جميع المسببات التشغيلية' : 'All Activities'}</option>
413	              <option value="order">{isAr ? 'الطرود والشحنات' : 'Shipment COD Charges'}</option>
414	              {entityType === 'courier' && <option value="expense">{isAr ? 'العهد والمسحوبات والمصاريف' : 'Custody & Expenses'}</option>}
415	              {entityType === 'customer' && <option value="payment">{isAr ? 'مدفوعات التسوية' : 'Cash Payments'}</option>}
416	              <option value="transaction">{isAr ? 'القيود اليدوية والتسويات' : 'Settlement Entries'}</option>
417	            </select>
418	          </div>
419	
420	          {/* Main Statement Table */}
421	          <div className="bg-[#121215] border border-slate-850 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
422	            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-850 bg-black/40 flex justify-between items-center text-start">
423	              <h4 className="font-black text-xs text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
424	                <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
425	                {isAr ? 'تفاصيل كشف الحركة المالي التراكمي' : 'CHRONOLOGICAL FINANCIAL AUDIT STATEMENT'}
426	              </h4>
427	              <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-950/25 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-900/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold font-mono">
428	                {isAr ? 'مكتمل لجميع الفترات' : 'ALL PERIODS'}
429	              </span>
430	            </div>
431	
432	            {loading ? (
433	              <div className="p-16 text-center text-slate-500 font-bold font-mono uppercase tracking-wider animate-pulse">
434	                [ {isAr ? 'جاري تجميع حركات الموديولات المترابطة بالتاريخ...' : 'generating_live_tracelines...'} ]
435	              </div>
436	            ) : (
437	              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
438	                <table className="w-full text-right text-xs">
439	                  <thead className="bg-black/30 text-[9px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest font-black border-b border-slate-850">
440	                    <tr>
441	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? 'تاريخ الحركة' : 'Posting Date'}</th>
442	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? 'التصنيف' : 'Classification'}</th>
443	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? 'البيان وشرح الحركة' : 'Description / Narrative'}</th>
444	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? 'رقم المرجع' : 'Reference Ref'}</th>
445	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? 'النوع' : 'Entry Type'}</th>
446	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? 'المبلغ (العملة الأصلية)' : 'Amount (Original Currency)'}</th>
447	                      <th className="p-3 text-start">{isAr ? `المبلغ (${settings.currency || 'YER'})` : `Amount (${settings.currency || 'YER'})`}</th>
448	                      <th className="p-3 text-left">{isAr ? 'الرصيد التراكمي' : 'Running Balance'}</th>
449	                    </tr>
450	                  </thead>
451	                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850 bg-[#08080a]/20">
452	                    {ledgerData
453	                      .filter(item => {
454	                        const q = finSearch.toLowerCase();
455	                        const matchesSearch = !q || 
456	                          (item.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || 
457	                          (item.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || 
458	                          (item.ref || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
459	                        const matchesModule = finModuleFilter === 'all' || item.module === finModuleFilter;
460	                        return matchesSearch && matchesModule;
461	                      })
462	                      .map((item, idx) => {
463	                        const isCredit = item.type === 'Credit';

232	function withRunningBalance(lines: LedgerLine[]): LedgerLine[] {
233	  let balance = 0;

247	      else totals.credits += line.amount;
248	      return totals;
249	    },
250	    { debits: 0, credits: 0 },

257	    const id = String(entityId || '').trim();
258	    if (!id) throw new Error('Entity id is required to build an entity ledger.');

261	      loadParty(entityType, id),

265	    const lines =
266	      entityType === 'customer'
267	        ? buildCustomerLines(await loadCustomerOrders(id), movements)
268	        : buildCourierLines(movements);
269	    const ordered = withRunningBalance(lines);

12	function collectSourceFiles(directory: string): string[] {
13	  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
14	    const path = resolve(directory, entry.name);
15	    if (entry.isDirectory()) return collectSourceFiles(path);
16	    return /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name) && !/\.test\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(entry.name) ? [path] : [];

    14	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);

    16	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' }).range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    17	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    18	    const items = (data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapEntry));
    19	    return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
    20	  }
    21

    23	    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('main_entry_id', id).maybeSingle();

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { API_MODES, assertProductionApiMode, getApiMode, parseApiMode } from './api-mode';
import { API_CONTRACT_MATRIX, getApiDomainContract } from './api-contract-matrix';

describe('API mode contract', () => {
  it('supports only the explicitly defined migration modes', () => {
    expect(API_MODES).toEqual(['api-only', 'shadow', 'legacy-migration']);
    expect(parseApiMode(' API-ONLY ')).toBe('api-only');
    expect(() => parseApiMode('fallback')).toThrow('Unsupported VITE_API_MODE');
  });

  it('does not allow legacy-migration in production', () => {
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('legacy-migration'))).toThrow(
      'Production cannot run with VITE_API_MODE=legacy-migration',
    );
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('shadow'))).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('api-only'))).not.toThrow();
  });

  it('does not silently permit legacy writes in shadow mode', () => {
    expect(getApiMode('shadow')).toMatchObject({
      mode: 'shadow',
      isApiOnly: false,
      allowsLegacyReads: true,
      allowsLegacyWrites: false,
    });
  });
});

describe('API contract matrix', () => {
  it('covers every registered gateway domain and records current gaps', () => {
    const registeredDomains = [
      'accounting', 'auth', 'browser', 'couriers', 'customers', 'employees',
      'financeEntries', 'notifications', 'orders', 'products', 'reports',
      'roles', 'settings', 'shipments', 'siteManagement', 'sources', 'users',
    ];
    expect(API_CONTRACT_MATRIX.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(getApiDomainContract('settings')?.status).toBe('available');
    expect(getApiDomainContract('currencies')?.status).toBe('available');
    for (const domain of registeredDomains) {
      const contract = getApiDomainContract(domain) ??
        getApiDomainContract(domain === 'financeEntries' ? 'finance' : domain);
      expect(contract, `Missing contract matrix entry for ${domain}`).toBeDefined();
    }
  });
});

import type { OrdersGateway } from '../../contracts/orders.gateway';
import type { GatewayPage, GatewayQuery } from '../../contracts/common.gateway';
import type { OrdersViewModel } from '../../../features/orders/types';
import { supabase } from '../supabase.client';
import { mapRow, mapSupabaseError } from '../supabase.mapper';

function mapOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): OrdersViewModel {
  return { id: String(row.order_id ?? row.id ?? '') };
}

function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
}

export class CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway implements OrdersGateway {
  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<OrdersViewModel>> {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' })
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return page((data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapOrder)), { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
  }

# Research Report

## 1. What the UI actually needs

All rows come via `extractSiteManagementRows` (`src/features/siteManagement/services/siteManagementGateway.ts:4-9`): only `id` + spread of the jsonb `data` column are used — a few columns, not full rows.

- **orders** (`portalOrders`): filtered client-side on `customerUid|portalUid|orderSourceType==='App'` (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:54`); rendered: `orderNumber, trackingNumber, createdAt, customerName, recipientName, customerPhone, deliveryCity, orderSourceName, orderStatus|status, totalPrice|totalAmount` (`components/PortalOrdersTab.tsx:50-58`). No mutations from this page.
- **portal_tickets** (`tickets`): `subject, userName, userEmail, status ('open'), message, replies[].{sender,createdAt,message}, createdAt` (`SupportTicketsTab.tsx:46-63`; sort `useWebsiteManagementData.ts:45`). **Write**: reply does `supabase.from('portal_tickets').update({data: cleanPayload}).eq('portal_ticket_id',…)` (`pages/WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:153`).
- **announcements**: `title, content, priority, targetAudience, isActive|is_active, createdAt` (`AnnouncementsTab.tsx:99-115`). **Writes**: insert `{announcement_id, data}` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:186`), update `data` (`:210`), delete (`:223`).
- **jobs_req**: `fullName, jobPosition, refCode, phone, email, city, address, qualification, experienceYears, idNumber, createdAt, notes, status, updatedAt` (`JobApplicationsTab.tsx:39-77`). **Writes**: update `data` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:245`), delete (`:284`), plus courier creation via `setDoc(doc(db,'couriers',…))` (`:261`).
- **couriers**: loaded (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:35`) but **never destructured/rendered** in `WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:31-40` — dead read path.
- `SiteAnalyticsTab.tsx:90-95` & `WebsiteManagementTabs.tsx:29`: only `status` counts.

## 2. Existing API coverage

- **`GET /api/v1/orders`** — admin JWT + permission `view_orders` (`alx_api/src/modules/operations/operations.routes.ts:90`, route() at `:37-39`). Query: `limit, offset, search, customerId` (`operations.schemas.ts:4-8`; applied in `operations.repository.ts:80-83`; search hits `order_number/external_order_number/tracking_number` `:169`). Columns: `orderListColumns` (`:52-64`) = orderId, orderNumber, trackingNumber, customerId, orderStatusId, orderStatus, orderParty*, courier ids, currency fields, externalOrderNumber, jsonb-extracted `amountPaid/amountRemaining/totalCostYER/paymentStatus`, createdAt, updatedAt. **No** customerName/recipientName/phone/deliveryCity/orderSourceName/totalPrice.
- **Couriers**: no `GET /api/v1/operations/couriers` list exists — only `GET /:id`, POST, PATCH, DELETE (`operations.routes.ts:479-522`). List is at **`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`** (admin JWT, `view_couriers`) (`reporting.routes.ts:12,29-31`), returning all couriers with `courierId, fullName, nameAr/En, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, courierLevel, commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, id` (`reporting.repository.ts:14-21`).
- **portal_tickets**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/tickets` — **portal-session Bearer auth** (`portal-owned.routes.ts:57-68,73`), no permission code, filters `WHERE user_uid = $1` (`portal-owned.repository.ts:217`) → **cannot list all rows**. Aliases: `portal_ticket_id AS id, user_uid AS "userUid", type, subject, message, status, replies, data, created_at AS "createdAt"` (`:214-215`), mapped to `PortalTicketDto` incl. `userName, userRole, adminResponse` (`portal-owned.contracts.ts:55-67`). `portal-admin.routes.ts` has **no** tickets endpoint (users only, `:31-114`).
- **announcements**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/announcements` — **public, no auth, no permission** (`portal.routes.ts:63`), but hard-caps `WHERE is_active = true … LIMIT 20` (`portal.repository.ts:102-106`) → cannot list all incl. inactive. Aliases `announcement_id AS id, title, content, priority, created_at AS "createdAt"`; no targetAudience, no `data`.
- **jobs_req**: only `POST /api/v1/portal/job-applications` (public, rate-limited) (`job-applications.routes.ts:24-27`); repository has `create` only (`job-applications.repository.ts:6`). **No list/get endpoint at all.**

## 3. Schema facts

- **portal_tickets** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1023-1038`): `portal_ticket_id text` (renamed from `id` in `supabase/migrations/202609170001_rename_primary_keys_to_table_id.sql:283`), `user_uid → portal_users`, `message, replies jsonb, status, subject, type, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. `data` jsonb not in the doc but exists — repository selects/inserts it (`portal-owned.repository.ts:215,228`). Index on `(user_uid, created_at DESC)` (`alx_api/src/db/migrations/0015_portal_owned_resource_indexes.sql:3-4`).
- **announcements**: two conflicting definitions. `alx_api/src/db/migrations/0011_portal_announcements.sql:11-36`: `announcement_id uuid PK, title, content, priority CHECK('normal','high','urgent'), is_active bool, expires_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at, created_by, updated_by` — **no data column**. `DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1364-1380`: adds `data jsonb {content, target_audience}`. Legacy UI writes only `{announcement_id, data}`.
- **jobs_req** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1341-1362`; PK renamed `id→jobs_req_id` at `202609170001…sql:184`): `jobs_req_id, address, city, email, experience_years int, full_name, id_number, job_position, notes, phone, qualification, ref_code, status, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. Doc omits `data`, but repository inserts `data jsonb` plus flat columns (`job-applications.repository.ts:25-31`). Note: the doc's `job_req_id` spelling is stale.

## 4. Gap verdict

- **orders** — covered by `GET /api/v1/orders` (`operations.routes.ts:90`), except missing display columns (customerName/phone/deliveryCity/source/totalPrice) that today come from the `data` jsonb spread.
- **couriers** — covered for listing by `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers` (`reporting.routes.ts:27-44`); UI doesn't render them anyway.
- **portal_tickets (admin list-all)** — **MISSING**. Natural home: `alx_api/src/modules/portal/portal-admin.routes.ts` (already the admin-JWT + permission module); pattern to copy: `listTickets` in `portal-owned.repository.ts:212-223` minus the `user_uid` filter, paginated like `page()` in `operations.repository.ts:66-91`. Reply mutation would need an admin PATCH there too.
- **announcements (admin full list + CRUD)** — **MISSING** for admin scope (public endpoint is active-only, LIMIT 20, no mutations). Home: `portal.routes.ts`/`portal-admin.routes.ts`; repository pattern: `getAnnouncements` in `portal.repository.ts:99-124`.
- **jobs_req (admin list + status update/delete)** — **MISSING** entirely. Home: `alx_api/src/modules/job-applications/job-applications.routes.ts` (currently submit-only); list pattern to copy: `reporting.repository.ts` definitions/`list()` (`:14-22`) or `page()` in `operations.repository.ts:66-91`.

# Research Report

## 1. What the UI actually needs

All rows come via `extractSiteManagementRows` (`src/features/siteManagement/services/siteManagementGateway.ts:4-9`): only `id` + spread of the jsonb `data` column are used — a few columns, not full rows.

- **orders** (`portalOrders`): filtered client-side on `customerUid|portalUid|orderSourceType==='App'` (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:54`); rendered: `orderNumber, trackingNumber, createdAt, customerName, recipientName, customerPhone, deliveryCity, orderSourceName, orderStatus|status, totalPrice|totalAmount` (`components/PortalOrdersTab.tsx:50-58`). No mutations from this page.
- **portal_tickets** (`tickets`): `subject, userName, userEmail, status ('open'), message, replies[].{sender,createdAt,message}, createdAt` (`SupportTicketsTab.tsx:46-63`; sort `useWebsiteManagementData.ts:45`). **Write**: reply does `supabase.from('portal_tickets').update({data: cleanPayload}).eq('portal_ticket_id',…)` (`pages/WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:153`).
- **announcements**: `title, content, priority, targetAudience, isActive|is_active, createdAt` (`AnnouncementsTab.tsx:99-115`). **Writes**: insert `{announcement_id, data}` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:186`), update `data` (`:210`), delete (`:223`).
- **jobs_req**: `fullName, jobPosition, refCode, phone, email, city, address, qualification, experienceYears, idNumber, createdAt, notes, status, updatedAt` (`JobApplicationsTab.tsx:39-77`). **Writes**: update `data` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:245`), delete (`:284`), plus courier creation via `setDoc(doc(db,'couriers',…))` (`:261`).
- **couriers**: loaded (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:35`) but **never destructured/rendered** in `WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:31-40` — dead read path.
- `SiteAnalyticsTab.tsx:90-95` & `WebsiteManagementTabs.tsx:29`: only `status` counts.

## 2. Existing API coverage

- **`GET /api/v1/orders`** — admin JWT + permission `view_orders` (`alx_api/src/modules/operations/operations.routes.ts:90`, route() at `:37-39`). Query: `limit, offset, search, customerId` (`operations.schemas.ts:4-8`; applied in `operations.repository.ts:80-83`; search hits `order_number/external_order_number/tracking_number` `:169`). Columns: `orderListColumns` (`:52-64`) = orderId, orderNumber, trackingNumber, customerId, orderStatusId, orderStatus, orderParty*, courier ids, currency fields, externalOrderNumber, jsonb-extracted `amountPaid/amountRemaining/totalCostYER/paymentStatus`, createdAt, updatedAt. **No** customerName/recipientName/phone/deliveryCity/orderSourceName/totalPrice.
- **Couriers**: no `GET /api/v1/operations/couriers` list exists — only `GET /:id`, POST, PATCH, DELETE (`operations.routes.ts:479-522`). List is at **`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`** (admin JWT, `view_couriers`) (`reporting.routes.ts:12,29-31`), returning all couriers with `courierId, fullName, nameAr/En, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, courierLevel, commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, id` (`reporting.repository.ts:14-21`).
- **portal_tickets**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/tickets` — **portal-session Bearer auth** (`portal-owned.routes.ts:57-68,73`), no permission code, filters `WHERE user_uid = $1` (`portal-owned.repository.ts:217`) → **cannot list all rows**. Aliases: `portal_ticket_id AS id, user_uid AS "userUid", type, subject, message, status, replies, data, created_at AS "createdAt"` (`:214-215`), mapped to `PortalTicketDto` incl. `userName, userRole, adminResponse` (`portal-owned.contracts.ts:55-67`). `portal-admin.routes.ts` has **no** tickets endpoint (users only, `:31-114`).
- **announcements**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/announcements` — **public, no auth, no permission** (`portal.routes.ts:63`), but hard-caps `WHERE is_active = true … LIMIT 20` (`portal.repository.ts:102-106`) → cannot list all incl. inactive. Aliases `announcement_id AS id, title, content, priority, created_at AS "createdAt"`; no targetAudience, no `data`.
- **jobs_req**: only `POST /api/v1/portal/job-applications` (public, rate-limited) (`job-applications.routes.ts:24-27`); repository has `create` only (`job-applications.repository.ts:6`). **No list/get endpoint at all.**

## 3. Schema facts

- **portal_tickets** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1023-1038`): `portal_ticket_id text` (renamed from `id` in `supabase/migrations/202609170001_rename_primary_keys_to_table_id.sql:283`), `user_uid → portal_users`, `message, replies jsonb, status, subject, type, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. `data` jsonb not in the doc but exists — repository selects/inserts it (`portal-owned.repository.ts:215,228`). Index on `(user_uid, created_at DESC)` (`alx_api/src/db/migrations/0015_portal_owned_resource_indexes.sql:3-4`).
- **announcements**: two conflicting definitions. `alx_api/src/db/migrations/0011_portal_announcements.sql:11-36`: `announcement_id uuid PK, title, content, priority CHECK('normal','high','urgent'), is_active bool, expires_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at, created_by, updated_by` — **no data column**. `DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1364-1380`: adds `data jsonb {content, target_audience}`. Legacy UI writes only `{announcement_id, data}`.
- **jobs_req** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1341-1362`; PK renamed `id→jobs_req_id` at `202609170001…sql:184`): `jobs_req_id, address, city, email, experience_years int, full_name, id_number, job_position, notes, phone, qualification, ref_code, status, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. Doc omits `data`, but repository inserts `data jsonb` plus flat columns (`job-applications.repository.ts:25-31`). Note: the doc's `job_req_id` spelling is stale.

## 4. Gap verdict

- **orders** — covered by `GET /api/v1/orders` (`operations.routes.ts:90`), except missing display columns (customerName/phone/deliveryCity/source/totalPrice) that today come from the `data` jsonb spread.
- **couriers** — covered for listing by `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers` (`reporting.routes.ts:27-44`); UI doesn't render them anyway.
- **portal_tickets (admin list-all)** — **MISSING**. Natural home: `alx_api/src/modules/portal/portal-admin.routes.ts` (already the admin-JWT + permission module); pattern to copy: `listTickets` in `portal-owned.repository.ts:212-223` minus the `user_uid` filter, paginated like `page()` in `operations.repository.ts:66-91`. Reply mutation would need an admin PATCH there too.
- **announcements (admin full list + CRUD)** — **MISSING** for admin scope (public endpoint is active-only, LIMIT 20, no mutations). Home: `portal.routes.ts`/`portal-admin.routes.ts`; repository pattern: `getAnnouncements` in `portal.repository.ts:99-124`.
- **jobs_req (admin list + status update/delete)** — **MISSING** entirely. Home: `alx_api/src/modules/job-applications/job-applications.routes.ts` (currently submit-only); list pattern to copy: `reporting.repository.ts` definitions/`list()` (`:14-22`) or `page()` in `operations.repository.ts:66-91`.

const requestId = (response: Response) => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
const route = (permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) => [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function pathParam(request: Request, name: string): string | null {
  const value = request.params[name];
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 ? value : null;
}
function handleError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  if (error instanceof PortalAuthServiceError) return sendFailure(response, error.statusCode, error.code, error.safeMessage, requestId(response));
  return next(error);
}

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { PortalAdminRepository, PortalAdminUserDto } from './portal-admin.contracts';

function timestamp(value: unknown): number {
  const parsed = value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : Date.parse(String(value ?? ''));
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}
function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try { return record(JSON.parse(value)); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
}
function text(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? ''); }
function role(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['role'] {
  return value === 'courier' || value === 'supplier' ? value : 'customer';
}
function approval(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['approvalStatus'] {
  return value === 'pending_approval' || value === 'rejected' ? value : 'approved';
}
function mapRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalAdminUserDto {
  const userData = record(row.userData);
  const details = record(row.detailsData);
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    username: text(row.username || userData.username),
    email: text(row.email || userData.email),
    fullName: text(row.fullName || userData.fullName),
    phone: text(row.phone || userData.phone),
    role: role(row.portalRole || userData.portalRole || row.type),
    approvalStatus: approval(row.approvalStatus || userData.approvalStatus),
    disabled: Boolean(row.disabled || row.isDisabled || userData.disabled),
    ...(row.linkedCustomerId || userData.customerId ? { linkedCustomerId: text(row.linkedCustomerId || userData.customerId) } : {}),
    customerDetails: { id: text(row.detailId), customer_id: text(row.detailCustomerId), ...details },
    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
  };
}

const mockPool = (rows: unknown[] = []) => { const fn = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ rows, rowCount: rows.length ? 1 : 0 }); return { fn, pool: { query: fn } as unknown as Pool }; };

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

Now write the frontend service. Decisions:
- Service `src/services/siteContentService.ts` exposes typed methods returning row objects shaped like the legacy `{id, ...data}` so the tabs need no changes.
- Reads: `listTickets()`, `listAnnouncements()`, `listJobApplications()` using readAllFinanceRows (which paginates).

- Ticket row shape: SupportTicketsTab reads subject, userName, userEmail, status, message, replies[].sender/message/createdAt. My DTO gives id, subject, message, status, replies, createdAt, data{userName,userEmail}. Map to `{ id, subject, message, status, replies, createdAt, userName, userEmail }`.
- Announcement: `{ id, title, content, priority, targetAudience, isActive, createdAt }`.
- Job: `{ id, fullName, jobPosition, refCode, phone, email, city, address, qualification, experienceYears, idNumber, notes, status, createdAt, updatedAt }` — from `data`.

The backend returns `data` too, so the frontend spreads data then overlays normalized fields — keeps any extra legacy keys visible.

export interface ApiClientOptions {
  baseUrl: string;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
  credentials?: RequestCredentials;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  requestIdFactory?: () => string;
  maxReadRetries?: number;
  accessTokenFactory?: () => string | null | undefined;
}

export class ApiClientError extends ApplicationError {
  constructor(details: ErrorDetails) {
    super(details);
    this.name = "ApiClientError";
  }
}

export class ApiClient {
  private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch;

  constructor(private readonly options: ApiClientOptions) {
    this.fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  }

    const url = new URL(path, this.options.baseUrl);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query ?? {})) {
      if (value !== undefined) url.searchParams.set(key, String(value));
    }

    let response: Response | null = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt += 1) {

      const timeout = setTimeout(
        () => controller.abort(),
        this.options.timeoutMs ?? 10000
      );

60	const text = (value: unknown): string => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? ''));
61	
62	const timestamp = (value: unknown): number => {
63	  if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
64	  if (value instanceof Date) return value.getTime();
65	  const parsed = Date.parse(String(value ?? ''));
66	  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
67	};
68	
69	const record = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> =>
70	  value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? (value as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
71	
72	/** ردود التذكرة: مصفوفة الخادم أولًا ثم أرشيف `data` إذا وصل بصيغة مختلفة. */
73	function repliesOf(row: Record<string, unknown>): TicketReply[] {
74	  const source = Array.isArray(row.replies) ? row.replies : Array.isArray(record(row.data).replies) ? (record(row.data).replies as unknown[]) : [];
75	  return (source as unknown[]).map((entry) => {
76	    const reply = record(entry);
77	    return { sender: text(reply.sender), message: text(reply.message), createdAt: timestamp(reply.createdAt) };
78	  });
79	}
80	
81	/** يدمج `data` تحت الحقول المُطبَّعة فيبقى أي مفتاح قديم ظاهرًا للتبويب دون اختلاق قيم. */
82	function mergeData(row: Record<string, unknown>, normalized: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
83	  return { ...record(row.data), ...row, ...normalized };
84	}
85	
86	function mapTicket(row: Record<string, unknown>): SupportTicketRow {
87	  const data = record(row.data);
88	  const normalized = {
89	    id: text(row.id),
90	    subject: text(row.subject),
91	    message: text(row.message),
92	    type: text(row.type),
93	    status: text(row.status) || 'open',
94	    replies: repliesOf(row),
95	    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
96	    userName: text(row.userName || data.userName),
97	    userEmail: text(row.userEmail || data.userEmail),
98	  };
99	  return mergeData(row, normalized) as SupportTicketRow;
100	}
101	
102	function mapAnnouncement(row: Record<string, unknown>): AnnouncementRow {
103	  const data = record(row.data);
104	  const normalized = {
105	    id: text(row.id),
106	    title: text(row.title || data.title),
107	    content: text(data.content),
108	    priority: text(row.priority || data.priority) || 'normal',
109	    targetAudience: text(data.targetAudience || data.target_audience) || 'all',
110	    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
111	    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt || data.createdAt),
112	  };
113	  return mergeData(row, normalized) as AnnouncementRow;
114	}
115	
116	function mapJobApplication(row: Record<string, unknown>): JobApplicationRow {
117	  const normalized = {
118	    id: text(row.id),
119	    status: text(row.status) || 'pending_review',
120	    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
121	    updatedAt: timestamp(row.updatedAt),
122	  };
123	  return mergeData(row, normalized) as JobApplicationRow;
124	}

126	async function listAll<T>(path: string, map: (row: Record<string, unknown>) => T): Promise<T[]> {
127	  const rows = await readAllFinanceRows(path, {}, PAGE_SIZE);
128	  return rows.map((row) => map(row as Record<string, unknown>));
129	}

6	import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, RequestHandler, Response } from 'express';

22	 * Reuses the two permission codes the site-management page already requires, so no permission seeding is needed.

24	const READ_PERMISSION = 'view_website_management';

30	  requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),

34	function idParam(request: Request, response: Response): string | null {
35	  const id = request.params.id;
36	  return typeof id === 'string' && id.trim().length > 0
37	    ? id.trim()
38	    : (sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_IDENTIFIER', 'المعرّف غير صالح.', requestId(response)), null);
39	}

41	/** يولّد معرّف إعلان آمنًا نصيًا فقط — لا يُمرر مُدخل المستخدم إلى SQL كمعامل مُركّب. */
42	function announcementId(title: string): string {
43	  const slug = title.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 24);
44	  return `ann_${Date.now()}_${slug || 'item'}`;
45	}

49	  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,

53	    const query = siteContentListSchema.safeParse(request.query as unknown);
54	    if (!query.success) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SITE_QUERY', 'معاملات قائمة التذاكر غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
55	    try {

58	    } catch (error) {
59	      return next(error);
60	    }
61	  });

import { Globe, Activity, Users, User, Package, Briefcase, MessageSquare, Megaphone, Shield, Link as LinkIcon, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, Plus, Trash2, Check, X, Eye, Edit2, Send, Server, Key, Lock, Settings as SettingsIcon, ChevronRight, ArrowUpRight, Award, UserCheck, ShieldAlert, Cpu, Phone, Mail, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';

type SiteTab = 'analytics' | 'portal_users' | 'pending' | 'orders' | 'tickets' | 'announcements' | 'jobs' | 'security' | 'api';
type PortalOrder = { id: string; orderNumber?: string; trackingNumber?: string; createdAt?: string | number | Date; customerName?: string; recipientName?: string; customerPhone?: string; deliveryCity?: string; orderSourceName?: string; orderStatus?: string; status?: string; totalPrice?: string | number; totalAmount?: string | number };
export interface PortalOrdersTabProps {
  activeTab: SiteTab;
  isAr: boolean;
  portalOrders: PortalOrder[];
}

export const PortalOrdersTab: React.FC<PortalOrdersTabProps> = (props) => {
  const { activeTab, isAr, portalOrders } = props;

  return (
    <>
      {/* ── TAB 3: Web Portal Orders ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'orders' && (
        <div className="space-y-4 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-[#0a0a0c] border border-white/[0.04] p-4 rounded-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              {isAr ? 'استقبال وتوجيه طلبات البوابة الإلكترونية' : 'Web Portal Orders Routing'}
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold">{portalOrders.length} طلبات موقع</span>
          </div>

          {portalOrders.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-slate-500 space-y-2 bg-[#0a0a0c] border border-white/[0.04] rounded-3xl">
              <Package className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-slate-600" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{isAr ? 'لا توجد طلبات جديدة من البوابة حالياً' : 'No web portal orders found'}</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="bg-[#0a0a0c] border border-white/[0.04] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-xs text-right text-slate-300">
                  <thead className="bg-black/50 text-slate-400 font-bold border-b border-white/[0.05]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-3.5">رقم الطلب</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">التاريخ</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">العميل / المستلم</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">مصدر الشراء</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">الحالة</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">الإجمالي</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/[0.03]">
                    {portalOrders.map(ord => (
                      <tr key={ord.id} className="hover:bg-white/[0.02]">
                        <td className="p-3.5 font-bold font-mono text-[#d4af37]">{ord.orderNumber || ord.trackingNumber || ord.id.slice(0, 10)}</td>
                        <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-400">{ord.createdAt ? new Date(ord.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB') : '—'}</td>
                        <td className="p-3.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-white">{ord.customerName || ord.recipientName || '—'}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{ord.customerPhone || ord.deliveryCity}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3.5"><span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-[10px] font-bold">{ord.orderSourceName || 'البوابة'}</span></td>
                        <td className="p-3.5"><span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 text-[10px] font-bold">{ord.orderStatus || ord.status || 'معلق'}</span></td>
                        <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-white">{ord.totalPrice || ord.totalAmount || 0} YER</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default PortalOrdersTab;

66	async function page(
67	  pool: Pool,
68	  table: string,
69	  columns: string,
70	  order: string,
71	  input: PageQuery,
72	  searchColumns: string[],
73	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
74	  const values: unknown[] = [];
75	  const filters: string[] = [];
76	  if (input.search) {
77	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
78	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
79	  }
80	  if (input.customerId) {
81	    values.push(input.customerId);
82	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
83	  }
84	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
85	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
86	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
87	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
88	    values,
89	  );
90	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
91	}

95	  const ranks: Record<string, number> = {
96	    pending: 0,
97	    new: 0,
98	    created: 0,
99	    'قيد الطلب': 0,
100	    confirmed: 1,
101	    processing: 1,
102	    'قيد التجهيز': 1,
103	    shipped: 2,
104	    in_transit: 2,
105	    'تم الشحن': 2,
106	    delivered: 3,
107	    completed: 3,
108	    'تم التسليم': 3,
109	    cancelled: 4,
110	    canceled: 4,
111	    ملغي: 4,
112	  };
113	  return ranks[normalized] ?? -1;
114	}

81	async function page<T>(

88	    input.params,
89	  );
90	  const rows = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
91	    `SELECT ${input.columns} ${input.from}${input.where} ORDER BY ${input.orderBy} LIMIT $${input.params.length + 1} OFFSET $${input.params.length + 2}`,
92	    [...input.params, input.limit, input.offset],
93	  );
94	  return { items: rows.rows.map(map), total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };

asyncState.loading() : asyncState.idle());\n  const [portalUsers, setPortalUsers] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  const [portalOrders, setPortalOrders] = useState<PortalOrderRow[]>([]);\n  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicketRow[]>([]);\n  const [announcements, setAnnouncements] = useState<AnnouncementRow[]>([]);\n  const [jobApplications, setJobApplications] = useState<JobApplicationRow[]>([]);\n\n  const loadAllData = useCallback(async () => {\n    const result = await runQuery(async () => {\n      const [enrichedUsers, orders, tick, ann, jobs] = await Promise.all([\n        portalUserService.getPortalUsers(),\n        siteContentService.listPortalOrders(),\n        siteContentService.listTickets(),\n        siteContentService.listAnnouncements(),\n        siteContentService.listJobApplications(),\n      ]);\n      return { enrichedUsers, portalOrders: orders, tickets: tick, announcements: ann, jobApplications: jobs };\n    }, setQueryState, () => false);\n\n    if (result.status === 'success') {\n      setPortalUsers(result.data.enrichedUsers);\n      setPortalOrders(result.data.portalOrders);\n      setTickets(result.data.tickets);\n      setAnnouncements(result.data.announcements);\n      setJobApplications(result.data.jobApplications);\n    } else if (result.status === 'error') {\n      console.error('[WebsiteManagement] Error loading portal data:', result.error);\n      toast.error(isAr ?
