import type { FinanceEntriesGateway } from '../../contracts/finance-entries.gateway';
import type { FinanceEntryViewModel } from '../../../features/financeEntries/types';
import type { GatewayPage, GatewayQuery } from '../../contracts/common.gateway';
import { supabase } from '../supabase.client';
import { mapRow, mapSupabaseError } from '../supabase.mapper';

const mapEntry = (row: Record<string, unknown>): FinanceEntryViewModel => ({
  entryId: String(row.main_entry_id ?? ''),
  status: String(row.posting_status ?? ''),
});

export class CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway implements FinanceEntriesGateway {
  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<FinanceEntryViewModel>> {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
    const { data, error, count } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' }).range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    const items = (data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapEntry));
    return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
  }

  async getById(id: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel | null> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('main_entry_id', id).maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return data ? mapRow(data, mapEntry) : null;
  }

  async post(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'posted', posted_by_uid: actorId, posted_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
  }

  async reverse(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'voided', voided_by_uid: actorId, voided_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
  }
}

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { FinanceRepository } from './finance.contracts';
import {
  accountsQuerySchema,
  assetInputSchema,
  assetsQuerySchema,
  autoEntryRuleSchema,
  createEntrySchema,
  custodyAdvanceSchema,
  defaultAccountSchema,
  entityIdSchema,
  entityPurgeTypeSchema,
  entriesQuerySchema,
  entryModuleInputSchema,
  entryTypeInputSchema,
  financialAccountSchema,
  hierarchyImportSchema,
  hierarchyNodeSchema,
  orderPaymentSchema,
  pageQuerySchema,
  recalculateSchema,
  reverseEntrySchema,
  salaryHistoryQuerySchema,
  salaryHistorySchema,
  settleCustodySchema,
} from './finance.schemas';

function requestId(response: Response): string {
  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
}
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {
  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
}
function pageHandler(
  load: (query: {
    limit: number;
    offset: number;
    search?: string | undefined;
  }) => Promise<{ items: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]; total: number }>,
) {
  return async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
    if (!query.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const result = await load(query.data);
      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  };
}
function idParam(request: Request, response: Response): string | undefined {
  const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
    return undefined;
  }
  return parsed.data;
}
function writeError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  if (error instanceof Error && /غير متوازن|balance|balanced/i.test(error.message)) {
    sendFailure(response, 422, 'FINANCIAL_ENTRY_NOT_BALANCED', 'لا يمكن إنشاء قيد غير متوازن.', requestId(response));
    return;
  }
  next(error);
}

// مطابقة منطق الصلاحيات الدقيقة للإجراءين secure_replace/secure_delete في قاعدة البيانات
// Mirrors the granular permission mapping of the legacy secure_replace/secure_delete RPC wrappers.
const RECEIPT_TYPE_CODES = ['RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT'];
const PAYMENT_TYPE_CODES = ['PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT'];

function entryPermissionFor(typeCode: string | null, category: string, action: 'edit' | 'delete'): string {
  if (RECEIPT_TYPE_CODES.includes(typeCode ?? '')) return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_receipt_vouchers' : 'delete_receipt_vouchers';
  if (PAYMENT_TYPE_CODES.includes(typeCode ?? '')) return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_payment_vouchers' : 'delete_payment_vouchers';
  if (category === 'Compound') return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_compound_entries' : 'delete_compound_entries';
  if (category === 'Temp') return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_temporary_entries' : 'delete_temporary_entries';
  return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_general_entries' : 'delete_general_entries';
}

async function hasPermission(auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, userId: string, code: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!auth) return false;
  const permissions = await auth.listPermissions({ userId });
  return permissions.includes(code);
}

describe('Finance read filters (phase 7-هـ)', () => {
  const bearer = 'Authorization';
  const lastCall = (mock: unknown) => (mock as jest.Mock).mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0];

  it('keeps disabled accounts hidden unless includeInactive is requested', async () => {
    const app = createApiApp({ environment, auth: auth(['view_financial_accounts']), finance: repository });

    const active = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/accounts').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(active.status).toBe(200);
    expect(lastCall(repository.listAccounts)).toMatchObject({ includeInactive: false, limit: 25, offset: 0 });

    const all = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/accounts?includeInactive=true').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(all.status).toBe(200);
    expect(lastCall(repository.listAccounts)).toMatchObject({ includeInactive: true });

    const invalid = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/accounts?includeInactive=maybe').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(invalid.status).toBe(400);
    expect(invalid.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_PAGE_QUERY');
  });

  it('filters entries by automation key so duplicate automatic entries stay detectable', async () => {
    const app = createApiApp({ environment, auth: auth(['view_finance']), finance: repository });

    const response = await request(app)
      .get('/api/v1/finance/entries?automationKey=auto-voucher:o1:rule:order_charge&limit=1')
      .set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(lastCall(repository.listEntries)).toMatchObject({ automationKey: 'auto-voucher:o1:rule:order_charge', limit: 1 });

    const rejected = await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/entries?automationKey=%20').set(bearer, 'Bearer token');
    expect(rejected.status).toBe(400);
  });
});

No frontend service today calls `GET /api/v1/customers/:id`; that path is only used with PATCH/DELETE (`customersApiDataGateway.ts:47,52`). The shared client to call it directly is `appApiClient` (`src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23`), whose `get(path, query)` builds search params and reads the token from sessionStorage (`src\data\http\api-client.ts:32-36`).

**Courier — there is NO GET-by-id route at all.**

- `alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.routes.ts` registers only `POST /api/v1/operations/couriers` (:477), `PATCH /api/v1/operations/couriers/:id` (:488), `DELETE` (:519). No `app.get` for couriers anywhere in `modules/operations`.
- The only courier HTTP read is the reporting resource: `alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.routes.ts:12` (`couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' }`) generating `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers` (:28-45).
- Its query schema is `pageQuerySchema` (`alx_api\src\modules\operations\operations.schemas.ts:4-14`: `limit` 1–1000 default 25, `offset`, `search`, `customerId`), **but** `createReportingRepository.list` applies only `search` — `customerId` is accepted by zod then silently dropped (`alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.repository.ts:90-99`). `search` ILIKE-matches `full_name/name_ar/name_en` (:18), never the id.
- Consequence: a single courier by id must come from a paged list + client-side match. Reusable helper: `staffApiDataGateway` internal `readRows('/api/v1/reporting/couriers')` with 1000/20000 pagination and `normalizeCourier` (`src\features\staff\services\staffApiDataGateway.ts:70-80`, `:87-97`, used at `:158`).
- **Trap**: `ordersApiDataGateway.collections.couriers` is configured `readPath: '/api/v1/reporting/couriers'` with `writePath: '/api/v1/operations/couriers'` (`ordersApiDataGateway.ts:68`), so its `get(id)` produces `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers/{id}` → route does not exist (404). Do not use it for single reads.

### D. Field naming you can read after conversion

**Customer** (`GET /api/v1/customers/{id}`, `CustomerDto` in `alx_api\src\modules\customers\customers.contracts.ts:1-18`; aliases from `customers.repository.ts:6`):
`customerId, accountId, isActive, joinBy, referrerId, fullName, nameAr, nameEn, customerLevel, createdAt, updatedAt, acquisitionSource, preferredCategories, location, address, onboardingCompleted`.
⚠️ **No `phone`, no `email`, no `city`, no `financialBalance`/`walletBalance`.** So `entityData?.phone` (`GlobalEntityLedgerModal.tsx:327,328`) and `entityData?.financialBalance || walletBalance` (`:354`) have no API equivalent for customers — phone must come from `preferredCategories/location`-free sources or a balance/account route; `fullName`/`address` do exist.

**Courier** (`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`, `alx_api\src\modules\reporting\reporting.repository.ts:20`):
`courierId, fullName, nameAr, nameEn, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, type (dup of courierType), courierLevel, level (dup), commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy, updatedBy`, plus `map` adds `id = courierId` (`:21`). `staffApiDataGateway.normalizeCourier` (`:87-97`) coerces the nullable strings to `""` and derives `disabled = isActive === false`. So couriers give you `phone`/`address`; customers do not.

**Account movements** (`movementColumns`, `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.repository.ts:23`): `transactionId, entryId, entryNumber, module (= main_entry.entry_category), lineNo, transType, accountId, accountCurrencyNo, amount, amountOriginal, currencyOriginalNo, currencyPriceId, currencyPriceSeq, paymentMethod, entityType, entityId, orderId, shipmentId, custodyId, automationKey, autoRuleId, description, note, createdAt`.
Gaps vs the modal's current reads: there is **no `id`** (use `transactionId`, or `normalizeRows` which injects it), **no `refNumber`** (modal's `tx.refNumber` at `:151` must become `entryNumber`), **no `currency` string** (only numeric `currencyOriginalNo` — `tx.currencyOriginal || 'YER'` at `:198,264` needs resolution via `currencyService`), and **no `moduleId`** (modal's `tx.moduleId` at `:229`). Payment-order matching at `:151` compares `tx.refNumber === order.orderNumber`; the API rows expose `entryNumber` + `orderId`, so match on `orderId` instead.

1	import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';

5	import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
6	import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
7	import type { CustomerRepository } from './customers.contracts';
8	import {
9	  createCustomerSchema,
10	  customerIdSchema,
11	  listCustomersQuerySchema,
12	  updateCustomerSchema,
13	} from './customers.schemas';
14	
15	function principal(response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined {
16	  return response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
17	}

19	export function registerCustomersRoutes(
20	  app: Express,
21	  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
22	  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
23	  repository: CustomerRepository,
24	): void {
25	  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
26	  const viewCustomers = requirePermission(auth, 'view_customers');
27	  const createCustomers = requirePermission(auth, 'add_customers');
28	  const editCustomers = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_customers');
29	  const deleteCustomers = requirePermission(auth, 'delete_customers');

31	  app.get(
32	    '/api/v1/customers',
33	    authenticate,
34	    viewCustomers,
35	    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
36	      const id = String(response.locals.requestId);
37	      const parsed = listCustomersQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
38	      if (!parsed.success) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_CUSTOMERS_QUERY', 'معاملات البحث غير صالحة.', id);
39	      try {
40	        const result = await repository.list(parsed.data);
41	        return sendSuccess(response, result.items, id, {
42	          limit: parsed.data.limit,
43	          offset: parsed.data.offset,
44	          total: result.total,
45	        });
46	      } catch (error) {
47	        return next(error);
48	      }
49	    },
50	  );
51	
52	  app.post(
53	    '/api/v1/customers',
54	    authenticate,
55	    createCustomers,
56	    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
57	      const id = String(response.locals.requestId);
58	      const actor = principal(response);
59	      const parsed = createCustomerSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
60	      if (!parsed.success || !actor) {
61	        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_CUSTOMER_INPUT', 'بيانات العميل غير صالحة.', id);
62	      }
63	      try {
64	        const customer = await repository.create(parsed.data, actor.userId);
65	        return sendSuccess(response, customer, id);
66	      } catch (error) {
67	        return next(error);
68	      }
69	    },
70	  );

83	      }

29	async function writeAudit(client: PoolClient, action: string, customerId: string, actorUserId: string): Promise<void> {
30	  const now = new Date();
31	  await client.query(
32	    `INSERT INTO public.activity_logs
33	      (activity_log_id, action, category, target, type, details, user_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
34	     VALUES ($1, $2, 'customer', $3, 'api', $4, $5, $6, $6, $5, $5)`,
35	    [
36	      `audit_${randomUUID()}`,
37	      action,
38	      customerId,
39	      JSON.stringify({ source: 'alx_api', entityType: 'customer', entityId: customerId }),
40	      actorUserId,
41	      now,
42	    ],
43	  );
44	}
45	
46	async function inTransaction<T>(pool: Pool, operation: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
47	  const client = await pool.connect();
48	  try {
49	    await client.query('BEGIN');
50	    const result = await operation(client);
51	    await client.query('COMMIT');
52	    return result;
53	  } catch (error) {
54	    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
55	    throw error;
56	  } finally {
57	    client.release();
58	  }
59	}
60	
61	function writeFields(input: CustomerWriteInput): { assignments: string[]; values: unknown[] } {
62	  const fields: Array<[keyof CustomerWriteInput, string]> = [
63	    ['accountId', 'account_id'],
64	    ['isActive', 'is_active'],
65	    ['joinBy', 'join_by'],
66	    ['referrerId', 'referrer_id'],
67	    ['fullName', 'full_name'],
68	    ['nameAr', 'name_ar'],
69	    ['nameEn', 'name_en'],
70	    ['customerLevel', 'customer_level'],
71	    ['acquisitionSource', 'acquisition_source'],
72	    ['preferredCategories', 'preferred_categories'],
73	    ['location', 'location'],
74	    ['address', 'address'],
75	    ['onboardingCompleted', 'onboarding_completed'],
76	  ];
77	  const assignments: string[] = [];
78	  const values: unknown[] = [];
79	  for (const [property, column] of fields) {
80	    if (input[property] !== undefined) {
81	      values.push(input[property] ?? null);
82	      assignments.push(`${column} = $${values.length}`);
83	    }
84	  }
85	  return { assignments, values };
86	}
87	
88	export function createCustomersRepository(pool: Pool): CustomerRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async list(query) {
91	      const values: unknown[] = [];
92	      const filters: string[] = [];
93	      if (query.search) {
94	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
95	        filters.push(
96	          `(full_name ILIKE $${values.length} OR name_ar ILIKE $${values.length} OR name_en ILIKE $${values.length})`,
97	        );
98	      }
99	      if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
100	        values.push(query.isActive);
101	        filters.push(`is_active = $${values.length}`);
102	      }
103	      const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
104	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
105	      const result = await pool.query<CustomerRow>(
106	        `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS total_count FROM alx_api_private.customers_read ${where} ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id ASC LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
107	        values,
108	      );
109	      return { items: result.rows.map(mapCustomer), total: Number(result.rows[0]?.total_count ?? 0) };
110	    },
111	    async findById(customerId) {
112	      const result = await pool.query<CustomerRow>(
113	        `SELECT ${columns} FROM alx_api_private.customers_read WHERE customer_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
114	        [customerId],
115	      );
116	      return result.rows[0] ? mapCustomer(result.rows[0]) : null;
117	    },
118	    async create(input, actorUserId) {
119	      return inTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
120	        const customerId = input.customerId ?? `cust_${randomUUID()}`;
121	        const fields = writeFields(input);
122	        const columnsToInsert = ['customer_id', ...fields.assignments.map((assignment) => assignment.split(' = ')[0]), 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'created_by', 'updated_by'];
123	        const values = [customerId, ...fields.values, new Date(), new Date(), actorUserId, actorUserId];
124	        const placeholders = values.map((_, index) => `$${index + 1}`).join(', ');
125	        const result = await client.query<CustomerRow>(
126	          `INSERT INTO public.customers (${columnsToInsert.join(', ')}) VALUES (${placeholders}) RETURNING ${columns}`,
127	          values,
128	        );
129	        const row = result.rows[0];
130	        if (!row) throw new Error('CUSTOMER_CREATE_RETURNED_NO_ROW');
131	        const customer = mapCustomer(row);
132	        await writeAudit(client, 'create_customer', customer.customerId, actorUserId);
133	        return customer;
134	      });
135	    },
136	    async update(customerId, input, actorUserId) {
137	      return inTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
138	        const fields = writeFields(input);
139	        if (fields.assignments.length === 0) return null;
140	        const values = [...fields.values, new Date(), actorUserId, customerId];
141	        const result = await client.query<CustomerRow>(
142	          `UPDATE public.customers SET ${fields.assignments.join(', ')}, updated_at = $${values.length - 2}, updated_by = $${values.length - 1} WHERE customer_id = $${values.length} RETURNING ${columns}`,
143	          values,
144	        );
145	        if (!result.rows[0]) return null;
146	        const customer = mapCustomer(result.rows[0]);
147	        await writeAudit(client, 'update_customer', customer.customerId, actorUserId);
148	        return customer;
149	      });
150	    },
151	    async archive(customerId, actorUserId) {
152	      return inTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
153	        const values = [new Date(), actorUserId, customerId];
154	        const result = await client.query<CustomerRow>(
155	          `UPDATE public.customers SET is_active = false, updated_at = $1, updated_by = $2 WHERE customer_id = $3 RETURNING ${columns}`,
156	          values,
157	        );
158	        if (!result.rows[0]) return null;
159	        const customer = mapCustomer(result.rows[0]);
160	        await writeAudit(client, 'archive_customer', customer.customerId, actorUserId);
161	        return customer;
162	      });
163	    },
164	  };
165	}

115	const ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>> = {
116	  customer: '/api/v1/customers',
117	  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',
118	  employee: '/api/v1/operations/employees',
119	  source: '/api/v1/operations/sources',
120	  shipping_company: '/api/v1/operations/shipping-companies',
121	};

123	/**
124	 * يربط الحساب المالي بسجل الكيان. الفشل هنا تحذير فقط: الحساب أُنشئ ولا يجوز التراجع عنه بصمت.
125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.
126	 */
127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}
146	
147	/** التحقق من وجود قيد بمفتاح أتمتة معين — يمنع تكرار القيود التلقائية. */
148	export async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean> {
149	  const key = String(automationKey || '').trim();
150	  if (!key) return false;
151	  const { rows, total } = await readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { automationKey: key, limit: 1 });
152	  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? '') === key);
153	}
154	
155	/** يعيد احتساب الأرصدة عبر الدالة الآمنة؛ بدون معرفات = كل الحسابات. */
156	export async function recalculateAccountBalances(
157	  accountIds?: string[],
158	): Promise<{ success: boolean; recalculatedCount: number }> {
159	  const res = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ result?: { success?: boolean; recalculatedCount?: number } }>>(
160	    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/recalculate',
161	    accountIds && accountIds.length > 0 ? { accountIds } : {},
162	  );
163	  const result = res?.data?.result ?? {};
164	  return {
165	    success: result.success !== false,
166	    recalculatedCount: Number(result.recalculatedCount ?? accountIds?.length ?? 0),
167	  };
168	}

1	import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
2	import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
3	import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
4	import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
5	import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
6	import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
7	import type { ReportingRepository, ReportingResource } from './reporting.contracts';
8	import { pageQuerySchema } from '../operations/operations.schemas';
9	
10	const resources: Record<string, { resource: ReportingResource; permission: string }> = {
11	  expenses: { resource: 'expenses', permission: 'view_expenses' },
12	  couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' },
13	  employees: { resource: 'employees', permission: 'view_employees' },
14	  sources: { resource: 'sources', permission: 'view_sources' },
15	  'shipping-companies': { resource: 'shippingCompanies', permission: 'view_shipping_companies' },
16	  users: { resource: 'users', permission: 'view_users' },
17	  'activity-logs': { resource: 'activityLogs', permission: 'view_dashboard' },
18	  'report-templates': { resource: 'reportTemplates', permission: 'view_reports' },
19	};
20	
21	export function registerReportingRoutes(
22	  app: Express,
23	  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
24	  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
25	  repository: ReportingRepository,
26	): void {
27	  for (const [path, definition] of Object.entries(resources)) {
28	    app.get(
29	      `/api/v1/reporting/${path}`,
30	      requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),
31	      requirePermission(auth, definition.permission),
32	      async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
33	        const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId);
34	        const parsed = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
35	        if (!parsed.success)
36	          return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_REPORTING_QUERY', 'معاملات التقرير غير صالحة.', requestId);
37	        try {
38	          const result = await repository.list(definition.resource, parsed.data);
39	          return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId, { ...parsed.data, total: result.total });
40	        } catch (error) {
41	          return next(error);
42	        }
43	      },
44	    );
45	  }
46	}

88	export function createReportingRepository(pool: Pool): ReportingRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async list(resource, query) {
91	      const definition = definitions[resource];
92	      const values: unknown[] = [];
93	      const filters: string[] = [];
94	      if (query.search) {
95	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
96	        const placeholder = `$${values.length}`;
97	        filters.push(`(${definition.searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE ${placeholder}`).join(' OR ')})`);
98	      }
99	      const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
100	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
101	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
102	        `SELECT ${definition.columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM ${definition.from} ${where} ORDER BY ${definition.orderBy} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
103	        values,
104	      );
105	      return {
106	        items: result.rows.map(({ _total: _ignored, ...row }) => definition.map?.(row) ?? (row as ReportingRow)),
107	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0),
108	      };
109	    },
110	  };
111	}

67	/**
68	 * Universal Currency Converter (Client side helper)
69	 */
70	function convertCurrency(
71	  amount: number,
72	  from: string,
73	  to: string,
74	  rates: Record<string, number>
75	): number {
76	  if (!from || !to || from === to) return amount;
77	
78	  // Convert to YER base
79	  let baseAmountYER = amount;
80	  if (from === 'YER') {
81	    baseAmountYER = amount;
82	  } else {
83	    const fromRate = rates[from] || 1;
84	    baseAmountYER = amount * fromRate;
85	  }
86	
87	  // Convert YER to target
88	  if (to === 'YER') return baseAmountYER;
89	  const toRate = rates[to] || 1;
90	  return baseAmountYER / (toRate || 1);
91	}

93	/**
94	 * Determines the normal balance side for an account type.
95	 * Returns +1 if Debit increases balance (Asset/Expense)
96	 * Returns -1 if Credit increases balance (Liability/Equity/Revenue)

98	export function getAccountNormalSide(type: AccountType): 1 | -1 {
99	  if (type === 'Asset' || type === 'Expense') return 1;
100	  return -1;

103	/**
104	 * Compute balance from debit and credit totals using the proper accounting formula.

106	 * @param creditTotal - Total of all Credit entries (amount)
107	 * @param type        - Account type (Asset | Liability | Equity | Revenue | Expense)
108	 */
109	export function computeAccountBalance(
110	  debitTotal: number,
111	  creditTotal: number,
112	  type: AccountType,
113	): number {
114	  const normalSide = getAccountNormalSide(type);
115	  return normalSide === 1
116	    ? debitTotal - creditTotal
117	    : creditTotal - debitTotal;
118	}

export function registerOperationsRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: OperationsRepository,
): void {
  const list =
    (
      load: (query: {
        limit: number;
        offset: number;
        search?: string | undefined;
        customerId?: string | undefined;
      }) => Promise<{ items: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]; total: number }>,
    ) =>
    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
      if (!query.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await load(query.data);
        return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    };
  const single =
    (load: (key: string) => Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null>) =>
    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
      if (!parsed.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await load(parsed.data);
        return result
          ? sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response))
          : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'السجل غير موجود.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    };

  app.get('/api/v1/orders', ...route('view_orders', auth), list(repository.listOrders));
  app.get('/api/v1/orders/:id', ...route('view_orders', auth), single(repository.getOrder));
  app.get('/api/v1/orders/:id/history', ...route('view_orders', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
    if (!parsed.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));

async function page(
  pool: Pool,
  table: string,
  columns: string,
  order: string,
  input: PageQuery,
  searchColumns: string[],
): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  const values: unknown[] = [];
  const filters: string[] = [];
  if (input.search) {
    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
  }
  if (input.customerId) {
    values.push(input.customerId);
    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
  }
  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
    values,
  );
  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
}

  c.customer_id,
  c.account_id,
  c.is_active,
  c.join_by,
  c.referrer_id,
  c.full_name,
  c.name_ar,

}

function isEmployeeRecord(value: unknown): value is EmployeeRecord {
  return isEntityRecord(value);
}

function isCourierRecord(value: unknown): value is CourierRecord {
  return isEntityRecord(value);
}

function isOrderRecord(value: unknown): value is OrderRecord {
  return isEntityRecord(value);
}

function parseOrderRecord(value: unknown): OrderRecord | null {
  if (!isEntityRecord(value)) return null;
  const orderStatusId = value.orderStatusId;
  const amountRemaining = value.amountRemaining;
  const createdAt = value.createdAt;
  return {
    ...value,
    id: value.id,
    orderStatus: readText(value.orderStatus) ?? undefined,
    status: readText(value.status) ?? undefined,
    orderNumber: readText(value.orderNumber) ?? undefined,
    customerId: readText(value.customerId) ?? undefined,
    orderStatusId:
      typeof orderStatusId === 'string' || typeof orderStatusId === 'number'
        ? orderStatusId
        : undefined,
    orderSourceName: readText(value.orderSourceName) ?? undefined,
    orderSourceType: readText(value.orderSourceType) ?? undefined,
    customerName: readText(value.customerName) ?? undefined,
    customerPhone: readText(value.customerPhone) ?? undefined,
    amountPaid:
      typeof value.amountPaid === 'string' || typeof value.amountPaid === 'number'
        ? value.amountPaid
        : undefined,
    amountRemaining:
      typeof amountRemaining === 'string'
        ? amountRemaining
        : typeof amountRemaining === 'number'
          ? String(amountRemaining)
          : amountRemaining === null
            ? null
            : undefined,
    currency: readText(value.currency) ?? undefined,
    exchangeRateUSD:
      typeof value.exchangeRateUSD === 'number' ? value.exchangeRateUSD : undefined,
    exchangeRateSAR:
      typeof value.exchangeRateSAR === 'number' ? value.exchangeRateSAR : undefined,
    createdAt:
      typeof createdAt === 'string' || typeof createdAt === 'number' ? createdAt : undefined,
  };
}

127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}

  success: true;

};
type Row = Record<string, unknown> & { id: string };

  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: string;
  gpsLocation?: string;
  notes?: string;
};
type EmployeeWriteInput = {
  employeeId?: string;

  currency?: string;

  email?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;

  gpsLocation?: string;
  notes?: string;
};
type StaffState = {
  couriers: Row[];
  employees: Row[];
  orders: Row[];
  accounts: Row[];
};

  onData: (state: StaffState) => void;
  onError?: (error: unknown) => void;

const PAGE_SIZE = 1_000;
const MAX_ROWS = 20_000;

const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:3001",
  accessTokenFactory: () =>
    typeof sessionStorage === "undefined"
      ? null
      : (sessionStorage.getItem("alx_access_token") || sessionStorage.getItem("alx_api_access_token")),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

async function readRows(path: string): Promise<Row[]> {
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < MAX_ROWS; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<Row[]>>(path, { limit: PAGE_SIZE, offset });
    const page = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [];
    rows.push(...page);
    const total = Number(response.meta?.total ?? rows.length);
    if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE || rows.length >= total) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { ReportingRepository, ReportingResource } from './reporting.contracts';
import { pageQuerySchema } from '../operations/operations.schemas';

const resources: Record<string, { resource: ReportingResource; permission: string }> = {
  expenses: { resource: 'expenses', permission: 'view_expenses' },
  couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' },
  employees: { resource: 'employees', permission: 'view_employees' },
  sources: { resource: 'sources', permission: 'view_sources' },
  'shipping-companies': { resource: 'shippingCompanies', permission: 'view_shipping_companies' },
  users: { resource: 'users', permission: 'view_users' },
  'activity-logs': { resource: 'activityLogs', permission: 'view_dashboard' },
  'report-templates': { resource: 'reportTemplates', permission: 'view_reports' },
};

export function registerReportingRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: ReportingRepository,
): void {
  for (const [path, definition] of Object.entries(resources)) {
    app.get(
      `/api/v1/reporting/${path}`,
      requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),
      requirePermission(auth, definition.permission),
      async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
        const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId);
        const parsed = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
        if (!parsed.success)
          return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_REPORTING_QUERY', 'معاملات التقرير غير صالحة.', requestId);
        try {
          const result = await repository.list(definition.resource, parsed.data);
          return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId, { ...parsed.data, total: result.total });
        } catch (error) {
          return next(error);
        }
      },
    );
  }
}

  /**
   * Get financial account by entity ID
   */
  async getAccountByEntityId(
    entityId: string,
    entityType?: AccountEntityType,
  ): Promise<FinancialAccount | null> {
    const id = String(entityId || '').trim();
    if (!id) return null;
    try {
      const rows = await readFinanceRows(`${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/by-entity`, { entityId: id });
      const matched = entityType ? rows.find((row) => row?.entityType === entityType) : rows[0];
      return matched ? mapAccountRow(matched) : null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("[FinancialAccountService] Error fetching account:", error);
      return null;
    }
  }

22	  | 'order_collected'
23	  | 'order_commission'
24	  | 'expense_disbursed'
25	  | 'wage_paid'
26	  | 'generic';
27	
28	export interface LedgerParty {
29	  id: string;
30	  name: string;
31	  phone: string;
32	  /** رصيد الحساب المالي المرتبط بالكيان من `accounts`؛ صفر إن لم يُربط حساب بعد. */
33	  balance: number;
34	}
35	
36	export interface LedgerLine {
37	  id: string;
38	  kind: LedgerLineKind;
39	  category: LedgerCategory;
40	  date: number;
41	  type: 'Debit' | 'Credit';
42	  amount: number;
43	  amountOriginal: number;
44	  currencyOriginal: string;
45	  ref: string;
46	  note: string;
47	  runningBalance: number;
48	}

50	export interface EntityLedger {
51	  party: LedgerParty;
52	  lines: LedgerLine[];
53	  totals: { debits: number; credits: number };
54	}
55	
56	const MOVEMENTS_PATH = '/api/v1/finance/account-movements';
57	const ORDERS_PATH = '/api/v1/orders';
58	const PROFILE_PATH: Record<LedgerEntityType, string> = {
59	  customer: '/api/v1/customers',
60	  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',
61	};
62	
63	const number = (value: unknown): number => {
64	  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : parseFloat(String(value ?? ''));
65	  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
66	};
67	
68	const text = (value: unknown): string => String(value ?? '').trim();
69	
70	const timestamp = (value: unknown): number => {
71	  if (value == null || value === '') return 0;
72	  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Date.parse(String(value));
73	  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
74	};
75	
76	/**
77	 * وحدة القيد (entry_module.code) ونوعه (entry_type.code) هما المرجع الصحيح للتصنيف التشغيلي؛
78	 * `module` القادم من alx_api هو فئة القيد المحاسبية (General/Compound/Temp/Reversing) ولا يصلح للتصنيف.
79	 * The entry module/type codes carry the operational meaning; the `module` alias is the accounting category.
80	 */
81	function categoryOf(row: any): LedgerCategory {
82	  const moduleCode = text(row?.moduleCode).toUpperCase();
83	  const typeCode = text(row?.entryTypeCode).toUpperCase();
84	  if (moduleCode === 'CUSTODY') return 'custody';
85	  if (moduleCode === 'SALARIES' || typeCode === 'SALARY_PAYMENT') return 'wage';
86	  if (moduleCode === 'EXPENSES' || typeCode === 'PAYMENT_VOUCHER') return 'expense';
87	  if (moduleCode === 'ORDERS') return typeCode === 'ORDER_PAYMENT' ? 'payment' : 'order';
88	  if (moduleCode === 'RECEIPTS' || typeCode === 'RECEIPT_VOUCHER') return 'payment';
89	  return 'transaction';
90	}
91	
92	/** خرائط أكواد العملات تُبنى مرة واحدة لكل كشف: `currency_original_no` رقمي ولا يملك الواجهة تحويله محليًا. */
93	async function buildCurrencyCodes(): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
94	  const currencies = await currencyService.getAllCurrencies(false);
95	  return new Map(currencies.map((currency) => [String(currency.cur_id), String(currency.code || 'YER')]));
96	}
97	
98	async function loadParty(entityType: LedgerEntityType, entityId: string): Promise<LedgerParty> {
99	  const profile = await readFinanceRecord(`${PROFILE_PATH[entityType]}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`);
100	  const account = await financialAccountService.getAccountByEntityId(entityId, entityType);
101	  return {
102	    id: entityId,
103	    name: text(profile?.fullName || profile?.nameAr || profile?.nameEn) || entityId,
104	    // الهاتف غير مكشوف في حدود قراءة العملاء المتعمَّدة، فيبقى فارغًا بدل اختلاق قيمة.
105	    // Phone is intentionally outside the customers read boundary, so it stays empty rather than invented.
106	    phone: text(profile?.phone),
107	    balance: Number(account?.balance ?? 0),
108	  };
109	}
110	
111	async function loadMovements(entityId: string, currencyCodes: Map<string, string>): Promise<any[]> {
112	  const rows = await readAllFinanceRows(MOVEMENTS_PATH, { entityId });
113	  return rows.map((row) => ({
114	    id: text(row.transactionId) || text(row.id),
115	    entryId: text(row.entryId),
116	    ref: text(row.entryNumber),
117	    date: timestamp(row.createdAt),
118	    type: text(row.transType) === 'Credit' ? 'Credit' : 'Debit',
119	    amount: number(row.amount),
120	    amountOriginal: number(row.amountOriginal ?? row.amount),
121	    currencyOriginal: currencyCodes.get(text(row.currencyOriginalNo)) || 'YER',
122	    category: categoryOf(row),
123	    description: text(row.description),
124	    orderId: text(row.orderId),
125	  }));
126	}
127	
128	async function loadCustomerOrders(customerId: string): Promise<any[]> {
129	  const rows = await readAllFinanceRows(ORDERS_PATH, { customerId });
130	  return rows.map((row) => ({
131	    id: text(row.orderId),
132	    orderNumber: text(row.orderNumber),
133	    total: number(row.amountPaid) + number(row.amountRemaining),
134	    paid: number(row.amountPaid),
135	    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
136	    updatedAt: timestamp(row.updatedAt || row.createdAt),
137	  }));
138	}
139	
140	function movementLine(movement: any, kind: LedgerLineKind, type: string, category: LedgerCategory): LedgerLine {
141	  return {
142	    id: movement.id,
143	    kind,
144	    category,
145	    date: movement.date,
146	    type: type === 'Credit' ? 'Credit' : 'Debit',
147	    amount: movement.amount,
148	    amountOriginal: movement.amountOriginal,
149	    currencyOriginal: movement.currencyOriginal,
150	    ref: movement.ref,
151	    note: movement.description,
152	    runningBalance: 0,
153	  };
154	}
155	
156	function isSettlementDescription(description: string): boolean {
157	  return description.includes('تسوية') || description.includes('سداد') || description.toLowerCase().includes('settle');
158	}
159	
160	/** سطور كشف العميل: رسوم الطلبات من الطلبات نفسها، والمدفوعات غير المقيدة كفرق، ثم بقية القيود المرحّلة. */
161	function buildCustomerLines(orders: any[], movements: any[]): LedgerLine[] {
162	  const lines: LedgerLine[] = [];
163	
164	  for (const order of orders) {
165	    if (order.total > 0) {
166	      lines.push({
167	        id: `order-charge-${order.id}`,
168	        kind: 'order_charge',
169	        category: 'order',
170	        date: order.createdAt,
171	        type: 'Debit',
172	        amount: order.total,
173	        amountOriginal: order.total,
174	        currencyOriginal: 'YER',
175	        ref: order.orderNumber || order.id,
176	        note: '',
177	        runningBalance: 0,
178	      });
179	    }
180	
181	    const recorded = movements
182	      .filter((movement) => movement.category === 'payment' && movement.orderId === order.id)
183	      .reduce((sum, movement) => sum + (movement.amountOriginal || movement.amount), 0);
184	    const unrecorded = order.paid - recorded;
185	    if (unrecorded > 0.01) {
186	      lines.push({
187	        id: `order-pay-${order.id}`,
188	        kind: 'unrecorded_payment',
189	        category: 'payment',
190	        date: order.updatedAt + 1,
191	        type: 'Credit',
192	        amount: unrecorded,
193	        amountOriginal: unrecorded,
194	        currencyOriginal: 'YER',
195	        ref: order.orderNumber || order.id,
196	        note: '',
197	        runningBalance: 0,
198	      });
199	    }
200	  }
201	
202	  // سطر قيمة الطلب يُبنى من الطلب نفسه، لذلك تُستبعد حركات category 'order' حتى لا يتكرر المبلغ.
203	  // The order-charge debit already comes from the order row, so order-category movements are skipped.
204	  for (const movement of movements) {
205	    if (movement.category === 'order') continue;
206	    lines.push(movementLine(movement, 'generic', movement.type, movement.category));
207	  }
208	
209	  return lines;
210	}
211	
212	/** سطور كشف المندوب: كل حركة تُصنَّف تشغيليًا ويُفرض اتجاهها عند الحاجة (العُهدة والمصروفات والأجور). */
213	function buildCourierLines(movements: any[]): LedgerLine[] {
214	  return movements.map((movement) => {
215	    if (movement.category === 'custody') {
216	      return isSettlementDescription(movement.description)
217	        ? movementLine(movement, 'custody_settlement', 'Credit', 'custody')
218	        : movementLine(movement, 'custody_handover', 'Debit', 'custody');
219	    }
220	    if (movement.category === 'order') {
221	      return movement.type === 'Debit'
222	        ? movementLine(movement, 'order_collected', 'Debit', 'order')
223	        : movementLine(movement, 'order_commission', 'Credit', 'order');
224	    }
225	    if (movement.category === 'expense') return movementLine(movement, 'expense_disbursed', 'Credit', 'expense');
226	    if (movement.category === 'wage') return movementLine(movement, 'wage_paid', 'Credit', 'wage');
227	    return movementLine(movement, 'generic', movement.type, movement.category);
228	  });
229	}
230	
231	/** يرتب السطور زمنيًا ثم يضيف الرصيد التراكمي (المدين +/الدائن −) ويعيدها الأحدث أولًا. */
232	function withRunningBalance(lines: LedgerLine[]): LedgerLine[] {
233	  let balance = 0;
234	  return [...lines]
235	    .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)
236	    .map((line) => {
237	      balance = line.type === 'Debit' ? balance + line.amount : balance - line.amount;
238	      return { ...line, runningBalance: balance };
239	    })
240	    .reverse();
241	}
242	
243	function totalsOf(lines: LedgerLine[]): { debits: number; credits: number } {
244	  return lines.reduce(
245	    (totals, line) => {
246	      if (line.type === 'Debit') totals.debits += line.amount;
247	      else totals.credits += line.amount;
248	      return totals;
249	    },
250	    { debits: 0, credits: 0 },
251	  );
252	}
253	
254	export const entityLedgerService = {
255	  /** يكشف كشفًا كاملًا لكيان واحد: الملف + الرصيد + السطور التراكمية + الإجماليات. */
256	  async loadLedger(entityType: LedgerEntityType, entityId: string): Promise<EntityLedger> {
257	    const id = String(entityId || '').trim();
258	    if (!id) throw new Error('Entity id is required to build an entity ledger.');
259	
260	    const [party, currencyCodes] = await Promise.all([
261	      loadParty(entityType, id),
262	      buildCurrencyCodes(),
263	    ]);
264	    const movements = await loadMovements(id, currencyCodes);
265	    const lines =
266	      entityType === 'customer'
267	        ? buildCustomerLines(await loadCustomerOrders(id), movements)
268	        : buildCourierLines(movements);
269	    const ordered = withRunningBalance(lines);
270	
271	    return { party, lines: ordered, totals: totalsOf(ordered) };
272	  },
273	};

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { API_MODES, assertProductionApiMode, getApiMode, parseApiMode } from './api-mode';
import { API_CONTRACT_MATRIX, getApiDomainContract } from './api-contract-matrix';

describe('API mode contract', () => {
  it('supports only the explicitly defined migration modes', () => {
    expect(API_MODES).toEqual(['api-only', 'shadow', 'legacy-migration']);
    expect(parseApiMode(' API-ONLY ')).toBe('api-only');
    expect(() => parseApiMode('fallback')).toThrow('Unsupported VITE_API_MODE');
  });

  it('does not allow legacy-migration in production', () => {
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('legacy-migration'))).toThrow(
      'Production cannot run with VITE_API_MODE=legacy-migration',
    );
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('shadow'))).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => assertProductionApiMode('production', getApiMode('api-only'))).not.toThrow();
  });

  it('does not silently permit legacy writes in shadow mode', () => {
    expect(getApiMode('shadow')).toMatchObject({
      mode: 'shadow',
      isApiOnly: false,
      allowsLegacyReads: true,
      allowsLegacyWrites: false,
    });
  });
});

describe('API contract matrix', () => {
  it('covers every registered gateway domain and records current gaps', () => {
    const registeredDomains = [
      'accounting', 'auth', 'browser', 'couriers', 'customers', 'employees',
      'financeEntries', 'notifications', 'orders', 'products', 'reports',
      'roles', 'settings', 'shipments', 'siteManagement', 'sources', 'users',
    ];
    expect(API_CONTRACT_MATRIX.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(getApiDomainContract('settings')?.status).toBe('available');
    expect(getApiDomainContract('currencies')?.status).toBe('available');
    for (const domain of registeredDomains) {
      const contract = getApiDomainContract(domain) ??
        getApiDomainContract(domain === 'financeEntries' ? 'finance' : domain);
      expect(contract, `Missing contract matrix entry for ${domain}`).toBeDefined();
    }
  });
});

import { supabase } from '../supabase.client';
import { mapRow, mapSupabaseError } from '../supabase.mapper';

function mapOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): OrdersViewModel {
  return { id: String(row.order_id ?? row.id ?? '') };
}

function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
}

export class CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway implements OrdersGateway {
  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<OrdersViewModel>> {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' })
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return page((data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapOrder)), { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
  }

19	  const setLoading = (value: boolean) => setQueryState(value ? asyncState.loading() : asyncState.idle());
20	  const [portalUsers, setPortalUsers] = useState<any[]>([]);

24	  const [jobApplications, setJobApplications] = useState<any[]>([]);
25	  const [couriers, setCouriers] = useState<any[]>([]);
26	
27	  const loadAllData = useCallback(async () => {
28	    const result = await runQuery(async () => {
29	      const [enrichedUsers, oRes, tRes, aRes, jRes, cRes] = await Promise.all([
30	        portalUserService.getPortalUsers(),
31	        siteManagementGateway.selectCollection('orders'),
32	        siteManagementGateway.selectCollection('portal_tickets'),
33	        siteManagementGateway.selectCollection('announcements'),
34	        siteManagementGateway.selectCollection('jobs_req'),
35	        siteManagementGateway.selectCollection('couriers'),
36	      ]);

38	      const orders = extractSiteManagementRows(oRes.data || []);
39	      const tick = extractSiteManagementRows(tRes.data || []);
40	      const ann = extractSiteManagementRows(aRes.data || []);
41	      const jobs = extractSiteManagementRows(jRes.data || []);
42	      const cour = extractSiteManagementRows(cRes.data || []);
43	
44	      orders.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
45	      tick.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
46	      ann.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
47	      jobs.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
48	
49	      return { enrichedUsers, orders, tick, ann, jobs, cour };
50	    }, setQueryState, () => false);
51	    if (result.status === 'success') {
52	      const { enrichedUsers, orders, tick, ann, jobs, cour } = result.data;
53	      setPortalUsers(enrichedUsers);
54	      setPortalOrders(orders.filter(o => o.customerUid || o.portalUid || o.orderSourceType === 'App'));
55	      setTickets(tick);
56	      setAnnouncements(ann);
57	      setJobApplications(jobs);
58	      setCouriers(cour);

62	      toast.error(isAr ? 'حدث خطأ أثناء تحميل بيانات الموقع' : 'Error loading portal data');
63	    }
64	  }, [isAr]);

66	  useEffect(() => {

68	  }, [loadAllData]);
69

71	}

# Research Report

## 1. What the UI actually needs

All rows come via `extractSiteManagementRows` (`src/features/siteManagement/services/siteManagementGateway.ts:4-9`): only `id` + spread of the jsonb `data` column are used — a few columns, not full rows.

- **orders** (`portalOrders`): filtered client-side on `customerUid|portalUid|orderSourceType==='App'` (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:54`); rendered: `orderNumber, trackingNumber, createdAt, customerName, recipientName, customerPhone, deliveryCity, orderSourceName, orderStatus|status, totalPrice|totalAmount` (`components/PortalOrdersTab.tsx:50-58`). No mutations from this page.
- **portal_tickets** (`tickets`): `subject, userName, userEmail, status ('open'), message, replies[].{sender,createdAt,message}, createdAt` (`SupportTicketsTab.tsx:46-63`; sort `useWebsiteManagementData.ts:45`). **Write**: reply does `supabase.from('portal_tickets').update({data: cleanPayload}).eq('portal_ticket_id',…)` (`pages/WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:153`).
- **announcements**: `title, content, priority, targetAudience, isActive|is_active, createdAt` (`AnnouncementsTab.tsx:99-115`). **Writes**: insert `{announcement_id, data}` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:186`), update `data` (`:210`), delete (`:223`).
- **jobs_req**: `fullName, jobPosition, refCode, phone, email, city, address, qualification, experienceYears, idNumber, createdAt, notes, status, updatedAt` (`JobApplicationsTab.tsx:39-77`). **Writes**: update `data` (`WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:245`), delete (`:284`), plus courier creation via `setDoc(doc(db,'couriers',…))` (`:261`).
- **couriers**: loaded (`useWebsiteManagementData.ts:35`) but **never destructured/rendered** in `WebsiteManagementPage.tsx:31-40` — dead read path.
- `SiteAnalyticsTab.tsx:90-95` & `WebsiteManagementTabs.tsx:29`: only `status` counts.

## 2. Existing API coverage

- **`GET /api/v1/orders`** — admin JWT + permission `view_orders` (`alx_api/src/modules/operations/operations.routes.ts:90`, route() at `:37-39`). Query: `limit, offset, search, customerId` (`operations.schemas.ts:4-8`; applied in `operations.repository.ts:80-83`; search hits `order_number/external_order_number/tracking_number` `:169`). Columns: `orderListColumns` (`:52-64`) = orderId, orderNumber, trackingNumber, customerId, orderStatusId, orderStatus, orderParty*, courier ids, currency fields, externalOrderNumber, jsonb-extracted `amountPaid/amountRemaining/totalCostYER/paymentStatus`, createdAt, updatedAt. **No** customerName/recipientName/phone/deliveryCity/orderSourceName/totalPrice.
- **Couriers**: no `GET /api/v1/operations/couriers` list exists — only `GET /:id`, POST, PATCH, DELETE (`operations.routes.ts:479-522`). List is at **`GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers`** (admin JWT, `view_couriers`) (`reporting.routes.ts:12,29-31`), returning all couriers with `courierId, fullName, nameAr/En, accountId, currency, isActive, courierType, courierLevel, commissionRate, phone, email, address, gpsLocation, notes, createdAt, updatedAt, id` (`reporting.repository.ts:14-21`).
- **portal_tickets**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/tickets` — **portal-session Bearer auth** (`portal-owned.routes.ts:57-68,73`), no permission code, filters `WHERE user_uid = $1` (`portal-owned.repository.ts:217`) → **cannot list all rows**. Aliases: `portal_ticket_id AS id, user_uid AS "userUid", type, subject, message, status, replies, data, created_at AS "createdAt"` (`:214-215`), mapped to `PortalTicketDto` incl. `userName, userRole, adminResponse` (`portal-owned.contracts.ts:55-67`). `portal-admin.routes.ts` has **no** tickets endpoint (users only, `:31-114`).
- **announcements**: only `GET /api/v1/portal/announcements` — **public, no auth, no permission** (`portal.routes.ts:63`), but hard-caps `WHERE is_active = true … LIMIT 20` (`portal.repository.ts:102-106`) → cannot list all incl. inactive. Aliases `announcement_id AS id, title, content, priority, created_at AS "createdAt"`; no targetAudience, no `data`.
- **jobs_req**: only `POST /api/v1/portal/job-applications` (public, rate-limited) (`job-applications.routes.ts:24-27`); repository has `create` only (`job-applications.repository.ts:6`). **No list/get endpoint at all.**

## 3. Schema facts

- **portal_tickets** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1023-1038`): `portal_ticket_id text` (renamed from `id` in `supabase/migrations/202609170001_rename_primary_keys_to_table_id.sql:283`), `user_uid → portal_users`, `message, replies jsonb, status, subject, type, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. `data` jsonb not in the doc but exists — repository selects/inserts it (`portal-owned.repository.ts:215,228`). Index on `(user_uid, created_at DESC)` (`alx_api/src/db/migrations/0015_portal_owned_resource_indexes.sql:3-4`).
- **announcements**: two conflicting definitions. `alx_api/src/db/migrations/0011_portal_announcements.sql:11-36`: `announcement_id uuid PK, title, content, priority CHECK('normal','high','urgent'), is_active bool, expires_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at, created_by, updated_by` — **no data column**. `DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1364-1380`: adds `data jsonb {content, target_audience}`. Legacy UI writes only `{announcement_id, data}`.
- **jobs_req** (`DATABASE_SCHEMA.md:1341-1362`; PK renamed `id→jobs_req_id` at `202609170001…sql:184`): `jobs_req_id, address, city, email, experience_years int, full_name, id_number, job_position, notes, phone, qualification, ref_code, status, created_at timestamptz, updated_at, created_by, updated_by`. Doc omits `data`, but repository inserts `data jsonb` plus flat columns (`job-applications.repository.ts:25-31`). Note: the doc's `job_req_id` spelling is stale.

## 4. Gap verdict

- **orders** — covered by `GET /api/v1/orders` (`operations.routes.ts:90`), except missing display columns (customerName/phone/deliveryCity/source/totalPrice) that today come from the `data` jsonb spread.
- **couriers** — covered for listing by `GET /api/v1/reporting/couriers` (`reporting.routes.ts:27-44`); UI doesn't render them anyway.
- **portal_tickets (admin list-all)** — **MISSING**. Natural home: `alx_api/src/modules/portal/portal-admin.routes.ts` (already the admin-JWT + permission module); pattern to copy: `listTickets` in `portal-owned.repository.ts:212-223` minus the `user_uid` filter, paginated like `page()` in `operations.repository.ts:66-91`. Reply mutation would need an admin PATCH there too.
- **announcements (admin full list + CRUD)** — **MISSING** for admin scope (public endpoint is active-only, LIMIT 20, no mutations). Home: `portal.routes.ts`/`portal-admin.routes.ts`; repository pattern: `getAnnouncements` in `portal.repository.ts:99-124`.
- **jobs_req (admin list + status update/delete)** — **MISSING** entirely. Home: `alx_api/src/modules/job-applications/job-applications.routes.ts` (currently submit-only); list pattern to copy: `reporting.repository.ts` definitions/`list()` (`:14-22`) or `page()` in `operations.repository.ts:66-91`.

=== 0011
-- Migration: 0011_portal_announcements.sql
-- Description: إنشاء جدول الإعلانات العامة للبوابة الإلكترونية
-- Creation of public announcements table for the customer portal module
-- Date: 2026-10-05
-- Author: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking)

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. جدول الإعلانات العامة (public announcements)
-- Used by the portal module for customer-facing announcements
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.announcements (
  -- المعرف الفريد للإعلان
  announcement_id       UUID        NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- عنوان الإعلان
  title                 TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- محتوى الإعلان
  content               TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- أولوية الإعلان: normal | high | urgent
  priority              TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal'
                        CHECK (priority IN ('normal', 'high', 'urgent')),

  -- هل الإعلان نشط (مرئي للعملاء)
  is_active             BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

  -- تاريخ انتهاء الإعلان (اختياري)
  expires_at            TIMESTAMPTZ,

  -- حقول التدقيق
  created_at            TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at            TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_by            TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
  updated_by            TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system'
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. فهارس جدول الإعلانات
-- Indexes for announcements table
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- فهرس للإعلانات النشطة مرتبة بالأولوية
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_announcements_active_priority
  ON public.announcements (is_active, priority DESC, created_at DESC)
  WHERE is_active = TRUE;

     5	const PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{1,127}$/;
     6	
     7	export function requirePermission(useCases: AuthUseCases | undefined, permissionCode: string): RequestHandler {
     8	  if (!PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN.test(permissionCode)) {
     9	    throw new TypeError('A canonical permission code is required.');

    11	
    12	  return async (_request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {

    15	    if (!useCases || !principal?.userId) {

    19

    22	      if (!permissions.includes(permissionCode)) {

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { PortalAdminRepository, PortalAdminUserDto } from './portal-admin.contracts';

function timestamp(value: unknown): number {
  const parsed = value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : Date.parse(String(value ?? ''));
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}
function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try { return record(JSON.parse(value)); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
}
function text(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? ''); }
function role(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['role'] {
  return value === 'courier' || value === 'supplier' ? value : 'customer';
}
function approval(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['approvalStatus'] {
  return value === 'pending_approval' || value === 'rejected' ? value : 'approved';
}
function mapRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalAdminUserDto {
  const userData = record(row.userData);
  const details = record(row.detailsData);
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    username: text(row.username || userData.username),

82	async function page<T>(
83	  pool: Pool,

85	  map: (row: Record<string, unknown>) => T,

93	    [...input.params, input.limit, input.offset],
94	  );
95	  return { items: rows.rows.map(map), total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };

      .get('/api/v1/finance/accounts')

  });

      auth: auth(['view_financial_accounts', 'view_auto_entries']),

    });

    ).toBe('a1');

      (await request(app).get('/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules').set('Authorization', 'Bearer token')).status,
    ).toBe(200);
  });

      .post('/api/v1/finance/entries')
      .set('Authorization', 'Bearer token')
      .send({ ...balancedEntry, lines: [{ ...balancedEntry.lines[0], amountOriginal: 101 }, balancedEntry.lines[1]] });
    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    expect(repository.createEntry).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('accepts a balanced entry and passes the authenticated actor', async () => {
    const response = await request(createApiApp({ environment, auth: auth(['add_finance']), finance: repository }))
      .post('/api/v1/finance/entries')

      .send(balancedEntry);
    expect(response.status).toBe(200);

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.

127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];

134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};

136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {

140	    return true;

143	    return false;

41	/** يولّد معرّف إعلان آمنًا نصيًا فقط — لا يُمرر مُدخل المستخدم إلى SQL كمعامل مُركّب. */
42	function announcementId(title: string): string {
43	  const slug = title.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 24);
44	  return `ann_${Date.now()}_${slug || 'item'}`;
45	}

47	export function registerSiteContentRoutes(
48	  app: Express,
49	  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
50	  repository: SiteContentRepository,
51	): void {
52	  app.get('/api/v1/site/tickets', ...route(READ_PERMISSION, auth), async (request, response, next) => {
53	    const query = siteContentListSchema.safeParse(request.query as unknown);
54	    if (!query.success) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SITE_QUERY', 'معاملات قائمة التذاكر غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
55	    try {
56	      const result = await repository.listTickets(query.data);
57	      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
58	    } catch (error) {
59	      return next(error);
60	    }
61	  });
62	
63	  app.post('/api/v1/site/tickets/:id/replies', ...route(WRITE_PERMISSION, auth), async (request, response, next) => {
64	    const ticketId = idParam(request, response);
65	    if (!ticketId) return undefined;
66	    const body = ticketReplySchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
67	    if (!body.success) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_TICKET_REPLY', 'نص رد الدعم غير صالح.', requestId(response));
68	    try {
69	      const updated = await repository.addTicketReply({
70	        ticketId,
71	        sender: ADMIN_REPLY_SENDER,
72	        message: body.data.message,
73	        repliedAt: Date.now(),
74	      });
75	      return updated
76	        ? sendSuccess(response, updated, requestId(response))
77	        : sendFailure(response, 404, 'TICKET_NOT_FOUND', 'التذكرة غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
78	    } catch (error) {
79	      return next(error);
80	    }
81	  });
82	
83	  app.get('/api/v1/site/announcements', ...route(READ_PERMISSION, auth), async (request, response, next) => {
84	    const query = siteContentListSchema.safeParse(request.query as unknown);

87	      const result = await repository.listAnnouncements(query.data);

import React from 'react';
import { Globe, Activity, Users, User, Package, Briefcase, MessageSquare, Megaphone, Shield, Link as LinkIcon, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, Plus, Trash2, Check, X, Eye, Edit2, Send, Server, Key, Lock, Settings as SettingsIcon, ChevronRight, ArrowUpRight, Award, UserCheck, ShieldAlert, Cpu, Phone, Mail, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';

type SiteTab = 'analytics' | 'portal_users' | 'pending' | 'orders' | 'tickets' | 'announcements' | 'jobs' | 'security' | 'api';
type PortalOrder = { id: string; orderNumber?: string; trackingNumber?: string; createdAt?: string | number | Date; customerName?: string; recipientName?: string; customerPhone?: string; deliveryCity?: string; orderSourceName?: string; orderStatus?: string; status?: string; totalPrice?: string | number; totalAmount?: string | number };
export interface PortalOrdersTabProps {
  activeTab: SiteTab;
  isAr: boolean;
  portalOrders: PortalOrder[];
}

export const PortalOrdersTab: React.FC<PortalOrdersTabProps> = (props) => {
  const { activeTab, isAr, portalOrders } = props;

  return (
    <>
      {/* ── TAB 3: Web Portal Orders ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'orders' && (
        <div className="space-y-4 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-[#0a0a0c] border border-white/[0.04] p-4 rounded-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              {isAr ? 'استقبال وتوجيه طلبات البوابة الإلكترونية' : 'Web Portal Orders Routing'}
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold">{portalOrders.length} طلبات موقع</span>
          </div>

          {portalOrders.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-slate-500 space-y-2 bg-[#0a0a0c] border border-white/[0.04] rounded-3xl">
              <Package className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-slate-600" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{isAr ? 'لا توجد طلبات جديدة من البوابة حالياً' : 'No web portal orders found'}</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="bg-[#0a0a0c] border border-white/[0.04] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-xs text-right text-slate-300">
                  <thead className="bg-black/50 text-slate-400 font-bold border-b border-white/[0.05]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-3.5">رقم الطلب</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">التاريخ</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">العميل / المستلم</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">مصدر الشراء</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">الحالة</th>
                      <th className="p-3.5">الإجمالي</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/[0.03]">
                    {portalOrders.map(ord => (
                      <tr key={ord.id} className="hover:bg-white/[0.02]">
                        <td className="p-3.5 font-bold font-mono text-[#d4af37]">{ord.orderNumber || ord.trackingNumber || ord.id.slice(0, 10)}</td>
                        <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-400">{ord.createdAt ? new Date(ord.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB') : '—'}</td>
                        <td className="p-3.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-white">{ord.customerName || ord.recipientName || '—'}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{ord.customerPhone || ord.deliveryCity}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3.5"><span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-[10px] font-bold">{ord.orderSourceName || 'البوابة'}</span></td>
                        <td className="p-3.5"><span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 text-[10px] font-bold">{ord.orderStatus || ord.status || 'معلق'}</span></td>
                        <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-white">{ord.totalPrice || ord.totalAmount || 0} YER</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default PortalOrdersTab;

56	  'delivery_courier_id AS "deliveryCourierId"', 'shipping_courier_id AS "shippingCourierId"',
57	  'currency', 'order_currency AS "orderCurrency"', 'order_currency_price AS "orderCurrencyPrice"',
58	  'external_order_number AS "externalOrderNumber"',
59	  // المبالغ تسكن `orders.data` (jsonb)؛ تُقرأ كنص ويُرجع تحليلها للطبقة المستهلكة كما كان الحال في المحوّل القديم.
60	  // Amounts live in the orders.data jsonb; projected as text and parsed by the consuming layer, like the legacy adapter did.
61	  `data->>'amountPaid' AS "amountPaid"`, `data->>'amountRemaining' AS "amountRemaining"`,
62	  `data->>'totalCostYER' AS "totalCostYER"`, `data->>'paymentStatus' AS "paymentStatus"`,
63	  'created_at AS "createdAt"', 'updated_at AS "updatedAt"',
64	].join(', ');
65	
66	async function page(
67	  pool: Pool,
68	  table: string,
69	  columns: string,
70	  order: string,
71	  input: PageQuery,
72	  searchColumns: string[],
73	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
74	  const values: unknown[] = [];
75	  const filters: string[] = [];
76	  if (input.search) {
77	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
78	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
79	  }
80	  if (input.customerId) {
81	    values.push(input.customerId);
82	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
83	  }
84	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
85	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
86	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
87	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
88	    values,
89	  );
90	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
91	}

93	function statusRank(status: string): number {
94	  const normalized = status.trim().toLowerCase();
95	  const ranks: Record<string, number> = {
96	    pending: 0,
97	    new: 0,
98	    created: 0,
99	    'قيد الطلب': 0,
100	    confirmed: 1,
101	    processing: 1,
102	    'قيد التجهيز': 1,
103	    shipped: 2,
104	    in_transit: 2,
105	    'تم الشحن': 2,
106	    delivered: 3,
107	    completed: 3,
108	    'تم التسليم': 3,
109	    cancelled: 4,
110	    canceled: 4,
111	    ملغي: 4,
112	  };
113	  return ranks[normalized] ?? -1;
114	}

      const rows = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
        `SELECT ${jobApplicationColumns} FROM public.jobs_req jr${where}
          ORDER BY jr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, jr.jobs_req_id DESC
          LIMIT $${params.length + 1} OFFSET $${params.length + 2}`,
        [...params, input.limit, input.offset],
      );
      return { items: rows.rows.map(mapJobApplication), total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };
    },

    async updateJobApplicationStatus({ jobRequestId, status }) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `UPDATE public.jobs_req
            SET data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('status', $2, 'updatedAt', $3::double precision),
                updated_at = now()
          WHERE jobs_req_id = $1`,
        [jobRequestId, status, Date.now()],
      );
      if ((result.rowCount ?? 0) === 0) return null;
      const read = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
        `SELECT ${jobApplicationColumns} FROM public.jobs_req jr WHERE jr.jobs_req_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
        [jobRequestId],
      );
      return read.rows[0] ? mapJobApplication(read.rows[0]) : null;
    },

    async deleteJobApplication(jobRequestId) {
      const result = await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.jobs_req WHERE jobs_req_id = $1', [jobRequestId]);
      return (result.rowCount ?? 0) > 0;
    },
  };
}
