- التصنيف التشغيلي للحركة يأتي من `entry_module.code` (CUSTODY/SALARIES/EXPENSES/ORDERS/RECEIPTS…) و`entry_type.code` (ORDER_PAYMENT/RECEIPT_VOUCHER/PAYMENT_VOUCHER/SALARY_PAYMENT…) عبر `LEFT JOIN`؛ أما `main_entry.entry_category` فيبقى قيمته `General/Compound/Temp/Reversing` ولا يصلح تصنيفًا للأنشطة — وهذا سبب الفجوة التي أُغلقت بإضافة `moduleCode`/`entryTypeCode` إلى `movementColumns`.
- `orders`: حقول المال (`amountPaid`, `amountRemaining`, `totalCostYER`, `paymentStatus`) مخزَّنة داخل `orders.data` jsonb ولا أعمدة لها؛ يُقرأ منها بـ `data->>'amountPaid' AS "amountPaid"` كنص. أي ترحيل مستقبلي يحوّلها لأعمدة رقمية يجب أن يبقي النسخة النصية حتى لا ينكسر مسار الكشف.
- `couriers`: القراءة المفردة `WHERE courier_id = $1` تستخدم نفس `courierColumns` المستخدمة في `INSERT/UPDATE ... RETURNING`، فالملف المعروض مطابق تمامًا لما يُكتب.
- `customers`: حدود القراءة في `0008_customers_read_boundary.sql` تستبعد `phone` عمدًا؛ لذلك كشف العميل يعرض المعرّف بدل الهاتف. إضافة الهاتف تتطلب قرار صلاحيات + ترحيل حدود، لا حيلة في الواجهة.
- الترحيلات 0021/0022/0023 ما زالت معلّقة وهي شرط لنشر كود alx_api الجديد (مسارات الحركات المرشّحة و`GET /api/v1/operations/couriers/:id`).

import type { FinanceEntriesGateway } from '../../contracts/finance-entries.gateway';
import type { FinanceEntryViewModel } from '../../../features/financeEntries/types';
import type { GatewayPage, GatewayQuery } from '../../contracts/common.gateway';
import { supabase } from '../supabase.client';
import { mapRow, mapSupabaseError } from '../supabase.mapper';

const mapEntry = (row: Record<string, unknown>): FinanceEntryViewModel => ({
  entryId: String(row.main_entry_id ?? ''),
  status: String(row.posting_status ?? ''),
});

export class CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway implements FinanceEntriesGateway {
  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<FinanceEntryViewModel>> {
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
    const { data, error, count } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' }).range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    const items = (data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapEntry));
    return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
  }

  async getById(id: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel | null> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').select('main_entry_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('main_entry_id', id).maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return data ? mapRow(data, mapEntry) : null;
  }

  async post(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'posted', posted_by_uid: actorId, posted_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
  }

  async reverse(entryId: string, actorId: string): Promise<FinanceEntryViewModel> {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('main_entry').update({ posting_status: 'voided', voided_by_uid: actorId, voided_at: now, updated_by_uid: actorId, updated_at: now }).eq('main_entry_id', entryId).select('main_entry_id,posting_status,created_at,updated_at').single();
    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
    return mapRow(data, mapEntry);
  }
}

## Summary
تم تتبع المسارات الخمسة من طبقة الواجهة (frontend) إلى طبقة المسارات (routes) ثم المستودعات (repositories) ثم ملفات الترحيل (migrations). الخلاصة أن مساري default-accounts وaccount-movements يمران من التحقق بمخطط zod بنجاح عند limit=1000/100 ثم يفشلان داخل استعلامات SQL في المستودع، وأن فشل account-movements يرجَّح بقوة إلى مرجعة المستودع لعمود باسم قديم في جدول account_trans لا تنشئه أي ترحيلات موجودة، وأن جدول products لا يوجد أي DDL لإنشائه داخل المستودع مع وجود ترحيل في الجذر يحذف عمود is_allowed بينما ترحيل لاحق في alx_api يعيد إضافته يدويًا. المسار الرابع (limit=1500) يُرفض قبل المستودع لأن حد limit الأقصى في مخطط الصفحة هو 1000. أما GET على مستخدم بوابة واحد بالمعرّف فليس له أي مسار GET مطابق في الخادم أصلًا، وسقف app.ts يعيد 404 لهذا المسار، لذا أي 400 مرصود له مصدر خارج مطابقة مسارات alx_api (لم يُعثر على مُعالِج يعيد 400 لهذا الشكل داخل الخادم).

## Implementation Details

### 1) GET /api/v1/finance/default-accounts?limit=1000&offset=0 → 500
- `finance.routes.ts` (L663): المسار مسجّل بمعالج `pageHandler` فوق `repository.listDefaultAccounts`، والصلاحية المطلوبة `view_financial_accounts` (عبر الوسيطين في L40-42). معالج الصفحة في L43-61 يفشل بـ400 فقط عند فشل `pageQuerySchema`؛ حد limit الأقصى 1000 (finance.schemas.ts L5-14) أي أن limit=1000 يمر.
- `finance.repository.ts` — `listDefaultAccounts` (L500-512): استعلاما عدّ وصفحة على public.default_accounts؛ قائمة الأعمدة `defaultAccountColumns` (L59) تطلب `default_account_id AS "defaultAccountId"` وترتيب بـdefault_key.
- الترحيل: الجدول أُنشئ في الجذر باسم `202608270030_create_accounting_hierarchy_schema.sql` (L57-67) بمفتاح اسمه id؛ أُعيدت تسمية المفتاح إلى default_account_id في `202609170001_rename_primary_keys_to_table_id.sql` (سطر إعادة التسمية عند L289). لا يوجد في alx_api أي ترحيل ينشئ default_accounts؛ الوحيد هو منح DELETE في 0023 (L29). أي أن نجاح المسار مشروط بتنفيذ ترحيل إعادة التسمية في قاعدة التشغيل؛ بدونه يفشل عمود default_account_id في 202609170001 وقد لا يكون نُفِّذ، وهو ما يتسق مع 500 المرصود. لا يشير SQL إلى data->> ولا إلى أي view.

### 2) GET /api/v1/finance/account-movements?limit=100&offset=0 → 500
- `finance.routes.ts` (L161-171): الصلاحية `view_account_movements`؛ التحقق عبر `accountMovementsQuerySchema` الممتد من مخطط الصفحة (finance.schemas.ts L253-255؛ limit الأقصى 1000) فالاستدعاء بـ100 يمر ويُدخل المستودع.
- `finance.repository.ts` — `listAllAccountMovements` (L191-204): عدّ وحصر على public.account_trans مع JOIN بـpublic.main_entry على الشرط me.main_entry_id = at.main_entry_id وبمرشّح posting_status等于posted، ثم نفس الوصلة في استعلام الصفوف. قوائم الأعمدة `movementColumns` (L23) و`movementFrom` (L27) تطلب أيضًا at.main_entry_id وme.entry_number وet.code وem.code بوصلة LEFT JOIN على et.id وem.id في entry_type وentry_module.
- التناقض مع DDL: `202608270100_create_financial_entry_core.sql` ينشئ account_trans (L87-116) بعمود مرجع اسمه entry_id لا main_entry_id، وmain_entry بمرجع module_id وentry_type_id (L40-44). `202609170001` يعيد تسمية المفاتيح فقط: main_entry_id عند L253 وaccount_trans_id عند L256 وentry_module_id L202 وentry_type_id L205 — البحث عن أي إعادة تسمية لـentry_id إلى main_entry_id لم يُرجع نتيجة في كل الترحيلات. كما أن وصلات `movementFrom` (L27) تستخدم et.id وem.id بينما الترحيل 202609170001 أعاد تسمية هذين المفتاحين إلى entry_type_id/entry_module_id، فعمود id لم يعد موجودًا في entry_type/entry_module بعد الترحيل. هذا يجعل استعلام account-movements مرجَّحًا بقوة للفشل (عمود غير موجود) → خطأ pg → `next(error)` في routes L168-169 → 500 من مولد الأخطاء في app.ts (L190-207). ملاحظة عدم يقين: لم أُتحقق كامل محتوى ترحيل استخراج الأعمدة 20261002023000؛ إن كان قد أضاف main_entry_id أو أبقى id في entry_type/entry_module فقد يختلف التشخيص.

### 3) GET /api/v1/products?limit=1000&offset=0 → 500

- `operations.repository.ts` — `listProducts` (L217-225): يقرأ من public.products عبر الدالة المساعدة `page` (L66-80) بإسقاط يتضمن `is_allowed AS "isAllowed"` و`item_category_id` و`unit_price` و`cbm` و`width`/`height`/`length`/`weight` و`created_by`/`updated_by`، وبحث ILIKE على product_name_ar/product_name_en/product_id. لا يستخدم data->>.

### 5) GET /api/v1/portal/admin/users/puser_t01o26ftv → 400
- `portal-admin.routes.ts` (L31 وL38 وL57 وL81 وL92 وL103): توجد فقط GET قائمة، POST، PATCH/:id، POST/:id/approval، POST/:id/disabled، DELETE/:id — لا يوجد أي GET لمستخدم واحد بالمعرّف. القائمة بصلاحية view_users وتتحقق بـ`portalAdminListSchema` (رسالة 400 عند فشلها في L33).
- `app.ts` (L186-188): كل /api/v1 غير المطابق يسقط إلى سقف يعيد 404 بشيفرة ROUTE_NOT_FOUND، ومولد الأخطاء يعيد 400 فقط عند خطأ تحليل JSON من الجسم (L195-197) — أي GET بلا جسم لن يُنتج 400 من alx_api لهذا المسار. الخلاصة الموثّقة: المسار غير معرّف أصلًا؛ أي 400 مرصود مصدره وسيط/خادم استضافة خارج مسارات alx_api التي تتبعتها، وليس معالجًا في الخادم نفسه (لم أعثر على أي معالج GET مطابق يعيد 400 لهذا الشكل).

### التسجيل في app.ts وserver.ts
- `app.ts`: الاستيراد والتسجيل — operations عند السطرين 14 و164، finance عند 16 و165، portalAdmin عند 32 و178؛ جميعها مشروطة بمرور المستودع المطابق في options. `server.ts` (alx_api): ربط createOperationsRepository وcreateFinanceRepository وportalAdmin عند الأسطر 74-75 و84؛ عند غياب قاعدة البيانات لا تُسجَّل هذه المسارات فيسقط النداء إلى سقف 404، وليس 500 — أي أن 500 المرصود يعني المسارات مسجّلة وأن الفشل من داخل SQL نفسه، وهو ما يؤكد فرض "معرَّف لكن المستودع يخطئ عند غياب جدول/عمود" المطلوبة.

## Code Flow Analysis
1. واجهة: `accountingHierarchyService.ts:readRows(default-accounts, limit 1000)` و`entityLedgerService.ts:MOVEMENTS_PATH` و`productService.ts:fetchProducts(limit 1000)` و`FinanceEntriesPage.tsx:line 74 (limit 1500)` → apiClient إلى /api/v1.
2. `alx_api/src/server.ts` يبني app مع المستودعات المرتبطة بالـpool → `createApp` يسجّل `registerFinanceRoutes` و`registerOperationsRoutes` و`registerPortalAdminRoutes` (app.ts L164-L178).
3. الوسائط `requireAuthenticatedUser` ثم `requirePermission` (routes L40-42) ثم تحقق zod (400 عند تجاوز limit أو مطابقة قائمة portal).
4. المستودعات تنفذ SQL مباشرة على pg pool؛ أي خطأ pg (عمود/جدول مفقود حسب التحليل أعلاه) يمر عبر next إلى `app.ts errorHandler` (L190-206) فيُعاد 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.
5. المسارات غير المطابقة (مثل GET لمستخدم بوابة واحد) تصل إلى سقف app.ts L186-188 (404 من alx_api؛ الـ400 المرصود من مصدر وسيط خارج المسارات المسجّلة).

import 'dotenv/config';
import { Pool } from 'pg';

async function main() {
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
  });

  for (const table of ['couriers', 'employees', 'users']) {
    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable 
       FROM information_schema.columns 
       WHERE table_name = $1 AND table_schema = 'public'
       ORDER BY ordinal_position`,
      [table]
    );
    console.log(`=== ${table.toUpperCase()} COLUMNS ===`);
    for (const r of res.rows) {
      console.log(`  ${r.column_name}: ${r.data_type} (nullable: ${r.is_nullable})`);
    }
  }

  await pool.end();
}

main().catch(console.error);

```ts
// جلب كل صفحات القائمة ضمن سقف الـ API (1000 لكل صفحة) — pages through the API's 1000-row page cap instead of over-requesting.
const readAllPages = async (path: string, pageSize = 1000, maxRows = 5000): Promise<UnknownRecord[]> => {
  const rows: UnknownRecord[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
    const pageRows = unwrapList(await apiClient.get<unknown>(path, { limit: pageSize, offset }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })));
    rows.push(...pageRows);
    if (pageRows.length < pageSize) break;
  }
  return rows;
};
```

Important findings:
- The flat `notifications` columns exist but are NULL for most rows (title/message/creator_name null, is_read null) while `data` holds the values (188/201 rows have title/message/creatorName in data). So earlier migrations added columns but never backfilled! That's a real gap: the sections read `data` because flat columns are empty.
- `settings`: setting_id is the doc key (e.g. 'general', 'logistics', 'dashboard_...'), category mostly NULL; the payload lives in `data`. END IF;\n  RETURN trunc(raw::numeric)::integer;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;\nEND $$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_boolean(raw text)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n  RETURN btrim(raw)::boolean;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;\nEND $$;\n\n-- يقبل الطابع ISO أو milliseconds epoch — accepts ISO timestamps or epoch milliseconds.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(raw text)\nRETURNS timestamptz LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; Confirmed: `setActivityLogs` and `setDbSessions` are declared but never called → both sections are permanently empty. This is a leftover from the legacy→API migration (the old Firestore listeners were removed without replacements). That's a real, root-caused gap.

Fix plan:
1. alx_api: new `activity-logs` module: 
   - GET /api/v1/activity-logs?limit&offset&search&userId&category → reads activity_logs flat columns (user_name/user_role come from migration 0026; until then user_id).
   - POST /api/v1/activity-logs → writes (userId, userName, userRole, action, target, details) — the frontend service calls it.
   - Also GET /api/v1/users/:id/sessions for admin sessions view.
2. Frontend: 
   - activityLogService.log() → POST to API (fire and forget) + a `list()` method.
   - UserManagementPage: load activityLogs from API + dbSessions from API.
   - alxListSessions: unwrap { sessions }.

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import { AuthServiceError } from '../auth/auth.use-cases';
import { entityIdSchema, pageQuerySchema } from '../operations/operations.schemas';
import type { UsersRepository } from './users.contracts';
import { adminResetPasswordSchema, createUserSchema, provisionUserSchema, setUserRolesSchema, updateUserSchema, verifyPinSchema } from './users.schemas';

function requestId(response: Response): string {
  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
}
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {
  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
}

export function registerUsersRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: UsersRepository,
): void {
  app.get('/api/v1/users', ...route('view_users', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
    if (!query.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const result = await repository.listUsers(query.data);
      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/v1/users/:id', ...route('view_users', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
    if (!parsed.success)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const result = await repository.getUser(parsed.data);
      return result
        ? sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response))
        : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'المستخدم غير موجود.', requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return next(error);
    }
  });

  /** Creates a profile only; the password is established by a one-time reset link. */
  app.post('/api/v1/users/provision', ...route('add_users', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {

    const actorId = principalId(response);
    if (!body.success || !auth)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PROVISIONING_INPUT', 'بيانات إنشاء المستخدم الآمن غير صالحة.', requestId(response));

10	   SET user_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(user_name, ''), data->>'userName'),

12	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';

14	-- تفاصيل الحدث سطر/قيمة بدل كرة jsonb — one row per detail key instead of a jsonb blob.
15	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.activity_log_detail (
16	  activity_log_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.activity_logs (activity_log_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
17	  field_name text NOT NULL,
18	  field_value text,
19	  PRIMARY KEY (activity_log_id, field_name)
20	);
21	
22	INSERT INTO public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id, field_name, field_value)
23	     SELECT a.activity_log_id, x.key, x.value #>> '{}'
24	       FROM public.activity_logs a, jsonb_each(a.data->'details') AS x(key, value)
25	      WHERE jsonb_typeof(a.data->'details') = 'object'
26	        AND jsonb_typeof(x.value) <> 'object'
27	     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
28	
29	-- القيم المتداخلة (كائن داخل تفاصيل) تُسطّر بمسار منقّط — nested values flatten to dotted paths.
30	INSERT INTO public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id, field_name, field_value)
31	     SELECT a.activity_log_id, x.key || '.' || y.key, y.value #>> '{}'
32	       FROM public.activity_logs a
33	       JOIN jsonb_each(a.data->'details') AS x(key, value) ON jsonb_typeof(x.value) = 'object'
34	       CROSS JOIN jsonb_each(x.value) AS y(key, value)
35	     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
36	
37	-- ملخص نصي قابل للعرض مباشرة في الواجهة — a plain-text summary for direct rendering.
38	UPDATE public.activity_logs
39	   SET details = COALESCE(NULLIF(details, ''), data->>'details')
40	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data->'details') = 'string';

42	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS activity_log_detail_log_idx
43	  ON public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id);
44	
45	ALTER TABLE public.activity_log_detail DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
46	
47	GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.activity_logs, public.activity_log_detail TO alx_api_runtime;

1	-- alx_api Auth persistence foundation.
2	-- Intentionally creates objects only in a non-public schema.
3	-- No RLS/GRANTS statements and no legacy credential data is copied.
4	
5	CREATE SCHEMA alx_api_private;
6	
7	CREATE TABLE alx_api_private.user_credentials (
8	  user_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
9	  password_hash text NOT NULL,
10	  password_algorithm text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'argon2id',
11	  password_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
12	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
13	  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
14	  CONSTRAINT user_credentials_algorithm_check CHECK (password_algorithm = 'argon2id'),
15	  CONSTRAINT user_credentials_password_version_check CHECK (password_version >= 1),
16	  CONSTRAINT user_credentials_argon2id_hash_check CHECK (password_hash LIKE '$argon2id$%')
17	);
18	
19	CREATE TABLE alx_api_private.user_security (
20	  user_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
21	  failed_login_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
22	  locked_until timestamptz,
23	  last_login_at timestamptz,
24	  last_password_change_at timestamptz,
25	  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
26	  CONSTRAINT user_security_failed_attempts_check CHECK (failed_login_attempts >= 0)
27	);
28	
29	CREATE TABLE alx_api_private.api_sessions (
30	  session_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
31	  user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
32	  device_name text,
33	  user_agent text,
34	  ip_address text,
35	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
36	  last_used_at timestamptz,
37	  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
38	  revoked_at timestamptz,
39	  revoke_reason text,
40	  CONSTRAINT api_sessions_expiry_check CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
41	);
42	CREATE INDEX api_sessions_user_expiry_idx ON alx_api_private.api_sessions(user_id, expires_at);
43	
44	CREATE TABLE alx_api_private.api_refresh_tokens (
45	  token_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
46	  session_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES alx_api_private.api_sessions(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { ReportingRepository, ReportingResource } from './reporting.contracts';
import { pageQuerySchema } from '../operations/operations.schemas';

const resources: Record<string, { resource: ReportingResource; permission: string }> = {
  expenses: { resource: 'expenses', permission: 'view_expenses' },
  couriers: { resource: 'couriers', permission: 'view_couriers' },
  employees: { resource: 'employees', permission: 'view_employees' },
  sources: { resource: 'sources', permission: 'view_sources' },
  'shipping-companies': { resource: 'shippingCompanies', permission: 'view_shipping_companies' },
  users: { resource: 'users', permission: 'view_users' },
  'activity-logs': { resource: 'activityLogs', permission: 'view_dashboard' },
  'report-templates': { resource: 'reportTemplates', permission: 'view_reports' },
};

export function registerReportingRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: ReportingRepository,
): void {
  for (const [path, definition] of Object.entries(resources)) {
    app.get(
      `/api/v1/reporting/${path}`,
      requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),
      requirePermission(auth, definition.permission),
      async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
        const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId);
        const parsed = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
        if (!parsed.success)
          return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_REPORTING_QUERY', 'معاملات التقرير غير صالحة.', requestId);
        try {
          const result = await repository.list(definition.resource, parsed.data);
          return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId, { ...parsed.data, total: result.total });
        } catch (error) {
          return next(error);
        }
      },
    );
  }
}

{
  "content": "/**\n * activity-logs.repository.ts\n * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n * وصول البيانات لوحدة سجل النشاط (Activity Logs data access).\n * Reads the flattened activity_logs columns plus the activity_log_detail child rows,\n * and writes through the shared audit writer so every module records events identically.\n */\n\nimport type { Pool } from 'pg';\nimport type { PageResult } from '../operations/operations.contracts';\nimport { insertActivityLog, insertActivityLogDetails } from '../../core/audit/activity-audit';\nimport type {\n  ActivityLogPageQuery,\n  ActivityLogsRepository,\n  CreateActivityLogInput,\n} from './activity-logs.contracts';\n\nexport function createActivityLogsRepository(pool: Pool): ActivityLogsRepository {\n  return {\n    async list(input: ActivityLogPageQuery): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {\n      const values: unknown[] = [];\n      const filters: string[] = [];\n      if (input.userId) {\n        values.push(input.userId);\n        filters.push(`al.user_id = $${values.length}`);\n      }\n      if (input.action) {\n        values.push(input.action);\n        filters.push(`al.action = $${values.length}`);\n      }\n      if (input.search) {\n        values.push(`%${input.search}%`);\n        const needle = values.length;\n        filters.push(`(al.action ILIKE $${needle} OR al.target ILIKE $${needle} OR al.summary ILIKE $${needle} OR al.user_name ILIKE $${needle})`);\n      }\n      const where = filters.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';\n      values.push(input.limit, input.offset);\n\n      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(\n        `SELECT al.activity_log_id AS \"activityLogId\",\n                al.action, al.category, al.target, al.type, al.summary,\n                al.user_id AS \"userId\", al.user_name AS \"userName\", al.user_role AS \"userRole\",\n                al.created_at AS \"createdAt\",\n                COALESCE(fields.aggregated, '{}'::jsonb) AS \"details\",\n                count(*) OVER()::text AS _total\n           FROM public.activity_logs al\n           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n             SELECT jsonb_object_agg(d.field_name, d.field_value) AS aggregated\n               FROM public.activity_log_detail d\n              WHERE d.activity_log_id = al.activity_log_id\n           ) AS fields ON TRUE\n           ${where}\n          ORDER BY al.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, al.activity_log_id ASC\n          LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,\n        values,\n      );\n\n      return {\n        items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row),\n        total: Number(result.rows[0]?.['_total'] ?? 0),\n      };\n    },\n\n    async create(input: CreateActivityLogInput): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {\n      const client = await pool.connect();\n      try {\n        await client.query('BEGIN');\n        const activityLogId = await insertActivityLog(client, {\n          action: input.action,\n          ...(input.category !== undefined ? { category: input.category } : {}),\n          ...(input.target !== undefined ? { target: input.target } : {}),\n          ...(input.summary !== undefined ? { summary: input.summary } : {}),\n          actorUserId: input.actorUserId,\n        });\n        if (!activityLogId) {\n          await client.query('ROLLBACK');\n          return null;\n        }\n        if (input.details) await insertActivityLogDetails(client, activityLogId, input.details);\n        await client.query('COMMIT');\n      } catch (error) {\n        await client.query('ROLLBACK');\n        throw error;\n      } finally {\n        client.release();\n      }\n\n      const created = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(\n        `SELECT al.activity_log_id AS \"activityLogId\",\n                al.action, al.category, al.target, al.type, al.summary,\n                al.user_id AS \"userId\", al.user_name AS \"userName\", al.user_role AS \"userRole\",\n                al.created_at AS \"createdAt\"\n           FROM public.activity_logs al WHERE al.activity_log_id = (\n             SELECT max(activity_log_id) FROM public.activity_logs WHERE created_by = $1 AND action = $2\n           )`,\n        [input.actorUserId, input.action],\n      );\n      return created.rows[0] ?? null;\n    },\n  };\n}\n",

'');\n}\nfunction principal(response: Response): { userId: string; sessionId: string } | undefined {\n  return response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId: string; sessionId: string } | undefined;\n}\n\nexport function registerActivityLogsRoutes(\n  app: Express,\n  _environment: ApiEnvironment,\n  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,\n  repository: ActivityLogsRepository,\n): void {\n  app.get(\n    '/api/v1/activity-logs',\n    requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),\n    requirePermission(auth, 'view_users'),\n    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n      const parsed = activityLogPageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);\n      if (!parsed.success)\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ACTIVITY_LOG_QUERY', 'معاملات سجل النشاط غير صالحة.', requestId(response));\n      try {\n        const result = await repository.list(parsed.data);\n        return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...parsed.data, total: result.total });\n      } catch (error) {\n        return next(error);\n      }\n    },\n  );\n\n  app.post(\n    '/api/v1/activity-logs',\n    requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),\n    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n      const parsed = createActivityLogSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);\n      const actor = principal(response);\n      if (!parsed.success || !actor)\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ACTIVITY_LOG_INPUT', 'بيانات سجل النشاط غير صالحة.', requestId(response));\n      try {\n        const created = await repository.create({\n          action: parsed.data.action,\n          ...(parsed.data.category !== undefined ? { category: parsed.data.category } : {}),\n          ...(parsed.data.target !== undefined ? { target: parsed.data.target } : {}),\n          ...(parsed.data.summary !== undefined ? { summary: parsed.data.summary } : {}),\n          ...(parsed.data.details !== undefined ? { details: parsed.data.details } : {}),\n          actorUserId: actor.userId,\n        });\n        return created\n          ? sendSuccess(response, created, requestId(response))\n          : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ACTOR_NOT_FOUND', 'تعذر تسجيل النشاط لهذا الحساب.', requestId(response));\n      } catch (error) {\n        return next(error);\n      }\n    },\n  );\n}\n",
  "file_path": "F:\\system\\swiftship-tracker\\swiftshift2\\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\\alx_api\\src\\modules\\activity-logs\\activity-logs.routes.ts"
}

  const logger = options.logger ?? pino({ level: environment.nodeEnv === 'test' ? 'silent' : environment.logLevel });
  const readiness = options.readiness ?? (() => ({ database: false }));
  const app = express();

  app.set('trust proxy', environment.nodeEnv === 'production' ? 1 : false);
  app.use(requestIdMiddleware);
  app.use(
    pinoHttp({
      logger,
      genReqId(_request, response) {
        return String(response.locals.requestId);
      },
      redact: ['req.headers.authorization', 'req.headers.cookie'],
      serializers: {
        req(request) {
          return { id: request.id, method: request.method, url: request.url };
        },
      },
    }),

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

Many call sites spread whole form objects (e.g. `{ ...editFormData }`, `{ ...shippingFormData }`, `{ ...formData }`) — all flat scalars (strings/booleans/numbers). Some may have nested arrays (e.g. `permissions` array?). `{ id: roleFormData.id, permCount: roleFormData.permissions.length }` — number. `{ ...editFormData }` in shipping company form — flat.

But `editDbCurrencyForm` spread might contain arrays. The API schema rejects arrays/objects → POST 400 and the log is lost. To be robust without weakening the API: the service should serialize non-scalar values to a string summary before sending (e.g., Array → joined, object → JSON string truncated). That keeps the API contract strict (scalars only) while never losing an action.

So in activityLogService: flatten details:
```ts
const toDetailValue = (value: unknown): string | number | boolean | null => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(v => String(v)).join(', ');
  return JSON.stringify(value).slice(0, 300);
};
```
Numbers must be finite: `Number.isFinite(value) ? value : String(value)`.

Now write the corrected 0010 migration. Design decisions:

- `public.notifications` already exists as a legacy table; 0010 should not create it. Instead 0010 owns the outbox table + grants. Notifications flat-column guarantee belongs to 0025.
- Outbox: no payload jsonb. Add `notification_id text REFERENCES public.notifications(notification_id) ON DELETE SET NULL`? notifications.notification_id is text. Fine — but referencing before notifications exists? It exists in the legacy DB. However for a fresh DB (test schema?), the repo has no migration creating public.notifications... Let's check whether an earlier migration creates notifications table. Grep showed only 0010/0025/0034 mention notifications. So 0010 is the only place creating the notifications table for a fresh environment. The live DB has the legacy table. Hmm — the fictional CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is actually useful for fresh environments, but wrong columns.

Better: 0010 creates `public.notifications` with the full flat schema (matching what live DB has after 0025) using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, since it's the only definer. Columns: notification_id text PK, user_id text, title text, message text, type text, category text, is_public boolean, is_read boolean, read boolean (legacy dup — avoid; but live has it. For fresh table we don't need `read`), creator_id text, creator_name text, associated_user_ids text[], created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by.

But careful: if live DB already has notifications with `data jsonb`, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is a no-op, and 0025 does the flattening/ALTERs. And the text[] cast in 0025 on live works. For fresh, associated_user_ids already text[] → 0025's `ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE text[] USING` with jsonb_typeof check would fail on a text[] column (jsonb_typeof(text[]) → error "cannot execute jsonb_typeof against..."). Actually `CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'array'` with text[] arg → Postgres will error: jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) needs jsonb; text[] is not implicitly cast → "function jsonb_typeof(text[]) does not exist". So 0025 is not fresh-safe. I should make 0025 robust: wrap the cast in a DO block that checks information_schema for data_type='jsonb'. Also 0025's initial UPDATE assumes `data` column exists — for fresh table, `data` doesn't exist → error "column "data" does not exist".

Simplest and cleanest: split responsibilities.
- 0010: create outbox only (+ grants, RLS). Also ensure schema alx_api_private.
- 0025: guard the legacy-jsonb migration with DO blocks so it works on both fresh and live DBs:
  - If `data` column exists → run backfill inside DO with helper availability (0024 provides alx_api_private.payload_boolean; if absent, use plain ->> with coalesce... 0024 must be applied first; that's the documented order).
  - ALTER COLUMN only if it is jsonb.
  - Add flat columns IF NOT EXISTS so fresh DBs (created how?) ... hmm, in a fresh DB who creates public.notifications? Nobody in repo. So the fresh path isn't really supported by repo migrations anyway — the DB is the legacy Supabase one. So I shouldn't over-engineer for a hypothetical fresh DB. Keep 0025 targeting the real legacy table (which has data jsonb), and add `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` guards for all flat columns it writes — that's cheap insurance and documents the contract. But `ALTER COLUMN associated_user_ids TYPE text[] USING (jsonb...)` would break on re-run after conversion. Wrap in a DO block checking data_type='jsonb' → idempotent.

Also need `data` column existence guard: `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` for flat columns is fine; but the big UPDATE references `data` — if data absent (after 0034 drops it) the migration fails on re-run. Wrap in DO with a column-existence check. Good: idempotent and re-runnable after 0034.

    text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_by         text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at         timestamptz,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at         timestamptz;\n\n-- data->>'type'),\n           category     = COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''),     data->>'category'),\n           creator_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(creator_id, ''),   data->>'creatorId'),\n user_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''),      data->>'userId')\n     WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';\n\n    -- مصفوفة المستلمين: تجمع مصدرها من العمود أو من data قبل jsonb_typeof(data->'associatedUserIds') = 'array'\n                  THEN data->'associatedUserIds' END,\n             '[]'::jsonb)\n     WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object'\n       AND jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'jsonb';\n  END IF;\nEND\n$$;\n\n-- قيود NOT NULL بعد التعبئة — constraints are applied only once the values exist.\nUPDATE public.notifications SET is_read = ALTER COLUMN updated_at SET DEFAULT NOW();\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 3. مستلمو الإشعار: جدول علائقي يحمل حالة القراءة لكل مستلم — one row per recipient.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_recipient (\n  notification_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications (notification_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  user_id text NOT NULL,\n  is_read boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n  read_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),\n  PRIMARY KEY (notification_id, user_id)\n);\n\n-- تحويل عمود المستلمين من jsonb إلى text[] (عمود رئيسي) مرة واحدة فقط — convert jsonb → text[] idempotently.\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns\n     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications'\n       AND column_name = 'associated_user_ids' AND data_type = 'jsonb'\n  ) THEN\n    ALTER TABLE public.notifications\n      ALTER COLUMN associated_user_ids TYPE text[]\n        USING (\n          SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT btrim(x.value #>> '{}'))\n                            FILTER (WHERE btrim(x.value #>> '{}') <> ''),\n                         ARRAY[]::text[])\n            FROM jsonb_array_elements(\n                   CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'array'\n                        THEN associated_user_ids ELSE '[]'::jsonb END\n                 ) AS x(value)\n        );\n  END IF;\nEND\n$$;\n\n-- تعبئة الجدول العلائقي من text[] (أو من الحمولة القديمة إن بقيت) — populate the child table once.\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns\n     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications'\n       AND column_name = 'associated_user_ids' AND data_type = 'ARRAY'\n  ) THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id)\n         SELECT n.notification_id, btrim(r.user_id)\n           FROM public.notifications n\n           CROSS JOIN 12	import type {
13	  ActivityLogPageQuery,
14	  ActivityLogsRepository,
15	  CreateActivityLogInput,
16	} from './activity-logs.contracts';

18	export function createActivityLogsRepository(pool: Pool): ActivityLogsRepository {
19	  return {
20	    async list(input: ActivityLogPageQuery): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
21	      const values: unknown[] = [];
22	      const filters: string[] = [];
23	      if (input.userId) {
24	        values.push(input.userId);
25	        filters.push(`al.user_id = $${values.length}`);
26	      }
27	      if (input.action) {
28	        values.push(input.action);
29	        filters.push(`al.action = $${values.length}`);
30	      }
31	      if (input.search) {
32	        values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
33	        const needle = values.length;
34	        filters.push(`(al.action ILIKE $${needle} OR al.target ILIKE $${needle} OR al.summary ILIKE $${needle} OR al.user_name ILIKE $${needle})`);
35	      }
36	      const where = filters.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
37	      values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
38	
39	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
40	        `SELECT al.activity_log_id AS "activityLogId",
41	                al.action, al.category, al.target, al.type, al.summary,
42	                al.user_id AS "userId", al.user_name AS "userName", al.user_role AS "userRole",
43	                al.created_at AS "createdAt",
44	                COALESCE(fields.aggregated, '{}'::jsonb) AS "details",
45	                count(*) OVER()::text AS _total
46	           FROM public.activity_logs al
47	           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
48	             SELECT jsonb_object_agg(d.field_name, d.field_value) AS aggregated
49	               FROM public.activity_log_detail d
50	              WHERE d.activity_log_id = al.activity_log_id
51	           ) AS fields ON TRUE
52	           ${where}
53	          ORDER BY al.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, al.activity_log_id ASC
54	          LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
55	        values,
56	      );
57	
58	      return {
59	        items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => ({ ...row, id: String(row['activityLogId'] ?? '') })),
60	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?.['_total'] ?? 0),
61	      };
62	    },
63	
64	    async create(input: CreateActivityLogInput): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
65	      const client = await pool.connect();
66	      let created: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
67	      try {
68	        await client.query('BEGIN');
69	        created = await insertActivityLog(client, {
70	          action: input.action,
71	          ...(input.category !== undefined ? { category: input.category } : {}),
72	          ...(input.target !== undefined ? { target: input.target } : {}),
73	          ...(input.summary !== undefined ? { summary: input.summary } : {}),
74	          actorUserId: input.actorUserId,
75	        });
76	        if (!created) {
77	          await client.query('ROLLBACK');
78	          return null;
79	        }
80	        const activityLogId = String(created['activityLogId']);
81	        if (input.details) await insertActivityLogDetails(client, activityLogId, input.details);
82	        await client.query('COMMIT');
83	      } catch (error) {
84	        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
85	        throw error;
86	      } finally {
87	        client.release();
88	      }
89	      return { ...created, id: String(created['activityLogId']), details: input.details ?? {} };
90	    },
91	  };
92	}

'');\n}\n\n// دالة مساعدة لاستخراج userId من الـ principal المصادق عليه\n// Helper to extract userId from the authenticated principal\nfunction principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {\n  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;\n}\n\n// دالة مساعدة لإنشاء middleware chain للمصادقة والصلاحية\n// Helper to build authentication + permission middleware chain\nfunction route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {\n  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];\n}\n\nexport function registerNotificationsRoutes(\n  app: Express,\n  _environment: ApiEnvironment,\n  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,\n  repository: NotificationsRepository,\n): void {\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 1. GET /api/v1/notifications — قائمة الإشعارات المرئية للمستخدم (فلترة + ترقيم)\n  // List the notifications the authenticated user may see, with filtering and pagination.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.get('/api/v1/notifications', ...route('view_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsed = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);\n      if (!parsed.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'المعاملات غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      // نطاق الظهور:المشاهد هو المستخدم المصادق عليه ما لم يُطلب غيره صراحة.\n      // Visibility scope defaults to the authenticated principal.\n      const viewer = parsed.data.visibilityFor ?? principalId(response);\n\n      const result = await repository.listNotifications({\n        limit: parsed.data.limit,\n        offset: parsed.data.offset,\n        ...(parsed.data.userId !== undefined ? { userId: parsed.data.userId } : {}),\n        ...(viewer !== undefined ? { visibilityFor: viewer } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.isRead !== undefined ? { isRead: parsed.data.isRead } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.category !== undefined ? { category: parsed.data.category } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.search !== undefined ? { search: parsed.data.search } : {}),\n      });\n\n      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), {\n        total: result.total,\n        limit: parsed.data.limit,\n        offset: parsed.data.offset,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 2. POST /api/v1/notifications — إنشاء إشعار داخلي\n  // Create an in-app notification (all fields are flat columns, no payload bag).\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.post('/api/v1/notifications', ...route('manage_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsed = createNotificationSchema.safeParse(request.body);\n      if (!parsed.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'البيانات غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const actorId = principalId(response);\n      const notification = await repository.createNotification({\n        title: parsed.data.title,\n        message: parsed.data.message,\n        type: parsed.data.type,\n        category: parsed.data.category,\n        isPublic: parsed.data.isPublic,\n        ...(parsed.data.userId !== undefined ? { userId: parsed.data.userId } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.associatedUserIds !== undefined ? { associatedUserIds: parsed.data.associatedUserIds } : {}),\n        ...(actorId !== undefined ? { actorId } : {}),\n      });\n\n      return sendSuccess(response, notification, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 3. PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read — تعليم الإشعار كمقروء لهذا المستخدم\n  // Mark one notification as read for the authenticated viewer.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.patch('/api/v1/notifications/:id/read', ...route('view_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsedId = notificationIdSchema.safeParse(request.params['id']);\n      if (!parsedId.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'معرف الإشعار غير صالح.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const userId = principalId(response);\n      const updated = await repository.markAsRead(parsedId.data, ...(userId !== undefined ? [userId] : []));\n      if (!updated) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 404, 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND', 'الإشعار غير موجود أو لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إليه.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      return sendSuccess(response, updated, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 4. POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all — تعليم إشعارات المستخدم كلها كمقروءة\n  // Mark every notification visible to the authenticated user as read.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.post('/api/v1/notifications/read-all', ...route('view_notifications', auth), async (_request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const userId = principalId(response);\n      if (!userId) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 'UNAUTHORIZED' as never as 401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'غير مصرح.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const count = await repository.markAllAsRead(userId);\n      return sendSuccess(response, { updatedCount: count }, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 5. POST /api/v1/notifications/send-external — تسجيل إشعار خارجي في الـ Outbox\n  // Queue an external notification (WhatsApp/Email/SMS) through the transactional outbox.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.post('/api/v1/notifications/send-external', ...route('manage_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsed = sendExternalNotificationSchema.safeParse(request.body);\n      if (!parsed.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'البيانات غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const result = await repository.recordOutboxEvent({\n        recipient: parsed.data.recipient,\n        channel: parsed.data.channel,\n        message: parsed.data.message,\n        ...(parsed.data.templateId !== undefined ? { templateId: parsed.data.templateId } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.idempotencyKey !== undefined ? { idempotencyKey: parsed.data.idempotencyKey } : {}),\n      });\n\n      // 202 Accepted: الإشعار في قائمة الانتظار وليس مرسلاً فوراً\n      // 202 Accepted: the notification is queued, not sent immediately.\n      response.status(202);\n      return sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n}\n",

18	export class NotificationDeliveryProvider implements PasswordResetDelivery {

21	  async send(input: { email: string; token: string; expiresAt: Date }): Promise<void> {
22	    const resetUrl = `${this.options.resetBaseUrl}?token=${encodeURIComponent(input.token)}`;
23	    const subject = 'طلب إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور - SwiftShip / ALX';
24	    const textContent = `مرحباً،\nلقد تلقينا طلباً لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور الخاصة بحسابك.\nيرجى استخدام الرابط التالي للبدء:\n${resetUrl}\n\nينتهي الرابط عند: ${input.expiresAt.toISOString()}`;
25	    const htmlContent = `
26	      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; direction: rtl; text-align: right; padding: 20px;">
27	        <h2>إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور</h2>
28	        <p>مرحباً، لقد تلقينا طلباً لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور الخاصة بحسابك في منصة <strong>SwiftShip / ALX</strong>.</p>
29	        <p>يمكنك تغيير كلمة المرور بالضغط على الزر أدناه:</p>
30	        <div style="margin: 20px 0;">
31	          <a href="${resetUrl}" style="background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block;">إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور</a>
32	        </div>
33	        <p style="color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.9em;">ينتهي الرابط تلقائياً في: ${input.expiresAt.toLocaleString('ar-EG')}</p>
34	      </div>
35	    `;
36	
37	    switch (this.options.provider) {
38	      case 'resend':
39	        await this.sendViaResend({ to: input.email, subject, text: textContent, html: htmlContent });
40	        break;
41	      case 'sendgrid':
42	        await this.sendViaSendGrid({ to: input.email, subject, text: textContent, html: htmlContent });
43	        break;
44	      case 'logger':
45	      default:
46	        this.options.logger?.info(
47	          {
48	            to: input.email,
49	            expiresAt: input.expiresAt.toISOString(),
50	            resetUrl,
51	          },
52	          'NotificationDeliveryProvider [Logger Mode]: Password reset email logged safely.',
53	        );
54	        break;
55	    }

58	  private async sendViaResend(payload: { to: string; subject: string; text: string; html: string }): Promise<void> {
59	    if (!this.options.resendApiKey) {
60	      throw new Error('RESEND_API_KEY_MISSING');
61	    }
62	    const response = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
63	      method: 'POST',
64	      headers: {
65	        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
66	        Authorization: `Bearer ${this.options.resendApiKey}`,
67	      },
68	      body: JSON.stringify({
69	        from: this.options.fromEmail,
70	        to: [payload.to],
71	        subject: payload.subject,
72	        text: payload.text,
73	        html: payload.html,
74	      }),
75	    });
76	
77	    if (!response.ok) {
78	      const errorText = await response.text();
79	      this.options.logger?.error({ status: response.status, body: errorText }, 'Resend email delivery failed');
80	      throw new Error(`RESEND_DELIVERY_FAILED: ${response.status}`);
81	    }
82	  }
83	
84	  private async sendViaSendGrid(payload: { to: string; subject: string; text: string; html: string }): Promise<void> {
85	    if (!this.options.sendgridApiKey) {
86	      throw new Error('SENDGRID_API_KEY_MISSING');
87	    }
88	    const response = await fetch('https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send', {
89	      method: 'POST',
90	      headers: {
91	        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
92	        Authorization: `Bearer ${this.options.sendgridApiKey}`,
93	      },
94	      body: JSON.stringify({
95	        personalizations: [{ to: [{ email: payload.to }] }],
96	        from: { email: this.options.fromEmail },
97	        subject: payload.subject,
98	        content: [
99	          { type: 'text/plain', value: payload.text },
100	          { type: 'text/html', value: payload.html },
101	        ],
102	      }),
103	    });
104	
105	    if (!response.ok) {
106	      const errorText = await response.text();
107	      this.options.logger?.error({ status: response.status, body: errorText }, 'SendGrid email delivery failed');
108	      throw new Error(`SENDGRID_DELIVERY_FAILED: ${response.status}`);
109	    }
110	  }
111	}

115	  logger?: Logger,

119	    resendApiKey: environment.resendApiKey,
120	    sendgridApiKey: environment.sendgridApiKey,
121	    fromEmail: environment.notificationFromEmail,
122	    resetBaseUrl: environment.passwordResetBaseUrl,
123	    logger,
124	  });

import type { GatewayRegistryContract } from '../../contracts/gatewayRegistry';
import { CurrentSupabaseBrowserGateway } from './browser.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway } from './finance-entries.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway } from './orders.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway } from './roles.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseAuthGateway } from './auth.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseAccountingGateway } from './accounting.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseCouriersGateway } from './couriers.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseCustomersGateway } from './customers.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseEmployeesGateway } from './employees.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseNotificationsGateway } from './notifications.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseProductsGateway } from './products.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseReportsGateway } from './reports.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseSettingsGateway, currentSupabaseSiteManagementGateway } from './site-settings.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseShipmentsGateway } from './shipments.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseSourcesGateway } from './sources.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseUsersGateway } from './users.gateway';

/**
 * Concrete transitional registry. It only wires feature gateways; it does not
 * contain business rules or orchestration.
 */
export function createCurrentSupabaseGatewayRegistry(): GatewayRegistryContract {
  return {
    accounting: currentSupabaseAccountingGateway,
    auth: new CurrentSupabaseAuthGateway(),
    browser: new CurrentSupabaseBrowserGateway(),
    couriers: currentSupabaseCouriersGateway,
    customers: currentSupabaseCustomersGateway,
    employees: currentSupabaseEmployeesGateway,
    financeEntries: new CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway(),
    notifications: currentSupabaseNotificationsGateway,
    orders: new CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway(),
    products: currentSupabaseProductsGateway,
    reports: currentSupabaseReportsGateway,
    roles: new CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway(),
    settings: currentSupabaseSettingsGateway,
    shipments: currentSupabaseShipmentsGateway,
    siteManagement: currentSupabaseSiteManagementGateway,
    sources: currentSupabaseSourcesGateway,
    users: currentSupabaseUsersGateway,
  };
}

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

import 'dotenv/config';
import { Pool } from 'pg';

// Read-only: column inventory for the tables behind the broken sections.
const TABLES = [
  'products', 'user_sessions', 'activity_logs', 'notifications', 'settings',
  'orders', 'order_sources', 'customers', 'portal_users', 'employees', 'users',
];

async function main() {
  const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } });
  const tables = await pool.query(
    `SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name`,
  );
  console.log('ALL TABLES:', tables.rows.map(r => r.table_name).join(', '));
  for (const t of TABLES) {
    const cols = await pool.query(
      `SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name=$1 ORDER BY ordinal_position`,
      [t],
    );
    console.log(`\n=== ${t} (${cols.rowCount} cols) ===`);
    console.log(cols.rows.map(c => `${c.column_name}:${c.data_type}`).join(', '));
  }
  await pool.end();

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { PortalAdminRepository, PortalAdminUserDto } from './portal-admin.contracts';

function timestamp(value: unknown): number {
  const parsed = value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : Date.parse(String(value ?? ''));
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}
function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try { return record(JSON.parse(value)); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
}
function text(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? ''); }
function role(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['role'] {
  return value === 'courier' || value === 'supplier' ? value : 'customer';
}
function approval(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['approvalStatus'] {
  return value === 'pending_approval' || value === 'rejected' ? value : 'approved';
}
function mapRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalAdminUserDto {
  const userData = record(row.userData);
  const details = record(row.detailsData);
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    username: text(row.username || userData.username),
    email: text(row.email || userData.email),
    fullName: text(row.fullName || userData.fullName),
    phone: text(row.phone || userData.phone),
    role: role(row.portalRole || userData.portalRole || row.type),
    approvalStatus: approval(row.approvalStatus || userData.approvalStatus),
    disabled: Boolean(row.disabled || row.isDisabled || userData.disabled),
    ...(row.linkedCustomerId || userData.customerId ? { linkedCustomerId: text(row.linkedCustomerId || userData.customerId) } : {}),
    customerDetails: { id: text(row.detailId), customer_id: text(row.detailCustomerId), ...details },
    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
  };
}
const selectSql = `
  SELECT p.portal_user_id AS id,
         p.username, p.email, p.full_name AS "fullName", p.phone,
         p.portal_role AS "portalRole", p.type,
         p.approval_status AS "approvalStatus", p.disabled, p.is_disabled AS "isDisabled",
         p.linked_customer_id AS "linkedCustomerId", p.created_at AS "createdAt", p.data AS "userData",
         d.cust_detail_id AS "detailId", d.customer_id AS "detailCustomerId", d.data AS "detailsData"
    FROM public.portal_users p
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT cust_detail_id, customer_id, data
        FROM public.cust_details
       WHERE user_uid = p.portal_user_id OR customer_id = p.linked_customer_id
       ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
       LIMIT 1
    ) d ON true`;

export function createPortalAdminRepository(pool: Pool): PortalAdminRepository {
  const find = async (portalUserId: string): Promise<PortalAdminUserDto | null> => {
    const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(`${selectSql} WHERE p.portal_user_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [portalUserId]);
    return result.rows[0] ? mapRow(result.rows[0]) : null;
  };
  return {
    async listUsers({ limit, offset }) {
      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(`${selectSql} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.portal_user_id LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2`, [limit, offset]);
      return result.rows.map(mapRow);
    },
    async updateUser(input) {
      const fields: string[] = [];
      const values: unknown[] = [];
      const add = (sql: string, value: unknown) => { values.push(value); fields.push(sql.replace('?', `$${values.length}`)); };
      if (input.username !== undefined) add('username = ?', input.username);
      if (input.email !== undefined) add('email = ?', input.email);
      if (input.fullName !== undefined) add('full_name = ?', input.fullName);
      if (input.phone !== undefined) add('phone = ?', input.phone);
      if (input.role !== undefined) add('portal_role = ?', input.role);
      if (input.approvalStatus !== undefined) add('approval_status = ?', input.approvalStatus);
      if (input.disabled !== undefined) { add('disabled = ?', input.disabled); add('is_disabled = ?', input.disabled); }
      if (input.linkedCustomerId !== undefined) add('linked_customer_id = ?', input.linkedCustomerId);
      add('updated_at = ?', input.updatedAt);
      values.push(input.portalUserId);
      await pool.query(`UPDATE public.portal_users SET ${fields.join(', ')} WHERE portal_user_id = $${values.length}`, values);
      if (input.details && input.linkedCustomerId) {
        await pool.query(`INSERT INTO public.cust_details (cust_detail_id, user_uid, customer_id, data, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, $5)
          ON CONFLICT (cust_detail_id) DO UPDATE SET data = public.cust_details.data || EXCLUDED.data, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at`,
          [`cust_dtl_${input.linkedCustomerId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`, input.portalUserId, input.linkedCustomerId, JSON.stringify(input.details), input.updatedAt]);
      }
      return find(input.portalUserId);
    },
    async toggleDisabled(portalUserId, disabled, updatedAt) {
      await pool.query('UPDATE public.portal_users SET disabled = $2, is_disabled = $2, updated_at = $3 WHERE portal_user_id = $1', [portalUserId, disabled, updatedAt]);
      return find(portalUserId);
    },
    async deleteUser(portalUserId) {
      const result = await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.portal_users WHERE portal_user_id = $1', [portalUserId]);
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.cust_details WHERE user_uid = $1', [portalUserId]);
      return (result.rowCount ?? 0) > 0;
    },
    async saveCustomerDetails(input) {
      const detailId = `cust_dtl_${input.customerId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
        `INSERT INTO public.cust_details (cust_detail_id, user_uid, customer_id, data, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, $5)
         ON CONFLICT (cust_detail_id) DO UPDATE
           SET user_uid = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.user_uid, ''), public.cust_details.user_uid),
               data = public.cust_details.data || EXCLUDED.data,
               updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
         RETURNING cust_detail_id AS id, user_uid AS "userUid", customer_id AS "customerId", data,
                   created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"`,
        [detailId, input.userUid ?? '', input.customerId, JSON.stringify(input.details), input.updatedAt],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? { id: detailId, customerId: input.customerId, ...input.details };

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { PortalAuthService } from './portal-auth.service';
import { PortalAuthServiceError } from './portal-auth.service';
import type { PortalAdminRepository } from './portal-admin.contracts';
import { portalAdminCreateSchema, portalAdminListSchema, portalAdminUpdateSchema } from './portal-admin.schemas';

const requestId = (response: Response) => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
const route = (permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) => [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function pathParam(request: Request, name: string): string | null {
  const value = request.params[name];
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 ? value : null;
}
function handleError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  if (error instanceof PortalAuthServiceError) return sendFailure(response, error.statusCode, error.code, error.safeMessage, requestId(response));
  return next(error);
}

export function registerPortalAdminRoutes(
  app: Express,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  portalAuth: PortalAuthService,
  repository: PortalAdminRepository,
): void {
  app.get('/api/v1/portal/admin/users', ...route('view_users', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const query = portalAdminListSchema.safeParse(request.query);
    if (!query.success) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PORTAL_USER_QUERY', 'معاملات مستخدمي البوابة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.listUsers(query.data), requestId(response), query.data); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });

5	CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS alx_api_private;

7	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_number(raw text)
8	RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
9	BEGIN
10	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
11	  RETURN raw::numeric;
12	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
13	END $$;
14	
15	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_integer(raw text)
16	RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
17	BEGIN
18	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
19	  RETURN trunc(raw::numeric)::integer;
20	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
21	END $$;
22	
23	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_boolean(raw text)
24	RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
25	BEGIN
26	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
27	  RETURN btrim(raw)::boolean;
28	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
29	END $$;
30	
31	-- يقبل الطابع ISO أو milliseconds epoch — accepts ISO timestamps or epoch milliseconds.
32	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(raw text)
33	RETURNS timestamptz LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
34	BEGIN
35	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
36	  IF raw ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN
37	    RETURN to_timestamp(raw::numeric / 1000);
38	  END IF;
39	  RETURN raw::timestamptz;
40	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
41	END $$;
42	
43	-- استخراج قيمة نصية من مفاتيح متعددة بالترتيب — first non-empty text among several jsonb keys.
44	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_text(payload jsonb, VARIADIC keys text[])
45	RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
46	  SELECT NULLIF(btrim(x.value #>> '{}'), '')
47	    FROM unnest(keys) AS k(key)
48	    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT payload -> k.key AS value) x ON TRUE
49	   WHERE x.value IS NOT NULL AND btrim(x.value #>> '{}') <> ''
50	   LIMIT 1
51	$$;
52	
53	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_number(payload jsonb, key text)
54	RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
55	  SELECT alx_api_private.cast_number(payload ->> key)
56	$$;
57	
58	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_boolean(payload jsonb, key text)
59	RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
60	  SELECT alx_api_private.cast_boolean(payload ->> key)
61	$$;
62	
63	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_timestamp(payload jsonb, key text)
64	RETURNS timestamptz LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
65	  SELECT alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(payload ->> key)
66	$$;
67	
68	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_text_array(payload jsonb, key text)
69	RETURNS text[] LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
70	  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(btrim(x.value #>> '{}'))
71	                     FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(payload -> key, '[]'::jsonb)) x(value)
72	                    WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload -> key) = 'array'
73	                      AND btrim(x.value #>> '{}') <> ''), '{}')
74	$$;

50	     WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';

52	    -- مصفوفة المستلمين: تجمع مصدرها من العمود أو من data قبل التحويل — merge both legacy sources first,
53	    -- لأن صفوفًا حقيقية لا تحمل قائمة المستلمين إلا داخل الحمولة القديمة.
54	    -- نفس الشرط يحمي إعادة التنفيذ بعد تحويل العمود إلى text[].
55	    IF EXISTS (
56	      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
57	       WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications'
58	         AND column_name = 'associated_user_ids' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
59	    ) THEN
60	      UPDATE public.notifications
61	         SET associated_user_ids = COALESCE(
62	               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'array' AND associated_user_ids <> '[]'::jsonb
63	                    THEN associated_user_ids END,
64	               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'associatedUserIds') = 'array'
65	                    THEN data->'associatedUserIds' END,
66	               '[]'::jsonb)
67	       WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
68	    END IF;
69	  END IF;
70	END
71	$$;
