1	-- 0024_flatten_notifications.sql
2	-- تسطير الإشعارات: نقل كل ما يبقى داخل data إلى أعمدة حقيقية ثم جدول مستلمين علائقي.
3	-- Flattens notifications: every jsonb payload field moves to a real column, recipients become a relational table.
4	-- لا يمكن لمس الواجهة أي حقل jsonb بعد هذا الترحيل — the API never reads jsonb after this migration.
5	
6	ALTER TABLE public.notifications
7	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_by_uid text;
8	
9	-- تعبئة الحقول المسطّحة من حمولة data القديمة — backfill flat columns from the legacy payload.
10	UPDATE public.notifications
11	   SET title        = COALESCE(NULLIF(title, ''),        data->>'title'),
12	       message      = COALESCE(NULLIF(message, ''),      data->>'message'),
13	       type         = COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''),         data->>'type'),
14	       category     = COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''),     data->>'category'),
15	       creator_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(creator_id, ''),   data->>'creatorId'),
16	       creator_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(creator_name, ''), data->>'creatorName'),
17	       is_public    = COALESCE(is_public, alx_api_private.payload_boolean(data, 'isPublic')),
18	       is_read      = COALESCE(is_read, read, alx_api_private.payload_boolean(data, 'read'), false),
19	       read         = COALESCE(is_read, read, alx_api_private.payload_boolean(data, 'read'), false),
20	       user_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''),      data->>'userId')
21	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
22	
23	-- مستلمو الإشعار: جدول علائقي بدل مصفوفة jsonb — one recipient row per notification instead of a jsonb array.
24	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_recipient (
25	  notification_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications (notification_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
26	  user_id text NOT NULL,
27	  is_read boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
28	  read_at timestamptz,
29	  PRIMARY KEY (notification_id, user_id)
30	);
31	
32	INSERT INTO public.notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id)
33	     SELECT n.notification_id, btrim(x.value #>> '{}')
34	       FROM public.notifications n, jsonb_array_elements(n.data->'associatedUserIds') AS x(value)
35	      WHERE jsonb_typeof(n.data->'associatedUserIds') = 'array'
36	     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
37	
38	-- إبقاء العمود المسطّح متطابقًا مع الجدول العلائقي لضمان انتقال آمن.
39	-- Keep the flat column aligned with the relational table for a safe rollout.
40	UPDATE public.notifications
41	   SET associated_user_ids = COALESCE(
42	         (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r.user_id))
43	            FROM public.notification_recipient r
44	           WHERE r.notification_id = notifications.notification_id),
45	         '[]'::jsonb);
46	
47	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS notification_recipient_user_idx
48	  ON public.notification_recipient (user_id);
49

  channel               TEXT        NOT NULL
                        CHECK (channel IN ('whatsapp', 'email', 'sms')),

  recipient             TEXT        NOT NULL,

  template_id           TEXT,

  payload               JSONB,

2	
3	export type NotificationType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
4	
5	interface NotificationParams {
6	  title: string;
7	  message: string;
8	  type: NotificationType;
9	  orderId?: string;
10	  userId?: string; // Target specific user
11	  associatedUserIds?: string[]; // Users associated with this notification
12	  isPublic?: boolean;
13	  category?: 'order' | 'finance' | 'system';
14	}
15	
16	// ─── Electron API bridge helper ────────────────────────────────────────────
17	const electronAPI = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI)
18	  ? (window as any).electronAPI
19	  : null;
20	
21	export const notificationService = {
22	  async notify({ title, message, type, orderId, userId, associatedUserIds, isPublic = true, category }: NotificationParams) {
23	    try {
24	      // 1. Show local toast (always)
25	      switch (type) {
26	        case 'success':
27	          toast.success(message, { duration: 4000 });
28	          break;
29	        case 'error':
30	          toast.error(message, { duration: 5000 });
31	          break;
32	        default:
33	          toast(message, { icon: type === 'warning' ? '⚠️' : 'ℹ️', duration: 4000 });
34	      }
35	
36	      // 2. Show native OS notification when running inside Electron
37	      if (electronAPI?.showNotification) {
38	        try {
39	          await electronAPI.showNotification({ title, body: message, type });
40	        } catch (nativeErr) {
41	          console.warn('[notificationService] native notification failed:', nativeErr);
42	        }
43	      }
44	    } catch (error) {
45	      console.error('Failed to create notification:', error);
46	    }
47	  }
48	};

8	import type { Pool } from 'pg';

18	const notificationColumns =
19	  'notification_id AS "notificationId", user_id AS "userId", title, body, notification_type AS "type", is_read AS "isRead", channel, metadata, created_at AS "createdAt", read_at AS "readAt"';
20	
21	export function createNotificationsRepository(pool: Pool): NotificationsRepository {
22	  return {
23	    async listNotifications(query: PageQuery): Promise<PageResult<NotificationRecord>> {
24	      const values: unknown[] = [];
25	      const conditions: string[] = [];
26	
27	      if (query.userId) {
28	        values.push(query.userId);
29	        conditions.push(`user_id = $${values.length}`);
30	      }
31	      if (query.isRead !== undefined) {
32	        values.push(query.isRead);
33	        conditions.push(`is_read = $${values.length}`);
34	      }
35	
36	      const whereClause = conditions.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}` : '';
37	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
38	
39	      const limitIdx = values.length - 1;
40	      const offsetIdx = values.length;
41	
42	      const sql = `
43	        SELECT ${notificationColumns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total
44	        FROM public.notifications
45	        ${whereClause}
46	        ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id ASC
47	        LIMIT $${limitIdx} OFFSET $${offsetIdx}
48	      `;
49	
50	      try {
51	        const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(sql, values);
52	        const items: NotificationRecord[] = result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => ({
53	          notificationId: String(row['notificationId']),
54	          userId: row['userId'] ? String(row['userId']) : null,
55	          title: String(row['title'] ?? ''),
56	          body: String(row['body'] ?? ''),
57	          type: String(row['type'] ?? 'system'),
58	          isRead: Boolean(row['isRead']),
59	          channel: row['channel'] ? String(row['channel']) : 'in_app',
60	          metadata: (row['metadata'] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null,
61	          createdAt: new Date(String(row['createdAt'] ?? Date.now())).toISOString(),
62	          readAt: row['readAt'] ? new Date(String(row['readAt'])).toISOString() : null,
63	        }));
64	
65	        const total = Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0);
66	        return { items, total };
67	      } catch {
68	        // Fallback for environment before table migration
69	        return { items: [], total: 0 };
70	      }

73	    async getNotification(notificationId: string): Promise<NotificationRecord | null> {

91	          readAt: row['readAt'] ? new Date(String(row['readAt'])).toISOString() : null,

95	      }

97	
98	    async createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<NotificationRecord> {
99	      const notificationId = `notif_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
100	      const now = new Date().toISOString();
101	
102	      try {
103	        const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
104	          `INSERT INTO public.notifications
105	             (notification_id, user_id, title, body, notification_type, is_read, channel, metadata, created_at, created_by, updated_by)
106	           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, false, $6, $7::jsonb, NOW(), $8, $8)
107	           RETURNING ${notificationColumns}`,
108	          [
109	            notificationId,
110	            input.userId ?? null,
111	            input.title,
112	            input.body,
113	            input.type ?? 'system',
114	            input.channel ?? 'in_app',
115	            JSON.stringify(input.metadata ?? {}),
116	            input.actorId ?? input.userId ?? 'system',
117	          ],
118	        );
119	
120	        // التحقق من وجود الصف قبل الوصول إليه — Guard against undefined row
121	        const row = result.rows[0];
122	        if (!row) throw new Error('INSERT returned no rows');
123	
124	        return {
125	          notificationId: String(row['notificationId']),
126	          userId: row['userId'] ? String(row['userId']) : null,
127	          title: String(row['title'] ?? input.title),
128	          body: String(row['body'] ?? input.body),
129	          type: String(row['type'] ?? input.type ?? 'system'),
130	          isRead: false,
131	          channel: row['channel'] ? String(row['channel']) : (input.channel ?? 'in_app'),
132	          metadata: input.metadata ?? null,
133	          createdAt: now,
134	          readAt: null,
135	        };
136	      } catch {
137	        // Fallback in-memory representation for non-blocking notification flow
138	        return {
139	          notificationId,
140	          userId: input.userId ?? null,
141	          title: input.title,
142	          body: input.body,
143	          type: input.type ?? 'system',
144	          isRead: false,
145	          channel: input.channel ?? 'in_app',
146	          metadata: input.metadata ?? null,
147	          createdAt: now,
148	          readAt: null,
149	        };
150	      }
151	    },
152	
153	
154	    async markAsRead(notificationId: string, userId?: string): Promise<NotificationRecord | null> {
155	      try {
156	        const userCondition = userId ? 'AND user_id = $2' : '';
157	        const params = userId ? [notificationId, userId] : [notificationId];
158	        const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
159	          `UPDATE public.notifications
160	           SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
161	           WHERE notification_id = $1 ${userCondition}
162	           RETURNING ${notificationColumns}`,
163	          params,
164	        );
165	        if (!result.rows[0]) return null;
166	        const row = result.rows[0];
167	        return {
168	          notificationId: String(row['notificationId']),
169	          userId: row['userId'] ? String(row['userId']) : null,
170	          title: String(row['title'] ?? ''),
171	          body: String(row['body'] ?? ''),
172	          type: String(row['type'] ?? 'system'),
173	          isRead: true,
174	          channel: row['channel'] ? String(row['channel']) : 'in_app',
175	          metadata: (row['metadata'] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null,
176	          createdAt: new Date(String(row['createdAt'] ?? Date.now())).toISOString(),
177	          readAt: new Date().toISOString(),
178	        };
179	      } catch {
180	        return null;
181	      }
182	    },
183	
184	    async markAllAsRead(userId: string): Promise<number> {
185	      try {
186	        const result = await pool.query(
187	          `UPDATE public.notifications
188	           SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
189	           WHERE user_id = $1 AND is_read = false`,
190	          [userId],
191	        );
192	        return result.rowCount ?? 0;
193	      } catch {
194	        return 0;
195	      }
196	    },
197	
198	    async recordOutboxEvent(input: SendExternalNotificationInput): Promise<{ outboxId: string; status: string }> {
199	      const idempotencyKey = input.idempotencyKey ?? `outbox_${input.channel}_${input.recipient}_${Date.now()}`;
200	      try {
201	        const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
202	          // تسجيل حدث Outbox في جدول الإشعارات الخارجية مع Idempotency
203	          // Record outbox event in dedicated notification_outbox table with idempotency
204	          `INSERT INTO alx_api_private.notification_outbox
205	             (idempotency_key, channel, recipient, template_id, message, payload, status, created_by)
206	           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, 'queued', 'api')
207	           ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
208	             SET updated_at = NOW()
209	           RETURNING outbox_id::text AS "outboxId", status`,
210	          [
211	            idempotencyKey,
212	            input.channel,
213	            input.recipient,
214	            input.templateId ?? null,
215	            input.message,
216	            JSON.stringify(input.metadata ?? {}),
217	          ],
218	        );
219	        const row = result.rows[0];
220	        return {
221	          outboxId: row ? String(row['outboxId']) : `outbox_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
222	          status: row ? String(row['status']) : 'queued',
223	        };
224	      } catch {
225	        // Fallback graceful: إذا فشل الـ Outbox لا نوقف العملية الأصلية
226	        return { outboxId: `outbox_${crypto.randomUUID()}`, status: 'queued' };
227	      }
228	    },
229	  };
230	}

1	-- 0025_flatten_notifications.sql
2	-- تسطير الإشعارات: نقل كل ما يبقى داخل data إلى أعمدة حقيقية، ومصفوفة المستلمين إلى text[]،
3	-- ثم جدول مستلمين علائقي يحمل حالة القراءة لكل مستلم على حدة.
4	-- Flattens notifications: every jsonb payload field moves to a real column, the recipient array
5	-- becomes a first-class text[] (not jsonb), and per-recipient read state becomes a child table.
6	-- لا يمكن لمس الواجهة أي حقل jsonb بعد هذا الترحيل — the API never reads jsonb after this migration.
7	
8	ALTER TABLE public.notifications
9	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_by_uid text;
10	
11	-- تعبئة الحقول المسطّحة من حمولة data القديمة — backfill flat columns from the legacy payload.
12	UPDATE public.notifications
13	   SET title        = COALESCE(NULLIF(title, ''),        data->>'title'),
14	       message      = COALESCE(NULLIF(message, ''),      data->>'message'),
15	       type         = COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''),         data->>'type'),
16	       category     = COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''),     data->>'category'),
17	       creator_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(creator_id, ''),   data->>'creatorId'),
18	       creator_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(creator_name, ''), data->>'creatorName'),
19	       is_public    = COALESCE(is_public, alx_api_private.payload_boolean(data, 'isPublic')),
20	       is_read      = COALESCE(is_read, read, alx_api_private.payload_boolean(data, 'read'), false),
21	       read         = COALESCE(is_read, read, alx_api_private.payload_boolean(data, 'read'), false),
22	       user_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''),      data->>'userId')
23	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
24	
25	-- مصفوفة المستلمين: تجمع مصدرها من العمود أو من data قبل التحويل — merge both legacy sources first,
26	-- because rows exist where only the jsonb payload carries the recipient list.
27	UPDATE public.notifications
28	   SET associated_user_ids = COALESCE(
29	         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'array' AND associated_user_ids <> '[]'::jsonb THEN associated_user_ids END,
30	         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'associatedUserIds') = 'array' THEN data->'associatedUserIds' END,
31	         '[]'::jsonb)
32	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
33	
34	-- مصفوفة المستلمين: من jsonb إلى text[] (عمود رئيسي) — recipient ids become a first-class text array.
35	ALTER TABLE public.notifications
36	  ALTER COLUMN associated_user_ids TYPE text[]
37	    USING (
38	      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT btrim(x.value #>> '{}')) FILTER (WHERE btrim(x.value #>> '{}') <> ''), ARRAY[]::text[])
39	        FROM jsonb_array_elements(
40	               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'array' THEN associated_user_ids ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
41	             ) AS x(value)
42	    );
43	
44	-- مستلمو الإشعار: جدول علائقي يحمل حالة القراءة لكل مستلم — one recipient row per notification.
45	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_recipient (
46	  notification_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications (notification_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
47	  user_id text NOT NULL,
48	  is_read boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
49	  read_at timestamptz,
50	  PRIMARY KEY (notification_id, user_id)
51	);
52	
53	INSERT INTO public.notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id)
54	     SELECT n.notification_id, r.user_id
55	       FROM public.notifications n
56	       CROSS JOIN unnest(n.associated_user_ids) AS r(user_id)
57	      WHERE r.user_id IS NOT NULL AND r.user_id <> ''
58	     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
59	
60	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS notification_recipient_user_idx
61	  ON public.notification_recipient (user_id);
62	
63	ALTER TABLE public.notification_recipient DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
64	
65	GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.notifications, public.notification_recipient TO alx_api_runtime;

5	 * Reads the flattened activity_logs columns plus the activity_log_detail child rows,
6	 * and writes through the shared audit writer so every module records events identically.

14	  ActivityLogsRepository,
15	  CreateActivityLogInput,
16	} from './activity-logs.contracts';

18	export function createActivityLogsRepository(pool: Pool): ActivityLogsRepository {
19	  return {
20	    async list(input: ActivityLogPageQuery): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
21	      const values: unknown[] = [];
22	      const filters: string[] = [];
23	      if (input.userId) {
24	        values.push(input.userId);
25	        filters.push(`al.user_id = $${values.length}`);
26	      }
27	      if (input.action) {
28	        values.push(input.action);
29	        filters.push(`al.action = $${values.length}`);
30	      }
31	      if (input.search) {
32	        values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
33	        const needle = values.length;
34	        filters.push(`(al.action ILIKE $${needle} OR al.target ILIKE $${needle} OR al.summary ILIKE $${needle} OR al.user_name ILIKE $${needle})`);
35	      }
36	      const where = filters.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
37	      values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
38	
39	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
40	        `SELECT al.activity_log_id AS "activityLogId",
41	                al.action, al.category, al.target, al.type, al.summary,
42	                al.user_id AS "userId", al.user_name AS "userName", al.user_role AS "userRole",
43	                al.created_at AS "createdAt",
44	                COALESCE(fields.aggregated, '{}'::jsonb) AS "details",
45	                count(*) OVER()::text AS _total
46	           FROM public.activity_logs al
47	           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
48	             SELECT jsonb_object_agg(d.field_name, d.field_value) AS aggregated
49	               FROM public.activity_log_detail d
50	              WHERE d.activity_log_id = al.activity_log_id
51	           ) AS fields ON TRUE
52	           ${where}
53	          ORDER BY al.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, al.activity_log_id ASC
54	          LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
55	        values,
56	      );

60	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?.['_total'] ?? 0),

  "content": "/**\n * notifications.routes.ts\n * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n * المسارات والـ Endpoints الخاصة بوحدة الإشعارات (Notifications HTTP Routes).\n * Notifications module routes — follows the standard Route/Controller pattern used across all modules.\n *\n * الأرقام المعرّفة للإشعارات نصية بمسار notif_ — أي معرف آخر يُرفض 400 بدل أن يصل للمستودع.\n * Notification ids are opaque notif_-prefixed strings; anything else is rejected with 400.\n */\n\nimport type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';\nimport type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';\nimport type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';\nimport type { NotificationsRepository } from './notifications.contracts';\nimport { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';\nimport { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';\nimport { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';\nimport {\n  createNotificationSchema,\n  notificationIdSchema,\n  pageQuerySchema,\n  sendExternalNotificationSchema,\n} from './notifications.schemas';\n\n// دالة مساعدة لاستخراج requestId من الاستجابة\n// Helper to extract requestId from response locals\nfunction requestId(response: Response): string {\n  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');\n}\n\n// دالة مساعدة لاستخراج userId من الـ principal المصادق عليه\n// Helper to extract userId from the authenticated principal\nfunction principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {\n  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;\n}\n\n// دالة مساعدة لإنشاء middleware chain للمصادقة والصلاحية\n// Helper to build authentication + permission middleware chain\nfunction route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {\n  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];\n}\n\nexport function registerNotificationsRoutes(\n  app: Express,\n  _environment: ApiEnvironment,\n  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,\n  repository: NotificationsRepository,\n): void {\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 1. GET /api/v1/notifications — قائمة الإشعارات المرئية للمستخدم (فلترة + ترقيم)\n  // List the notifications the authenticated user may see, with filtering and pagination.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.get('/api/v1/notifications', ...route('view_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsed = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);\n      if (!parsed.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'المعاملات غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      // نطاق الظهور:المشاهد هو المستخدم المصادق عليه ما لم يُطلب غيره صراحة.\n      // Visibility scope defaults to the authenticated principal.\n      const viewer = parsed.data.visibilityFor ?? principalId(response);\n\n      const result = await repository.listNotifications({\n        limit: parsed.data.limit,\n        offset: parsed.data.offset,\n        ...(parsed.data.userId !== undefined ? { userId: parsed.data.userId } : {}),\n        ...(viewer !== undefined ? { visibilityFor: viewer } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.isRead !== undefined ? { isRead: parsed.data.isRead } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.category !== undefined ? { category: parsed.data.category } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.search !== undefined ? { search: parsed.data.search } : {}),\n      });\n\n      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), {\n        total: result.total,\n        limit: parsed.data.limit,\n        offset: parsed.data.offset,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 2. POST /api/v1/notifications — إنشاء إشعار داخلي\n  // Create an in-app notification (all fields are flat columns, no payload bag).\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.post('/api/v1/notifications', ...route('manage_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsed = createNotificationSchema.safeParse(request.body);\n      if (!parsed.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'البيانات غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const actorId = principalId(response);\n      const notification = await repository.createNotification({\n        title: parsed.data.title,\n        message: parsed.data.message,\n        type: parsed.data.type,\n        category: parsed.data.category,\n        isPublic: parsed.data.isPublic,\n        ...(parsed.data.userId !== undefined ? { userId: parsed.data.userId } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.associatedUserIds !== undefined ? { associatedUserIds: parsed.data.associatedUserIds } : {}),\n        ...(actorId !== undefined ? { actorId } : {}),\n      });\n\n      return sendSuccess(response, notification, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 3. PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read — تعليم الإشعار كمقروء لهذا المستخدم\n  // Mark one notification as read for the authenticated viewer.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.patch('/api/v1/notifications/:id/read', ...route('view_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsedId = notificationIdSchema.safeParse(request.params['id']);\n      if (!parsedId.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'معرف الإشعار غير صالح.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const userId = principalId(response);\n      const updated = await repository.markAsRead(parsedId.data, ...(userId !== undefined ? [userId] : []));\n      if (!updated) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 404, 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND', 'الإشعار غير موجود أو لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إليه.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      return sendSuccess(response, updated, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 4. POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all — تعليم إشعارات المستخدم كلها كمقروءة\n  // Mark every notification visible to the authenticated user as read.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.post('/api/v1/notifications/read-all', ...route('view_notifications', auth), async (_request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const userId = principalId(response);\n      if (!userId) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 'UNAUTHORIZED' as never as 401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'غير مصرح.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const count = await repository.markAllAsRead(userId);\n      return sendSuccess(response, { updatedCount: count }, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // 5. POST /api/v1/notifications/send-external — تسجيل إشعار خارجي في الـ Outbox\n  // Queue an external notification (WhatsApp/Email/SMS) through the transactional outbox.\n  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  app.post('/api/v1/notifications/send-external', ...route('manage_notifications', auth), async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {\n    try {\n      const parsed = sendExternalNotificationSchema.safeParse(request.body);\n      if (!parsed.success) {\n        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', 'البيانات غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));\n      }\n\n      const result = await repository.recordOutboxEvent({\n        recipient: parsed.data.recipient,\n        channel: parsed.data.channel,\n        message: parsed.data.message,\n        ...(parsed.data.templateId !== undefined ? { templateId: parsed.data.templateId } : {}),\n        ...(parsed.data.idempotencyKey !== undefined ? { idempotencyKey: parsed.data.idempotencyKey } : {}),\n      });\n\n      // 202 Accepted: الإشعار في قائمة الانتظار وليس مرسلاً فوراً\n      // 202 Accepted: the notification is queued, not sent immediately.\n      response.status(202);\n      return sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response));\n    } catch (error) {\n      return next(error);\n    }\n  });\n}\n",

}

18	export class NotificationDeliveryProvider implements PasswordResetDelivery {

20	
21	  async send(input: { email: string; token: string; expiresAt: Date }): Promise<void> {
22	    const resetUrl = `${this.options.resetBaseUrl}?token=${encodeURIComponent(input.token)}`;
23	    const subject = 'طلب إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور - SwiftShip / ALX';
24	    const textContent = `مرحباً،\nلقد تلقينا طلباً لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور الخاصة بحسابك.\nيرجى استخدام الرابط التالي للبدء:\n${resetUrl}\n\nينتهي الرابط عند: ${input.expiresAt.toISOString()}`;
25	    const htmlContent = `
26	      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; direction: rtl; text-align: right; padding: 20px;">
27	        <h2>إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور</h2>
28	        <p>مرحباً، لقد تلقينا طلباً لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور الخاصة بحسابك في منصة <strong>SwiftShip / ALX</strong>.</p>
29	        <p>يمكنك تغيير كلمة المرور بالضغط على الزر أدناه:</p>
30	        <div style="margin: 20px 0;">
31	          <a href="${resetUrl}" style="background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block;">إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور</a>
32	        </div>
33	        <p style="color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.9em;">ينتهي الرابط تلقائياً في: ${input.expiresAt.toLocaleString('ar-EG')}</p>
34	      </div>
35	    `;
36	
37	    switch (this.options.provider) {
38	      case 'resend':
39	        await this.sendViaResend({ to: input.email, subject, text: textContent, html: htmlContent });
40	        break;
41	      case 'sendgrid':
42	        await this.sendViaSendGrid({ to: input.email, subject, text: textContent, html: htmlContent });
43	        break;
44	      case 'logger':
45	      default:
46	        this.options.logger?.info(
47	          {
48	            to: input.email,
49	            expiresAt: input.expiresAt.toISOString(),
50	            resetUrl,
51	          },
52	          'NotificationDeliveryProvider [Logger Mode]: Password reset email logged safely.',
53	        );
54	        break;

58	  private async sendViaResend(payload: { to: string; subject: string; text: string; html: string }): Promise<void> {
59	    if (!this.options.resendApiKey) {
60	      throw new Error('RESEND_API_KEY_MISSING');
61	    }
62	    const response = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
63	      method: 'POST',
64	      headers: {
65	        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
66	        Authorization: `Bearer ${this.options.resendApiKey}`,
67	      },
68	      body: JSON.stringify({
69	        from: this.options.fromEmail,
70	        to: [payload.to],
71	        subject: payload.subject,
72	        text: payload.text,
73	        html: payload.html,
74	      }),
75	    });
76	
77	    if (!response.ok) {
78	      const errorText = await response.text();
79	      this.options.logger?.error({ status: response.status, body: errorText }, 'Resend email delivery failed');
80	      throw new Error(`RESEND_DELIVERY_FAILED: ${response.status}`);
81	    }
82	  }
83	
84	  private async sendViaSendGrid(payload: { to: string; subject: string; text: string; html: string }): Promise<void> {
85	    if (!this.options.sendgridApiKey) {
86	      throw new Error('SENDGRID_API_KEY_MISSING');
87	    }
88	    const response = await fetch('https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send', {
89	      method: 'POST',
90	      headers: {
91	        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
92	        Authorization: `Bearer ${this.options.sendgridApiKey}`,
93	      },
94	      body: JSON.stringify({
95	        personalizations: [{ to: [{ email: payload.to }] }],
96	        from: { email: this.options.fromEmail },
97	        subject: payload.subject,
98	        content: [
99	          { type: 'text/plain', value: payload.text },
100	          { type: 'text/html', value: payload.html },
101	        ],
102	      }),
103	    });
104	
105	    if (!response.ok) {
106	      const errorText = await response.text();
107	      this.options.logger?.error({ status: response.status, body: errorText }, 'SendGrid email delivery failed');
108	      throw new Error(`SENDGRID_DELIVERY_FAILED: ${response.status}`);
109	    }
110	  }
111	}

113	export function createNotificationDeliveryProvider(
114	  environment: ApiEnvironment,
115	  logger?: Logger,
116	): NotificationDeliveryProvider {
117	  return new NotificationDeliveryProvider({

119	    resendApiKey: environment.resendApiKey,
120	    sendgridApiKey: environment.sendgridApiKey,
121	    fromEmail: environment.notificationFromEmail,
122	    resetBaseUrl: environment.passwordResetBaseUrl,
123	    logger,
124	  });

import type { GatewayRegistryContract } from '../../contracts/gatewayRegistry';
import { CurrentSupabaseBrowserGateway } from './browser.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway } from './finance-entries.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway } from './orders.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway } from './roles.gateway';
import { CurrentSupabaseAuthGateway } from './auth.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseAccountingGateway } from './accounting.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseCouriersGateway } from './couriers.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseCustomersGateway } from './customers.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseEmployeesGateway } from './employees.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseNotificationsGateway } from './notifications.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseProductsGateway } from './products.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseReportsGateway } from './reports.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseSettingsGateway, currentSupabaseSiteManagementGateway } from './site-settings.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseShipmentsGateway } from './shipments.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseSourcesGateway } from './sources.gateway';
import { currentSupabaseUsersGateway } from './users.gateway';

/**
 * Concrete transitional registry. It only wires feature gateways; it does not
 * contain business rules or orchestration.
 */
export function createCurrentSupabaseGatewayRegistry(): GatewayRegistryContract {
  return {
    accounting: currentSupabaseAccountingGateway,
    auth: new CurrentSupabaseAuthGateway(),
    browser: new CurrentSupabaseBrowserGateway(),
    couriers: currentSupabaseCouriersGateway,
    customers: currentSupabaseCustomersGateway,
    employees: currentSupabaseEmployeesGateway,
    financeEntries: new CurrentSupabaseFinanceEntriesGateway(),
    notifications: currentSupabaseNotificationsGateway,
    orders: new CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway(),
    products: currentSupabaseProductsGateway,
    reports: currentSupabaseReportsGateway,
    roles: new CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway(),
    settings: currentSupabaseSettingsGateway,
    shipments: currentSupabaseShipmentsGateway,
    siteManagement: currentSupabaseSiteManagementGateway,
    sources: currentSupabaseSourcesGateway,
    users: currentSupabaseUsersGateway,
  };
}

import { asyncState, runMutation, type AsyncState } from '../../../shared/contracts/ui.contracts';
import { 
  Bell, Package, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, Clock, X, Settings2, 
  Send, Database, Key, Phone, ShieldCheck, Layers, Play, Check, 
  FileText, Info, ExternalLink, Lock, Settings, HelpCircle, Activity, Sparkles, RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { collection, onSnapshot, query, orderBy, limit, writeBatch, doc } from '../../../data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts';
import { db, safeToDate } from '../../../data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import { ar } from 'date-fns/locale';
import { useRole } from '../../../hooks/useRole';
import { useAuthSession } from '../../../features/auth/AuthSessionProvider';
import { ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSettings } from '../../../context/SettingsContext';
import { whatsappService, WhatsAppConfig, defaultWhatsAppConfig } from '../../../services/whatsappService';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { activityLogService } from '../../../services/activityLogService';

type NotificationRecord = { id: string; createdAt: Date | null; read?: boolean; type?: string; eventType?: string; title?: string; message?: string; creatorId?: string; userId?: string; associatedUserIds?: string[]; category?: string };
type DeliveryLog = { id: string; phone?: string; eventType?: string; message?: string; orderId?: string; status?: string; errorMsg?: string; createdAt: Date | null };
type TestResult = { success: boolean; status?: string; errorMsg?: string; message?: string };
type SnapshotDocument = { id: string; data: () => Record<string, unknown> | undefined };
const asNotificationRecord = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
const errorMessage = (error: unknown): string => error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';

export default function NotificationsPage() {
  const { legacyAuth: auth } = useAuthSession();
  const { settings } = useSettings();
  const isAr = settings.language === 'ar';
  
  // Tabs: 'alerts' (system notifications), 'settings' (whatsapp settings), 'logs' (whatsapp dispatch logs)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'alerts' | 'settings' | 'logs'>('alerts');
  
  // State variables
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<NotificationRecord[]>([]);
  const { role, hasPermission, loading: roleLoading } = useRole();
  const canSendNotif = role === 'Admin' || hasPermission('send_notifications');
  const canManageWhatsApp = role === 'Admin' || hasPermission('view_edit_notification_settings');
  const [alertsState, setAlertsState] = useState<AsyncState<unknown[]>>(asyncState.loading());
  const loadingAlerts = alertsState.status === 'loading';
  const setLoadingAlerts = (value: boolean) => setAlertsState(value ? asyncState.loading() : asyncState.idle());
  
  // WhatsApp Settings state
  const [whatsappConfig, setWhatsappConfig] = useState<WhatsAppConfig>(defaultWhatsAppConfig);
  const [configState, setConfigState] = useState<AsyncState<unknown>>(asyncState.loading());

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

7	export function requirePermission(useCases: AuthUseCases | undefined, permissionCode: string): RequestHandler {
8	  if (!PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN.test(permissionCode)) {
9	    throw new TypeError('A canonical permission code is required.');
10	  }
11	
12	  return async (_request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
13	    const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
14	    const principal = response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
15	    if (!useCases || !principal?.userId) {
16	      sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId);
17	      return;

19

22	      if (!permissions.includes(permissionCode)) {
23	        sendFailure(response, 403, 'AUTH_FORBIDDEN', 'لا تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة.', requestId);
24	        return;
25	      }
26	      next();
27	    } catch (error) {
28	      next(error);

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { PortalAdminRepository, PortalAdminUserDto } from './portal-admin.contracts';

function timestamp(value: unknown): number {
  const parsed = value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : Date.parse(String(value ?? ''));
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}
function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try { return record(JSON.parse(value)); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
}
function text(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? ''); }
function role(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['role'] {
  return value === 'courier' || value === 'supplier' ? value : 'customer';
}
function approval(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['approvalStatus'] {
  return value === 'pending_approval' || value === 'rejected' ? value : 'approved';
}
function mapRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalAdminUserDto {
  const userData = record(row.userData);
  const details = record(row.detailsData);
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    username: text(row.username || userData.username),
    email: text(row.email || userData.email),
    fullName: text(row.fullName || userData.fullName),
    phone: text(row.phone || userData.phone),
    role: role(row.portalRole || userData.portalRole || row.type),
    approvalStatus: approval(row.approvalStatus || userData.approvalStatus),
    disabled: Boolean(row.disabled || row.isDisabled || userData.disabled),
    ...(row.linkedCustomerId || userData.customerId ? { linkedCustomerId: text(row.linkedCustomerId || userData.customerId) } : {}),
    customerDetails: { id: text(row.detailId), customer_id: text(row.detailCustomerId), ...details },
    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
  };
}
const selectSql = `
  SELECT p.portal_user_id AS id,
         p.username, p.email, p.full_name AS "fullName", p.phone,
         p.portal_role AS "portalRole", p.type,
         p.approval_status AS "approvalStatus", p.disabled, p.is_disabled AS "isDisabled",
         p.linked_customer_id AS "linkedCustomerId", p.created_at AS "createdAt", p.data AS "userData",
         d.cust_detail_id AS "detailId", d.customer_id AS "detailCustomerId", d.data AS "detailsData"
    FROM public.portal_users p
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT cust_detail_id, customer_id, data
        FROM public.cust_details
       WHERE user_uid = p.portal_user_id OR customer_id = p.linked_customer_id
       ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
       LIMIT 1
    ) d ON true`;

export function createPortalAdminRepository(pool: Pool): PortalAdminRepository {
  const find = async (portalUserId: string): Promise<PortalAdminUserDto | null> => {
    const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(`${selectSql} WHERE p.portal_user_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [portalUserId]);
    return result.rows[0] ? mapRow(result.rows[0]) : null;
  };
  return {
    async listUsers({ limit, offset }) {
      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(`${selectSql} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.portal_user_id LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2`, [limit, offset]);
      return result.rows.map(mapRow);
    },
    async updateUser(input) {
      const fields: string[] = [];
      const values: unknown[] = [];
      const add = (sql: string, value: unknown) => { values.push(value); fields.push(sql.replace('?', `$${values.length}`)); };
      if (input.username !== undefined) add('username = ?', input.username);
      if (input.email !== undefined) add('email = ?', input.email);
      if (input.fullName !== undefined) add('full_name = ?', input.fullName);
      if (input.phone !== undefined) add('phone = ?', input.phone);
      if (input.role !== undefined) add('portal_role = ?', input.role);
      if (input.approvalStatus !== undefined) add('approval_status = ?', input.approvalStatus);
      if (input.disabled !== undefined) { add('disabled = ?', input.disabled); add('is_disabled = ?', input.disabled); }
      if (input.linkedCustomerId !== undefined) add('linked_customer_id = ?', input.linkedCustomerId);
      add('updated_at = ?', input.updatedAt);
      values.push(input.portalUserId);
      await pool.query(`UPDATE public.portal_users SET ${fields.join(', ')} WHERE portal_user_id = $${values.length}`, values);
      if (input.details && input.linkedCustomerId) {
        await pool.query(`INSERT INTO public.cust_details (cust_detail_id, user_uid, customer_id, data, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, $5)
          ON CONFLICT (cust_detail_id) DO UPDATE SET data = public.cust_details.data || EXCLUDED.data, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at`,
          [`cust_dtl_${input.linkedCustomerId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`, input.portalUserId, input.linkedCustomerId, JSON.stringify(input.details), input.updatedAt]);
      }
      return find(input.portalUserId);
    },
    async toggleDisabled(portalUserId, disabled, updatedAt) {
      await pool.query('UPDATE public.portal_users SET disabled = $2, is_disabled = $2, updated_at = $3 WHERE portal_user_id = $1', [portalUserId, disabled, updatedAt]);
      return find(portalUserId);
    },
    async deleteUser(portalUserId) {
      const result = await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.portal_users WHERE portal_user_id = $1', [portalUserId]);
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.cust_details WHERE user_uid = $1', [portalUserId]);
      return (result.rowCount ?? 0) > 0;
    },
    async saveCustomerDetails(input) {
      const detailId = `cust_dtl_${input.customerId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
        `INSERT INTO public.cust_details (cust_detail_id, user_uid, customer_id, data, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, $5)
         ON CONFLICT (cust_detail_id) DO UPDATE
           SET user_uid = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.user_uid, ''), public.cust_details.user_uid),
               data = public.cust_details.data || EXCLUDED.data,
               updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
         RETURNING cust_detail_id AS id, user_uid AS "userUid", customer_id AS "customerId", data,
                   created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"`,
        [detailId, input.userUid ?? '', input.customerId, JSON.stringify(input.details), input.updatedAt],
      );
      return result.rows[0] ?? { id: detailId, customerId: input.customerId, ...input.details };

const requestId = (response: Response) => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
const route = (permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) => [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function pathParam(request: Request, name: string): string | null {
  const value = request.params[name];
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 ? value : null;
}
function handleError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  if (error instanceof PortalAuthServiceError) return sendFailure(response, error.statusCode, error.code, error.safeMessage, requestId(response));
  return next(error);
}

  });

2	-- دوال تحويل متسامحة تُستخدم في كل ترحيلات التسطير؛ تعيد NULL بدل إسقاط الترحيل عند بيانات قديمة وسخة.
3	-- Tolerant casts used by every flattening migration: dirty legacy values become NULL instead of aborting.
4	
5	CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS alx_api_private;
6	
7	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_number(raw text)
8	RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
9	BEGIN
10	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
11	  RETURN raw::numeric;
12	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
13	END $$;
14	
15	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_integer(raw text)
16	RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
17	BEGIN
18	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
19	  RETURN trunc(raw::numeric)::integer;
20	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
21	END $$;
22	
23	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_boolean(raw text)
24	RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
25	BEGIN
26	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
27	  RETURN btrim(raw)::boolean;
28	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
29	END $$;
30	
31	-- يقبل الطابع ISO أو milliseconds epoch — accepts ISO timestamps or epoch milliseconds.
32	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(raw text)
33	RETURNS timestamptz LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$
34	BEGIN
35	  IF raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
36	  IF raw ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN
37	    RETURN to_timestamp(raw::numeric / 1000);
38	  END IF;
39	  RETURN raw::timestamptz;
40	EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
41	END $$;
42	
43	-- استخراج قيمة نصية من مفاتيح متعددة بالترتيب — first non-empty text among several jsonb keys.
44	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_text(payload jsonb, VARIADIC keys text[])
45	RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
46	  SELECT NULLIF(btrim(x.value #>> '{}'), '')
47	    FROM unnest(keys) AS k(key)
48	    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT payload -> k.key AS value) x ON TRUE
49	   WHERE x.value IS NOT NULL AND btrim(x.value #>> '{}') <> ''
50	   LIMIT 1
51	$$;
52	
53	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_number(payload jsonb, key text)
54	RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
55	  SELECT alx_api_private.cast_number(payload ->> key)
56	$$;
57	
58	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_boolean(payload jsonb, key text)
59	RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
60	  SELECT alx_api_private.cast_boolean(payload ->> key)
61	$$;
62	
63	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.payload_timestamp(payload jsonb, key text)
64	RETURNS timestamptz LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
65	  SELECT alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(payload ->> key)
66	$$;

1	-- 0026_flatten_activity_logs.sql
2	-- تسطير سجل النشاط: اسم المستخدم ودوره أعمدة حقيقية، وملخص نصي، وتفاصيل الحدث جدول علائقي.
3	-- Flattens activity logs: user name/role become first-class columns, the ambiguous `details`
4	-- text blob is renamed to `summary`, and structured event fields become a child table.
5	
6	ALTER TABLE public.activity_logs
7	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_name text,
8	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_role text;
9	
10	-- العمود النصي القديم كان يخزن أحياناً كرة JSON مضغوطة؛ اسمه الجديد يوضح دوره: ملخص مقروء فقط.
11	-- The legacy text column sometimes held a compacted JSON blob; renaming it makes its real
12	-- role explicit: a human-readable summary line and nothing else.
13	ALTER TABLE public.activity_logs RENAME COLUMN details TO summary;
14	
15	UPDATE public.activity_logs
16	   SET user_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(user_name, ''), data->>'userName'),
17	       user_role = COALESCE(NULLIF(user_role, ''), data->>'userRole')
18	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
19	
20	-- تفاصيل الحدث سطر/قيمة بدل كرة jsonb — one row per detail key instead of a jsonb blob.
21	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.activity_log_detail (
22	  activity_log_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.activity_logs (activity_log_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
23	  field_name text NOT NULL,
24	  field_value text,
25	  PRIMARY KEY (activity_log_id, field_name)
26	);
27	
28	INSERT INTO public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id, field_name, field_value)
29	     SELECT a.activity_log_id, x.key, x.value #>> '{}'
30	       FROM public.activity_logs a, jsonb_each(a.data->'details') AS x(key, value)
31	      WHERE jsonb_typeof(a.data->'details') = 'object'
32	        AND jsonb_typeof(x.value) <> 'object'
33	     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
34	
35	-- القيم المتداخلة (كائن داخل تفاصيل) تُسطّر بمسار منقّط — nested values flatten to dotted paths.
36	INSERT INTO public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id, field_name, field_value)
37	     SELECT a.activity_log_id, x.key || '.' || y.key, y.value #>> '{}'
38	       FROM public.activity_logs a
39	       JOIN jsonb_each(a.data->'details') AS x(key, value) ON jsonb_typeof(x.value) = 'object'
40	       CROSS JOIN jsonb_each(x.value) AS y(key, value)
41	     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
42	
43	-- ملخص نصي قابل للعرض مباشرة في الواجهة — a plain-text summary for direct rendering.
44	UPDATE public.activity_logs
45	   SET summary = COALESCE(NULLIF(summary, ''), data->>'details')
46	 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data->'details') = 'string';
47	
48	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS activity_logs_created_at_idx
49	  ON public.activity_logs (created_at DESC NULLS LAST, activity_log_id);
50	
51	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS activity_logs_user_idx
52	  ON public.activity_logs (user_id, created_at DESC NULLS LAST);
53	
54	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS activity_log_detail_log_idx
55	  ON public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id);
56	
57	ALTER TABLE public.activity_log_detail DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
58

85	-- 3. مستلمو الإشعار: جدول علائقي يحمل حالة القراءة لكل مستلم — one row per recipient.
86	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
87	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_recipient (
88	  notification_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.notifications (notification_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
89	  user_id text NOT NULL,
90	  is_read boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
91	  read_at timestamptz,
92	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
93	  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
94	  PRIMARY KEY (notification_id, user_id)
95	);

97	-- تحويل عمود المستلمين من jsonb إلى text[] (عمود رئيسي) مرة واحدة فقط — convert jsonb → text[] idempotently.
98	DO $$
99	BEGIN
100	  IF EXISTS (
101	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
102	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications'
103	       AND column_name = 'associated_user_ids' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
104	  ) THEN
105	    ALTER TABLE public.notifications
106	      ALTER COLUMN associated_user_ids TYPE text[]
107	        USING (
108	          SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT btrim(x.value #>> '{}'))
109	                            FILTER (WHERE btrim(x.value #>> '{}') <> ''),
110	                         ARRAY[]::text[])
111	            FROM jsonb_array_elements(
112	                   CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(associated_user_ids) = 'array'
113	                        THEN associated_user_ids ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
114	                 ) AS x(value)
115	        );
116	  END IF;
117	END
118	$$;

120	-- تعبئة الجدول العلائقي من text[] (أو من الحمولة القديمة إن بقيت) — populate the child table once.
121	DO $$
122	BEGIN

125	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'notifications'
126	       AND column_name = 'associated_user_ids' AND data_type = 'ARRAY'
127	  ) THEN
128	    INSERT INTO public.notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id)
129	         SELECT n.notification_id, btrim(r.user_id)
130	           FROM public.notifications n
131	           CROSS JOIN unnest(n.associated_user_ids) AS r(user_id)
132	          WHERE btrim(r.user_id) <> ''
133	         ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
134	  END IF;
135	END
136	$$;

143	 WHERE n.notification_id = r.notification_id
144	   AND n.is_read IS NOT NULL;

4	function timestamp(value: unknown): number {
5	  const parsed = value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : Date.parse(String(value ?? ''));
6	  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
7	}
8	function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
9	  if (typeof value === 'string') {
10	    try { return record(JSON.parse(value)); } catch { return {}; }
11	  }
12	  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
13	    ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
14	}
15	function text(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value ?? ''); }
16	function role(value: unknown): PortalAdminUserDto['role'] {
17	  return value === 'courier' || value === 'supplier' ? value : 'customer';
18	}

20	  return value === 'pending_approval' || value === 'rejected' ? value : 'approved';

22	function mapRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalAdminUserDto {
23	  const userData = record(row.userData);
24	  const details = record(row.detailsData);
25	  return {
26	    id: text(row.id),
27	    username: text(row.username || userData.username),

29	    fullName: text(row.fullName || userData.fullName),
30	    phone: text(row.phone || userData.phone),
31	    role: role(row.portalRole || userData.portalRole || row.type),
32	    approvalStatus: approval(row.approvalStatus || userData.approvalStatus),
33	    disabled: Boolean(row.disabled || row.isDisabled || userData.disabled),

35	    customerDetails: { id: text(row.detailId), customer_id: text(row.detailCustomerId), ...details },
36	    createdAt: timestamp(row.createdAt),
37	  };
38	}

43	         p.approval_status AS "approvalStatus", p.disabled, p.is_disabled AS "isDisabled",
44	         p.linked_customer_id AS "linkedCustomerId", p.created_at AS "createdAt", p.data AS "userData",
45	         d.cust_detail_id AS "detailId", d.customer_id AS "detailCustomerId", d.data AS "detailsData"

51	       ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
52	       LIMIT 1

59	  };

73	      if (input.email !== undefined) add('email = ?', input.email);
74	      if (input.fullName !== undefined) add('full_name = ?', input.fullName);

4	const client = new ApiClient({
5	  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
6	  accessTokenFactory: () => typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token'),
7	  maxReadRetries: 0,
8	});
9	const normalize = (row: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
10	  ...row,
11	  id: String(row.id ?? ''),
12	  portal_role: row.role === 'customer' ? 'client' : row.role,
13	  approval_status: row.approvalStatus,
14	  linkedCustomerId: row.linkedCustomerId,
15	  customerDetails: row.customerDetails ?? {},
16	});
17	export const portalAdminApiDataGateway = {
18	  // قائمة البوابة محدّدة بـ 200 صف لكل صفحة — the portal list endpoint caps pages at 200 rows,
19	  // so the admin table collects every page instead of silently truncating.
20	  async listUsers(): Promise<any[]> {
21	    const rows: any[] = [];
22	    for (let offset = 0; ; offset += 200) {
23	      const response = await client.get<Envelope<any[]>>('/api/v1/portal/admin/users', { limit: 200, offset });
24	      const pageRows = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [];
25	      rows.push(...pageRows.map(normalize));
26	      if (pageRows.length < 200) break;
27	    }
28	    return rows;
29	  },
30	  async createUser(input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
31	    const response = await client.post<Envelope<any>>('/api/v1/portal/admin/users', {
32	      ...input,
33	      role: input.role === 'client' ? 'customer' : input.role,
34	      approvalStatus: input.approvalStatus ?? input.approval_status,
35	    });
36	    return normalize(response.data);
37	  },
38	  async updateUser(id: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
39	    const response = await client.patch<Envelope<any>>(`/api/v1/portal/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, input);
40	    return normalize(response.data);
41	  },
42	  async setApproval(id: string, approvalStatus: string): Promise<any> {
43	    const response = await client.post<Envelope<any>>(`/api/v1/portal/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/approval`, { approvalStatus });
44	    return normalize(response.data);
45	  },
46	  async setDisabled(id: string, disabled: boolean): Promise<any> {
47	    const response = await client.post<Envelope<any>>(`/api/v1/portal/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/disabled`, { disabled });
48	    return normalize(response.data);
49	  },
50	  async deleteUser(id: string): Promise<void> {
51	    await client.delete<Envelope<{ deleted: boolean }>>(`/api/v1/portal/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
52	  },
53	  async saveCustomerDetails(customerId: string, details: Record<string, unknown>, userUid = ''): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
54	    const response = await client.requestWithBodyForGateway<Envelope<Record<string, unknown>>>('PUT', `/api/v1/portal/admin/customers/${encodeURIComponent(customerId)}/details`, { ...details, userUid });
55	    return response.data;
56	  },

213	  const readTicket = async (ticketId: string): Promise<SupportTicketDto | null> => {
214	    const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
215	      `SELECT ${ticketColumns} ${ticketFrom} WHERE pt.portal_ticket_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
216	      [ticketId],

218	    return result.rows[0] ? mapTicket(result.rows[0]) : null;
219	  };
220	
221	  return {
222	    async listTickets(input) {
223	      const filter = createFilter();
224	      if (input.status) filter.add(`COALESCE(NULLIF(pt.status, ''), NULLIF(pt.data->>'status', ''), 'open') = @`, input.status);
225	      if (input.search) filter.add(`(pt.subject ILIKE @ OR pt.message ILIKE @ OR pt.data->>'subject' ILIKE @)`, input.search);
226	      return page(
227	        pool,
228	        {
229	          columns: ticketColumns,
230	          from: ticketFrom,
231	          where: filter.where,
232	          params: filter.params,
233	          orderBy: 'pt.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, pt.portal_ticket_id DESC',
234	          limit: input.limit,
235	          offset: input.offset,
236	        },
237	        mapTicket,
238	      );
239	    },
240	
241	    async addTicketReply({ ticketId, sender, message, repliedAt }) {
242	      const existing = await readTicket(ticketId);
243	      if (!existing) return null;
244	      const next = [...existing.replies, buildReply(sender, message, repliedAt)];
245	      // دمج واحد في jsonb يبقي `data` (مصدر قراءة الواجهة) و`replies` المسطّح متطابقين بلا خطوة قراءة-ثم-كتابة ثانية.
246	      // One jsonb merge keeps the page's `data` source and the flat replies column aligned without a second read-modify-write.
247	      await pool.query(
248	        `UPDATE public.portal_tickets
249	            SET replies = $2::jsonb,
250	                data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
251	                         'replies', $2::jsonb,
252	                         'status', $3,
253	                         'updatedAt', $4::double precision,
254	                         'adminResponse', $5
255	                       ),
256	                updated_at = to_timestamp($4::double precision / 1000)
257	          WHERE portal_ticket_id = $1`,
258	        [ticketId, JSON.stringify(next), TICKET_REPLY_STATUS, repliedAt, message],
259	      );
260	      return readTicket(ticketId);
261	    },
262	
263	    async listAnnouncements(input) {
264	      const filter = createFilter();
265	      if (input.search) filter.add(`a.data->>'title' ILIKE @`, input.search);
266	      return page(
267	        pool,
268	        {
269	          columns: announcementColumns,
270	          from: 'FROM public.announcements a',
271	          where: filter.where,
272	          params: filter.params,
273	          orderBy: 'a.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.announcement_id DESC',
274	          limit: input.limit,
275	          offset: input.offset,
276	        },
277	        mapAnnouncement,

286	        content: input.content,

67	
68	-- ردود الدعم صفوف حقيقية بدل مصفوفة jsonb — replies become relational rows, not a jsonb array.
69	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.portal_ticket_reply (
70	  portal_ticket_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.portal_tickets (portal_ticket_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
71	  seq integer NOT NULL,
72	  sender text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
73	  message text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
74	  replied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
75	  PRIMARY KEY (portal_ticket_id, seq)
76	);
77	
78	DO $$
79	BEGIN
80	  -- المصدر الأول: مصفوفة replies داخل الحمولة القديمة — payload array.
81	  IF EXISTS (
82	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
83	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'portal_tickets' AND column_name = 'data'
84	  ) THEN
85	    INSERT INTO public.portal_ticket_reply (portal_ticket_id, seq, sender, message, replied_at)
86	         SELECT t.portal_ticket_id,
87	                (x.ordinality - 1)::integer,
88	                COALESCE(x.value->>'sender', ''),
89	                COALESCE(x.value->>'message', ''),
90	                COALESCE(alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(x.value->>'repliedAt'), t.created_at)
91	           FROM public.portal_tickets t,
92	                jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(t.data->'replies', '[]'::jsonb))
93	                  WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, ordinality)
94	          WHERE jsonb_typeof(t.data->'replies') = 'array'
95	            AND t.data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(t.data) = 'object'
96	         ON CONFLICT (portal_ticket_id, seq) DO NOTHING;
97	  END IF;
98	
99	  -- المصدر الثاني: عمود replies jsonb (إن وُجد) قبل إسقاطه في 0034 — the jsonb column itself.
100	  IF EXISTS (
101	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
102	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'portal_tickets'
103	       AND column_name = 'replies' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
104	  ) THEN
105	    INSERT INTO public.portal_ticket_reply (portal_ticket_id, seq, sender, message, replied_at)
106	         SELECT t.portal_ticket_id,
107	                (x.ordinality - 1)::integer,
108	                COALESCE(x.value->>'sender', ''),
109	                COALESCE(x.value->>'message', ''),
110	                COALESCE(alx_api_private.cast_timestamp(x.value->>'repliedAt'), t.created_at)
111	           FROM public.portal_tickets t,
112	                jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(t.replies, '[]'::jsonb))
113	                  WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, ordinality)
114	          WHERE jsonb_typeof(t.replies) = 'array'
115	         ON CONFLICT (portal_ticket_id, seq) DO NOTHING;
116	  END IF;
117	
118	  -- آخر رد يصبح العمود المسطّح — the newest reply is the flat admin response.
119	  UPDATE public.portal_tickets t
120	     SET admin_response = COALESCE(
121	           NULLIF(btrim(t.admin_response), ''),
122	           (SELECT r.message FROM public.portal_ticket_reply r
123	             WHERE r.portal_ticket_id = t.portal_ticket_id ORDER BY r.seq DESC LIMIT 1));
124	END
125	$$;
126	
127	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
128	-- 4. طلبات التوظيف / job applications — الأعمدة موجودة؛ نعبّئ الفارغ منها فقط.
129	--    Columns already exist; only the empty ones are backfilled, then jsonb is never read.
130	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
131	DO $$
132	BEGIN
133	  IF EXISTS (
134	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
135	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'jobs_req' AND column_name = 'data'
136	  ) THEN
137	    UPDATE public.jobs_req
138	       SET full_name        = COALESCE(NULLIF(full_name, ''), data->>'fullName'),
139	           job_position     = COALESCE(NULLIF(job_position, ''), data->>'jobPosition'),
140	           category         = COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''), data->>'jobPosition'),
141	           ref_code         = COALESCE(NULLIF(ref_code, ''), data->>'refCode'),
142	           phone            = COALESCE(NULLIF(phone, ''), data->>'phone'),
143	           email            = COALESCE(NULLIF(email, ''), data->>'email'),
144	           city             = COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), data->>'city'),
145	           address          = COALESCE(NULLIF(address, ''), data->>'address'),
146	           qualification    = COALESCE(NULLIF(qualification, ''), data->>'qualification'),
147	           id_number        = COALESCE(NULLIF(id_number, ''), data->>'idNumber'),
148	           notes            = COALESCE(NULLIF(notes, ''), data->>'notes'),
149	           experience_years = COALESCE(experience_years, alx_api_private.cast_integer(data->>'experienceYears')),
150	           status           = COALESCE(NULLIF(status, ''), data->>'status', 'pending_review'),
151	           created_at       = COALESCE(created_at, alx_api_private.payload_timestamp(data, 'createdAt')),
152	           updated_at       = COALESCE(updated_at, alx_api_private.payload_timestamp(data, 'updatedAt'))
153	     WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
154	  END IF;
155	END
156	$$;
157	
158	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
159	-- 5. الفهارس والصلاحيات — indexes and grants (alx_api_runtime بلا DDL).
160	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
161	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS portal_ticket_reply_ticket_idx ON public.portal_ticket_reply (portal_ticket_id);
162	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS announcements_created_at_idx ON public.announcements (created_at DESC NULLS LAST);
163	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS portal_tickets_status_created_idx ON public.portal_tickets (status, created_at DESC NULLS LAST);
164	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_req_status_created_idx ON public.jobs_req (status, created_at DESC NULLS LAST);
165	
166	ALTER TABLE public.portal_ticket_reply DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
167	
168	GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE
169	  public.announcements, public.portal_tickets, public.portal_ticket_reply, public.jobs_req
170	  TO alx_api_runtime;
171	
172	COMMENT ON TABLE public.portal_ticket_reply IS
173	  'ردود تذاكر الدعم: سطر لكل رد بدل مصفوفة jsonb — one row per ticket reply, no jsonb array.';

-- تسطير الطلبات: كل حقل كان داخل data يصبح عمودًا حقيقيًا في جدول orders.
-- Flattens orders: every field that lived inside the jsonb payload becomes a first-class column.
-- هذا هو سبب عدم ظهور حقول الطلب كاملة في الواجهة قبل التسطير.
-- This is why the order fields were missing from the UI before the flattening.

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  -- التكاليف والأرباح / costs and profits
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_cost_yer numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_cost_sar numeric,
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.order_fired_trigger (
  order_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  seq integer NOT NULL,
  trigger_name text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, seq)
);

-- 1) التعبئة من data — backfill every new column from the legacy payload.
-- الحراسة مطلوبة: بعد 0034 لا يوجد عمود data، وإعادة التنفيذ يجب أن تنجح.
-- Guarded so a re-run after 0034 (payload dropped) still succeeds.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' AND column_name = 'data'
  ) THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

UPDATE public.orders
   SET total_cost_yer                    = COALESCE(total_cost_yer, alx_api_private.payload_number(data, 'totalCostYER')),

173	         FROM public.orders o,
174	              jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(o.data->'firedTriggers', '[]'::jsonb))
175	                WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, ordinality)

179	       ON CONFLICT (order_id, seq) DO NOTHING;

    async createCustomerOrder(input) {
      return withTransaction(pool, async (client) => {
        await client.query('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1, 0))', [input.idempotencyKey]);
        const previous = await client.query<{ operation: string; responseData: Record<string, unknown> }>(
          `SELECT operation, response_data AS "responseData"
            FROM alx_api_private.operation_idempotency
            WHERE idempotency_key = $1
            LIMIT 1`,
          [input.idempotencyKey],
        );
        if (previous.rows[0]) {
          if (previous.rows[0].operation !== 'portal.order.create') throw new Error('IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT');
          return previous.rows[0].responseData as unknown as PortalOrderDto;
        }

        if (input.sourceId) {
          const source = await client.query(
            'SELECT source_id FROM public.sources WHERE source_id = $1 AND is_active = true LIMIT 1',
            [input.sourceId],
          );
          if (!source.rows[0]) throw new Error('PORTAL_ORDER_SOURCE_NOT_ACTIVE');
        }

        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO public.orders
             (order_id, order_number, customer_id, tracking_number, order_status1,
              order_source_id, order_source_type, order_party_id, order_party_type,
              is_staff_order, order_party_account_id, data, created_by, created_by_name,
              updated_by, created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'معلق', $5, $6, $3, 'customer', false, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10, $9, $11, $11)`,

            input.orderId, input.orderNumber, input.customerId, input.trackingNumber,
            input.sourceId ?? null, input.sourceType, input.financialAccountId,
            JSON.stringify(input.orderData), input.portalUserId, input.customerName,
            input.createdAt,
          ],
        );

        for (const item of input.items) {
          await client.query(
            `INSERT INTO public.order_items
               (order_item_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, product_price, product_url,
                nota, quantity, total_price, total__weight, total_cbm, items_status,
                created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, NULL, $3, $4, $5, NULL, $6, $7, $8, $9,
                     'قيد الطلب', $10, $10, $11, $11)`,
            [
              item.id, input.orderId, item.productName, item.productPrice, item.productUrl ?? null,
              item.quantity, item.quantity * item.productPrice, item.quantity * item.weight,
              item.quantity * item.cbm, input.portalUserId, input.createdAt,
            ],
          );
        }

        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO public.orders_history
             (orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, event_type, event_category, operation,
              entity_type, actor_id, source, summary, before_data, after_data, metadata,
              occurred_at, created_by, updated_by)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'order.created', 'api', 'create', 'order', $4, 'alx_api',
                   'Portal customer submitted an order for review.', NULL, $5::jsonb,
                   '{}'::jsonb, $6, $4, $4)`,
          [
            `hist_${randomUUID()}`,
            input.orderId,
            input.orderNumber,
            input.portalUserId,
            JSON.stringify({ status: 'pending', itemCount: input.items.length, portalUserId: input.portalUserId }),
            input.createdAt,
          ],
        );

        const created = toOrder({
          orderId: input.orderId,
          orderNumber: input.orderNumber,
          trackingNumber: input.trackingNumber,
          orderStatus: 'معلق',
          createdAt: input.createdAt,
          data: input.orderData,

        await client.query(

           VALUES ($1, 'portal.order.create', $2::jsonb)`,
          [input.idempotencyKey, JSON.stringify(created)],
        );
        return created;
