function toOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalOrderDto {
  const data = asRecord(row.data);
  const createdAt = timestamp(row.createdAt);
  const safeData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of customerVisibleOrderFields) {
    if (key in data) safeData[key] = data[key];
  }
  const items = Array.isArray(safeData.items)
    ? safeData.items.filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))
      .map((item) => ({
        id: typeof item.id === 'string' ? item.id : '',
        productName: typeof item.productName === 'string' ? item.productName : '',
        productUrl: typeof item.productUrl === 'string' ? item.productUrl : '',
        quantity: typeof item.quantity === 'number' ? item.quantity : 0,
        productPrice: typeof item.productPrice === 'number' ? item.productPrice : 0,
        weight: typeof item.weight === 'number' ? item.weight : 0,
        cbm: typeof item.cbm === 'number' ? item.cbm : 0,
        length: typeof item.length === 'number' ? item.length : 0,
        width: typeof item.width === 'number' ? item.width : 0,
        height: typeof item.height === 'number' ? item.height : 0,
        trackingNumber: typeof item.trackingNumber === 'string' ? item.trackingNumber : '',
      }))
    : [];

  return {
    ...safeData,
    id: String(row.orderId),
    orderNumber: String(row.orderNumber),
    trackingNumber: String(row.trackingNumber ?? row.orderNumber),
    status: String(data.status ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    orderStatus: String(data.orderStatus ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    createdAt: typeof data.createdAt === 'number' ? data.createdAt : createdAt,
    updatedAt: typeof data.updatedAt === 'number' ? data.updatedAt : createdAt,
    items,

/**
 * site-content.schemas.ts
 * مخططات التحقق لوحدة محتوى الموقع — قراءات إدارية ومخرجات كتابة صارمة.
 * Validation schemas for the site content module: admin list queries and strict write payloads.
 */
import { z } from 'zod';

/** قائمة إدارية مرقّمة؛ `search` و`status` اختياريان ويُهما عند الفراغ. */
export const siteContentListSchema = z.object({
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).default(50),
  offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0),
  search: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(120)
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : undefined))
    .optional(),
  status: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(40)
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : undefined))
    .optional(),
});

/** رد الدعم — النص مطلوب ومحدود؛ اسم المرسل يُفرض خادميًا لا من العميل. */
export const ticketReplySchema = z
  .object({
    message: z.string().trim().min(1).max(4000),
  })
  .strict();

export const announcementPrioritySchema = z.enum(['normal', 'high', 'urgent']);
export const announcementAudienceSchema = z.enum(['all', 'customer', 'courier', 'supplier']);

const announcementBase = {
  title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(300),
  content: z.string().trim().min(1).max(8000),
  targetAudience: announcementAudienceSchema,
  priority: announcementPrioritySchema,
  isActive: z.boolean(),
};

/** إنشاء إعلان: كل الحقول مطلوبة لأن الإعلان يُقرأ لاحقًا من نفس الشكل. */
export const createAnnouncementSchema = z.object(announcementBase).strict();

/** تعديل إعلان: تُقبل الحقول الجزئية فقط؛ `isActive` وحدها تكفي لتبديل الإظهار. */
export const updateAnnouncementSchema = z.object(announcementBase).partial().strict().refine(
  (value) => Object.keys(value).length > 0,
  { message: 'At least one announcement field must be provided.' },
);

/** حالة طلب التوظيف — نص قصير مقيد بالقيم المستعملة فعليًا في الواجهة. */
export const jobApplicationStatusSchema = z.object({ status: z.string().trim().min(2).max(40) }).strict();

function toOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalOrderDto {
  const data = asRecord(row.data);
  const createdAt = timestamp(row.createdAt);
  const safeData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of customerVisibleOrderFields) {
    if (key in data) safeData[key] = data[key];
  }
  const items = Array.isArray(safeData.items)
    ? safeData.items.filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))
      .map((item) => ({
        id: typeof item.id === 'string' ? item.id : '',
        productName: typeof item.productName === 'string' ? item.productName : '',
        productUrl: typeof item.productUrl === 'string' ? item.productUrl : '',
        quantity: typeof item.quantity === 'number' ? item.quantity : 0,
        productPrice: typeof item.productPrice === 'number' ? item.productPrice : 0,
        weight: typeof item.weight === 'number' ? item.weight : 0,
        cbm: typeof item.cbm === 'number' ? item.cbm : 0,
        length: typeof item.length === 'number' ? item.length : 0,
        width: typeof item.width === 'number' ? item.width : 0,
        height: typeof item.height === 'number' ? item.height : 0,
        trackingNumber: typeof item.trackingNumber === 'string' ? item.trackingNumber : '',
      }))
    : [];

  return {
    ...safeData,
    id: String(row.orderId),
    orderNumber: String(row.orderNumber),
    trackingNumber: String(row.trackingNumber ?? row.orderNumber),
    status: String(data.status ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    orderStatus: String(data.orderStatus ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    createdAt: typeof data.createdAt === 'number' ? data.createdAt : createdAt,
    updatedAt: typeof data.updatedAt === 'number' ? data.updatedAt : createdAt,
    items,
  };
}

BEGIN

  END IF;
END

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'activity_logs'
       AND column_name = 'details'
  ) THEN
    -- الدمج قبل التحويل: احتفظ بأي ملخص حقيقي ثم أعد تسمية العمود القديم.
    -- Merge first so no real summary is lost, then rename the legacy column once.
    UPDATE public.activity_logs
       SET summary = COALESCE(NULLIF(summary, ''), NULLIF(btrim(details), ''));
    ALTER TABLE public.activity_logs DROP COLUMN details;
  END IF;
END
$$;
